src: This greataxe was once the weapon of Gorshab, a legendary orc warchief. Gorshab disdained mere raiding and did not fear leading his warriors into pitched battles. Ultimately this practice led to his defeat, but not before he had ravaged many lands. Some have reported hearing a faint sound resembling fearsome orcish warcries when in the vicinity of this mighty blade. One imagines that this sound might seem much louder to those actually struck by the greataxe, but confirming this would require that they survive: unlikely given the exceptionally deadly blade.

src: Spells: When a thrall of Graz'zt gains 1st level, and every two levels after that (plus 10th level), the character gains new spells per day as if she had also gained a level in whatever spellcasting class she belonged to before she added the prestige class. She does not, however, gain any other benefit a character of that class would have gained (improved chance of controlling or rebuking undead, metamagic or item creation feats, hit points, beyond those received from the prestige class, and so on), except for an increased effective level of spellcasting. This essentially means that she adds the new level of thrall of Graz'zt to the level of whatever other spellcasting class the character has, then determines spells per day, spells known, and caster level accordingly.

浏览的顾客

在我先前于卡林沙漠的冒险中，我发现了关于一个名叫拉贾尔的人的一些信息，他是卡林港这里一些强盗劫掠者维持的一个联系人。这个拉贾尔究竟是谁并不完全清楚，但显然他能为任何参与犯罪活动的人提供许多有用的服务。我找到了一张纸，上面写着他藏身下水道的路线，并注意到我应该使用口令“Jaraj”来进入那里。只要我随身保留这张纸以供参考，我就应该能够通过下水道系统找到去那里的路。然而，我必须决定，是应该独自去寻找这个拉贾尔，还是把我发现的关于他的信息交给城市守卫，希望他们能利用这些信息来终结他的犯罪活动。

我已经把我发现的信息交给了守卫，由达沙尔·扎伊内姆中尉代表。原来拉贾尔是卡林港某个盗贼公会的首领。扎伊内姆中尉请求我协助将拉贾尔绳之以法，因为他担心让太多可能腐败的守卫卷入此事，并且他需要一个有些偷窃技能的人。他的计划要求我去拉贾尔公会的区域，但避开入口。相反，我应该向左转，寻找一扇密门，它提供了一条通往迷宫的另一条路线，公会用这个迷宫来测试潜在成员。如果我能闯过迷宫里的锁、陷阱和其他挑战，我就能从一个出人意料的方向进入公会。我还得到了一根法杖，一旦我进入公会，它就会召唤一个魔像来协助我对抗盗贼。扎伊内姆中尉还建议我去和卡姆·赛特夫谈谈，他是城市守卫地牢里的一名囚犯，也是提供这个迷宫信息的线人。他也许能给我一些提示，帮助我通过迷宫。我应该把拉贾尔的头带回去给扎伊内姆中尉以领取奖赏。

我已经成功通过了迷宫。现在我应该能够进入盗贼公会，在那里我很可能会有一场恶战。
src:
During my previous adventures in the Calim Desert, I discovered some information about one Rajar, a contact maintained by some bandit raiders here in Calimport. It was not entirely clear just who this Rajar is, but apparently he can provide many useful services to anyone involved in criminal activities. I found a paper containing directions to his hideout in the sewers, and notice that I should use the password "Jaraj" to gain access to it. So long as I keep this paper in my possession for reference, I should be able to find my way there by traveling through the sewer system. I must decide, however, whether I should seek out this Rajar on my own, or instead give what information I have found about him to the City Watch, in the hope that they can use it to put an end to his criminal activities.

I have turned over the information I found to the Watch, represented by Lieutenant Dashar Zaynem. It turns out Rajar is the head of one of Calimport's Thieves' Guilds. Lt. Zaynem has asked for my assistance in bringing Rajar to justice, as he fears involving too many of the possibly corrupt Watchmen in this matter, and could use someone with a few thieving skills. His plan calls for me to go to the area of Rajar's guild, but avoid the entrance. Instead, I should turn to the left and search for a secret door that provides an alternative route into a maze the guild uses as a test for prospective members. If I can work my way through the locks, traps and other challenges of the maze, I will gain entrance to the guild from a surprsing direction. I have also been given a rod that, once I gain access to the guild, will summon a golem to assist me in fighting the thieves. Lt. Zaynem has also suggested that I talk to Kam Saitef, a prisoner in the City Guard's dungeon, an informant who is the source of this information about the maze. He may be able to give me a few tips to help me get through it. I should bring Rajar's head back to Lt. Zaynem to be rewarded.

I have successfully run the maze. Now I should be able to enter the Thieves' Guild, where I will most likely have quite a fight on my hands.

Buer, Grandmother Huntress
  
Buer grants binders superior healing as well as powers against poisons and diseases.

Vestige Level: 4th
Binding DC: 20
Special Requirement: Buer requires that her seal be drawn outdoors.

Influence: Under Buer's influence, you are plagued by momentary memory lapses. For an instant, you might forget even a piece of information as familiar as the name of a friend or family member. Furthermore, since Buer abhors the needless death of living creatures other than animals and vermin, the first melee attack you make against such a foe must be for nonlethal damage. In addition, Buer requires that you not make any coup de grace attacks.

Granted Abilities: 
Buer grants you healing powers, the ability to ignore toxins and ailments, and skills that help you navigate the natural world.

Buer's Knowledge: You gain a +4 bonus on Heal, Lore, and Animal Empathy checks.

Buer's Purity: You have immunity to disease and poison.

Delay Diseases and Poisons: Each ally within 30 feet of you gains immunity to poison and disease. 

Fast Healing: You gain the fast healing 1, and the rate of healing increases with your effective binder level. You gain fast healing 2 at 10th level, fast healing 3 at 13th level, fast healing 4 at 16th level, and fast healing 5 at 19th level.

Healing Gift: As a standard action, you can cure 1d8 points of damage +1 point per effective binder level (maximum 1d8+10 points). You cannot use your healing gift again for 5 rounds. Both uses of the ability channel positive energy and deal a corresponding amount of damage to undead.

Track: You gain the Track feat.

dst: 黑暗卫士 治疗轻伤

扎拉拉给了我一封信，让我交给伊纳斯·森卡尔，一位住在“学者角”的历史学家。扎拉拉希望他协助研究古代巨灵魔法，尤其是关于卡洛玛斯·泽卡尔所拥有的那把古老魔法剑，她小时候曾激活过它的力量。森卡尔要求我找到一些对历史研究有价值的东西作为他完成这项工作的报酬，我果然在黑暗卡林港找到了一块刻有文字的古老石板，他认为可以接受。

森卡尔花了几天时间研究此事，然后交给我一个据称包含研究结果的包裹。然而，当我把它交给扎拉拉时，却发现我拿到的东西是给别人的，并不是她想要的研究。森卡尔一定是把我的包裹和别的东西弄混了。我得回去找他换成正确的那个。

我回到森卡尔的住处，发现那里正遭到恶魔袭击。处理完此事后，我终于拿到了正确的包裹，并带着它回到了扎拉拉那里。
src:
Zarala has given me a letter to take to Inas Senkhar, a historian living in the "Scholar's Corner." Zarala wants his assistance in researching ancient djinni magic, particularly regarding the ancient magical sword owned by Kalomas Zekar whose powers she was able to activate as a child. Senkhar demanded that I find something of value to historical research as his price to carry out this job, and I duly found an ancient tablet with some writing on it in Dark Calimport, which he accepted as satisfactory.

Senkhar took a couple of days to research the matter and presented me with a packet allegedly containing the results. When I delivered it to Zarala, however, it turned out what I was given was intended for someone else and was not the research she wanted. Senkhar must have gotten my packet mixed up with something else. I will have to return to him to exchange it for the correct one.

I returned to Senkhar's residence to find the place being assailed by demons. That being dealt with, I was finally able to get the correct packet, and  return with it to Zarala.

src:
Lizardfolk are reptilian humanoids, primitive by modern standards but rumored to be relatives of the creator races. Lizardfolk are tall and muscular, and prefer frontal assaults in combat. Organized tribes, however, are able to use traps and ambushes to compensate for a lack of numbers. Survival is the primary concern in lizardfolk society and will engage in a number of activities, such as allying with other races of pledging servitude to dragons, to ensure this. Lizardfolk can speak draconian and can become competent druids, although their size makes them ideal fighters.

Lizardfolk Ability Adjustments: +2 Str, +2 Con, -2 Int
Favored Class (Druid): A multiclass lizardfolk's druid class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

- Weapon Proficiency (Simple): All Lizardfolk are proficient with Simple Weapons.
- Natural Weapon: Lizardfolk can make an natural bite attack.
- Shield: All Lizardfolk are proficient with shields.
- Skill Affinity (Jump): +4 racial bonus to Jump checks.
- Natural Armor Bonus: Racial natural armor bonus of 5.
- Darkvision: Lizardfolk are able to see in the dark.
- Reptilian: Lizardfolk count as Reptilian for the purpose of spells.

The Triad is a gestalt of three forgotten gods of a lost civilization of mystics, consumed by the Plane of Shadow. They give binders access to both martial abilities and lore-seeking traits.

Vestige Level: 6th
Binding DC: 26
Special Requirement: The Triad will not bind with someone with any connection to the Plane of Shadow, whether that's by feat, class abilities, or any other association.

Influence: Your mental aspect shifts to match the face that is currently your sign. As Gorn, you are inquisitive and use many words -- some would say too many. As Rujsha, you are caring and motherly, speaking to others as if they were children. As Mintar, you are honor-bound and slightly combative in manner. When your path crosses that of one influenced by shadow, the gestalt insists that you either face that being first when in combat or avoid that being (and any effects or assistance the being may wish to provide) outside of combat.

Granted Abilities: 
While bound to the Triad, you gain a range of abilities that represents the essence of their former separate beings.

Psionic Boon: You gain 15 power points when you bind to the Triad. These are added to your pool of power if you already possess psionic power, or they create a pool and you become a psionic creature for the duration of this binding.

Gorn's Knowledge

Call to Mind: You gain access to the psionic power call to mind for the duration of the binding.

Psicraft Bonus: You gain a +5 bonus on Psicraft checks.

Bardic Knowledge: You gain a bonus to Lore equal to your binder level.

Rujsha's Justice

Empathy: You gain access to the psionic power empathy for the duration of the binding. 

Diplomacy Bonus: You gain a +5 bonus on Persuade checks.

Smite Evil: Three times per day, you can attempt to smite an evil creature with a single melee attack. You add your Charisma bonus (if any) to the attack roll and deal 1 extra point of damage per effective binder level. If you accidentally smite a creature that is not evil, the attempt has no effect. Once you have used this ability, you cannot do so again for 5 rounds.

Mintar's Honor

Detect Hostile Intent: You gain access to the psionic power mental disruption for the duration of the binding.

Sense Motive Bonus: You gain a +5 bonus on Sense Motive checks.

Weapon Proficiency: You gain proficiency in all simple, martial, and exotic weapons.

src:
Necrocarnum Vestments

Descriptors: Evil, necrocarnum
Classes: Incarnate, soulborn
Chakra: Heart, Waist
Saving Throw: See text

Necrocarnum twists and writhes into the shape of long, flowing vestments. These vestments cling tightly to your shoulders, but drape loosely over the rest of your body, obscuring other garments behind an ever-shifting screen of terror. As with all necrocarnum melds, faint forms seem to swim in the depths of this shadowy vestment. These tortured apparitions seem wracked by incomprehensible agony, their elongated faces wrenched open in eternal screams.

When you have necrocarnum vestments shaped, you gain resistance to cold 5 as the energies of necrocarnum deaden your flesh to the effects of cold.

Essentia: For every point of essentia invested in the necrocarnum vestments, you gain 3 temporary hit points.

Chakra Bind (Heart)
When you have necrocarnum vestments bound to your heart chakra, you are immune to stunning and death effects.

Chakra Bind (Waist)
When you have necrocarnum vestments bound to your waist chakra, any living creature adjacent to you at the end of your turn takes 1d6 points of cold damage (Fortitude negates).

src:
Shax, Sea Sister
  
Another giant among the vestiges, Shax gives her summoners the ability to laugh off lightning, to wriggle free of any bonds, and to strike foes like a thunderbolt.

Vestige Level: 6th
Binding DC: 26
Special Requirement: No

Influence: While under Shax's influence, you become possessive and stingy, particularly about territory-be it actual land or simply a room in an inn. In addition, her influence requires you to demand compensation for any service rendered and to tax any use of your territory. However, you can accept nearly any item of value-be it material goods or a service-as payment.

Granted Abilities: 
Shax grants you the ability to strike foes with sonic force and electricity. She also gives you immunity to electricity and allows you to move freely despite restraints.

Freedom of Movement: As a swift action, you can give yourself the ability to ignore restraints. This effect functions like the freedom of movement spell, except that it lasts only 1 round. Once you have used this ability, you cannot do so again for 5 rounds.

Immunity to Electricity: You gain immunity to electricity damage.

Storm Strike: As a swift action, you can charge a melee attack or melee touch attack with electricity and sonic power. Your next melee attack deals an extra 1d6 points of electricity damage and 1d6 points of sonic damage.

Unlike their nonpsionic cousins, psychic rogues have discovered their innate talent for psionics and how to best put it to use in their chosen way of life. Understandably they follow a slightly different path that foregoes some of the standards of typical rogue training in favor of developing their psionic prowess. 

While skilled in stealthy movement and other arts requiring subtlety, the psychic rogue also depends on his psionic abilities to deal with whatever the world brings his way. Those attracted to the ways of stealth and darkness may find the psychic rogue an attractive choice. Their use of psionic powers also attracts those who have a wish to enhance their mental abilities. The combination of his skills and psionic powers make for a dangerous foe, so those who claim any psychic rogue as an enemy had best watch out for unusual tactics.

卡林港一家魔法商店的店主布林芬·泽姆昆告诉我，他在下水道里安装了一台机器，用来处理下水道的污水，从中提取有用的材料，并将其泵送到他的商店。不幸的是，这台机器最近似乎停止了工作，而且由于下水道里有鼠人的危险，布林芬不敢亲自去检查。他请我去调查这个问题。仅仅提供关于问题所在的信息，他就会付给我一些报酬，但如果我能设法修好机器并让它重新运转，他会付得更多。\n\n我向布林芬报告说，他的装置被下水道里的鼠人破坏了，并且我成功修复了它。布林芬对我所完成的事情很满意，给了我丰厚的奖励。
src: Blimfin Zemquin, proprietor of a Calimport magic shop, has told about a machine he set up in the sewers to process the sewer water, extract useful material from it, and pump it up to his shop. Unfortunately, the machine appears to have stopped working recently, and because of the danger of wererats in the sewers, Blimfin dare not check on it himself. He has asked me to investigate the problem for him. He will pay me something simply for information about what the problem is, but even more if I somehow manage to repair the machine and get it working again.\n\nI reported to Blimfin that his contraption had been sabotaged by the sewer's wererats, and my successful repair of it. Blimfin was pleased with what I had accomplished and rewarded me well.

src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
Ur-priests despise gods. However, a small number of them have learned to tap into divine power and use it for their own needs without praying to or worshiping a deity. Instead, each day they go into a trance and mentally steal the power that gods normally channel to devout clerics. Ur-priests are canny and cunning, never stealing too much power from any one deity, but instead metaphysically slip in, draw out the power they need for their spells, and slip out again. They learn to be resilient toward divine power and creative with the energies that they steal. The greatest ur-priest commands the level of power of the most powerful cleric, although she does not have the cleric's variety of spellcasting options. 

- Hit Die: d8 
- Proficiencies: An ur-priest does not gain any additional weapon or armor proficiencies. 
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS: 

Alignment: Any evil.
Base Save Bonus: Fort +3, Will +3.
Skills: Bluff 6 ranks, Intimidate 5 ranks, Concentration 5 ranks, Lore 8 ranks, Spellcraft 8 ranks.
Feats: Iron Will, Spell Focus (evil).
Special: The character must have no ability to cast divine spells. If such spellcasting ability was previously possessed (as with an ex-cleric), that ability is forever forsaken. 

CLASS FEATURES:

格玛拉克·科尔兹曾是一名用于角斗的奴隶，这段经历将他训练成一名技艺超群的战士。在多位反对奴隶制的贵族的帮助下，他成功摆脱了奴役，此后便以冒险者的身份施展自己的武艺。然而，他并未忘记自己的过去。获得自由后，他做的第一件事就是报复前主人的残暴对待，杀死了一位曾对他尤为残忍的前主人，剥下他的皮，并用其制成一条鞭子，至今仍作为武器使用（当然，他为此鞭安排了强大的附魔）。

格玛拉克的冒险常常对卡林杉的人民有所帮助。在一次著名的事件中，他摧毁了一个试图在卡林港立足的眼魔渗透组织；在另一次事件中，他保护了该国的边远地区免受兽人大举入侵。他甚至在一场沙漠中的传奇战斗中杀死了一头肆虐的蓝龙类。与此同时，他经常与该国当局发生冲突，因为（正如剥皮事件所暗示的）他很少顾及自己行为的合法性，也不介意杀死任何挡路的人。

有一次，超过一百名守卫，在法师和各种雇佣冒险者的支援下，试图逮捕格玛拉克——当时他正与一伙名声有些犯罪色彩的冒险者同行——却被他及其盟友击败，百人中大部分被杀。这一事件证明，格玛拉克已成为卡林杉地区经验最丰富、装备最精良、总体实力最强的冒险者之一。

目前，据信格玛拉克已离开卡林杉，甚至离开了整个物质位面，因为他曾宣称找不到足够强大的敌人来挑战自己，因而对该地区提供的冒险感到厌倦，于是计划设法前往所谓的“门之城”印记城，再从那里前往其他异域位面地点。有传言称他成功实现了这一计划，目前正与一群来自诸位面各种奇异种族的异常强大的冒险者一起在位面间游荡。在撰写本书时，尚不知他是否会重返卡林杉。

本书是据称关于近期卡林杉本地著名冒险者系列中的一本，不过从字里行间读来，人们不禁怀疑，用“臭名昭著”来形容这位特定的冒险者或许比“著名”更为恰当。
src:
Gemarak Korz was once a slave used for gladiatorial combats, an experience that trained him to become a fighter of exceptional skill. He managed to free himself from slavery with the aid of various nobles opposed to the institution and thereafter employed his martial talents as an adventurer. He has not forgotten his past, however. One of his first acts after securing his freedom was to avenge his former brutal treatment by killing one of his former masters, who apparently had been particularly cruel, flaying him, and fashioning from his removed skin a whip he continues to wield as a weapon (after arranging powerful enchantments for it of course).

Gemarak's adventures have often proved helpful to the people of Calimshan. In one famous incident he destroyed a Beholder infiltration trying to establish itself in Calimport, and in another he protected the outlying regions of the nation from a major onslaught of orcs. He even slew a marauding blue dragon in an epic battle in the desert. At the same time, he has often clashed with the nation's authorities, since (as the flaying incident might suggest) he has little concern for the legality of his actions, and has little compunction about killing anyone who gets in his way. 

On one occasion, more than a hundred Watchmen, supported by mages and hired adventurers of various sorts, attempted to apprehend Gemarak, at the time traveling with a party of adventurers with somewhat criminal reputations, yet was defeated by him and his allies, with most of the hundred being slain. This incident proved that Gemarak had become one of the most experienced, well-equipped and generally powerful adventurers operating in the Calimshan region.

Currently, Gemarak is believed to have left Calimshan, and indeed this entire plane of existence, as he had declared that he could not find any foes powerful enough to challenge him and was thus becoming bored with the adventures on offer in the region, and thus planned to find a way to travel to Sigil, the so-called "City of Doors," and from there to other exotic planar locations. Rumors have circulated that he was successful in this plan, and is currently wandering the planes with a party of exceptionally powerful adventurers drawn from various  strange races found in the planes. It is unknown at the time of this writing whether he will ever return to Calimshan.

This book is one in what is claimed to be a series on famous adventurers of recent times native to Calimshan, though reading between the lines of this book one wonders whether "notorious" might not be better than "famous" when applied to this particular adventurer.

- 武器防具擅长：莎芮丝的庆典者不获得任何武器防具擅长
- 技能点：6+ 智力调整值。

要求：

A mortal imbued with fiendish cruelty, the drow judicator is a knight most foul. This unholy warrior is steeped in the divine energy of Selvetarm, the Spider That Waits, self-appointed Champion of Lolth. Consort of demons and demonic arachnids, the drow judicator is hated and feared by all, especially other male drow who are jealous of the heights of power to which he has risen. src: The halfling warrior Dabo Burrows was a firm believer in the value of missle weapons. His preferred tactic was to pelt foes with slingstones while using his speed and agility to always stay far enough away from them that melee combat, in which a small halfling would be at a disadvantage, was impossible. While no enemy archers could match his accuracy, Dabo recognized that the presence of enemy spellcasters could pose a serious problem for his "safe distance" strategy, as he could not outrun their spells. Therefore, he arranged to have his sling imbued with protection against magical attack.

src:
This small, rune-carved stone was fashioned by the dwarf Karadin Brightblade, a Paladin of Moradin who was also a master weaponsmith and runecaster. Karadin often worried that the weapons he forged might be turned against the innocent, and as a result he tended to fashion enchantments for his weapons that would make them more easily used by good wielders, and more effective against evil foes than others.

This particular rune is supposed to be able to permanently confer the Holy Avenger property on a melee weapon, but it is not clear how to actually make use of it. You hope that you will find a way to do so in the future, and resolve to hold on to it until this happens.

src:
Morality Undone
Enchantment [Evil, Mind-Affecting]
Level: Brd 5, Clr 5, Corruption 4, Mortal Hunter 4
Components: V, S, M/DF
Casting Time: 1 action
Range: Close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target: One non-evil creature
Duration: 10 minutes/level
Saving Throw: Will negates
Spell Resistance: Yes

The caster turns one creature evil. The chaotic/neutral/lawful component of the subject's alignment is unchanged. The subject retains whatever outlook, allegiances, and outlooks it had before, so long as they do not conflict with the new alignment. Otherwise, it acts with its new selfish, bloodthirsty, cruel outlook on all things. For example, a wizard might not immediately turn on her fighter companion for no apparent reason, particularly in the middle of a combat when they're fighting on the same side. But she might try to steal the fighter's bag of gems, even using applicable spells (charm person, suggestion, and invisibility,
for instance) against her friend. She might even eventually decide to betray or attack her friend if there is some potential gain involved.

Using this spell in conjunction with a spell such as dominate person or suggestion is particularly useful, because it changes what acts are against a subject's nature.

Arcane Material Component: A powdered holy symbol.

Githzerai are tall, thin humanoids with sharp features and somber, yellow eyes. The are typically hard-hearted creatures, making their homes in hidden monasteries on the plane of Limbo. The gith empire arose from slave rebellion against their master mind flayers. Once free, the gith split into two distinct races - the githyanki and githzerai. The githzerai's imprisonment at the hands of the illithids formed the foundation or their monastic lifestyle. Their fortress of perfect order provides a sharp contrast to the perpetual chaos that exists on their native plane.

Favored Class (Monk): A multiclass githzerai's monk class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

src:
Type of Feat: General
Prerequisite: Perform 6 ranks, Bardic music
Benefit: By expending one of your daily uses of bardic music, you may perform a deadly style of combat known as the snowflake wardance. Activating a snowflake wardance is a free action, and once activated, you add your Charisma modifier to your attack rolls with any slashing melee weapon you wield in one hand. This bonus to hit stacks with any bonuses you get from a high Strength score (or Dexterity score, if you are using Weapon Finesse). You cannot use this feat if you are carrying a shield, wearing medium or heavy armor, or carrying a medium or heavy load. A snowflake wardance lasts for a number of rounds equal to your ranks in Perform. Performing a snowflake wardance is physically tiresome - when the snowflake wardance ends, you become fatigued for the next 10 minutes.
Use: Selected.

src: Written by the famous Calishite swordmaster Khaladar Korad, this book provides much instruction in melee combat techniques, as well as the proper care and maintenance of one's weapons. For Korad, perfecting one's skill with weapons is an art, and indeed a way of life, not simply a practical talent that might help one survive. His book will be most useful to those who approach the arts of combat with intense discipline and dedication, but will be somewhat useful to any warrior.\n\nNote: Using this book will provide some experience to the player, the amount being inversely proportional to his level and dependent on his class. This particular book will primarily benefit fighters and weapon masters, though any warrior class can expect to receive more than the minimum XP gain.

Khaasta are a race of reptilian humanoids that roam the Outlands and the chaotic planes.  Outwardly they resemble lizardfolk, but they are stronger, tougher, and more aggressive.  They have tough, small scales and crests in wild color patterns, and long tails used for balance rather than combat.  They are infamous for being raiders, plunderers, raiders, and slavers. dst:
哈马德一直在筹备对阿然那总部的进攻，既然我们已经掌握了其位置的情报，这场进攻几乎就要发动了，军队正集结于蜘蛛沼泽的一处集结点。哈马德命令我前往这处集结点，为进攻贡献我的能力。到达之后，我要向那里的指挥官卡拉德·杰拉因将军报到，并以他认为合适的任何方式提供协助。是时候前往城门，在那里带上我想要的任何随从，然后动身前往沼泽了。

我已抵达沼泽中的集结点，并向杰拉因将军报到。他的部队已经在与那些侍奉我们阿然那敌人的类人生物（在这里，大多是蜥蜴人）交战。他预计最终会取得胜利，但担心等到胜利之时，我们敌人的首领早已逃离他们的总部，以便从其他地点继续他们的战争。为了防止这种情况，他打算派我沿一条他的斥候发现的北面小路前进，这条路能让我绕过敌军主力，抵达基地。我要沿着这条路走，并与驻扎在小路再次转向南面之前的一支军队斥候会合。然后，我和斥候们要一路杀穿敌军后方——希望那里抵抗薄弱——抵达基地。一到那里，我就要在阿然那首领策划逃跑之前杀死他们。

虽然与军队斥候的会合并未按计划进行，但我还是抵达了基地并潜入其中。现在是时候执行将军的计划了，在阿然那及其可能在场的任何盟友设法逃跑之前，将他们杀死。

抵达基地下层后不久，我前来时经过的通道就在我身后坍塌了。看来此时我只能继续前进。这次坍塌很可能是阿然那为了在他们逃跑时阻止追击而制造的，所以赶在它前面很可能对完成这项任务至关重要。

原来阿然那正逃往卡林港下水道中鼠人的一处基地，这些鼠人显然是他们的盟友。我追到了那里，并已杀死了阿然那的首领泽克苏娅。随着他们的基地失守、领导层被摧毁，阿然那组建怪物大军蹂躏卡林杉的计划现在应该会土崩瓦解。等我有机会时，应当向哈马德报告我成功完成了这项任务。
src:
The assault Hamad has been preparing upon the headquarters of the aranea, now that we have information on its location, is nearly ready to be launched, with military forces converging upon a staging area in the Spider Swamp. Hamad has instructed me to travel to this staging area to add my abilities to the attack. Once there, I am to report to the commander there, a General Kalad Jra'ein, and assist in whatever way he deems appropriate. Time to head to the city gates, pick up any henchmen I want with me there, and then head off to the swamp.

I have reached the staging area in the swamp, and reported to General Jra'ein. His forces are already in battle against the humanoids (here, mostly lizardmen) in service to our aranea enemies. He expects eventual victory but fears that by the time it is achieved the leaders of our foes will have fled their headquarters in order to carry on their war from some other location. To prevent this, he plans to send me along a path to the north his scouts have discovered that will allow me to bypass their main force and reach the base. I am to follow this path and link up with a body of the army's scouts stationed just before the point where it starts heading south again. The scouts and I are then to fight our way through the hopefully light opposition we will find in the enemy's rear areas to reach the base. Once there I am to slay the aranea leaders before they can engineer an escape.

While the rendezvous with the army's scouts did not go as planned, I have nevertheless reached the base and penetrated within. It is time to proceed with the general's plan by killing the aranea here, along with any of their allies who may be present, before they can effect some sort of escape.

Soon after reaching the lower level of the base, the passage I took to reach it collapsed behind me. It would appear I can only go forward at this point. Likely this collapse was engineered by the aranea to block pursuit while they escape, so getting ahead of it may well have been crucial to the accomplishment of this quest.

It turns out that the aranea were escaping to a base of the wererats of Calimport's sewers, who were apparently their allies. I pursued them there and have now slain the leader of the aranea, Zeaxua. With their base lost and their leadership destroyed, the aranea's plans to raise an army of monsters to overrun Calimshan should now fall apart. My successful accomplishmet of this quest should be reported to Hamad when I have an opportunity.

dst: "之后发生了什么，我还是有点不清楚。我想他们打了我的头之类的。我只知道，当我醒来时，有一种无法抗拒的冲动，要保护这个地方不受入侵者侵犯。而这正是我要做的！当然，我是个商人，不是战士，所以我会用自己的方式来保护他们：我会卖东西，直到赚到足够的利润，雇一队佣兵当守卫。"
src: "I'm still a little unclear on what happened next. I think they hit me on the head or something. All I know is that when I woke up, I had an irresistible compulsion to protect this place against intruders. And that's just what I'm going to do! Of course, I'm a merchant, not a warrior, so I will protect them in my own way: I will sell merchandise until I make enough of a profit to hire a band of mercenaries as guards."

src:
These small, rune-carved stones are said to have been fashioned by the dwarf Karadin Brightblade, a Paladin of Moradin who was also a master weaponsmith and runecaster. When used, it will cause a targeted melee weapon to be permanently blessed with holy power, as well as attuning it to those who have taken the vows of a paladin, dedicating themselves to be virtuous warriors. This attunement stems form Karadin's frequent worry that the weapons he forged might be turned against the innocent. As a result he tended to make weapons that are more easily used by good wielders, and more effective against evil foes than others.

IMPORTANT CAUTIONS: Before the new enhancements are applied, the targeted weapon will first be stripped of any pre-existing magical properties. Therefore it is best used to enhance an ordinary, non-magical weapon.

You should also be sure that you target a MELEE WEAPON when using this item. If a ranged weapon, or non-weapon, is targeted when it is used, it will be wasted.

此专长不影响你每日祈唤次数或已知祈唤。它只增加你的施法者等级，这将帮助你穿透法术抗力并增加祈唤的持续时间和其他效果。

src:
Type of Feat: General.
Prerequisite: Spellcraft 4.
Specifics: Your caster level for the chosen invoking class increases by 4. This benefit can't increase your caster level to higher than your Hit Dice. However, even if you can't benefit from the full bonus immediately, if you later gain Hit Dice in levels of noninvoking classes, you might be able to apply the rest of the bonus.

For example, a human 5th-level warlock/3rd-level fighter who selects this feat would increase his warlock caster level from 5th to 8th (since he has 8 Hit Dice). If he later gained a fighter level, he would gain the remainder of the bonus and his warlock caster level would become 9th (since he now has 9 Hit Dice). 

This feat does not affect your invocations per day or invocations known. It increases your caster level only, which would help you penetrate spell resistance and increase the duration and other effects of your invocations.
Use: Automatic.

在守卫总部，我遇到了一个叫塞卡娅·哈辛的人，她正徒劳地试图说服守卫队派人搜寻她失踪的丈夫阿拉达尔。阿拉达尔是一本关于名为扭曲符文的邪恶组织的书的作者，几天前他在研究一本后续著作时失踪了。我已同意去寻找他。塞卡娅告诉我，她最后一次见到他时，他正要去找一个叫拉玛什·卡萨特的人，此人住在贵族区西侧，所以我应该从那里开始调查。如果我发现了什么，可以去商人区东北部她的家中向她报告。

我和拉玛什·卡萨特谈过了，他转而让我去找水手科拉努·乌马尔。现在我已经和科拉努谈过了，他又告诉我阿拉达尔可能调查过的两条线索：第一，他以前的同船伙伴德拉沙姆·埃纳尔，科拉努认为此人曾是符文的特工，现在住在商人区西南部；第二，贵族区东北部一堵墙上的暗门通往一个隐秘房间，科拉努认为那是符文使用的藏身处。既然已经有人告诉我该往哪里找，这扇门应该不会太难找到。

我搜查了那个隐秘房间，它似乎已被废弃很久，我在那里找到了一块似乎蕴含某种魔法的守护石。它很可能对这次调查有价值或关联，尽管目前还不清楚具体是什么。无论如何，我在那里找不到其他东西了。
src:
At Watch Headquarters, I ran into one Sekaya Hasin, who was futilely attempting to convince the Watch to initiate a search for her missing husband, Aladar. Aladar is the author of a book on the sinister organization known as the Twisted Rune, and disappeared a few days ago when he was engaged in researching a follow-up book. I have agreed to search for him. Sekaya told me that when she last saw him, he was going to speak to one Lamash Kasat, who lives along the western side of the Noble District, so that is where I should begin the investigation. If I discover anything I can report it to Sekaya at her home in the northeast of the Merchant District.

I spoke to Lamash Kasat, who in turn sent me to seek out the sailor Kolanu Umal. Now I have spoken to Kolanu, and he in turn has told me of two paths that Aladar might have investigated: first, a former shipmate of his, Drasham Enar, who Kolanu believes was an agent of the Rune, and who now lives in the southwest part of the Merchant District, and secondly, a hidden chamber accessed through a secret door in a wall in the northeastern part of the Noble District, that Kolanu believes to be a hideout used by the Rune. This door should not be too difficult to find now that I have been directed where to look.

I have searched through the hidden chamber, which seems to be long abandoned, and found a wardstone that seems to have some sort of magic in it. lt may well turn out to have some value or relevance to this investigation, though at the moment it is not clear what that would be. At any rate, I could find nothing else there.

src:
Muls are a cross between humans and dwarves, force-bred to be slaves and gladiators.  They combine human height and adaptability with dwarven musculature and resilience.  Unlike other half-breeds, they are sterile, so the only way to make more is to breed more humans and dwarves.  Muls are stoic and dull to pain, able to easily ignore bruises and other pains of life due to their raising.  Even those that find freedom still are rarely able to escape their past, as each is marked with tattoos showing their history, owners, and so on.  Even untattooed muls are valuable to slavers, as its cheaper to "retrieve" an "escaped" mul than to try and breed a new one.  Physically they are second only to the half-giant in strength, and range in height up to 7' tall and 250 pounds in weight.  They carry almost no fat, and are often hairless, with copper-colored skin.  Common facial features include angular, almost protrusive eye ridges, and ears that point sharply backwards against the temples.

Mul Ability Adjustments: +4 Str, +2 Con, -2 Cha.
Favored Class (fighter): A multiclass mul's fighter class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

- Darkvision: Muls are able to see in the dark.
- Nonlethal Damage Resistance: Damage Resistance 1/-.
- Dwarven: Muls count as Dwarves for the purpose of spells.

dst: 抵达米尔森林附近的特布纳斯村，准备增援本应保护该村的军团时，我发现此地已陷入火海，正遭到一大群地精的袭击。我击败了附近的地精，并与村长交谈。他告诉我，我本应增援的军团已经进入森林，显然已被周围异常庞大且强悍的地精部队击败，因为不久之后村庄就遭到了攻击。然而，森林中仍能听到战斗的声音，想必是军团残部仍在进行抵抗。看来我必须深入森林，营救军团的幸存者，并希望能找到办法阻止地精对这个防御薄弱的地区采取侵略行动。\n\n我已攻入地精用作基地的旧堡垒，并杀死了他们的首领：至少看起来如此。然而，地精首领的尸体在死亡时被传送走了，这让我担心我还没有彻底解决他们。在我与他们战斗的房间里有一个界门，或许应该调查一下。
src: Upon arriving in the village of Tebnas, near the Forest of Mir, to reinforce the army regiment supposed to be protecting it, I found the place in flames and under assault by a horde of goblins. I defeated the goblins in the immediate vicinity, and spoke to the mayor of the village. He informed me that the regiment I was supposed to reinforce had already entered the forest, and apparently been defeated by the unusually large and capable goblin forces about, since shortly afterwards came the attack on the village. However, sounds of fighting can still be heard coming from the forest, presumably from remnants of the regiment still offering some resistance. It would seem I must head further into the forest to rescue any survivors of the regiment and hopefully find some way of discouraging the goblins from aggressive action against this poorly defended region.\n\nI have penetrated the old fortress the goblins were using as a base and slain their leaders: or so it seems. The bodies of the goblin leaders were teleported away on their deaths, however, making me fear I am not yet done with them. There is a portal in the chamber where I fought them that should perhaps be investigated.

src:
Maeluths are planetouched descended from dwarves and devils.

Maeluths look like sturdy dwarves with fiendish features that hint at their devil-tainted ancestry. Common maeluth features include red eyes, weirdly elongated fingers, and nearly hairless bodies. Maeluths favor dark colors and often wear spiked armor.
Although similar in many ways to their dwarf ancestors, maeluths are more adept at social interaction because of their fiendish blood. They often use their innate social skills to attain powerful positions within dwarf society.

Maeluth Ability Adjustments: -2 Dex, +4 Con

Favored Class (Fighter): A multiclass maeluth's fighter class does not count when determining whether they suffer an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Racial Traits:
- An maeluth's base land speed is 20 feet.

以太之民是源自以太位面原生种族之一的后裔，属于位面生物。他们既不完全属于以太位面，也不完全属于物质位面，拥有在两个位面之间来回移动的能力。以太之民看起来像普通，不起眼的人类。事实上，他们几乎一切都容易被遗忘，容易被忽视。他们喜欢穿深色，简单的衣服，不引起任何注意。以太之民似乎并不介意自己如此不显眼，并利用这一点为自己谋利。他们是出色的间谍，因为他们可以从以太位面的安全处偷听对话，并将听到的任何信息卖给出价最高的人。以太之民也以专精暗杀，盗窃和其他犯罪活动而闻名。

src:
Shyfts are planetouched beings descended from one of the native races of the Ethereal Plane. Belonging fully to neither the Ethereal Plane nor the Material Plane, they have the ability to move back and forth between both planes.  Shyfts appear as regular, unassuming humans. In fact, almost everything about them is forgettable and easy to overlook. They prefer to wear dark, simple clothing that does not draw any attention. Shyfts do not seem to mind that they are so inconspicuous and use it to their advantage.  They are excellent spies, since they can listen in on conversations from the safety of the Ethereal Plane and sell any information they hear to the highest bidder. Shyfts are also
known to specialize in assassination, thievery, and other criminal pursuits.

Shyft Ability Adjustments: -2 Str, +2 Dex, +2 Wis, 

Favored Class (Rogue): A multiclass shyft's rogue class does not count when determining whether they suffer an XP penalty for multiclassing.

- Darkvision:  Shyfts are able to see in the dark as well as daylight.
- Low-light Vision: Shyfts can see twice as far in dark conditions.
- Proficiencies: Shyfts are proficient with all simple and martial weapons and light armor.
- Sonic Resistance 5: The shyft's unassuming aura acts as a supressor to muffle sounds around them.
- Fire & Cold Resistance 5: Due to their connection with the Etheral, shyfts are less susceptible to extremes of heat & cold.
- Skills: Shyfts have a +4 racial bonus on Hide and Move Slently checks.
- Outsider: Shyfts are outsiders for the purposes of spells and prerequisites.

Level Adjustment: +1

dst:
（进阶职业）
霜法师通常来自寒冷，冰雪之地：苔原，冰川，甚至永远笼罩在隆冬的外层位面。其他人则痴迷于冰川寒冷的力量，并将所有精力投入到发现霜落之地的奥秘及其魔法中。然而，所有霜法师最终都会适应寒冷环境，因为他们的皮肤慢慢变成霜。他们学会利用自然或魔法增强的霜落环境，驾驭现有的寒冷来进一步增强自己的法咒。

由于这个进阶职业的成员必须能够施放奥术，霜法师来自一个狭窄的群体，通常是吟游诗人，术士和法师。一些霜法师术士相信银龙血统在他们的血管中流淌，而另一些人则觉得自己拥有寒冷和冰魔法作品的天生才能。大多数成为霜法师的法师将霜落之地视为奥术力量的神秘和未被发现的边疆，他们可以从中汲取强大的魔法为自己所用。

(PRESTIGE CLASS)
Frost mages usually hail from lands of cold, snow, and ice: tundra, glaciers, even outer planes perpetually shrouded in winter. Others become obsessed with the power of glacial cold and focus all their energy into discovering the mysteries of the frostfell and its magic. All frost mages, however, eventually become adapted to cold environments as their skin slowly turns to frost. They learn to take advantage of the natural or magically enhanced frostfell environment, harnessing the existing cold to further empower their own spells. 

As members of this prestige class must have the ability to cast arcane spells, frost mages come from a narrow group, usually bards, sorcerers, and wizards. Some frost mage sorcerers believe silver dragon blood runs in their veins, while others feel they possess an innate talent for works of cold and ice magic. Most wizards who become frost mages see the frostfell as a mysterious and undiscovered frontier of arcane power, one from which they can draw strong magic for their own purposes.

1500 gp

LEGACY RITUALS 
Least: 4000 gp.

Greater: 43,000 gp.

LEGACY ITEM PENALTIES (These do not stack. Highest takes precedence)
Save Penalty: -1 at 6th
Skill Check Penalty: -1 at 8th
Caster Level Penalty: -1 at 7th, -2 at 13th

LEGACY ITEM ABILITIES
Starbright (Su): At 5th level you gain low-light vision while outside at night, if you have low-light vision, the range triples
Fire of the Heart (Sp): At 6th level and higher, at will on command, you can evoke a burst of magical starlight, which works as a faerie fire spell. The light created is blue. Caster level 5th.
Enthralling Lights (Sp): Starting at 7th level, three times per day on command, you can create an area of dancing stars and glowing dust, duplicating the effect of a hypnotic pattern spell. The save DC is 11, or 11 + your Charisma modifier, whichever is higher. Caster level 5th.
Color Spray (Sp): At 8th level and higher, you can command Bright Evening Star to emit a fountain of multicolored light that functions as a color spray spell. The save DC is 11, or 11 + your Charisma modifier, whichever is higher. This ability is usable three times per day. Caster level 5th
Blinding Flash (Sp): Beginning at 10th level, three times per day on command, you can cause Bright Evening Star to flare with a pulse of sudden, bright light that acts as a blindness spell. The save DC is 13, or 12 + your Charisma modifier, whichever is higher. Caster level 5th.
Shooting Stars (Sp): At 11th level and higher, two times per day, you can command Bright Evening Star to fire five darts of force that look like shooting stars. They function as a magic missile spell cast by a 10th-level caster.
Glittering Motes (Sp): Starting at 13th level, once per day on command, you can use glitterdust as the spell. The save DC is 13, or 12 + your Charisma modifier, whichever is higher. Caster level 5th.
Starlight Resistance (Su): At 14th level, Bright Evening Star grants you a +3 resistance bonus on all saving throws. At your option, the effect creates a glimmer of hundreds of tiny stars, which are visible on your body and clothing
Twinkle (Sp): At 16th level and higher, three times per day on command, you can use blink as the spell. Your image seems to fl icker like a twinkling star. Caster level 11th.
Silver Starlight (Sp): Beginning at 17th level, once per day on command, you can summon forth up to four beams of painfully bright, cold light. This ability functions much like sunbeam, but the light is pure, focused starlight and moonlight. The beam deals no extra damage to undead. Instead, lycanthropes take damage from the beam as if they were undead being affected by a normal sunbeam spell. Fungi, mold, oozes, and slimes still take extra damage (as if they were lycanthropes). The save DC is 20, or 17 + your Charisma modifi er, whichever is higher. Caster level 15th.
Starlight Dispelling (Sp): At 18th level and higher, once per day on command, you can use greater dispel magic as the spell. If the dispelling attempt is initiated by night under an unclouded sky, the associated caster level check is made with a +5 bonus. Caster level 15th.
Tales in the Sky (Sp): Many sages know that the future can be read through the stars, but few realize that, by tracing their movements backward, secrets of long ago can be divined. Beginning at 19th level, once per day on command, you can use legend lore as the spell. You must be able to see the stars for this ability to function. Caster level 15th.
Call Down a Star (Sp): At 20th level and higher, once every other day on command, you can summon an elder fi re elemental. Caster level 17th.

dst: 扎帕洛是一名地底侏儒（Svirfneblin），1 级武者铁匠，同时也具备一定的法师天赋。他试图将自己的才能用于打造一把强大的魔法战斧，以供守卫他社区的民兵使用。他希望能创造出一件真正宏伟的武器，但像许多地底侏儒（Svirfneblin），1 级武者一样，他在开始这个项目之前并没有真正考虑清楚自己设计参数的所有含义。在锻造过程中，他将各种附魔组件融入武器，首先发现需要加长斧柄才能容纳所有组件。接着他又发现需要添加第二片魔法斧刃，以保持他所使用的力量之间的平衡。等他完成时，他打造出的武器已经太大，地底侏儒（Svirfneblin），1 级武者民兵根本无法使用。这把武器不得不卖给人类商人，最终辗转流落到了卡林港。目前尚不清楚这把双头斧的名字是指它的创造者扎帕洛，还是指它用闪电弧"电击"敌人的能力。
src: Zapalo was a gnomish smith with some aptitude as a mage as well. He attempted to apply his talents to the construction of a powerful magical battleaxe that could be used by the militia guarding his community. He hoped to create a truly magnificent weapon, but like many gnomes he did not really think through all the implications of his design parameters before beginning work on the project. Working various enchanted components into the weapon he was forging, he first found he needed to lengthen the haft to make room for them all. Then he found that he needed to add on a second magical blade to keep the forces he was working with in balance. By the time he was done, he had fashioned a weapon far too large to be used by gnomish militia. The weapon had to be sold to human merchants, and eventually made its way to Calimport. It is not clear if the name bestowed on this Double Axe refers to its creater Zapalo, or its ability to "zap" foes with arcs of lightning.

安德罗玛利乌斯，悔悟的游荡者
  
安德罗玛利乌斯曾是神奥利达玛拉的宠儿，现在作为一个契灵存在。他授予的能力帮助他的召唤者在游荡者和无赖自己的游戏中击败他们。

契灵等级：3级
绑定DC:20
特殊要求：无

影响：在受安德罗玛利乌斯影响时，你会变成一个狡猾的恶作剧者，乐于制造小灾难--尤其是朋友之间的误会和认错人的事件。然而，安德罗玛利乌斯现在无法容忍盗窃行为，因此只要你处于法律明确禁止此类活动的权威管辖之下，他就禁止你从生物那里偷窃，从尸体上取走物品或未经允许从某地拿走他人的财产。同理，你不能占有任何你知道是被盗的物品。

授予能力：
安德罗玛利乌斯授予的能力帮助你抓住游荡者并归还被盗物品，发现邪恶和卑鄙交易，并惩罚作恶者。

小丑的欢笑：作为一个标准动作，你可以使一个对手爆发出无法控制的大笑。此能力的功能如同塔莎的狂笑术（施法者等级等于你的有效契灵师等级）.一旦你使用了此能力，你5轮内不能再次使用。

定位物品：随意，你可以施放定位物品。

看见隐形：随意，你可以使用看见隐形，如同该法咒（施法者等级等于你的有效契灵师等级）.

感知诡计：你在察言观色检定，估价检定和侦察检定上获得+4加值。

偷袭：当你夹击对手或在任何目标失去其敏捷加值时，你造成额外2d6点伤害。每当你拥有超过5级的每五个有效契灵师等级，你的偷袭伤害额外增加1d6点。
src:
Andromalius, the Repentant Rogue
  
Once the favorite of the god Olidammara, Andromalius now exists as a vestige. His granted abilities help his summoners beat rogues and ne'er-do-wells at their own game.

Vestige Level: 3rd
Binding DC: 20
Special Requirement: No

Influence: When influenced by Andromalius, you become a devious mischief-maker who delights in causing small calamities-especially misunderstandings between friends and incidents of mistaken identity. However, Andromalius cannot now abide acts of theft, so he forbids you to steal from a creature, take an item from a dead body, or remove someone else's possession from a location without permission so long as you are under the jurisdiction of an authority whose laws expressly forbid such activities. By the same logic, you cannot take possession of any object that you know to be stolen.

Granted Abilities: 
The abilities that Andromalius grants help you catch thieves and return stolen goods, discover wickedness and underhanded dealings, and punish wrongdoers. 

Jester's Mirth: As a standard action, you can cause an opponent to break into uncontrollable laughter. This ability functions like a Tasha's hideous laughter spell (caster level equals your effective binder level). Once you have used this ability, you cannot do so again for 5 rounds. 

Locate Item: At will, you can cast locate object.

See the Unseen: At will, you can use see invisibility as the spell (caster level equals your effective binder level).

Sense Trickery: You gain a +4 bonus on Sense Motive checks, on Appraise checks, and on Spot checks.

Sneak Attack: You deal an extra 2d6 points of damage when flanking an opponent or at any time when the target would be denied its Dexterity bonus. For every five effective binder levels you possess beyond 5th, your sneak attack damage increases by an additional 1d6 points.

src: "Lichdom need not be so grim as you suppose, for though my flesh may be gone my memory and imagination have been enhanced. Not that I personally would waste their powers on the sort of foolishness that seems to interest you. Though if retaining useless and distracting flesh as an undead is truly your desire, the path of vampirism might beckon. As for myself, I would not wish to become a slave to an appetite for blood, but perhaps in one less majestic than myself it would not constitute so ridiculous and pathetic a condition."

“我并不是要你做什么会妨碍你其他工作的事，我只是希望你能留意一个可能会出现也可能不会出现的机会。我不知道你的冒险是否会把你带到卡林沙漠，但如果会的话，我希望你能留意那里生长的任何植物。有几种植物的生命力非常顽强，即使在沙漠中也能存活。如果你能找到并带给我这种植物的种子，我想这能帮助我在这并不理想的环境中种活一些东西。这会给我一些新的东西来种植，而且通过研究这样的植物，也许我还能找到帮助其他生长之物的方法。”
src: "I'm not asking anything that would interfere with your other work, I'd just like you to keep watch for an opportunity that may or may not come up. I don't know if your adventures are likely to take you into the Calim Desert, but if they do, I'd like you to keep your eye out for any plants that grow there. There are a few plants hardy enough to survive even out in the desert. If you can find and bring me the seeds from such a plant, I think it would help me get some things growing even in this less than ideal environment. It would give me some new things to plant, and by studying such plants perhaps I could find ways to help other growing things as well."

dst: 在下水道探索时，一个伪装成下水道维护工人的鼠人把我引诱进一间有拉杆控制门的房间，然后把我锁在了里面。我可以试试里面的拉杆，但我估计它已经被破坏了。我可能会被困在这里无限期地出不去，除非拉杆能被修好，或者搜查这个房间能找到其他逃脱办法。我还应该警惕其他恶毒的意外，因为我不认为鼠人有耐心靠饥饿来让我死亡。\n\n我在一池下水道污水中找到了一条通道，让我能游出鼠人的陷阱：令人不快，但很有必要。现在如果我愿意，我可以绕回去，用外面的拉杆打开那个房间。

I may be trapped here indefinitely, unless the lever can be repaired or a search of the chamber turns up some other means of escape. I should also be alert for other nasty surprises, as I doubt the wererats have the patience to trust to starvation to bring about my demise.\n\nI found a passage in a pool of sewer water enabling me to swim out of the wererats' trap: unpleasant but necessary. Now I can double back and open the chamber with the external lever, if I wish.

dst: 现已查明，卡洛玛斯·泽卡尔参与了蜘变形蛛和吞噬之火武僧及其各盟友蹂躏卡林杉的计划。他还计划利用泽法德之剑或其最初的目的——释放卡利姆和门农，这很可能给这片土地带来巨大的破坏。他的女儿卡齐娅对他的计划感到不安，将此事告知了我们，并让我们进入泽卡尔塔，但首先要求我们发誓不杀她父亲，只从他手中夺走剑。此后，我们一直前往塔顶寻找他。途中，我们遇到了拉梅尔·加尼尔布，他是乌尔萨哈卜的阿巴亚拉之一，据说能预见未来，被囚禁于此。他告诉了我们许多关于泽卡尔和剑的有趣信息。显然，当这把剑被用来击败恶魔阿兹古尔卡时，它将他困在了某种口袋位面中。此后他一直被困在那里，但保留了通过剑影响这个位面的一些能力（并且保留了更多能力来影响各种与火相关的位面的事件，他在那里已有联系）。这意味着剑的持有者往往会受到恶魔的影响并最终被其控制。这就是泽卡尔的天命，也很大程度上解释了他原本疯狂毁灭性的行为。他还告诉我们，恶魔即将挣脱位面监狱，返回主物质位面，如果发生，这很可能是一场灾难。希望从泽卡尔手中夺走剑，正如我们已计划的那样，将阻止这一事件以及泽卡尔和恶魔利用剑挑起的其他麻烦。拉梅尔最后提到的一点涉及阿巴亚拉关于扎拉拉的种种预言（泽卡尔绑架他以了解更多这些预言），根据这些预言，她注定要干涉泽卡尔和阿兹古尔卡的计划，这导致两人都想要她的命。\n\n当我们在塔顶与泽卡尔对峙时，发现恶魔阿兹古尔卡已部分返回这个位面，并能将其力量施加于此。尽管如此，我们成功夺取了泽法德之剑，尽管在此过程中它断成了两截，现在由扎拉拉持有。任务完成后，我们传送回了加尔哈德尔庄园。不幸的是，我们回到那里时发现泽卡尔的袭击者已经突破防线，即将消灭哈马德和少数剩余的守卫。哈马德指示扎拉拉和我逃往下水道，通过那里前往一艘名为瓦尔库尔之剑的船的码头。扎拉拉之前已被告知这个应急计划，并知道穿过下水道的路。我们被告知，这艘船的船长欠哈马德人情，会载我们离开这个国家，远离泽卡尔，因为在阿兹古尔卡的煽动下，泽卡尔会寻求杀死扎拉拉。哈马德留下来抵挡追兵，这场战斗他肯定无法生还。然而，扎拉拉和我设法到达了码头。很快我们就会离开卡林杉。
src: It has now been revealed that Kalomas Zekar was involved in the plans of the aranea and the Consuming Fire monks and their various allies to ravage Calimshan.  He also plans to use the Sword of Zefad or its original purpose of freeing Calim and Memnon, likely unleashing considerable devastation upon the land. His daughter Kadzia, disturbed by his plans, inofrmed us of this and gave us access to the Zekar tower, first extracting from us an oath not to kill her father, but only take the sword from him. Since then we have been proceeding to the very top of the tower to find him. Along the way, we came across one Ramel Ganirb, one of the Abbayalar of Ul'Sahab, who are reputed to be able to see the future, being held prisoner. He told us much interesting information about Zekar and the sword. Apparently when the sword was used to defeat the demon Azghulkar, it trapped him in some sort of pocket plane. There he has been ever since, but has retained some ability to influence this plane through the sword (and retained even more ability to influence events of various fire-related planes where he already had connections). This means that wielders of the sword tend to come under the demon's influence and eventually control. This has been the fate of Zekar, and explains much about his otherwise madly destructive actions. He has also told us that the demon is on the verge of breaking free of his planar prison and returning to the Prime, an event likely to be disastrous if it occurs. Hopefully taking the sword from Zekar, as we already plan, will prevent this as well as the other trouble Zekar and the demon are using the sword to stir up. A final point Ramel made concerned various prophecies of the Abbalayar concerning Zarala (Zekar kidnapped him to find out more about these), according to which she is fated to interfere with the schemes of both Zekar and Azghulkar, and which has caused both to desire her death.\n\nWhen we confronted Zekar at the top of his tower, it turned out that the demon Azghulkar was partially returned to this plane and able to exert his power into it. Nevertheless, we succeeded in taking the Sword of Zefad, although it was broken into two pieces, now held by Zarala, in the process. Our mission accomplished, we then teleported back to the Galhadr Estate. Unfortunately we returned there to find that Zekar's attackers had broken through and were about to finish off Hamad and the few remaining defenders. Hamad instructed Zarala and myself to flee to the sewers, through which we were to travel to reach the dock of a ship named the Sword of Valkur. Zarala had been told of this as a contingency plan before, and knew the way through the sewers. The captain of this vessel, we were told, was indebted to Hamad and would sail us out of the country and away from Zekar, who, at Azghulkar's instigation, will be seeking Zarala's death. Hamad remained behind to hold off pursuit, a fight he will surely not survive. Zarala and I, however, have managed to reach the dock. Soon we will be departing Calimshan.

src: Zarala feels that she has been spending too much time in magical and historical research, and wants to branch out into some different activities. Specifically, she thinks her skill with weapons needs improvement and wants some martial training. Since she cannot leave the estate, she has asked me to locate an approrpriate instructor who could come there, and suggested I look at Khaladar Korad's school, located here in the Noble district. Korad only accepts select students, and would not train Zarala, but her thinking is that since even his students are quite formidable, one of them could be hired. She has told me to offer potential instructors an incentive of 250 gold per lesson, plus 500 up front, and given me some gold to pay this latter advance. I can keep whatever I don't need to spend.\n\nArrangements have been made with one of Korad's students, a fire genasi named Garad Ashaler, to act as the instructor Zarala requires.

传奇变形者

传奇变形者已经超越了普通的德鲁伊野性变形能力；当她变形时，她不再只是简单地采取一个新形态。传奇变形者实际上变成了新生物。传奇变形者很少以其真实形态出现；事实上，一些最古老和最强大的变形者声称（带着一些自豪）已经完全忘记了自己的真实形态。

传奇变形者通常是一群狂野不羁的人，他们喜欢花时间探索多元宇宙，并陶醉于沿途发现的新形态和形状。

src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
A Shifter has no form they call their own. Instead, they clothe themselves in whatever shape is most expedient at the time. While others base their identities largely on their external forms, the Shifter actually comes closer to their true self through all of their transformations. Of necessity, their sense of self is based not on their outward form, but on their soul, which is truly the only constant about them. It is the inner strength of that soul that enables them to take on any shape and remain themselves within.

(This PrC was created to bring the shifter closer to PnP rules.)

- Hit Die: d8.
- Proficiencies: A Shifter does not gain any additional weapon or armor proficiencies.
- Skill Points: 4+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:
Spellcasting: 3rd level spells.
Feats: Alertness, Endurance
Special: You must be able to assume an alternate form. See the following list:
  Arcane or divine classes with the ability to cast Polymorph Self.This includes:
    Archivist (spell level 4, class level 7)
    Hexblade (spell level 4, class level 14)
    Ranger (spell level 4, class level 15)
    Shaman (spell level 4, class level 7)
    Sublime Chord (spell level 4)
    Sorcerer (spell level 4, class level 8)
    Suel Archanamach (spell level 4, class level 8)
    Wizard (spell level 4, class level 7)
  Divine classes having the Animal domain, which gives the ability to cast Shapechange at spell level 9.
  Classes with the ability to use one of these invocations: 
    Mask of Flesh, Humanoid Shape, Spider Shape, Hellspawned Grace.
  Classes with certain special abilities:
    Bonded Summoner: Elemental Form (Level 10)
    Druid: Wild Shape (Level 5)
    Initiate of Draconic Mysteries: Dragon Shape (Level 10)
    Ninja Spy: Thousand Faces (Level 7)
    Werewolf: Alternate Form, Wolf (Level 1)
  Certain races:
    Aranea
    Changeling
    Fey'ri
    Hound Archon
    Naztharune Rakshasa
    Pixie
    Rakshasa
    Shifter
    Yuan-ti Pureblood
    Zakya Rakshasa

CLASS FEATURES:

Level:
1: Greater Wild Shape - Can change into small, medium and humanoid once per day. Creature Weapon Proficiency - Can use creature weapons.
2: Can change into animal and monstrous humanoid.
3: Can change into large, tiny and beast. Can use Greater Wild Shape three time a day.
4: Can change into giant and vermin.
5: Can change into magical beast. Can use Greater Wild Shape five times a day.
6: Can change into aberration and ooze.
7: Can change into huge and dragon. Can use Greater Wild Shape seven times a day.
8: Can change into undead and construct.
9: Can change into elemental and outsider. Can use Greater Wild Shape nine times a day.
10: Evershifting form - No limit to Greater Wild Shape/day.


Epic Shifter

The epic Shifter has gone beyond the normal druidic ability to wildshape; no longer does she simply assume a new form when she changes shape. The epic Shifter actually becomes the new creature. Epic Shifters are rarely encountered in their true form; indeed, some of the most ancient and powerful Shifters claim (with some pride) to have forgotten their true form entirely.

Epic Shifters are generally a wild and carefree lot, and they prefer to spend their time exploring the multiverse and reveling in new forms and shapes they discover along the way.

Level:

17: 5 Epic Wild Shape/day.
20: 7 Epic Wild Shape/day.
23: 9 Epic Wild Shape/day.
26: 11 Epic Wild Shape/day.

Kobolds are short, reptilian humanoids with a scaly hide and a doglike head. They are small creatures, about the size of a gnome or halfling. - Natural Armor Bonus: Racial natural armor bonus of 1.
- Light Sensitivity: Kobolds suffer -2 penalty to attack rolls, saves and checks while operating in bright light.
- Dragonblooded: Kobolds have the dragonblood subtype.
- Reptilian: Kobolds count as Reptilian for the purpose of spells.

《炉边之风》是一首历经岁月变迁而多有改动的诗——凡研习过它的人都清楚这一点——但它究竟被改动了多少，以及为何会发生这些改动，却无人知晓。许多学者认为这些变化代表了语言的自然演变以及现代风格的创新。关于这首诗的真实历史所知甚少，不过有些人相信它与费伦的造物种族有所关联。另一些人则推测它可能是某位古老宗教信徒所作的颂歌。在无冬城广为传唱的版本记录如下，不过其他地区的版本在主题上有所差异。

当你在寒冷与黑暗中颤抖，
望向炉火，在它的火花中看见——
我的眼睛
正注视着你。

当你行走在呼啸的风爪之中，
越过狼颚的嚎叫去倾听。
我的歌声
传向你。

当你迷失在无痕的雪原，
抬头望向雄鹰高飞之处。
我的星辰
为你闪耀。

在幽深的矿坑或崩裂的山巅，
听见我诉说的爱语。
我的思念
与你同在。

你并未被遗弃
你并未被遗忘。
北地无法吞没你。
冰雪无法掩埋你。
我会来寻你。
费伦终将回暖，
诸神终将微笑
但噢，我的爱，好好保护自己——
这一切或许要很久很久以后才会发生。
src:
"Wind by the Fireside" is a poem that has changed much over the ages - that much is clear to those who have studied it - but it is not known how much it has been altered, or why the alterations have taken place. Many scholars assume that these changes are representative of the natural evolution of language, as well as modern innovations of style. Little is known about the actual history of the poem, though some believe it to have some bearing upon the creator races of Faer�n. Others have speculated that it may have been written as an ode by a follower of some ancient religion. The popular version sung in Neverwinter is noted as the following, though other regions have variations in theme.

So as you shiver in the cold and the dark,
Look into the fire and see in its spark - 
My eye
Watching over you.

As you walk in the wind's whistling claws.
Listen past the howling of the wolf's jaws.
My song
Comes to you.

And when you're lost in trackless snow,
Look up high where the eagles go.
My star
Shines for you.

In deep, dark mine or on crumbling peak,
Hear the words of love I speak.
My thoughts
Are with you.

You are not forsaken
You are not forgotten.
The North cannot swallow you.
The snows cannot bury you.
I will come for you.
Faer�n will grow warmer,
And the gods will smile
But oh, my love, guard yourself well - 
All this may not happen for a long, long while.

src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
Most churches use analogy and allegory to describe the traits of their deities, as well as the proper attitude their faithful should maintain.  It's not unusual for these analogies to compare crusading gods and their clerics to elements of dragonkind.  After all, dragons are formidable creatures considered by many to be symbols of deific power.  In a few churches, the use of allegory becomes so strong that certain worshippers actually begin to refer to the church itself as a holy dragon, and to themselves as parts of that dragon.  Swift wings are church servants who see themselves as the fast-moving, hard-hitting crusaders of their god's cadre of worshipers.

- Hit Die: d8
- Proficiencies: A Swift Wing gains no additional proficiencies.
- Skill Points: 4 + Int Modifier

REQUIREMENTS:
Spellcasting: Must be able to cast 3rd level divine spells.
Base Attack Bonus: +3.
Special: Ability to turn undead.

CLASS FEATURES:

Level
1: Dragon Affinity - Your concept of yourself as part of a holy dragon that serves your church draws upon a mystic link to a particular kind of dragon you consider affiliated with your deity.  At first level you must select a dragon type within 1 step of your alignment.
Dragon Domain - At 1st level you are granted the Dragon Domain as a bonus domain.
2: Draconic Senses - You gain Draconic Senses as a bonus feat.
3: Breath of Life - At 3rd level, you gain the ability to channel positive energy into a breath weapon.  You can spend one use of your Turn Undead ability to create a 30-foot-long, cone-shaped breath weapon.  The breath weapon deals 1d6 points of damage per level to undead.  A successful Reflex save (DC 10 + class level + Cha modifier) halves this damage.  Living creatures are instead healed of 1 point of damage per level.
4: Energy Resistance - You gain resistance 20 to the energy type associated with your affiliated dragon type.
5: Wings - You can summon or dismiss dragon wings at any time, granting you a +10 to Jump.
7: Damage Reduction - At 7th level, your link to draconic energies gives you a hide as tough as a dragon.  You gain damage reduction 5/+1.
9: Energy Immunity - At 9th level, your link to draconic energy is so complete you gain immunity to the energy type associated with your dragon affinity.
10: Draconic Surge - At 10th level, you become filled with draconic energy, making you physically and mentally more dragonlike.  You gain a +1 to either Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution, and a +1 to either Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma.

BONUS DIVINE SPELLS

Every level in Swift Wing, the character gains new spells per day as if he had also gained a level in his highest divine caster class.

"不奇怪。大多数人不会留豺狼人俘虏，直接杀掉，而大多数豺狼人也受不了被囚禁，不喜欢身边没有部落。但加尔哈德尔老板不寻常。他教我提尔的教义，告诉我有一种适用于所有生物的正义标准。这不像豺狼人的想法，那里只有关于你能对同部落成员做什么的规矩，而外人可以随意杀死。我更喜欢提尔，所以我加入了提尔神殿，试着成为牧师。而提尔接纳了我！不像豺狼人的神祇似乎只想要豺狼人崇拜他们。提尔不在乎信徒的种族，成为神殿的一员几乎就像有了新部落。我想，这就是我的故事。" *咆哮*
src: "No surprise. Most people not take gnoll prisoners, just kill them, and most gnolls not take well to captivity, not liking having no tribe around. But Galhadr boss unusual. He teach me ways of Tyr, that there be a standard of justice that apply to all creatures. This not like gnoll thinking, where there are only rules about what you can do to other tribe members, and outsiders be freely killed. I like Tyr better, so much I join Tyr temple and try to become cleric. And Tyr accept me! Not like gnoll gods who only want gnolls to worship them, it seems. Tyr not care about worshipper's race, and being member of temple almost like having new tribe. And that be my story, I guess." *Snarl*

src:
Psychoportation
Level: Psion/wilder 3
Manifesting Time: 1 standard action
Range: Close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Targets: One Medium or smaller creature
Duration: 1 round/level; see text
Saving Throw: Will negates
Power Resistance: Yes
Power Points: 5
Metapsionics: Extend, Twin, Widen

The subject of the power hops forward in time 1 round for every manifester level you have. In effect, the subject seems to disappear in a shimmer of silver energy, then reappear after the duration of this power expires. The subject reappears in exactly the same orientation and condition as before. From the subject's point of view, no time has passed at all.

In each round of the power's duration, it can attempt a DC 15 Wisdom check. Success allows the subject to return. The subject can act normally on its next turn after this power ends.

Augment: You can augment this power in one or both of the following ways.
1. For every 2 additional power points you spend, you can affect a creature of one size category larger.
2. For every 2 additional power points you spend, this power can affect an additional target. Any additional target cannot be more than 15 feet from another target of the power.

src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
A battlesmith is a skilled dwarf armorer and weaponsmith who uses her experience in battle, as well as her masterful weaponsmithing and armorsmithing abilities, to create deadly items for her kinsmen to wield in defense of their homes. While typically only spellcasters can craft magic items, dwarven ingenuity has found a number of ways to make skill serve where nondwarves must rely on magic. Aside from her incredible skill crafting items of war, a battlesmith is equally capable of raining down death and destruction in combat. After all, no one knows her creations - or how to most effectively use them - better than the battlesmith herself, and she did not live to retire from the front lines by being anything less than the best. 

Fighters and paladins are well served by becoming battlesmiths. Spellcasters are less likely to find benefit in the profession, since they typically find little time to continue their more traditional mystical studies while working in the heat of the forge. That said, a number of clerics of Moradin take up the mantle of the battlesmith.

- Hit Die: d10
- Proficiencies: A battlesmith gains no additional proficiencies
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS: 

Race: Dwarf
Feats: Armor Proficiency (Heavy), Endurance, Weapon Focus (Warhammer)
Skills: Craft (Weapons) 10
Base Attack Bonus: +5

CLASS FEATURES:

Level 
1: One With the Hammer - Wisdom to damage for Warhammers
   Secrets of the Forge - Craft magic arms and armor at 3x class level
2: Flesh of my Flesh - +1 armor in heavy armor
3: Forged in Fire - Ignore exhaustion and fatigue
4: Flesh of my Flesh - +2
5: Tempered in Blood - Ignore 50% physical damage for one round

This part of the city has been having increasing trouble with violent criminal activity, so Hamad thinks it would be best for his charitable contribution to be delivered by someone armed and combat-capable, such as myself. src: In the sewers beneath the temple district, I have encountered a wererat named Querzat, who does not share the hostile tendencies of the other wererats about, and in fact seeks a cure for his lycanthropic condition. I have agreed to help him achieve this goal. He wants me to obtain a number of items he will need to effect a cure: some belladonna, a book detailing the proper preparation for the belladonna before he dare actually ingest it, and some alchemical equipment to actually carry out said preparations. This last can be obtained from a merchant named, according to Querzat, "Blimfin Nemquin or Temquin or something." I have been given a list of items to present to this Blimfin when I locate him. Querzat is not sure where the other two items might be found, but suggests I check out the various stores in the city.\n\nI have given Querzat the book and the alchemical equipment. I still need to bring him the alchemical belladonna.

dst:
卡林港的一位平民告诉我，他一直听到地下室里有奇怪的声音，尤其是沿着北墙。他想让我去调查，如果我找到并消除危险，他会付钱给我。看来我又要去另一个地下室了。我希望这不会变成某个无聊的杀老鼠任务。

确实有危险的东西正要冲进地下室：一群史莱姆怪。穿过它们似乎挖出的隧道，我进入了另一个地下室，里面满是奇怪的装置和魔法器具。史莱姆怪一定是从这里来的，但原因尚不清楚。需要进一步调查才能了解这里发生了什么。

我探索了另一个地下室，找到了一些可能解释这里发生了什么的线索，还有一把应该能让我上楼的钥匙。也许住在这里的人能帮我彻底解决这个小调查。
src:
A commoner in Calimport has told me that he has been hearing strange noises in his basement, especially along the north wall. He wants me to investigate, and will pay me if I find and eliminate some danger. Looks like I'm off to another basement. I hope this doesn't turn out to be some silly rat-killing quest.

There was indeed something dangerous about to burst into the basement: a bunch of slimes. Going through the tunnel they seemed to have carved has led me into another basement, full of strange devices and magical paraphernalia. The slimes must have come from here, but it is not clear why. Further investigation will be needed to understand what is going on here.

I have explored the other basement and found some clues as to what may have happened here, as well as a key that should let me head upstairs. Perhaps whoever lives here will help me resolve this little investigation definitively.

dst: 半人半蝎的毒刺是半人马的一种怪异变体。它们通常栖息在沙漠地区的地下巢穴中。不幸的是，它们兼具蝎子一方的敌意与攻击性，以及人形生物使用工具、武器和魔法的能力。它们还拥有一种非凡的能力，能感知石头或沙子中的微小震动并从中获取信息，有人怀疑这种能力并非纯粹自然，而是带有某种预言魔法。想躲过它们无疑非常困难。
src: Half humanoid and half scorpion, Stingers make for a bizarre variant on the centaur. They are typically found in subterranean colonies located in desert regions. Unfortunately, they combine the hostility and aggressiveness of their scorpion side with a humanoid's ability to use tools, weapons, and magic. They also possess a remarkable ability to sense small vibrations in stone or sand and glean information from them, an ability some suspect is not purely natural but touched with some sort of divination magic. It is certainly very difficult to hide from them.

src:
Type of Feat: Class
Requirements: Champion of Corellon level 1
You gain the ability to heal wounds by touch, much like a Paladin's Lay on Hands ability. Each day you can heal a total number of hitpoints of damage equal to your Champion level x your Charisma modifier (minimum 1). For example, a 6th level Champion of corellon with a Charisma score of 14 can heal 12 points of damage per day. You can choose to divide the healing among multiple recipients and you don't have to do it all at once. Using this ability is a standard action.
You can use any or all of this healing power to deal damage to undead creatures. Using Corellon's blessing in this way requires a successful melee touch attack and doesn't provoke attacks of opportunity. You decide how much of your daily allotment of healing to use as damage after successfully touching your undead foe.
If you have levels in Paladin, you add your levels of Champion of Corellon and Paladin together and determine your ability to heal accordingly (although if you have a Charisma score lower than 12, your Paladin levels do not contribute to your ability to heal).

操焰者喜欢火。非常喜欢。任何拥有一定心灵异能能力的角色都是此进阶职业的潜在人选。心灵术士（尤其是操能者）和狂念者若对火焰怀有热情，或许会认为放弃其他领域的能力获取是可以接受的。心灵武士也享受操焰者的力量。魂刃者常在此职业上提升等级，以便为其心智之刃获得“炽焰武器”能力。任何拥有“原始天赋”专长的角色也可能觉得此职业颇具吸引力。

(PRESTIGE CLASS)
Pyrokineticists know that a little psionic power goes a long way - for those interested only in fire. They find both beauty and utility in the chaotic shape of flame, its spectrum of fuel-dependent colors, its warming heat, and its never-ending hunger. Those who take one or more levels in the pyrokineticist class are sometimes colloquially referred to as 'pyros'.

Pyrokineticists like fire. A lot. Any character with some psionic ability is a possible candidate for this prestige class. Psions (particularly kineticists) and wilders might consider it acceptable to give up power acquisition in other areas if they have a passion for flame. Psychic warriors also enjoy the pyro's powers. Soulknives often take levels in this class to gain access to the weapon afire ability for their mind blades. Any character with the Wild Talent feat may also find this class appealing.

- Hit Die: d8.
- Proficiencies: A Pyrokineticist gains no additional proficiencies.
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:
Alignment: Any Chaotic
Skills: Concentration 8 ranks, Lore 2 ranks.
Psionics: Must have a power point reserve of at least 1 power point.

CLASS FEATURES:

Level
1:  Chosen Element - Element to be used with class abilities
    Fire Lash - Creates a whip using the chosen element
2:  Fire Adaptation - +4 to saves, resist 10 vs element
    Hand Afire - Unarmed attacks do 2d6 elemental damage
3:  Bolt of Fire - Ranged touch attack does 1d6 elemental damage per level
4:  Weapon Afire - Weapons (including ranged) do 2d6 elemental damage
5:  Nimbus - Protects and allows touch attacks
6:  Firewalk - Doubles speed for 1 power point per round
7:  Fear No Fire - +8 to saves, resist 20 vs element
8:  Greater Weapon Afire - Weapon, unarmed and nimbus attacks do 4d6 elemental damage
9:  Heat Death - Target saves or dies
10: Conflagration - Area of effect, targets failing damage save must save or die

"他们几乎什么都不知道，就算他们知道，我们也不必担心。让我给你解释一下如何保持秘密。到处留下尸体可不是办法：正如我解释过的，那会适得其反。另一方面，如果你只是让那些想调查的人发表他们的‘惊人揭露’，无视他们，他们的真实性就会受到怀疑。如果他们真的掌握了如此重大的秘密，我们为什么不杀了他们，或者做点什么？在没有真正令人震惊的事情（比如一具尸体）引起的公众关注的情况下，甚至不会有那么多人特别注意他们，更不用说相信他们了。"
src: "They have learned hardly anything, and even if that were not so, we should not worry about it. Let me explain to you something about maintaining secrecy. Leaving a trail of bodies everywhere you go is not how you go about it: very counter-productive that, as I explained. On the other hand, if you just let would-be investigators publish their 'shocking revelations,' just ignore them, their veracity will be doubted. Why would we not have killed them, or done something, if they are indeed such great secrets? In the absence of the publicity created by something really shocking, such as a corpse, not that many people will even pay any particular attention to them, never mind believe them."

School: Conjuration (Teleportation)
Level: Sor/Wiz 9
Components: V
Casting Time: 10 minutes
Range: 0 ft.
Effect: 5-ft.-radius circle that teleports those who activate it
Duration: 10 min./level
Saving Throw: None
Spell Resistance: Yes

You create a circle on the floor or other horizontal surface that teleports, as greater teleport, any creature who stands on it to a designated spot. Once you designate the destination for the circle, you cant change it. The spell fails if you attempt to set the circle to teleport creatures into a solid object, to a place with which you are not familiar and have no clear description, or to another plane.

The circle itself is subtle and nearly impossible to notice. If you intend to keep creatures from activating it accidentally, you need to mark the circle in some way.

Note: Magic traps such as teleportation circle are hard to detect and disable. A rogue (only) can use the Search skill to find the circle and Disable Device to thwart it. The DC in each case is 25 + spell level, or 34 in the case of teleportation circle.

李斯魔是尤斯魔社会中的苦力工人，低阶战士和仆从。虽然李斯魔通常在阿卡魔和哈蒂魔领导者的指挥下劳作，但图勒魔有时会聚集李斯魔作为猎人，斥候和可消耗的先头部队。没有领导时，李斯魔会独处。虽然它们为食物和财宝攻击其他生物，但它们温顺，胆小且容易被驱散。李斯魔避免正面战斗，即使面对较弱的敌人，通常满足于对柔软，容易的目标进行冷枪射击。

Lashemoi are the drudge workers, low-ranking warriors, and servitors of ushemoi society. Though lashemoi typically toil under the direction of arkamoi and hadrimoi leaders, turlemoi sometimes gather lashemoi to them as hunters, scouts, and expendable advance troops. Without leadership, lashemoi keep to themselves. Though they attack other creatures for food and treasure, they are meek, cowardly, and easily driven off. Lashemoi avoid standup fights even against weaker foes and are typically content to take potshots at soft, easy targets.

Lashemoi have a natural connection to their ushemoi brethren, but they are just as likely to be found in the service of ogre mages, hobgoblin chieftains, evil clerics, and the like. Other ushemoi refer to lashemoi as �mongrels,?not because of their heritage, but for the lashemoi's tendency to follow any charismatic creature.

Favored Class (Barbarian): A multiclass Lashemoi's barbarian class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

- Base movement of 30

- Damage Reduction: Innate damage reduction of 5/- to bludgeoning damage

- Lesser Strength from Pain (Ex): Whenever a lashemoi takes damage from any source, it gains a +1 bonus on attack rolls, a +1 bonus on damage rolls, and its natural armor bonus to AC increases by 1. These benefits last for 1 minute. Bonuses stack each time a lashemoi takes damage, to a maximum of a +5 bonus on attack rolls, a +5 bonus on damage rolls, and a +5 natural armor bonus to AC. src:
Savnok, the Instigator
  
Once a servant of gods, Savnok now grants his summoners the ability to wear heavy armor, to draw arrows from thin air, to take the place of allies in combat, and to cause wounds that do not heal.

Vestige Level: 2nd
Binding DC: 20
Special Requirement: No

Influence: Savnok's influence makes you headstrong and recalcitrant. Once you make up your mind about a particular issue, very little can change your thoughts on the matter. In addition, whenever you don armor, employ a shield, or wear any other item that improves your AC, Savnok requires that you not remove that protection for any reason.

Granted Abilities: 
Savnok grants you abilities associated with his death and the command of allies' positions.

Call Armor: At will as a full-round action, you can summon a suit of full plate armor, which appears about your body. As you attain higher effective binder levels, the armor's quality improves, as given on the following table. At 5th level, it becomes +1. At 9th level, +2. At 13th level, it grants immunity to sneak attacks. At 17th level, +4. At 20th level, immunity to critical hits. You can dismiss the armor with another full-round action.

Heavy Armor Proficiency: You are proficient with heavy armor.

Move Ally: You can instantly swap positions with any visible willing ally within 5 feet per two effective binder levels of your position. Using this ability is a standard action at first, though at 13th level you can use it as a swift action. Once you have used this ability, you cannot do so again for 5 rounds.

Savnok's Armor: While wearing your called armor, you can ignore some of the damage from attacks by nonpiercing weapons. When you first gain the ability to summon Savnok, this ability gives you damage reduction 1/piercing, and the value improves by +1 for every four effective binder levels you possess.

<StartHighlight>[守序 +1]</Start> "泽卡尔曾以为自己足够自律，能够抵抗我，但现在他是我意志的奴隶。为了捍卫秩序，你必须用恶魔的混乱手段杀死并摧毁一切反对它的东西。在使用我们的工具时，你就是在为我们服务，无论你是否意识到这一点。你们凡人永远不会明白，重要的不是你们的目的，因为比你们更强大的力量总会决定你们能否实现它们。只有你们选择用来确保它们的手段——光荣而富有同情心，还是无情而背信弃义——才是重要的，因为这决定了这些更强大的力量中哪一个愿意与你结盟，而深渊的方法是最实用的。"
src: <StartHighlight>[Lawful +1]</Start> "Zekar once thought himself disciplined enough to resist me, but now he is a slave to my will. To defend order, you must kill and destroy all that opposes it, using the chaotic methods of demons. In using our tools you serve us, whether you realize it or not. You mortals will never understand that it is not your ends that matter, for greater powers than you will always determine whether you accomplish them or not. Only the means you choose to secure them, honorable and compassionate or ruthless and treacherous, matter, for that decides which of these greater powers will be willing to ally with you, and it is the methods of the Abyss that are the most practical."
