dst: "事实上，几个世纪以来，蛇人一直有意将自己的血统与人类结合，或是通过魔法手段，或是通过更直接的方法，因为混血蛇人和纯血蛇人都能与人类交配繁衍。在他们看来，这样做是在帮人类的忙，通过赋予人类一些据称更优越的蛇类特征来改良他们的血统。抛开这个借口不谈，他们对繁育纯血蛇人尤其感兴趣，因为他们利用纯血蛇人作为间谍渗透人类社会，以推进其邪恶目标，其中包括最终让整个费伦臣服于蛇类的统治之下。"
src: "In fact, the Yuan-ti have deliberately combined their blood with those of humans over the centuries, either through magical techniques or more direct methods, since the halfbloods and purebloods can interbreed with humans. As they see it, they are doing humans a favor this way, improving their stock by giving them some of the characteristics of allegedly superior serpents. That excuse aside, they are particularly interested in breeding purebloods, since they use them as spies to infiltrate human society in furtherance of their nefarious goals, which include ultimately subjecting all of Faerun to the domination of serpentkind."

暮灵是外位面原生的小型但凶猛的妖精。他们自夸拥有其他种族所不具备的与魂能的天生联系--正如树精与其树木合一，他们声称，暮灵种族与魂能合一。

暮灵的身高与精灵相仿，但远比精灵健壮。他们平均身高约5英尺，体重约120磅。他们的皮肤是钢蓝灰色，头发从浅蓝色到深蓝色，灰色和黑色不等。他们的眼睛是深蓝色，翠绿色或紫色。他们有一种狂野，野性的外表--头发长而蓬乱，脸长而略带狐相。男性长着浓密的长胡须。

暮灵属性调整：+2 体质，-2 智力。
偏好职业（图腾师）：兼职暮灵的图腾师职业在决定是否因兼职而受到经验值惩罚时不计入。

特殊能力：
- 微光视觉：使他们在黑暗中比正常看得更清楚。
- 妖精（跨位面，魂能）：对于所有与种族相关的效果，暮灵被视为妖精。
- 魂能池：暮灵的魂能池永久增加1点。如果她没有魂能池，此特性赋予她一个具有1点魂能的魂能池。
- 暮灵的基础速度为30英尺。然而，暮灵可以投入魂能来提高此速度。每投入1点魂能于此种族特性，暮灵的速度提高5英尺。此增强加值仅在暮灵穿着轻甲或无甲且负重不超过轻载时适用。
src:
Dusklings are small but savage fey native to the Outer Planes. They boast of an innate connection to incarnum that no other race possesses-as a dryad is one with her tree, they claim, the duskling race is one with incarnum.

Dusklings stand about as tall as elves, though they are far more robust. They average about 5 feet tall and about 120 pounds. Their skin is steely blue-gray and their hair ranges from light blue to darker shades of blue, gray, and black. Their eyes are deep blue, emerald green, or purple. They have a wild, feral look about them-their hair grows long and unkempt, and their faces are long and somewhat vulpine. The men grow long, full beards.

Duskling Ability Adjustments: +2 Con, -2 Int.
Favored Class (Totemist): A multiclass Duskling's totemist class does not count when determining whether she suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:
- Low-Light Vision: Allows them to see better than normal in the dark.
- Fey (Extraplanar, Incarnum): For all effects related to race, a Duskling is considered a Fey.
- Essentia Pool: A duskling's essentia pool is permanently increased by 1. If she doesn't have an essentia pool, this trait grants her one with a single point of essentia.
- Duskling base speed is 30 feet. However, a duskling can invest essentia to improve this speed. For every point of essentia invested in this racial trait, the duskling's speed improves by 5 feet. This enhancement bonus only applies when the duskling is wearing light or no armor and carrying no more than a light load.

当你的恐惧甲壳被塑造时，当你使用啮咬攻击时，你在伤害检定上获得 +2 加值，或者当你使用爪击或其他天生攻击时获得 +1 加值。作为交换，你在使用天生武器的攻击检定上受到 -1 减值。

脉轮绑定（臂） 

虽然你的恐惧甲壳外观不变，你的上臂显现出鳞片状甲板，同时尖刺从你的肘部冒出。与此同时，你拥有的任何天生武器变得更加致命-更锋利，更长，更能切开皮肤和盔甲以撕裂脆弱的血肉。

你拥有的任何天生攻击（无论是天生的还是由于另一个灵魂融合） 的威胁范围加倍。

脉轮绑定（足）

虽然你的恐惧甲壳外观不变，你的腿变得越发肌肉发达，其形状略微改变，使你更自然地仅用脚趾和脚掌前部移动。

每分钟一次，你可以为你的速度添加 +60 尺的增强加值，持续 1 轮。

脉轮绑定（心） 

你的恐惧甲壳呈现出高度反光的光泽，暗示泰拉斯奎将法咒反射回施法者的能力。法咒很难穿过你的甲壳影响你。

你获得等于 5 + 每点投入恐惧甲壳的魂髓 4 的法术抗力。

脉轮绑定（图腾） 

两只强大的角从你的头部突出。尽管它们在战斗中无用，但它们改变了你的外观，使你的面容相当可怕。当你冲锋时，你的面容暗示着某种完全非人的东西，将恐惧刺入你敌人的心中。

当你冲锋时，所有 60 尺内能看到你的敌人变得战栗 1 轮（意志无效）.
src:
Dread Carapace

Descriptors: None 
Classes: Totemist 
Chakra: Arms, feet, heart (totem)
Saving Throw: See text

Incarnum forms into a heavy, caramel-brown carapace covering your back. Short spines protrude from this shell, and light gleams from its surface. Though it has no actual protective value (unless you bind it to your heart chakra), the carapace fills you with the destructive power of the tarrasque.

While your dread carapace is shaped, you gain a +2 bonus on damage rolls when you are using a bite attack, or a +1 bonus when you are using a claw or other natural attack. In exchange, you take a -1 penalty on attack rolls with natural weapons. 

Essentia: Every point of essentia you invest in your dread carapace increases your attack penalty by 1 and your damage bonus by 2 (for bite attacks) or 1 (for other natural weapons). 

Chakra Bind (Arms) 

While the appearance of your dread carapace is unchanged, your upper arms manifest scaly plates, while spikes emerge from your elbows. At the same time, any natural weapons you possess become more deadly-sharper, longer, better able to slice through skin and armor to tear at vulnerable flesh.

The threat range of any natural attacks you possess (either naturally or as a result of another soulmeld) is doubled.

Chakra Bind (Feet)

While the appearance of your dread carapace is unchanged, your legs become increasingly muscular, and their shape alters slightly so that you more naturally move on just your toes and the balls of your feet.

Once per minute, you can add an enhancement bonus of +60 feet to your speed for 1 round.

Chakra Bind (Heart) 

Your dread carapace takes on a highly reflective sheen, suggesting the tarrasque's ability to reflect spells back on their casters. Spells have a hard time reaching through your carapace to affect you.

You gain spell resistance equal to 5 + 4 per point of essentia you invest in your dread carapace.

Chakra Bind (Totem) 

Two mighty horns jut from your head. Though they are useless in combat, they alter your appearance, making your countenance quite fearsome. When you charge, your visage suggests something utterly inhuman, striking fear into the hearts of your foes.

When you charge, all enemies within 60 feet who can see you become shaken for 1 round (Will negates).

Type of Feat: Class
  Prerequisite: Spellfire Channeler level 1.
  Specifics: The channeler's capacity for storing spellfire energy levels is multiplied by the listed value. However, spellfire energy levels in excess of the channeler's Constitution score is dangerous, with different effects depending upon the number of levels stored:
  Constitution +1 to Constitution X2:
  The channeler's eyes glow brightly, and any creature, magic item or spell effect that touches the channeler causes 1 spellfire energy level to be discharged as a harmless burst of light. Once per day, the channeler must make a constitution check (DC 10) or take 1d6 points of damage as one of her spellfire energy level backfires.
  Constitution X2+1 to Constitution X3:
  As above, except a touch releases 1d4 spellfire energy levels as light, and the channeler must make the backfire Constitution check every hour.
  Constitution X3+1 to Constitution X4:
  As above, except the channeler feels a burning sensation within her body (treat as if distracted by a nondamaging spell, DC 20 to concentrate), and must make the backfire Constitution check every minute. A touch releases 1d6 spellfire energy levels as a flare spell (DC 10 + number of spellfire energy levels expended) against the channeler and all creatures within 5 feet of her.
  Constitution X4+1 to Constitution X5:
  As above, except the character is in pain (treat as if distracted by a nondamaging spell, DC 25 to concentrate), and must make the backfire Constitution check every round. A touch releases 2d6 energy levels as a flare spell (DC 10 + number of spellfire energy levels expended) against the channeler and all creatures within 5 feet of her. The channeler must make a Will save (DC 25) every round or be forced to expend a maximum-strength blast of energy at a random target within 30 feet in preference to any other action.
  Regardless of the number of spellfire energy levels stored, a channeler can voluntarily expend only a number of spellfire energy levels per round equal to her Constitution score. (Involuntary expenditure, such as that noted above, isn't limited in this way.)

在一个不死怪物的巢穴中，我发现了一枚魔法戒指的碎片，上面刻有提尔的符号。当我把它拿给莎尔神殿的首席女祭司费拉莎看时，她认出这是前些时候被盗的提尔圣物的一部分。她因我把找到的碎片给了她而奖励了我，并告诉我，如果我再找到戒指的其他碎片，她也想要，以便莎尔神殿可以玷污他们敌人提尔的这件圣物。

在找到圣戒的第二块碎片后，费拉莎告诉我，有了戒指的两块碎片，她可以施放一个预言法咒来定位最后一块碎片，然后打开一个临时界门，将人传送到那附近以取回最后一块碎片。她还承诺，如果我完成这次回收，将给予丰厚的奖励。我接受了这个任务，现在已经从它的不死守卫那里取回了这枚提尔圣戒的最后一块碎片。回到神殿后，我得知我的奖励就是这枚戒指本身，它将被重铸但被莎尔的力量腐化，并注入一套我可以自己选择的力量。一旦我准备好并知道我想选择什么力量，费拉莎就会着手为戒指注入力量。
src:
In the lair of an undead monster, I found a broken piece of a magical ring inscribed with symbols of Tyr. When I showed it to Ferazha, the head priestess of the Temple of Shar, she recognized it as part of a holy artifact of Tyr stolen some time ago. She rewarded me for giving her the piece I found, and has told me that she would also like any other pieces of the ring that I should happen to find, so that the Temple of Shar might defile this artifact of their enemy Tyr.

Having found a second piece of the holy ring, I was informed by Ferazha that with two pieces of the ring, she could cast a divination spell that would locate the final piece, and then open a temporary portal that would transport one near that location to recover the last fragment. She also promised a substantial reward should I effect this recovery. I accepted this quest and have now recovered the final fragment of this holy ring of Tyr from its undead guardians. Returning to the temple, I was informed that my reward would be this very ring, reforged but corrupted by the power of Shar, and infused with a set of powers that I myself can choose. As soon as I am ready and know what powers I wish to select, Ferazha will proceed to empower the ring.

哈马德一直在筹备对阿然尼亚总部的进攻，既然我们已经掌握了其位置的情报，这次进攻几乎已经准备就绪，军队正集结在蜘蛛沼泽的一处集结地。哈马德指示我前往这个集结地，为进攻贡献我的能力。到达后，我需向那里的指挥官——卡拉德·杰拉因将军报到，并以他认为合适的方式提供协助。是时候前往城门，带上我想带的任何随从，然后出发前往沼泽。

我已抵达沼泽中的集结地，并向杰拉因将军报到。他的部队已经在与服务于我们阿然尼亚敌人的类人生物（这里主要是蜥蜴人）交战。他预计最终会取得胜利，但担心等到胜利时，我们敌人的首领已经逃离总部，以便从其他地方继续他们的战争。为了防止这种情况，他计划让我沿着斥候发现的一条向北的小路前进，这条小路可以让我绕过他们的主力部队，直达基地。我将沿着这条小路前进，并与驻扎在小路开始再次向南拐弯之前的一支军队斥候会合。然后，我和斥候们将一路杀过敌人后方区域，那里希望抵抗较弱，以抵达基地。一旦到达那里，我将在阿然尼亚首领策划逃跑之前杀死他们。

我已经到达了北边小路上本应与军队斥候会合的地点，但他们不见踪影。也许我应该在继续前往基地之前四处寻找他们的踪迹。
src:
The assault Hamad has been preparing upon the headquarters of the aranea, now that we have information on its location, is nearly ready to be launched, with military forces converging upon a staging area in the Spider Swamp. Hamad has instructed me to travel to this staging area to add my abilities to the attack. Once there, I am to report to the commander there, a General Kalad Jra'ein, and assist in whatever way he deems appropriate. Time to head to the city gates, pick up any henchmen I want with me there, and then head off to the swamp.

I have reached the staging area in the swamp, and reported to General Jra'ein. His forces are already in battle against the humanoids (here, mostly lizardmen) in service to our aranea enemies. He expects eventual victory but fears that by the time it is achieved the leaders of our foes will have fled their headquarters in order to carry on their war from some other location. To prevent this, he plans to send me along a path to the north his scouts have discovered that will allow me to bypass their main force and reach the base. I am to follow this path and link up with a body of the army's scouts stationed just before the point where it starts heading south again. The scouts and I are then to fight our way through the hopefully light opposition we will find in the enemy's rear areas to reach the base. Once there I am to slay the aranea leaders before they can engineer an escape.

I have reached the point along the northern path where I was supposed to rendezvous with the army's scouts, but they are nowhere to be seen. Perhaps I should look around for some sign of them before proceeding onward to the base.

src: Saman Waladi has told me that if I am looking for work I should seek out one Namal Sarakan, captain of the ship Shining Searcher, currently to be found in the Docks District. This Captain Sarakan apparently wants the help of an adventurer in investigating some mysterious artifact he has found. Saman has already mentioned to him that I might be a suitable person for his needs, so he should be prepared to accept my assistance at such time as I offer it.\n\nI have spoken to Captain Sarakan, and learned something about the task he has for me. He has found a magical means of creating a portal to some underwater ruin, and wants my help in exploring it. I and any companions who go through (or are later summoned) will be provided magical protection against drowning. This will last four hours, and I should not return through the portal until I have accomplished the task, as this will disrupt the spell. Operating underwater will slow me down and reduce the effectiveness of attacks, prevent the use of missile weapons, and render any spells that involve the use of fire of limited effectiveness (at best). I should speak to him again at such time as I am ready to undertake a quest with these difficulties.

src:
Sons of malicious, predatory mothers, hagspawn are not a complete race, as there are no females of their kind. Hags continue their awful lineage by taking human males for mates, usually murdering and devouring the hapless captive later. The female children of a hag quickly grow into hags like their mothers, but the male children are hagspawn, half-human outcasts. dst: 女巫 防护秩序
桌子上放着一些文件。翻阅它们，你发现它们详细描述了吞噬之火教团计划以各种方式破坏和颠覆城市的主要神庙。显然，该教团认为这些机构行使的权力和影响力是其自身目标的潜在障碍。文件中包括鼓励受害神庙将麻烦归咎于敌对宗教的计划，以便各个组织能够开始互相争斗，替教团完成一些工作，并制造冲突，使渴望和平的民政当局不信任它们。
src: Some papers are lying on this desk. Looking through them, you see that they detail plans on the part of the Consuming Fire Order to sabotage and subvert the major temples of the city in various ways. Clearly the order regarded the power and influence exercised by these institutions as potential obstacles to its own goals. dst: 即时扩展

扎拉拉给了我一封信，让我交给伊纳斯·森卡尔，一位住在“学者角落”的历史学家。扎拉拉希望他协助研究古代巨灵魔法，尤其是关于卡洛玛斯·泽卡尔拥有的那把古老魔法剑，她小时候曾激活过它的力量。她告诉我，除了把详细说明她愿望的信交给他之外，我还可以提供最多5000金币（稍后由扎拉拉支付）以确保他协助。

我已经和伊纳斯·森卡尔谈过，但他不愿意仅仅为了钱而帮助扎拉拉。相反，他要我去被称为“黑暗卡林港”的古老废墟中寻找对历史研究有价值的东西，最好是一些书面记录（如果它能保存这么久，也许可以在石碑之类的东西上找到）。我听说人们可以在下水道的多个地点进入黑暗卡林港。也许在下水道系统的某处可以进入一处合适的废墟，让我找到森卡尔所要的东西。无论如何，如果想在这件事上取得任何进展，看来我必须这么做。

我在探索黑暗卡林港时设法找到了一件合适的物品。我应该把它带给森卡尔。
src:
Zarala has given me a letter to take to Inas Senkhar, a historian living in the "Scholar's Corner." Zarala wants his assistance in researching ancient djinni magic, particularly regarding the ancient magical sword owned by Kalomas Zekar whose powers she was able to activate as a child. She has told me that in addition to taking him the letter detailing her wishes, I can offer him up to 5000 gold (to be paid later by Zarala) to secure his assistance.

I have spoken to Inas Senkhar, but he is not willing to assist Zarala solely in exchange for money. Instead he wants me to search the old ruins known as "Dark Calimport" for something of value to historical research, preferably some kind of written record (perhaps to be found on a stone tablet or the like if it has survived this long). I am told that one can gain access to Dark Calimport at various points in the sewers. Perhaps somewhere in the sewer system there is access to a suitable set of ruins where I can find what Senkhar seeks. At any rate, it seems I must if any progress is to be made on this matter.

I managed to locate an appropriate item while exploring Dark Calimport. I should bring it to Senkhar.

（进阶职业）
魔法飞弹是龙与地下城中最具标志性的元素之一，是许多奥术施法者钟爱的招牌法咒，也是纯粹魔法力量的典范。因此，一群奥术施法者将他们的研究集中于这个法咒，决心将它的施法技巧完善到超越一切的程度，也就不足为奇了。当这些施法者痴迷地探索魔法飞弹的秘密并拓展它的边界时，这个法咒的每一个符文和魔法符号都不可阻挡地铭刻在他们的脑海中。这种专注研究的结果，是能够扭曲施放魔法飞弹所涉及的魔法能量，从而创造出增强该法咒效果的新能力。最终，最虔诚的研究者会对魔法的运作方式产生新的理解，揭示出普通施法者无法触及的深不可测的力量。这些受到启发的施法者被称为魔弹射手。

其他施法者不理解魔弹射手只专注于一个法咒的执着，并对他们眼中误入歧途的研究皱眉不已。在他们看来，魔弹射手是所有施法者的耻辱，因为他们将自身对魔法的理解局限于钻研一个许多人认为终究微不足道的法咒的秘密。由于这种蔑视，魔弹射手避开他们那些研究更广泛的同行，要么暗中进行研究，要么离群索居。这导致许多人过上了流浪者的生活，从一所学院或图书馆旅行到下一所，了解更多关于他们所选法咒的知识并探索世界。

src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
The spell magic missile is one of the most iconic elements of Dungeons and Dragons, a favored staple of many arcane spellcasters and an example of raw magical force. Thus, it is no wonder that a cabal of arcane spellcasters focuses their studies on this spell, determined to perfect its casting technique above all others. As these spellcasters obsessively explore magic missile's secrets and press its boundaries, every rune and magical symbol of the spell becomes inexorably etched upon their minds. The outcome of such focused study results in the ability to warp the magical energies involved in casting magic missile, which leads to the creation of new abilities that augment the spell's effects. Eventually the most devoted researchers come to a new understanding of how magic works, revealing unplumbed depths of power out of the reach of ordinary spellcasters. These inspired spellcasters are known as force missile mages. 

Other spellcasters don't understand the force missile mages' dedication to only one spell and frown upon what they see as misguided research. In their reasoning, force missile mages are a discredit to all spellcasters as they limit their understanding of magic to delve into the secrets of what many see as ultimately an insignificant spell. Due to this disdain, force missile mages avoid their more widely studied peers, either pursuing their studies subtly or in seclusion. This has led many to take up the life of a wanderer, traveling from one school or library to the next, learning more about their spell of choice and exploring the world. 

- Hit Die: d4
- Proficiencies: A Force Missile gains no additional proficiencies
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS: 

Skills: Concentration 9 ranks, Spellcraft 9 ranks
Feats: Combat Casting

CLASS FEATURES:

Level 
1: Bonus Missile - Magic Missile has an extra missile
2: Swift Shield - Cast Shield as a swift action 1/day
3: Overpowering Missile - +2 bonus to break through spell resistance
4: Reflective Shield - Reflect all magic missiles back to caster
5: Bonus Missile

Type of Feat: Epic
Prerequisite: One least, lesser, greater, and dark eldritch essence invocation, Spellcraft 24 ranks.
Specifics: When you use the eldritch blast ability, you can apply two eldritch essence invocations simultaneously. You could choose to fire an eldritch blast with both the binding blast and noxious blast eldritch essences. This also allows you to apply the same effect twice, though this is not beneficial in the case of all eldritch essences. The effects of each essence are resolved separately. If you imbue your eldritch blast with two different types of damage, half of the damage (rounded down) is dealt by each source. You must choose which essences you will use in conjunction with your eldritch blast before you start your action. If you possess the Eldritch Sculptor feat, you can apply two eldritch essence invocations to both your eldritch blasts in a single round. Activating this ability is part of the action to use an eldritch blast.

For example, if Morthos is fighting an outsider he has never encountered, he can choose to imbue his eldritch blast with both hellrime blast and brimstone blast. He rolls 10d6 damage, dealing half fire and half cold damage. If the outsider happened to be immune to cold, but not fire, it would still take damage from the half that dealt fire damage.

In addition, the DC of all eldritch essence invocations you use increases by 2. This is an extraordinary ability.

You can use this feat to toggle which essence slot your activated essence invocations go into.
Use: Selected.

src:
Far stronger and faster than other humanoid races, centaurs rule huge swathes of the wild. They build peaceful, idyllic communities, hunting what and where they wish. Centaurs inhabit the plains and forests in tribes of varying size. Even though they build permanent shelters and live in one place for many years at a time, centaurs roam from their homes on a regular basis, ranging over great distances 
in relatively short amounts of time. Centaurs regard such excursions as essential to understanding the world around their homes, and they greatly enjoy such activity for its own sake. Although their crafts have not reached the level of some of the humanoid races, it is only because centaurs prefer to venture from their homes often rather than to stay in one place and ply a single trade. 

Centaur Ability Adjustments: +8 Strength, +4 Dexterity, +4 Constitution, -2 Intelligence, +2 Wisdom.
Favored Class (Ranger): A multiclass Centaur's ranger class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

Large size: -1 penalty to Armor Class, -1 penalty on attack rolls, -4 penalty on Hide checks, +4 bonus on grapple checks
A centaur's base land speed is 50 feet.
Darkvision
+3 armor bonus
Racial Hit Dice: A centaur begins with four levels of monstrous humanoid, which provide 4d8 Hit Dice; a base attack bonus of +4; and base saving throw bonuses of Fort +1, Ref +4, and Will +4.
Level adjustment +2.

Prerequisite: Character level 6th
Specifics: Having this feat enables the character to attract a loyal companion and devoted follower, a subordinate who assists her. See the table below for what level of cohort the character can recruit.

A characters base Leadership score equals his level plus any Charisma modifier. In order to take into account negative Charisma modifiers, this table allows for very low Leadership scores, but the character must still be 6th level or higher in order to gain the Leadership feat.

The character can attract a single cohort of up to this level. Regardless of a characters Leadership score, he can only recruit a cohort who is two or more levels lower than himself. The cohort does not have any equipment of their own, that must be provided for them A character can try to attract a cohort of a particular race, class, and alignment. The cohorts alignment may not be opposed to the leaders alignment on either the law-vs-chaos or good-vs-evil axis, and the leader takes a Leadership penalty if she recruits a cohort of an alignment different from her own.

Cohorts earn XP as follows:
The cohort does not count as a party member when determining the party's XP.
Divide the cohorts level by the level of the PC with whom he is associated (the character with the Leadership feat who attracted the cohort).
Multiply this result by the total XP awarded to the PC and add that number of experience points to the cohorts total.
If a cohort gains enough XP to bring it to a level one lower than the associated PCs character level, the cohort does not gain the new level. Instead, the cohorts new XP total is 1 less than the amount needed attain the next level.

src:
Gold dragons hate injustice and foul play, but few things anger them more than tyranny of the strong over the weak, or the small.  When a gold dragon's territory includes or is near a halfling village, they often appoint themselves protector and take of threats too powerful for the halflings to handle alone.  Such villages seldom, if ever, learn of those dangers or of their guardian.  The dragon often walks among its charges, appearing as a small animal or as a halfling looking to settle in the town.  While any relationships from this are short-lived as far as the dragon is concerned, the signs of draconic heritage live on long after among the village inhabitants.  These dragonblooded halflings look for the most part like their more mundane kin, but bear a golden sheen to their complexion and inevitably have golden flecks in their eyes.  They also tend to show traits of nobility and courage, standing up to any threat they encounter.

Halfling Ability Adjustments: +2 Dex, -2 Str.

Favored Class (Rogue): A multiclass glimmerskin halfling's rogue class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

- Small Stature:
 +1 size bonus to attack rolls.
 +1 size bonus to AC.
 +4 size bonus to Hide checks.
- Skill Affinity (Listen): +2 racial bonus to Listen checks.
- Skill Affinity (Jump): +2 racial bonus to Jump checks.
- Lucky: +1 luck bonus to all saving throws.
- Fearless: +2 morale bonus to saving throws against spells and effects of the 'Fear' subtype.
- Good Aim: +1 racial bonus to attack rolls made with throwing weapons.
- Touch of Luck: Once per day, a glimmerskin halfling can grant himself or an ally within 30' a +2 bonus to saves for one round as an immediate action.
- Dragonblooded: Glimmerskin Halflings have the dragonblood subtype.
- Halfling: Glimmerskin Halflings count as Halflings for the purpose of spells.

dst: "虽然我不知道这些信息有多大用处，但我听说过这个诺莫格-盖亚。3000多年前，卡林杉的人民与一支庞大的大地精军队开战，他们来自一个叫做诺莫格-盖亚的地方，或者崇拜一位名叫诺莫格-盖亚的神明之类的。最终地精被击败，他们所崇拜的、激励他们作战的巨大神像也被摧毁了。我想知道这个地方是不是那个时代遗留下来的？当然，与那些大地精的最终决战发生在奥姆拉兰丁山脉，即今天的泰瑟尔，但他们无疑在其他地方也有基地。无论如何，据我所知，我们现在可能就在奥姆拉兰丁山脉之下。谁知道那个界门把我们带到了哪里？"
src: "While I don't know how useful the information might be, I have heard of this Nomog-Geaya. More than 3000 years ago the people of Calimshan waged a war against a great army of hobgoblins who were from someplace they called Nomog-Geaya, or worshipped a deity named that or something. Ultimately the goblins were defeated, and the great idol they worshipped, inspiring their efforts, was destroyed. I wonder if this place is something left over from those times? Of course the final confrontation with those hobgoblins occured in the Omlarandin Mountains in what is today Tethyr, but they doubtless had some bases elsewhere. In any case for all I know we are now under the Omlarandins. Who knows where that portal took us?"

A Sublime Chord of 6th level or higher with 16 or more ranks in the Perform skill knows the Song of Timelessness. As a standard action she can envelop a single creature within 60 feet in a field of timelessness, provided she has line of effect to the target. The subject is entitled to a Will save (DC10 + Sublime Chord level + Cha modifier) to negate the effect.
If the subject fails it's save, it is frozen in a shimmering aura of timelessness and can take no actions. However, no force can affect it - weapons can not reach it, spells that target it automatically fail, and if the ground it is standing on is somehow taken away, it would not even begin to fall. A Sublime Chord can keep it's target frozen in time for as long as she maintains the power by continuing to perform, up to a maximum of 1 minute per level. When she stops performing, the subject immediately returns to normal. As far as the creature is concerned, no time seems to have passed.

Ashardalon, Pyre of the Unborn
    
A seeker of pure power and wealth, the fiendish red dragon Ashardalon was among the toughest creatures of his era. Having escaped death more than once, he grants binders some of his powers as a dragon and fiend, as well as a portion of his great resilience.
  
Vestige Level: 8th
Binding DC: 35
Special Requirement: No
  
Influence: You greatly hunger for vengeance against those who harm or slight you. Ashardalon requires you to accept any opportunity to strike a foe who damages or insults you in preference over any other target. 
  
Granted Abilities: 
Ashardalon grants you some of the vast power he collected during his life as a dragon and a fiendish creature.

Ashardalon's Creed: You gain a bonus on Appraise checks and Search checks equal to your binder level. You can also locate objects near you, as the spell locate object at will.

Ashardalon's Presence: You can strike fear into the hearts of your foes. This acts as the fear spell. Once you have used this ability, you cannot use it again for 5 rounds.

Ashardalon's Vigor: Ashardalon grants you some of the vast resilience he enjoyed in life. When you bind this vestige, you gain temporary hit points equal to twice your binder level. These temporary hit points last for up to 24 hours.

Fiend's Heart: You share some of the defensive benefits of the balor once bound to Ashardalon's body. This effect grants you damage reduction 10/+3 and resistance to fire 30.

src: Kadzia has warned me that upon reaching the ground floor of the Zekar tower, I will be transported as I traverse it to the fiery planar trap I was in earlier. To determine the correct order, I must locate the unlighted brazier, to the northeast of the poratl. Casting a spell on it that involves fire, such as Burning Hands or Fireball, will cause it to light up, and as it does I will see the flames take on the shape of numbers. src: The Broken Ones are an order of monks dedicated to Ilmater, god of compassion and perseverance. Ilmater encourages his followers to willingly embrace suffering in service to others, and his monks have a tendency towards extreme asceticism. Rather than seeking to avoid pain, the Broken Ones willingly endure it for the sake of spiritual benefits. The enhancements on this robe reflect this philosophy: rather than increasing armor protection, like most monk robes, it instead increases the capacity to endure. A monk equipped with this robe will be easy to hurt, but hard to kill.

src: Upon arriving in the village of Tebnas, near the Forest of Mir, to reinforce the army regiment supposed to be protecting it, I found the place in flames and under assault by a horde of goblins. I defeated the goblins in the immediate vicinity, and spoke to the mayor of the village. He informed me that the regiment I was supposed to reinforce had already entered the forest, and apparently been defeated by the unusually large and capable goblin forces about, since shortly afterwards came the attack on the village. However, sounds of fighting can still be heard coming from the forest, presumably from remnants of the regiment still offering some resistance. It would seem I must head further into the forest to rescue any survivors of the regiment and hopefully find some way of discouraging the goblins from aggressive action against this poorly defended region.\n\nPressing into the woods, I found some information about the goblinoid army in a cave they were using as a supply depot. There were references to one Ulaz, apparently their commander, and to a fortress located deeper in the woods, apparently their main base of operations. If I could slay this Ulaz or destroy this base that would doubtless do much to cripple the power of this goblin horde, though I am not sure how easy a task this would be.

src:
Krenshar Mask

Descriptors: Fear, mind-affecting, sonic  
Classes: Totemist  
Chakra: Brow (totem) 
Saving Throw: See text

You form incarnum into a snarling, bestial mask of exposed bone and muscle. Its basic form is somewhere between that of a large cat and a wolf, but it lacks skin, showing sharp teeth, white bone, and pink-red muscles.

While wearing your krenshar mask, you gain a +4 competence bonus on Jump and Move Silently checks. 

Essentia: Every point of essentia you invest in your krenshar mask increases your competence bonus on Jump and Move Silently checks by 2. 
 
Chakra Bind (Brow) 

Your eyes stare forth from your krenshar mask, taking on a green-blue color. The jaws of the mask move as you speak, its muscles flexing weirdly in full view-an intimidating effect, to say the least.

As a result of the mask's frightful appearance, you gain a competence bonus on Intimidate checks equal to the bonus the mask gives on Jump and Move Silently checks. 

Chakra Bind (Totem) 

Your face becomes one with your krenshar mask, so all its muscles move to match your expressions. A ridge of skin around the edge of the mask quivers when you grow angry or enter combat, and a growling edge creeps into your voice.

You gain the ability to produce a loud screech (as a standard action) similar to that of a krenshar. In combination with the frightening aspect of the mask, this shriek causes one creature within 30 feet of you to become frightened for 1 round if it fails a Will save. This is a sonic, mind-affecting fear effect.

（进阶职业）
如同圣武士，光之战士致力于消灭所有邪恶生物，并且总是愿意帮助他人。他们经常与圣武士和其他善良阵营的盟友合作。

- 生命骰：d10。
- 武器和防具擅长：所有简单和军用武器，所有护甲和盾牌。
- 技能点：2+ 智力调整值。

要求：

基础攻击加值：+5
阵营：中立善良
技能：知识 4 级。
特殊：必须信仰 Elishar.（选择该职业的牧师必须拥有以下领域中的两个：善良，治疗，知识，幸运，保护，太阳。）

职业特性：

等级
1：驱散亡灵 - 如同与光之战士职业等级相同的牧师。这可以与任何牧师和/或圣武士等级叠加。
2：神恩 - 将魅力加值应用于所有豁免检定。
  击退亡灵 - 可以在对抗亡灵目标时，将感知加值加到攻击加值上。如果攻击命中，该打击每点感知加值造成 1 点正能量伤害。每天可使用 3 次，每天每点魅力加值 +1 次。
3：正能量坚韧 - 对抗死灵系法咒和吸取效果时，所有豁免检定获得 +2。
4：能量同伴 - 可以召唤一个 扎格-亚 同伴（正能量异界生物），每天 1 次。
5：神罚 - 可以花费 2 次驱散亡灵尝试，为施法者的武器添加 +2d6 对抗亡灵的正能量伤害（1 轮/魅力加值，最少 1 轮）.
6：-
7：快速治疗 1 - 每轮恢复 1 点生命值。
8：正能量速度爆发 - 可以花费两次驱散亡灵尝试，伤害角色 100 英尺内的所有亡灵，每光之战士等级造成 1d6 正能量伤害。受影响的亡灵可以进行反射豁免（DC: 10 + 光之战士等级） 以减半伤害。
  强化能量同伴：你的同伴获得 +2 生命骰。
9：-
10：快速治疗 2 - 每轮恢复 2 点生命值。

法咒列表：
基于感知以牧师方式施放法咒，施法者等级等于职业等级（加上任何适用的进阶职业）.

1 级：治疗轻伤，祝福武器，祝福，魔化武器，虔诚护盾，防护邪恶，光亮
2 级：治疗中度伤，援助，祝圣，次级复原术
3 级：治疗重伤，高等魔化武器，反邪恶法阵，灼热光辉，防护负能量，祈祷，移除疾病
4 级：治疗致命伤，防死结界，神圣武器，复原术

传奇：

13：治疗领域 - 治疗法咒被强化。
16：最大化驱散亡灵 - 当你驱散亡灵时，你的驱散伤害乘以 2（不与强效驱散叠加）.
19：快速治疗 3 - 每轮恢复 3 点生命值。
22：至高正能量速度爆发：现在你使用正能量速度爆发时只花费 1 次驱散尝试。

奖励专长：传奇光之战士在 10 级后每三级获得一个奖励专长。

光之战士奖励专长列表：
护甲皮肤，灰飞烟灭性重击，传奇声望，传奇坚韧，传奇武器专攻，传奇威能，强力击退，高等感知，压倒重击，完美健康，位面驱散。
src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
Like the paladin, the Soldier of Light is devoted to the destruction of all evil creatures and is always willing to help others. They often co-operate with paladin and other allies of good alignment.

- Hit Die: d10.
- Proficiencies: All simple and martial weapons, all armor and shields.
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:

Base Attack Bonus: +5
Alignment: Neutral Good
Skills: Lore 4 ranks.
Special: Must worship Elishar. (Clerics taking this class must have two of the following domains: Good, Healing, Knowledge, Luck, Protection, Sun.)

CLASS FEATURES:

Level
1: Turn Undead - As a cleric of the same class level as the Soldier of Light. This stacks with any levels of Cleric and/or Paladin.
2: Divine Grace - Applies Charisma bonus to all saving throws.
  Smite Undead - May add Wisdom bonus to attack bonus against an undead target. If the strike hits, the blow deals 1 point of positive damage per point of Wisdom bonus. Usable 3/day, +1 per Charisma bonus/day.
3: Positive Fortitude - Gains +2 to all saving throws against necromantic spells and drain effects.
4: Energon Companion - May summon a Xag-Ya companion (positive energy outsider), 1/day.
5: Divine Vengeance - May spend 2 Turn Undead attempts to add +2d6 positive damage against Undead to the caster's weapon (1 round/Cha bonus, minimum 1 round).
6: -
7: Fast Healing 1 - Regenerate 1 HP/round.
8: Positive Energy Burst - May spend two Turn Undead attempts to damage all undead within 100 feet of the character, dealing 1d6 positive damage per Soldier of Light level. Undead affected may make a reflex save (DC: 10 + Soldier of Light levels) for half damage.
  Improved Energon Companion: your companion gains +2HD.
9: -
10: Fast Healing 2 - Regenerate 2 HP/round.

SPELL LIST:
Casts spells as a cleric based on Wisdom with a caster level equal to class level (plus any applicable PrCs).

Level 1: Cure Light Wounds, Bless Weapon, Bless, Magic Weapon Shield of Faith, Protection from Evil, Light
Level 2: Cure Moderate Wounds, Aid, Consecrate Lesser Restoration
Level 3: Cure Serious Wounds, Greater Magic Weapon, Magic Circle against Evil, Searing Light, Negative Energy Protection, Prayer, Remove Disease
Level 4: Cure Critical Wounds, Death Ward, Holy Sword, Restoration

EPIC:

13: Healing Domain - Healing spells are empowered.
16: Maximize Turn Undead - When you turn undead, your turn damage is multiplied by 2 (Don't stacks with Empower Turning).
19: Fast Healing 3 - Regenerate 3 HP/round.
22: Supreme Positive Energy Burst: Now you only spend 1 turn attempt when you use Positive Energy Burst.

Bonus Feats: The epic Soldier of Light gains a bonus feat every three levels after 10th.

Soldier of Light Bonus Feats List:
Armor Skin, Devastating Critical, Epic Reputation, Epic Toughness, Epic Weapon Focus, Epic Prowess, Great Smiting, Great Wisdom, Overwhelming Critical, Perfect Health, Planar Turning.

dst: 本书是一本手册，旨在帮助任何违背自身意愿变成兽化人的人减轻甚至治愈自身的状况。除其他信息外，书中还包含使用颠茄草调配药剂的配方，这些药剂或许能治愈感染兽化症的人。书中警告说，这些药剂并非总能可靠奏效，有时甚至会致受试者于死地，但也提供了降低这种不理想结果出现概率的指导。任何想要对抗兽化诅咒的人，都很难找到比这更好的参考手册。
src: This book is a manual intended to assist anyone who has become a werecreature against his will in mitigating or even curing his condition. Among other information, it contains formulae for using the belladonna herb to concoct potions that may cure those afflicted with lycanthropy. It warns that these do not always work reliably and can sometimes kill the subject, but provides guidance in ways to reduce the probability of such an unsatisfactory outcome. Anyone seeking to combat a lycanthropic curse could hardly find a better reference manual.

你在底面或其他水平表面上创造一个圆圈，如同高等传送术一般，将任何站在其上的生物传送到指定地点。一旦你指定了圆圈的传送目的地，就无法更改。如果你试图将圆圈设定为把生物传送到固体物体内，传送到你不熟悉且没有清晰描述的地方，或传送到另一个位面，则此异能失败。

注意：诸如传送法阵之类的魔法陷阱很难被发现和解除。只有游荡者可以使用搜索技能找到圆圈，并使用解除装置技能来阻止它。每种情况的 DC 为 25 + 法术等级，对于传送法阵则为 34。
src:
Psychoportation (Teleportation)
Level: Nomad 9
Manifesting Time: 10 minutes
Range: 0 ft.
Effect: 5-ft.-radius circle that teleports those who activate it
Duration: 10 min./level
Saving Throw: None
Power Resistance: Yes
Power Points: 17
Metapsionics: Extend

You create a circle on the floor or other horizontal surface that teleports, as greater teleport, any creature who stands on it to a designated spot. Once you designate the destination for the circle, you cant change it. The power fails if you attempt to set the circle to teleport creatures into a solid object, to a place with which you are not familiar and have no clear description, or to another plane.

The circle itself is subtle and nearly impossible to notice. If you intend to keep creatures from activating it accidentally, you need to mark the circle in some way.

Note: Magic traps such as teleportation circle are hard to detect and disable. A rogue (only) can use the Search skill to find the circle and Disable Device to thwart it. The DC in each case is 25 + spell level, or 34 in the case of teleportation circle.

src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
Combat magic is usually reserved for spellcasters in the second rank who are content to lob spells as if artillery from behind the cover of front-rank combatants. Not so the havoc mage, who shares as much in common with a fighter as with a wizard. The havoc mage has learned to toss off spells with such reckless abandon that he can fight head-to-head with both sword and spell without incurring the bitter consequences other spellcasters must contend with. A havoc mage is interested in maximum carnage in the shortest amount of time, by dint of a quick spell cast where an enemy least expects it. A havoc mage must first learn the ways of arcane magic, so those most likely to take up the sword (to complement the wand) are sorcerers and wizards. These normally sedate characters are drawn to the frenzy of battle, during which a flashing sword can be just as effect in their own hands as a well timed spell.

- Hit Die: d8.
- Proficiencies: A havoc mage does not gain any additional weapon or armor proficiencies.
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:

Arcane Spellcasting: Able to cast 2nd-level spells.
Base Attack Bonus: +4
Skills: Lore 5 ranks.

CLASS FEATURES:

Level
1: Battlecast 2nd level - A havoc mage gains the ability to cast 2nd level or lower spells while making a single weapon attack. Casting a spell in this manner does not provoke an attack of opportunity.
3: Battlecast 4th level
5: Battlecast 8th level

BONUS SPELLS

Every other level in Havoc Mage, the character gains new spells per day as if he had also gained a level in his highest arcane caster class. He does not learn any new spells through his abilities.

src: Upon arriving in the village of Tebnas, near the Forest of Mir, to reinforce the army regiment supposed to be protecting it, I found the place in flames and under assault by a horde of goblins. I defeated the goblins in the immediate vicinity, and spoke to the mayor of the village. He informed me that the regiment I was supposed to reinforce had already entered the forest, and apparently been defeated by the unusually large and capable goblin forces about, since shortly afterwards came the attack on the village. However, sounds of fighting can still be heard coming from the forest, presumably from remnants of the regiment still offering some resistance. It would seem I must head further into the forest to rescue any survivors of the regiment and hopefully find some way of discouraging the goblins from aggressive action against this poorly defended region.\n\nThe goblins are using an old fortress as a base. Unfortunately the only way in is blocked by a field of magical force, but a pixie named Zeepa has told me that one Gorav, a lieutenant of the goblin leader Ulaz, should have a wardstone that allows access to it.

src:
Dragonfire Mask

Descriptors: Draconic, Fire
Classes: Totemist
Chakra: Brow, throat (totem)
Saving Throw: See text

Incarnum forms a dragon head of dull blue fire that wreaths your head and floats above your shoulders. It stares straight ahead, its expression unchanging. The eyes and mouth of the dragon head are full of brighter, flickering fire that shoots out light.

You gain low-light vision while this soulmeld is shaped.

Essentia: For every point of essentia invested in your dragonfire mask, you gain a +2 competence bonus on Spot checks.

Chakra Bind (Brow)

Your own eyes flicker with the same flames that burn within your dragon head.

You gain darkvision out to 60 feet (or your existing darkvision extends another 30 feet).

Chakra Bind (Throat)

A seething ring of fire encircles your neck, and wisps of smoke occasionally burst from the dragon head.

You gain the ability to emit a fiery breath weapon as a standard action. The breath weapon is a 30-foot cone that deals 2d6 points of fire damage + an extra 1d6 points of fire damage for every point of essentia invested in your dragonfire mask. Targets are allowed a Reflex save for half damage. After using your breath weapon, you must wait 1d4 rounds before you can use it again.

Chakra Bind (Totem)

The dragon head becomes a solid blue mask, forming a hollow shape that completely encloses your head at a distance. Fire still trails from its eyes and open mouth.

You can emanate an aura of frightful presence once per round as a swift action. All creatures within 10 feet with fewer Hit Dice than you become shaken for 1 round. A successful Will save negates the effect and renders the creature immune to the frightful presence of this soulmeld for 24 hours. For every point of essentia you have invested in your dragonfire mask, the radius of the frightful presence increases by 10 feet, and its duration increases by 1 round.

林灾审判者是处理那些不光彩之事--通常涉及清除人类--的首选之人。当精灵的敌人无论在物理，魔法还是政治上都有周全保护时--而那些伟大的领主和贵妇们又不敢为了从人类侵占中保护精灵家园的核心而弄脏自己的手--他们便会求助于你，林灾审判者。你手持长弓，自然之力听你号令，你出击，一个无声无息的狙击手，解决掉二十个外交官一百年也解决不了的问题--然后在敌人残余势力还没意识到你曾在那里之前，就已融回森林之中。

src:
The justice of weald and woe is the go-to person when something unsavory - usually involving the removal of humans - needs doing. When the foes of the elves are well protected physically, magically, and politically - and the grand lords and ladies dare not sully their hands with the dirty necessities of preserving the heart of elvendom from human encroachment - it is to you, the justice of weald and woe, that they turn. With your bow in hand and the power of nature at your command, you strike, a silent, unseen sniper, solving problems a score of diplomats couldn't solve in a hundred years - then melt back into the forest before what is left of the enemy's forces even knows you were there.

Requirements:
Base Attack Bonus: +6
Skills: Craft Weapon 8, Hide 8, Lore 4, Move Silently 8
Feats: Point Blank Shot, Weapon Focus (Longbow)

CLASS FEATURES:
Hit die: d8

Spellcasting: You gain spells per day as per the following tables.  You do not gain spells per day in any existing spellcasting class.  You can only choose spells from the justice spell list.

      1st    2nd    3rd   4th
1     0      -      -     -
2     1      -      -     -
3     2      0      -     -
4     3      1      -     -
5     3      2      0     -
6     3      3      1     -
7     3      3      2     0
8     3      3      3     1
9     3      3      3     2
10    3      3      3     3

Bonus Feats: At 2nd and 8th levels, you gain a bonus archery feat. When you gain a new bonus feat, you must choose from the following list: Deflect Arrows, Far Shot, Improved Critical (longbow), Improved Precise Shot, Manyshot, Mounted Archery, Precise Shot, Rapid Shot, Shot on the Run, Snatch Arrows, Weapon Specialization (longbow only), Greater Weapon Focus (longbow only), Greater Weapon Specialization (longbow only). You must meet all prerequisites for a bonus feat. Use your justice level when determining whether you meet a prerequisite of a minimum fighter level. For example, a ranger 8/justice 8 would meet the requirement for Greater Weapon Focus (fighter level 8th), but not Greater Weapon Specialization (fighter level 12th).

Woodland Stride (Ex): At 2nd level, you can move through any sort of undergrowth.

Sneak Attack (Ex): Beginning at 3rd and 7th level, you deal an extra 1d6 points of damage when striking an opponent when the opponent is denied a Dexterity bonus to armor class, such as when it is surprised and flat-footed, or when you attack from
a flanking position, as the sneak attack ability of rogues. Your damage dice stack with any sneak attack damage dice you might have gained from a previous class.

Lucky Shot (Su): Once per day as a free action, you can gain a +10 insight bonus to one attack roll with your longbow.

Trackless Step (Ex): At 4th level and higher, you leave no trail in natural surroundings and cannot be tracked. You can leave a trail on purpose if you so desire.

Poison Use (Ex): At 5th level, you learn to create and/or extract natural poisons and apply them to your weapons without any danger of harming yourself.

Hide in Plain Sight (Ex): At 9th level, you gain the ability to hide in plain sight.

Death Attack (Ex): At 10th level, you gain the ability to study your victim for 3 rounds and then make a sneak attack with a longbow that, if it successfully deals damage, has the additional effect of possibly either paralyzing or killing the target (your choice).

Poison Immunity (Ex): At 10th level, you gain immunity to poisons and animal venoms.

dst: 狂念者 反转灵能

（基础职业）
万物皆归于暗影，甚至光亦是如此。暗影并不代表光的缺失；它们昭示着黑暗的存在。因此，暗影与黑暗并非死亡或消亡；它们是宇宙的基本状态，是过去存在，现在存在，并将在万物寂灭之时依然存在的恒常。影之平面亦是如此，它是物质位面与诸多其他现实的黑暗镜像。影法师汲取这最根本的力量与位面，以施行其黑暗意志。通过将自身与影之平面相连，他们维系着与存在终极力量的微弱联系。

影法师理解黑暗真正原始的力量，使自身与影之平面同调，并习得堪比任何寻常法咒的伟大暗影秘术。这些黑暗施法者是异界魔法的操控者，拥有着连其他施法者都感到不安的，对世界与魔法的秘传理解。他们是黑暗力量的主人 - 也许，正如某些人所担忧的，也是其仆从。

- 生命骰：d6
- 擅长：你擅长所有简易武器。你不擅长任何类型的护甲或盾牌。任何类型的护甲都会干扰你的手势，这可能导致你的秘术在作为法咒运作时失败。
- 技能点：2+ 智力调整值。

职业特性：

等级
1：暗影基础 - 你初始可获取 3 个基础秘术，它们作为超自然能力运作，每天可使用 3 次。
    学徒秘术 - 你可以学习学徒秘术。
2：奖励专长
3：幽影视觉 - 黑暗视觉
4：奖励基础秘术
7：学徒秘术（类法咒），入门秘术
8：奖励基础秘术
11：幽影视觉 - 昏暗视觉
12：奖励基础秘术
13：学徒秘术（超自然），入门秘术（类法咒），大师秘术
14：基础秘术无限使用
15：维系暗影 I - 免疫毒素与疾病
16：奖励基础秘术
20：奖励基础秘术
    维系暗影 II - 免疫睡眠
    
秘术 - 你不像其他职业那样施放法咒，而是调用被称为秘术的神秘秘密。你在 1 级时知晓一个秘术，并且每提升一个职业等级再获得一个额外秘术。直到 6 级，你只能学习学徒秘术。在 7 级时，你获得入门秘术的获取权限，在 13 级时你能够使用大师秘术。在一个类别（学徒，入门，大师） 内，你只有学会了至少两个前一等级的秘术，才能学习一个新等级的秘术。然而，你总是可以选择你拥有获取权限的类别中最低等级的秘术。例如，即使你不知道任何 3 级秘术（所有这些都属于学徒类别），你也可以学习一个 4 级秘术（入门类别）.

当你只能施放学徒秘术时，你施放它们如同它们是奥术法咒。它们都具有姿势成分，基于护甲的法术失败率，并且可以被中断（但它们不需要材料成分，法器或语言成分）.在 7 级时，当你能够施放入门秘术时，你的学徒秘术作为类法术能力运作，并且不再需要姿势成分。你新的入门秘术作为奥术法咒运作，并遵循上述规则。当你达到 13 级并能够施放大师秘术时，另一个变化发生了。你的大师秘术现在作为奥术法咒运作，而你的入门秘术作为类法术能力运作。你的学徒秘术变为超自然能力，其 DC 公式变为 10 + 1/2 施法者等级 + 魅力，并且施放时不再引发借机攻击。

你每天可以使用每个你所知晓的秘术一定次数，具体取决于它是作为法咒（一次），类法术能力（两次） 还是超自然能力（三次） 施放。为了施放一个秘术，你的智力属性必须至少达到 10 + 该秘术的等级。你的秘术豁免 DC 等于 10 + 秘术等级 + 你的魅力调整值。最后，如果你的魅力足够高，你每天会获得奖励秘术。这遵循与术士或法师相同的公式。
奖励专长 - 你获得的奖励专长数量等于你完成的总道途数（道途是3个秘术的集合，全部属于同一类别）.你必须满足先决条件才能选择专长作为奖励专长。你可以选择的专长列表包括偏好秘术，高等道途专攻，夜行施法者，道途专攻，暗影施法以及任何超魔暗影专长。
src:
(BASE CLASS)
All things fall into shadow, even light. Shadows do not represent the absence of light; they show the presence of darkness. Thus, shadow and darkness are not death or diminishment; they are the fundamental state of the universe, the constant that existed before, that exists now, and that will exist when all other things are snuffed out. So it is with the Plane of Shadow, that dark mirror to the Material Plane and many other realities. Shadowcasters tap into this most fundamental of forces and planes to work their dark wills. By tying themselves to the Plane of Shadow, they maintain a tenuous link to the ultimate force of existence. 

The shadowcaster understands the true, primal power of darkness, attunes herself to the Plane of Shadow, and learns great shadow mysteries the equal of any mundane spell. These dark casters are workers of alien magic, possessing an occult understanding of the world and magic that even other spellcasters find disturbing. They are masters of a dark power - and perhaps, as some worry, its servants as well.

- Hit Die: d6
- Proficiencies: You are proficient with all simple weapons. You are not proficient with any type of armor or shield. Armor of any type interferes with your gestures, which can cause your mysteries to fail when they function as spells.
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

CLASS FEATURES:

Level
1:  Fundamentals of Shadow - You start with access to 3 fundamentals, which function as supernatural abilities and can be used 3 times/day.
    Apprentice Mysteries - You can learn apprentice mysteries.
2:  Bonus Feats
3:  Umbral Sight - Darkvision
4:  Bonus fundamental
7:  Apprentice Mysteries (spell-like), Initiate Mysteries
8:  Bonus fundamental
11: Umbral Sight - Low Light Vision
12: Bonus fundamental
13: Apprentice Mysteries (supernatural), Initiate Mysteries (spell-like), Master Mysteries
14: Unlimited use of fundamentals
15: Sustaining Shadow I - Immune to poison and disease
16: Bonus fundamental
20: Bonus fundamental
    Sustaining Shadow II - Immune to sleep
    
Mysteries - You do not cast spells as other classes do, but instead invoke mystical secrets called mysteries. You know one mystery at 1st level and gain one additional mystery every class level. Up to 6th level, you can learn only apprentice mysteries. At 7th level, you gain access to initiate mysteries, and at 13th level you become able to use master mysteries. Within a category (apprentice, initiate, master), you can only learn mysteries of a new level if you have learned at least two mysteries of a previous level. However, you can always select the lowest level mysteries in a category you have access to. For example, you could learn a 4th level mystery (Initiate category), even if you know no 3rd level mysteries (all of which are in the Apprentice category). 

When you are capable of casting only apprentice mysteries, you cast them as though they were arcane spells. They all have somatic components, armor-based spell failure chance, and are subject to interruption (but they do not require material components, foci, or verbal components). At 7th level, when you become capable of casting initiate mysteries, your apprentice mysteries function as spell-like abilities, and they no longer require somatic components. Your new initiate mysteries function as arcane spells and follow the rules described above. When you reach 13th level and become capable of casting master mysteries, another change occurs. Your master mysteries now function as arcane spells, and your initiate mysteries function as spell-like abilities. Your apprentice mysteries become supernatural abilities, changing their DC formula to 10 + 1/2 caster level + Cha, and no longer generating attacks of opportunity when cast.

You can use each mystery you know a certain number of times per day depending on whether it is cast as a spell (once), a spell-like ability (two times), or a supernatural ability (three times). In order to cast a mystery, you must have an Intelligence score of at least 10 + the mystery's level. The save DC for your mysteries equals 10 + mystery level + your Cha modifier. Finally, you gain bonus mysteries per day if you have a high enough Charisma. This follows the same formula as sorcerer or wizard.

Bonus Feats - You gain a bonus feat equal to the total number of Paths you complete (Paths are collections of 3 mysteries, all within the same category). You must meet the prerequisites in order to select a feat as a bonus feat. The list of feats you can select is Favored Mystery, Greater Path Focus, Nocturnal Caster, Path Focus, Shadow Cast, and any metashadow feat.

src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
Noctumancers bridge the gap between shadow and arcane magic. Those who succeed in becoming one of these elite not only gain a boost to their mystery user and arcane caster abilities, but are able to manipulate the mysteries and spells of others as no others can.

- Hit Die: d4
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:
Skills: Lore rank 6, Spellcraft rank 6
Shadowcasting: Able to cast level 2 mysteries
Spellcasting: Able to cast level 2 arcane spells

CLASS FEATURES:
Level
1:  Capture Magic's Shadow (Su) - At 1st level, when you successfully dispel a mystery or spell you can absorb its energy. You add one-half
    the level of the mystery or spell you dispelled to the caster level of any mystery or spell you cast in the next round.
2:  Innate Counterspell - Starting at 2nd level, you can attempt to counter a spell without using a readied action. Once per day, you can counter a spell as an immediate action by expending a spell slot or a spell use as long as the spell expended is of the same level as the spell to be countered.
5:  Innate Counterspell - 2/day
6:  Eldritch Disruption - As a standard action, you can disrupt the magical energies of a single target within 60 feet. That target must make a Will saving throw (DC 10 + your noctumancer level + your Cha modifier) or take a -4 penalty to its caster level for any mysteries or spells it casts for 1 minute. You can use eldritch disruption three times per day.
7:  Innate Counterspell (retain power) - When you successfully counter a spell using this ability, you gain the use of a mystery of 1/2 the countered spell level.
8:  Innate Counterspell - 3/day
10: Eldritch Vortex - You can emit mystic energies in a 20-foot-radius burst around yourself. Any creature other than you within that area takes a -4 penalty to caster level for any mysteries or spells. The vortex lasts 1 minute and can be used once per day.
    Shadow's Persistence - You gain temporary immunity to any mystery or spell captured or countered by means of your capture magic's shadow or innate counterspell ability. For 1 minute, you cannot be affected by any casting of that mystery or spell.

Mysteries/Spellcasting: At each level, you gain new mysteries and spells per day and an increase in caster level (and mysteries and spells known, if applicable) as if you had gained a level in both your mystery-using class and your arcane spellcasting class.

兽人是具有侵略性的人形生物，以战争和破坏而闻名。他们比半兽人表亲更强壮，但在对外界的认知上不如半兽人明智。兽人的头发通常是黑色的，长着狼一般的耳朵和红色的眼睛。兽人相信生存取决于尽可能多地征服领土，这使得他们与其他生物的关系非常困难。兽人通常以洞穴为家，但也能在地下建造有组织的城市。他们自豪地展示战斗伤疤，作为成就的标志。

兽人属性调整：+4 力量，-2 智力，-2 魅力，-2 感知。

- 黑暗视觉：兽人能够在黑暗中视物。
- 强光敏感：兽人在明亮光线下行动时，攻击检定，豁免和检定受到 -2 惩罚。

src:
Orcs are aggressive humanoids with a reputation for war and destruction. They are stronger than their Half-Orc cousins but not as wise to the world beyond their surroundings. An orc's hair is usually black and he sports lupine ears with reddish eyes. Orcs believe that survival depends on conquering as much territory as possible, which makes relations with other creatures very difficult. Orcs often make their home in caves but are capable of building organized cities below ground. They wear their battle scars proudly as signs of achievement.

Orc Ability Adjustments: +4 Str, -2 Int, -2 Cha, -2 Wis.
Favored Class (Barbarian): A multiclass orc's barbarian class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

- Darkvision: Orcs are able to see in the dark.
- Light Sensitivity: Orcs suffer -2 penalty to attack rolls, saves and checks while operating in bright light.
- Orcish: Orcs are considered Orcish for the purpose of spells.

dst: “许多人觉得我们伊尔梅特信徒所践行的苦修——剥夺自己的舒适甚至折磨自己——怪异而不可理解。那些欲望不那么可疑的人，对他们来说，自身利益与对他人职责之间的冲突只是偶尔发生，无疑会认为我们试图通过这种方法培养的严格自制是过度的。但对我来说，无论如何，这都是必不可少的。只有极端的手段才能驯服我内心的恶魔。”
src: "Many find the asceticism we Ilmaterians practice, depriving ourselves of comforts or even torturing ourselves, bizarre and incomprehensible. Those with less dubious appetites, for whom a conflict between their self-interest and their duties to others is only an occasional occurence, doubtless imagine that the stringent self-control we seek to develop through such methods is excessive. For me, at any rate, it was essential. Only extreme measures could have tamed the demon within me."

He wants me to obtain a number of items he will need to effect a cure: some belladonna, a book detailing the proper preparation for the belladonna before he dare actually ingest it, and some alchemical equipment to actually carry out said preparations. This last can be obtained from a merchant named, according to Querzat, "Blimfin Nemquin or Temquin or something." I have been given a list of items to present to this Blimfin when I locate him. Querzat is not sure where the other two items might be found, but suggests I check out the various stores in the city.\n\nI have given Querzat the book. I still need to bring him the belladonna and the alchemical equipment.

在码头区闲逛时，我遇到了商船船长法纳斯·纳塞布。他的专长是运送异国动物。不幸的是，他货舱里的一只凶暴虎挣脱了笼子，正威胁着要祸害下面的其他动物。他请求我帮忙制服这头野兽，并给了我一把附魔匕首，专门对老虎生效，能让它们入睡。我只需击中老虎一次，而且应该注意不要杀死如此珍贵的生物。

老虎已被制服，此事已报告给纳塞布船长。不过，他又给了我另一个任务，找到在码头区域各处传送的闪现犬，告诉它们回到他的船上。原来它们最初就是从那里来的，直到被老虎吓跑。他给了我一根法杖，可以证明我是他的代理人。装备它后，我应该与犬交谈，告诉它们老虎的威胁已经结束。总共有六只犬，而且它们不断传送，要找到全部可能有点困难。我需要查看码头区域各处以及相邻建筑内部。

七只犬都已找到并劝回，纳塞布船长已为我的工作给了报酬。
src:
While wandering about the Docks District, I ran into Phanas Naseb, captain of a merchant ship. His specialty is transporting exotic animals. Unfortunately, a dire tiger in his hold has broken free of its cage, and is threatening to wreak havoc amongst the other animals down there. He has asked my assistance in geting the beast under control, giving me a dagger that has been enchanted to affect tigers specifically, putting them to sleep. I should only need to score one hit on the tiger, and should make a point not to kill so valuable a creature.

The tiger has been rendered harmless, and this has been reported to Captain Naseb. He has given me another task, however, to find the various blink dogs teleporting about the docks area and tell them to return to his ship. It turns out that was where they orignally came from, until scared away by the tiger. He has given me a rod which will identify me as his agent. With it equipped, I should speak to the dogs and tell them that the threat from the tiger is over. There are six dogs in total and it may prove a bit difficult to find them all as they keep teleporting about. I will need to look all around the docks area as well as inside adjoining structures.

All seven dogs have been found and induced to return, and Captain Naseb has rewarded me for my work.

src:
Alternate Form (Su): An aranea's natural form is that of a large monstrous spider.  It can assume two other forms.  The first is a Medium-size humanoid (the exact form is fixed at birth).  The second form is a Medium-size, spider-humanoid hybrid.  Changing form is a standard action.

The aranea keeps its ability scores and can cast spells, but cannot use webs or poison in humanoid form.

In hybrid form, an aranea looks like a humanoid at first glance, but a closer inspection will reveal its fangs and spinneretes.  The aranea can use weapons and webs in this form.

凯勒姆·伊沙丁是伊尔梅特的一位圣武士，先前被派去对抗泰坦帮，此后便杳无音信。他很可能已在与他们的战斗中阵亡，但这并不确定，因此在对抗泰坦的同时，纳西拉克希望我留意任何有关他下落的迹象，若我查明他的遭遇，便向他报信。

我找到了凯勒姆，他被泰坦帮俘虏了。如今我已将他解救出来，他加入了与我并肩作战，协助我对抗剩余的泰坦。他持有一把钥匙，可以打开通往他们逃入的下水道的道路，若我需要，他还能帮我解除据说布满这条通道的陷阱。

我们已解决了泰坦帮，凯勒姆如今已经离去。我现在可以返回伊尔梅特神殿，报告此任务已完成。
src:
Kelem Ishadin is a paladin of Ilmater who was sent to fight the Titan gang earlier, and has not been heard from since. Likely he fell in battle against them, but this is not known with certainty, so while fighting the Titans Nasirak wants me to keep an eye out for any signs of his fate, and bring word to him if I discover what happened to him.

I have found Kelem, who had been captured by the Titan gang. Now that I have liberated him, he has joined with me to assist me in fighting the remaining Titans. He possesses a key that will open the path to the sewers down which they have fled, and should I need it can also help me in disarming the traps with which this route is said to be covered.

We have dealt with the Titan gang, and Kelem has now departed. I can now return to the Temple of Ilmater and report this mission as accomplished.

src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
Sune Firehair encourages beauty, passion, and love wherever they may be found. Heartwarders are aesthetes and hedonists who actively seek out pleasure and beauty in all things who nurture the creation of beautiful objects.

- Hit Die: d4.
- Proficiencies: The Heartwarder gains no weapon or armor proficiency.
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:

Alignment: Chaotic Good.
Feats: Dodge, Mobility, Spell Focus: Enchantment, Exotic Weapon Proficiency: Whip
Skills: Bluff 3, Persuade 6.
Divine Spellcasting: Ability to cast spells of Level 3.
Special: Must worship Sune Firehair. (Clerics must have two of Charm, Good and Protection domains.)

CLASS FEATURES:

Level
1: Charisma Increase - Bonus +1 to Charisma.
2: Heart of Passion - Bonus +2 to Charisma-based checks (skills, turning).
3: Charisma Increase - Bonus +2 to Charisma.
4: Lips of Rapture - Bonus +2 to Attacks, damages, saves and +4 to Enchantment spells saves. (Dazed on failed save).
5: Charisma Increase - Bonus +3 to Charisma.
6: Voice of a Siren - Gains Greater Spell Focus: Enchantment and Spell Penetration feats to verbal spells.
7: Charisma Increase - Bonus +4 to Charisma.
8: Tears of Evergold - Craft a Water Holy once per day.
9: Charisma Increase - Bonus +5 to Charisma.
10: Fey Metamorphosis - Type change to Fey.

BONUS SPELLS

Upon gaining a level in Heartwarder, the character gains new spells per day as if he had also gained a level in his highest caster class (druid or cleric). He does not learn any new spells through his abilities.

src:
Few dwarves delved as deep as the ancient Fireblood clan.  Particularly fond of dormant volcanos, these dwarves followed volcanic trails and tunnels in search of further access to the world's depths.  Unfortunately they stumbled on a nest of red dragons, and the outraged dragons enslaved the hapless clan to mine treasures for them.  Over time, whether by interbreeding, natural mutation, or magical effect the Fireblood clan began to take on unique traits making them better adapted to higher temperatures... and to battling dragons.  They won their freedom eventually, but the hatred for evil dragons in general and red dragons in specific still burns deep within this breed of dwarf.  The clan intermarried and spread their bloodline across many clans now, however, and a Fireblood dwarf may be born to any dwarf parents.  They are much the same as standard dwarves, but have dark red-brown skin, and are usually bald, with only the faintest of beards.

Dwarven Ability Adjustments: +2 Con, -2 Cha.
Favored Class (Fighter): A multiclass fireblood dwarf's fighter class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

- Stonecunning: +2 racial bonus on Search checks made in subterranean areas.
- Darkvision: Dwarves are able to see in the dark.
- Resistance to fire 5: Fireblood Dwarves have Fire Resistance 5.
- Hardiness vs. Spells: +2 racial bonus on saving throws against spells.
- Offensive Training vs. Orcs: +1 racial bonus on attack rolls against orcs.
- Offensive Training vs. Goblinoids: +1 racial bonus on attack rolls against goblinoids (goblins, hobgoblins, and bugbears).
- Defensive Training vs. Dragons: +4 dodge bonus to AC against dragons.
- Skill Affinity (Lore): +2 racial bonus to Lore checks.
- Skill Affinity (Craft Armor): +2 racial bonus to Craft Armor checks.
- Skill Affinity (Craft Weapon): +2 racial bonus to Craft Weapon checks.
- Skill Affinity (Appraise): +2 racial bonus to Appraise checks.
- Dragonblooded: Fireblood Dwarves have the dragonblood subtype.
- Dwarven: Fireblood Dwarves count as Dwarves for the purpose of spells.

He has given me a key to a grate near the north wall of the sewers beneath the slums, which I would have no reason to notice earlier, that leads to a series of passages and caves heading north, terminating out in the desert near the hermit's cave. src:
Type: Class
Prerequisite: Scout level 1
A Scout relies on mobility to deal extra damage and improve her defense. She deals an extra 1d6 points of damage on all attacks she makes during any round in which she moves at least 10 feet. The extra damage applies only to attacks taken during the Scout's turn. This extra damage increases by 1d6 for every four levels gained above 1st.
The extra damage only applies to living creatures that have a discernible anatomy. Undead, constructs, oozes, plants, incorporeal creatures and creatures immune to extra damage from critical hits are not vulnerable to this additional damage. The Scout must be able to see the target well enough to pick out a vital spot and must be able to reach such a spot. Scouts can apply this extra damage to ranged attacks made while skirmishing, but only if the target is within 30 feet.
At 3rd level, a Scout gains a +1 competence bonus to AC during any round in which she moves at least 10 feet. The bonus applies as soon as the Scout has moved 10 feet, and lasts until the start of her next turn. This bonus improves by 1 for every four levels gained above 3rd.
A Scout loses this ability when wearing medium or heavy armor or when carrying a medium or heavy load.

src: Saman Waladi has told me that if I am looking for work I should seek out one Namal Sarakan, captain of the ship Shining Searcher, currently to be found in the Docks District. This Captain Sarakan apparently wants the help of an adventurer in investigating some mysterious artifact he has found. Saman has already mentioned to him that I might be a suitable person for his needs, so he should be prepared to accept my assistance at such time as I offer it.\n\nI have spoken to Captain Sarakan, and learned something about the task he has for me. He has found a magical means of creating a portal to some underwater ruin, and wants my help in exploring it. I and any companions who go through (or are later summoned) will be provided magical protection against drowning. This will last four hours, and I should not return through the portal until I have accomplished the task, as this will disrupt the spell. Operating underwater will slow me down and reduce the effectiveness of attacks, prevent the use of missile weapons, and render any spells that involve the use of fire of limited effectiveness (at best). I should simply enter the portal whenever I am ready. The necessary spells will be automatically cast as I go through.

dst: 在码头区闲逛时，我遇到了商船船长法纳斯·纳塞布。他的专长是运输异域动物。不幸的是，他货舱里的一头凶暴虎挣脱了笼子，正威胁着要在下面其他动物中大肆破坏。他请求我帮忙制服这头野兽，并给了我一把专门附魔用来影响老虎的匕首，能让它们入睡。我只需要击中老虎一次，并且应该注意不要杀死这么珍贵的生物。
src: While wandering about the Docks District, I ran into Phanas Naseb, captain of a merchant ship. His specialty is transporting exotic animals. Unfortunately, a dire tiger in his hold has broken free of its cage, and is threatening to wreak havoc amongst the other animals down there. He has asked my assistance in getting the beast under control, giving me a dagger that has been enchanted to affect tigers specifically, putting them to sleep. I should only need to score one hit on the tiger, and should make a point not to kill so valuable a creature.

"嗯，我曾经像你一样是个冒险者。曾经我使用斧头或剑的灵巧程度就像我现在使用菜刀一样！然而，当我和战友们露营时，我不知怎么得到了在篝火上做饭的工作。最终，我也擅长了那个，所以当年龄开始追上我时，我想我可以在退休后当个厨师。我在帕夏加尔哈德尔的冒险岁月里认识了他，所以他很乐意雇用我。"
src: "Well, I used to be an adventurer like you. Once I was as deft with an axe or sword as I now am with a cooking knife! When I was camping with my comrades in arms, however, I somehow got the job of cooking meals over the campfire. Eventually, I got good at that too, so when age started catching up to me, I figured I could be a cook in my retirement. I'd met Pasha Galhadr in his adventuring days, and so he was happy to hire me."

src:
Conjuration (Healing)
Level: Cleric 1, Druid 1
Components: V, S,
Casting Time: 1 standard action
Range: Touch
Target: Living creature touched
Duration: 10 rounds + 1 round/level (max 15 rounds)
Saving Throw: Will negates (harmless)
Spell Resistance: Yes (harmless)

With a touch of your hand, you boost the subject's life energy, granting him or her the fast healing ability for the duration of the spell.

The subject heals 1 hit point per round of such damage until the spell ends and is automatically stabilized if he or she begins dying from hit point loss during that time.

Lesser vigor does not restore hit points lost from starvation, thirst, or suffocation, nor does it allow a creature to regrow or attach lost body parts.

The effects of multiple vigor spells do not stack; only the highest-level effect applies.

dst: 哈马德终于把注意力转向了我发现的关于变形蛛组建邪恶类人生物军队攻击卡林杉的阴谋。他收到了证实我发现的报告：地精在米尔森林集结，兽人在行进山脉集结。他建议了两个受到威胁的地点，我可以前往那里增援已经驻扎在那里的士兵：米尔森林附近的特布纳斯村，以及行进山脉山麓的阿哈兹堡。我应该前往城门，从那里向东前往其中一个或另一个地点，最终或许两个都去。\n\n其中一支类人生物军队的威胁已经解决。这已经报告给了哈马德，我现在应该把注意力转向另一支。
src: Hamad has finally turned his attention to the plot I discovered of aranea raising armies of evil humanoids to attack Calimshan. He has received reports confirming my discoveries: goblins massing in the Forest of Mir, and orcs in the Marching Mountains. He has suggested two threatened points that I could travel to in order to reinforce the soldiers already there: the village of Tebnas, near the Forest of Mir, and Fort Akhaz, in the foothills of the Marching Mountains. I should make my way to the city gates and from there travel east to one or the other of these locations, and in time perhaps both.\n\nThe threat posed by one of these humanoid armies has been dealt with. This has been reported to Hamad, and I should now turn my attention to the other one.

dst: 单一心智，普通
弩常被大量生产以装备军队，因为人们发现新兵学会使用这种武器并达到尚可的水平，比掌握普通弓要快得多。遗憾的是，弩的射速缓慢，这意味着装备弩的军队在被迫面对熟练的长弓手时，往往处于劣势。有一位国王试图弥补这一缺陷，为他的士兵装备了能提供特殊防护以抵御箭雨的弩。这确保了弩手缓慢但稳定而精准的射击能够轻易反制任何敌方弓箭手，后者的射击无论多么密集，此时大多都会落空。
src: Crossbows are frequently mass-produced for armies, since it has been found that new recruits can learn to use these weapons with reasonable competence more quickly than they can master a regular bow. Unfortunately, the slow rate of fire of crossbows means that an army equipped with them will often be at a disadvantage when forced to confront skilled longbowmen. One king tried to make up for this deficiency by equiping his soldiers with crossbows that provided special protection against a hail of arrows. This insured that the slow, but steady and accurate, fire of the crossbowmen would easily counter any enemy archers, whose shots, however numerous, would now mostly miss.

src: Spells per Day/Powers Known: When a new psychic theurge level is attained, the character gains new spells per day as if he had also attained a level in any one divine spellcasting class he belonged to before he added the prestige class. He gains additional power points per day and access to new powers as if he had also gained a level in any one manifesting class he belonged to previously. He does not, however, gain any other benefit a character of either class would have gained (bonus metamagic, metapsionic, or item creation feats, psicrystal special abilities, and so on). This essentially means that he adds the level of psychic theurge to the level of whatever other divine spellcasting class and manifesting class the character has, then determines spells per day, caster level, power points per day, powers known, and manifester level accordingly.

src:
Transmutation
Level: Druid 6,
Components: V, S, DF,
Casting Time: 1 standard action
Range: Touch
Target: Living creature touched
Duration: 10 minutes/level
Saving Throw: None
Spell Resistance: Yes (harmless)

In the blink of an eye, the creature you touched grows the armor plating of a tortoise across its torso and a tough, leathery skin elsewhere.  Tortoise shell grants a +6 enhancement bonus to the subject's existing natural armor bonus. This enhancement bonus increases by 1 for every three caster levels beyond 11th, to a maximum of +9 at 20th level.

The enhancement bonus provided by tortoise shell stacks with the target's natural armor bonus, but not with other enhancement bonuses to natural armor. A creature without natural armor has an effective natural armor of +0, much as a character wearing only normal clothing has an armor bonus of +0.

Tortoise shell slows a creature's movement as if it were wearing heavy armor. An elf subject to tortoise shell, for example, would have a speed of 20 feet and could run only 60 feet per round.  The spell affects only a creature's speed; tortoise shell doesn't carry an armor check penalty or an arcane spell failure chance.

src: The halfling rogue Haldo Burrows was fond of robbing mages; after all, powerful spellcasters invariably owned plenty of valuable items. Unfortunately this habit also tended to make him some powerful and magically capable enemies. While Haldo was an expert at evading fireballs and lightning bolts, he was less capable of dealing with enchantment spells, a weakness that could easily leave him at the mercy of a hostile wizard. He applied some of his ill-gotten wealth to the goal of acquiring items that would compensate for this weakness, and in due course obtained this headgear, which he thought an excellent tool for aiding a thief. as it both concealed identity, and possessed a limited ability to shield one from mind-affecting spells. Of course, these benefits can be helpful to many adventurers, not just thieves, but the item's history has made it a bit disreputable in some circles.\n\n

泰尔是冰封北方的原始猎人，是残忍而野蛮的生物，出没于东方的偏远山脉和隘口。他们向更温暖的地区发动战争，掠夺牲畜，食物储备，甚至人口作为氏族的食物。比起兽人或豺狼人等其他邪恶种族，泰尔更被其他种族视为粗鲁，嗜血的野兽，毫无可取之处。尽管泰尔将其他生物视为潜在的敌人或食物，但他们拥有令人惊讶的复杂口述历史，氏族内部的行为规则和部落智慧。
  
很久以前，这个种族发展出了一套全面的法典来约束其暴力倾向，至少在其成员之间是如此。任何不属于泰尔氏族的人都不受此法典保护，可以被随意抢劫，谋杀或吃掉。少数流浪到文明地区的泰尔要么将其“氏族”的概念扩展到其他一些智慧生物群体，如一群强盗，一个村庄或一支冒险队伍，要么很快就会死在愤怒的暴民手中。

泰尔属性调整：+4 力量，+2 体质，-4 智力，-2 魅力：泰尔坚韧且极其强壮，但狭隘且不具备其他种族的推理能力。
天赋职业（野蛮人）：在决定兼职泰尔是否遭受经验值惩罚时，其野蛮人职业不计入其中。

- 中型体型
- 泰尔的基础陆地速度为 30 英尺
- 巨人
- 种族生命骰：泰尔初始拥有两个巨人等级。这提供 2d8 生命骰，+1 基础攻击加值，以及强韧 +3，反射 +0 和意志 +0 的基础豁免。
- 黑暗视觉
- 天生防御 +2
- 天生攻击：徒手的泰尔可以以其正常攻击加值进行两次猛击，并以 -5 的惩罚进行啮咬攻击。泰尔的猛击造成 1d3 点伤害，啮咬造成 1d4 点伤害
- 寒冷亚种（超自然）：泰尔免疫寒冷伤害，但易受火焰攻击。无论是否允许豁免，也无论豁免成功或失败，他们受到火焰伤害为正常伤害的一倍半（+50%）
- 天赋职业：野蛮人

src:
Primitive hunters of the icebound north, taers are cruel and savage creatures who haunt the remote mountains and passes of the East. They launch war parties into warmer lands, carrying off livestock, food stores, or even people for the clan's larder. Even more so than other evil folk such as orcs or gnolls, taers are regarded by other races as crude, bloodthirsty beasts without a single redeeming quality. Although taers regard other creatures as potential enemies or meals, they possess a surprisingly complex store of oral histories, rules for conduct within the clan, and tribal wisdom.
  
Long ago, the race developed a comprehensive code to govern its tendency toward violence, at least between its own members. Anyone not of the taer's clan is beyond the protection of this code and can be robbed, murdered, or eaten at will. Those few taers who wander into civilized lands either extend their concept of "clan" to some other set of intelligent creatures, such as a group of bandits, a village, or an adventuring band, or quickly die at the hands of an angry mob. 

Taer Ability Adjustments:  +4 Strength, +2 Constitution, -4 Intelligence, -2 Charisma: Taers are tough and tremendously strong, but are insular and do not have the reasoning capacities of other races.
Favored Class (Barbarian): A multiclass taer's barbarian class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

- Medium size
- A taer's base land speed is 30 feet
- Giant
- Racial Hit Dice: A taer begins with two levels of giant. This provides 2d8 Hit Dice, a base attack bonus of +1, and base saving throws of Fort +3, Ref +0, and Will +0. 
- Darkvision
- Natural Armor +2
- Natural Attacks: An unarmed taer can make two slam attacks at his normal attack bonus and a bite attack at a -5 penalty on his normal attack bonus. The taer's slam attacks deal 1d3 points of damage, and the bite deals 1d4 points of damage
- Cold Subtype (Ex): Taers are immune to cold damage but are vulnerable to fire attacks. They take half again as much (+50%) damage as normal from fire, regardless of whether a saving throw is allowed, or if the save is a success or failure
- Favored Class: Barbarian
- Level Adjustment: +1

It has the power to restore lost life-forces to those attuned to these energies, applying a Resurrection spell to such a being. However, this spell will only affect beings of extra-planar origin, outsiders and elementals, and is useless if applied to anyone else. A further disadvantage is that it requires the one using it to sacrifice a small portion of his own life-forces to activate it: a player who uses this item will lose 10 Experience Points per level, or the maximum experience he can lose while retaining his current level, whichever is less.\n\nThis orb was given to you by a strange entity on the Plane of Air, so that you would be able to resurrect Zarala if that became necessary. It is foolhardy to explore a dungeon alone. Those who attempt to do so quickly find that they lack the skills needed to get the job done. Sometimes, this can happen in larger parties as well. Enter the factotum, capable of mimicking the abilities of others and filling in when the need is greatest. After a lifetime of work, few can claim even a fraction of the versatility that the factotum displays every day. Skilled in nearly every art, factotums draw upon their lore to master almost any trade or ability for a brief period of time before other pursuits draw their attention. Constantly on the hunt for new abilities and tricks, factotums eventually find the right tool to overcome practically any problem.

dst: 卷宗学者 良知之剑
"正是这个联盟付钱给泰坦帮去对付伊尔梅特神殿。麻烦在于，伊尔梅特信徒实际上正在改善这一带的生活水平。这让这些贵族担心，某个敌对派系会宣称既然这里的贫困已经不那么严重了，就不再需要扶贫办公室了，而用于它的资金就会被转给别人的私人项目。不幸的是，他们原本以为泰坦帮不会像实际上那么暴力和极端，这就导致了我们目前所处的这种不愉快的局面。"
src: "This same coalition was paying the Titan gang to go after the Temple of Ilmater. The trouble was that the Ilmaterians were actually improving the standard of living around here. That made these nobles afraid that some rival faction would declare that since poverty wasn't so bad here, there was no longer any need for a Poverty Relief Office, and funds for it would be diverted to someone else's pet project. Unfortunately, they expected the Titans to be a bit less violent and extreme than they were, which has led to the current unpleasant situation we are in."
