dst:
纳西拉克告诉过我一位名叫伊拉姆的伊尔梅特信徒，他是一位隐士，住在城墙外的一个洞穴里。这位伊拉姆有时会为其他武僧提供训练和指导，纳西拉克建议我，作为一名武僧，最好去找他。他给了我一把钥匙，可以打开贫民窟下方下水道北墙附近的一个格栅，我之前没有理由注意到它，它通向一系列向北延伸的通道和洞穴，最终通向隐士洞穴附近的沙漠。这是去那里最快的路线，但纳西拉克警告我这也可能很危险。

我沿着指定的路径前进，在洞穴中找到了伊拉姆大师。他开始了我的训练计划，并给了我几项任务。首先，我要去拿他洞穴西南角一个袋子里的刚毛衬衣，我将在训练期间穿着它。接下来，他要我从我来这里时穿过的隧道里一具尸体上找到的四件武僧装备中拿一件，带到洞穴外的悬崖边，扔进那里的深渊。他相信这将帮助我培养对物质财富的漠不关心。

我扔掉了其中一件物品，然后回来在伊拉姆大师的指导下进行了一些体能训练。现在他要我去站在他洞穴的东北角，什么都不做，直到他说可以为止，以帮助培养耐心和自制力。
src:
Nasirak has told me of an Ilmaterian monk named Iram who is a hermit living in a cave just outside the city walls. This Iram sometimes offers training and instruction to other monks, and Nasirak has recommended that, as a monk, I would be well-advised to seek him out. He has given me a key to a grate near the north wall of the sewers beneath the slums, which I would have no reason to notice earlier, that leads to a series of passages and caves heading north, terminating out in the desert near the hermit's cave. This is the quickest route there, but Nasirak has warned me it can also be hazardous.

I have followed the path laid out and located Master Iram in his cave. He has commenced my training program and given me a couple of tasks. Firstly, I am to get the hair shirt in a bag in the southwest corner of his cave, which I am to wear during my training. Next, he wants me to take one of four items of monk gear I found on a corpse in the tunnel I traversed coming here, bring it to the cliff outside the cave, and throw it into the chasm there. He believes this will assist me in developing a lack of concern for material possessions.

I threw away one of the items, and then returned to carry out some phyical exercises under Master Iram's direction. Now he wants me to go stand in the northeast corner of his cave without doing anything until he says otherwise, to assist in developing patience and self-control.

视觉遮蔽

我与一位塞露涅的牧师交谈过，他正试图在卡林港建立一座该神祇的神殿，希望能抵消莎尔在世界这一地区过大的影响力。他告诉我，神殿的建造工作正受到破坏者的干扰，他们在夜间动手，毁坏白天建好的一部分建筑。他请我设法处理这件事。他建议我从神殿的后门出去，那里堆放着大量建筑材料，找一些板条箱躲在后面。从那里我可以在夜间（破坏行为发生时）进行监视，运气好的话，我会看到肇事者靠近，并能够阻止他们。如果可能的话，最好也能找到一些确凿的证据，查明幕后主使是谁。
src: I spoke to a priest of Selune who is attempting to establish a temple to that deity in Calimport, in hopes of counteracting the excessive influence of Shar in this region of the world. He told me that construction work on the temple is being disrupted by vandals, who strike at night and wreck some of the building done during the day. He has asked me to try and do something about this. He suggests I go out the back entrance of the temple, where a lot of constuction materials are piled up, and find some crates to hide behind. From there I can watch during the night (when the vandalism occurs) and with any luck I will see the perpetrators approach and be able to stop them. It would be good as well to find some solid evidence about who is behind this, if possible.

An oily black smoke rolls out of nowhere, obscuring sight and sound. It leaves a distasteful residue on everything within, and the scent is one of open sewers and putrefied flesh.

The area of sickening shadow is filled with shadowy illumination, as per darkness. All creatures within the area, or those who enter it, must attempt a Fortitude save or be nauseated. Those who succeed are merely sickened. Creatures within the area must repeat the save each round until they either fail or leave the area. Once a creature has left the sickening shadow, the sickened effect lasts for 2d6 rounds. Nausea lasts for 1d4 rounds and is then followed by an additional 2d6 rounds of being sickened.

当你将铁粉和银粉倒入瓶中时，你念出古老而滑溜的词语。尽管粉末比容器能容纳的更多，但全部溶解了，留下一瓶点缀着枪灰色微粒的水。

这个变化系法咒将一瓶（1 品脱） 水注入秩序的秩序，将其转化为公理之水。公理之水对混乱异界生物造成的伤害，如同圣水对不死生物和邪恶异界生物造成的伤害。一瓶公理之水可以作为溅射武器投掷。将此攻击视为射程增量为 10 尺的远程接触攻击。如果投向实体生物的身体，瓶子会破碎，但要对虚体生物使用，持有者必须打开瓶子并将公理之水倒在目标上。因此，角色只有在与虚体生物相邻时才能用公理之水浇淋它。这样做是一次不会引发借机攻击的远程接触攻击。

一瓶公理之水直接命中会对混乱异界生物造成 2d4 点伤害。在瓶子击中点 5 尺内的每个此类生物受到 1 点溅射伤害。

材料成分：5 磅铁粉和银粉（价值 25 gp）.
src:
Transmutation [Lawful]
Level: Cleric 1, Paladin 1,
Components: V, S, M,
Casting Time: 1 minute
Range: Touch
Target: Flask of water touched
Duration: Instantaneous
Saving Throw: Will negates (object)
Spell Resistance: Yes (object)

You speak the ancient, slippery words as you pour the iron and silver into the flask. Despite the fact that there is more powder than will fit in the container, all of it dissolves, leaving a flask of water dotted with motes of gunmetal gray.

This transmutation imbues a flask (1 pint) of water with the order of law, turning it into axiomatic water. Axiomatic water damages chaotic outsiders the way holy water damages undead and evil outsiders. A flask of axiomatic water can be thrown as a splash weapon. Treat this attack as a ranged touch attack with a range increment of 10 feet. A flask breaks if thrown against the body of a corporeal creature, but to use it against an incorporeal creature, the bearer must open the flask and pout the axiomatic water out onto the target. Thus, a character can douse an incorporeal creature with axiomatic water only if he is adjacent to it. Doing so is a ranged touch attack that does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

A direct hit by a flask of axiomatic water deals 2d4 points of damage to a chaotic outsider. Each such creature within 5 feet of the point where the flask hits takes 1 point of damage from the splash.

Material Component: 5 pounds of powdered iron and silver (worth 25 gp).

拉贾尔又给我派了一项任务。我要去偷取塞尔哈德圣甲虫，它位于塞尔哈德贵族庄园的宝库中。为了进去，我应该进入贵族庄园下方的下水道，在那里我会找到通往该庄园地下室的通道。一旦进入，我需要在庄园里搜寻两把钥匙，一把用于宝库的外门，一把用于内门。找到这些后，我就可以进入庄园地下室的宝库，但我必须迅速找到圣甲虫并离开，因为内门在打开一分钟后会自动锁上。我还必须确保不伤害庄园里的任何人，因为如果这种事发生在显赫贵族的庄园里，当局绝不会轻饶。

我拿到了塞尔哈德圣甲虫，但当我试图离开时，我发现我进来的路线已被牢牢锁住并有守卫把守，这或许表明守卫察觉到了我在庄园里留下的某些痕迹。不过我还是找到了另一条出去的路，现在可以把圣甲虫带给拉贾尔了。

我成功逃出了庄园。现在只需要把圣甲虫带给拉贾尔。
src:
Rajar has assigned me yet another mission. I am to steal the Serkhad Scarab, located in the treasure vault of the Serkhad Noble Estate. To get in I should enter the sewers beneath the noble estates, where I will find a passage to the basement of this estate. Once in, I will need to search the estate for two keys, one for the outer, and one for the inner door to the vault. Once I find these I can enter the vault in the estate basement, but I will need to find the scarab quickly and get out, since the inner door will autolock one minute after it is opened. I should also be sure not to harm anyone on the estate, as the authorities will not be able to take any such incident lightly if it occurs on the estate of a prominent noble.

I acquired the Serkhad Scarab, but when I attempted to leave, I found the route through which I entered securely locked and guarded, perhaps an indication that the guards detected some sign of my presence on the estate. However I was able to find another means of getting out, and can now bring the Scarab to Rajar.

I was able to escape the estate. Now I just need to bring the scarab to Rajar.

src:
Psychometabolism
Level: Psion/wilder 2
Manifesting Time: 1 standard action
Range: Touch
Targets: You and one willing creature
Duration: 1 hour/level
Power Points: 3
Metapsionics: Extend

This power creates a psychometabolic connection between you and a willing subject so that some of your wounds are transferred to the subject. You take half damage from all attacks that deal hit point damage to you, and the subject takes the remainder. The amount of damage not taken by you is taken by the subject. If your hit points are reduced by a lowered Constitution score, that reduction is not shared with the subject because it is not a form of hit point damage. When this power ends, subsequent damage is no longer divided between the subject and you, but damage already shared is not reassigned.

If you and the subject move farther away from each other than close range, the power ends.


Implementation notes:
You may not have more than one Share Pain or Share Pain, Forced active at any one time. Any subsequent uses override the previous.

dst:
在我先前于卡林沙漠的冒险中，我发现了关于一个名叫拉贾尔的人的一些信息，他是卡林港这里一些强盗劫掠者维持的一个联系人。这个拉贾尔究竟是谁并不完全清楚，但显然他能为任何参与犯罪活动的人提供许多有用的服务。我找到了一张纸，上面写着他藏身下水道的路线，并注意到我应该使用口令“Jaraj”来进入那里。只要我随身保留这张纸以供参考，我就应该能够通过下水道系统找到去那里的路。然而，我必须决定，是应该独自去寻找这个拉贾尔，还是把我发现的关于他的信息交给城市守卫，希望他们能利用这些信息来终结他的犯罪活动。

我已经把我发现的信息交给了守卫，由达沙尔·扎伊内姆中尉代表。原来拉贾尔是卡林港某个盗贼公会的首领。扎伊内姆中尉请求我协助将拉贾尔绳之以法，因为他担心让太多可能腐败的守卫卷入此事，并且他需要一个有些偷窃技能的人。他的计划要求我去拉贾尔公会的区域，但避开入口。相反，我应该向左转，寻找一扇密门，它提供了一条通往迷宫的另一条路线，公会用这个迷宫来测试潜在成员。如果我能闯过迷宫里的锁、陷阱和其他挑战，我就能从一个出人意料的方向进入公会。我还得到了一根法杖，一旦我进入公会，它就会召唤一个魔像来协助我对抗盗贼。扎伊内姆中尉还建议我去和卡姆·赛特夫谈谈，他是城市守卫地牢里的一名囚犯，也是提供这个迷宫信息的线人。他也许能给我一些提示，帮助我通过迷宫。我应该把拉贾尔的头带回去给扎伊内姆中尉以领取奖赏。

我已经杀死了拉贾尔并取得了他的头颅。我可以把它带给扎伊内姆中尉以领取奖赏。
src:
During my previous adventures in the Calim Desert, I discovered some information about one Rajar, a contact maintained by some bandit raiders here in Calimport. It was not entirely clear just who this Rajar is, but apparently he can provide many useful services to anyone involved in criminal activities. I found a paper containing directions to his hideout in the sewers, and notice that I should use the password "Jaraj" to gain access to it. So long as I keep this paper in my possession for reference, I should be able to find my way there by traveling through the sewer system. I must decide, however, whether I should seek out this Rajar on my own, or instead give what information I have found about him to the City Watch, in the hope that they can use it to put an end to his criminal activities.

I have turned over the information I found to the Watch, represented by Lieutenant Dashar Zaynem. It turns out Rajar is the head of one of Calimport's Thieves' Guilds. Lt. Zaynem has asked for my assistance in bringing Rajar to justice, as he fears involving too many of the possibly corrupt Watchmen in this matter, and could use someone with a few thieving skills. His plan calls for me to go to the area of Rajar's guild, but avoid the entrance. Instead, I should turn to the left and search for a secret door that provides an alternative route into a maze the guild uses as a test for prospective members. If I can work my way through the locks, traps and other challenges of the maze, I will gain entrance to the guild from a surprsing direction. I have also been given a rod that, once I gain access to the guild, will summon a golem to assist me in fighting the thieves. Lt. Zaynem has also suggested that I talk to Kam Saitef, a prisoner in the City Guard's dungeon, an informant who is the source of this information about the maze. He may be able to give me a few tips to help me get through it. I should bring Rajar's head back to Lt. Zaynem to be rewarded.

I have slain Rajar and acquired his head. I can bring it to Lt. Zaynem for a reward.

dst:
我最近的冒险始于几周前，当时我来到卡林港的流沙旅店，寻找冒险工作。不久之后，商人萨曼·瓦拉迪雇佣我作为商队护卫。然而，在与瓦拉迪的商队出发之前，我遇到了一位名叫扎拉拉·加尔哈德尔的空气元素裔吟游诗人。她告诉我，她逃离了家乡，因为她的父亲试图强迫她接受包办婚姻，现在她正试图以冒险者的身份谋生。我同意让她陪伴我进行自己的冒险，她也随商队同行。

商队遭到强盗袭击并被击溃，我本人显然也在过程中丧生。然而，在我“死亡”之后，我发现自己身处一个似乎是气元素位面的地方，被那里某个强大的存在复活了。这个存在告诉我，如果我在战斗中倒下（鉴于我职业的危险性，这很有可能发生），它能够并且愿意再次恢复我的生命（并将我送回我所在位面倒下的地点），尽管它在特定时间段内只能这样做有限次数。作为这项极其宝贵服务的回报，它告诉我，我将被期望充当扎拉拉的保护者。据称她拥有某种伟大的命运，这个存在希望看到它实现。由于某些未完全明确的原因，这个存在无法或不被允许直接帮助扎拉拉，于是选择通过帮助我——她的同伴——来间接帮助她。

被这个存在复活并送回主物质位面后，我首先面临的任务是营救被强盗俘虏的扎拉拉。我也救出了萨曼，他承诺如果我在卡林港追上他，就会给我奖励。此后，扎拉拉和我在一个考古发掘地找到了避难所，并协助那里的人探索了一些充满亡灵的废墟。当我们发现那里的主要怪物——一个我们可能无法击败的强大吸血鬼时，这一切结束了。然而幸运的是，就在此时，扎拉拉的父亲带着一些强大的同伴出现寻找她，吓跑了吸血鬼。

原来，扎拉拉的父亲哈马德·加尔哈德尔实际上是一位提尔的圣武士，并没有像她声称的那样试图强迫她接受不想要的婚姻。他只是反对她冒着生命危险从事像冒险这样危险的职业。扎拉拉被带回了家。由于位面存在仍然期望我保护扎拉拉（尽管她目前似乎足够安全），我也一同前往，被哈马德雇佣为他的护卫之一。
src:
My recent adventures began a few weeks ago when I showed up at the Shifting Sands Inn in the city of Calimport, looking for adventuring work. In due course, I was hired by the merchant Saman Waladi as a caravan guard. Before setting out with Waladi's caravan, however, I met an air genasi bard named Zarala Galhadr. She told me that she had fled her home because her father was trying to force her into an arranged marriage, and was now trying to make her way as an adventurer. I agreed to let her accompany me on my own adventures, and she came along with the caravan as well.

The caravan was attacked by bandits and overrun, and I myself was apparently killed in the process. After my "death," however, I found myself in what appeared to be the Plane of Air, having been restored to life by some powerful entity there. This entity told me that it was able and willing to restore my life (and return me to the point at which I fell on my own plane) again if I ever fell in battle (a likely enough occurence given the danger of my profession), although it could only do so a limited number of times within a given time period. In return for this extraordinarily valuable service, it told me that I would be expected to act as Zarala's protector. She allegedly has some great destiny the entity wants to see fulfilled. Unable or forbidden to help Zarala directly (for reasons made less than entirely clear), the entity chose to assist her by helping me, her companion, instead.

Returned to life and the Prime Material Plane by the entity, I was first faced with the task of rescuing Zarala, who had been captured by the bandits. I rescued Saman as well and he promised me a reward for this if I ever caught up with him back in Calimport. After this, Zarala and I found refuge at an archaeological dig, and assisted the people there in exploring some undead-infested ruins. This ended when we found the chief monster there, a powerful vampire we probably would not have been able to defeat. Fortunately, however, at this point Zarala's father showed up looking for her with some powerful companions, and scared off the vampire.

It turned out that Zarala's father, Hamad Galhadr, was actually a Paladin of Tyr, and had not been trying to force Zarala into an unwanted marriage, as she claimed. He simply objected to her risking her life in a profession as dangerous as adventuring. Zarala was taken home. Still expected to protect Zarala by the planar entity (though she seems safe enough for the time being), I came as well, having been hired by Hamad as one of his guards.

src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
The highest art is magic, often referred to as *the* Art. Its most advanced practitioners are frequently Archmages, bending spells in ways unavailable to other spellcasters.

- Hit Die: d4.
- Proficiencies: An Archmage does not gain any additional weapon or armor proficiencies.
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:

Arcane Spellcasting: Able to cast 7th-level spells
Feats: Skill Focus (Spellcraft), Spell Focus (Any School)
Skills: Spellcraft 15 ranks, Lore 15 ranks

CLASS FEATURES:

Level
1: High Arcana*, Mastery of Elements (Normal)
2: High Arcana*
3: High Arcana*
4: High Arcana*
5: High Arcana*

BONUS SPELLS

The Archmage sacrifices the bonus spell slots he should gain in order to take a High Arcana feat at each level. He does, however, add his level to his base caster class when determining spell power (damage, duration...).

HIGH ARCANA:

Each level the Archmage must choose one of the following High Arcana feats:
* Arcane Fire: This feat allows the Archmage to convert any spells he knows into a powerful bolt of raw magical energy.
* Mastery of Elements: This feat allows the Archmage to change on the fly the damage type of any elemental spells. The feat to set them back to normal is free at level 1, the fire, cold, acid, electrical and sonic damages are separated in their own feats and must be selected.
* Mastery of Shapes: This feat allows the Archmage to create "holes" in her area of effect spells to protect his companions from the effects.
* Spell-Like ability: This feat allows the Archmage to permanently prepare a spell as a spell-like ability which she may then use 2 times per day.
* Spell Power: This feat allows the Archmage to increase his effective caster level by 1 (commutative with the normal level bonus they get).

（基础职业）
能够呼唤龙的炽热吐息并以类法咒能力强化自身，龙火专家是令人敬畏的人物，他们掌握龙类的魔法。他们没有奥术或神术，也不依赖身体力量。相反，他们利用与龙类存在本质的直接联系，将龙的原始魔法注入灵魂。这种联系最明显的体现是他们的喷吐武器，但随着联系加深，他们还学会强大的邪术，使他们能够使用不同的龙类能力。

- 生命骰：d8
- 擅长武器：龙火专家仅擅长简单武器。
- 技能点：4 + 智力调整值（1级时x4）

职业技能：估价，唬骗，攀爬，专注，手艺（通用），手艺（制毒），制造护甲，制造陷阱，制造武器，威吓，跳跃，聆听，知识，说服，搜索，察言观色，法咒辨识，侦察，真言，使用魔法装置


职业特性：
基础攻击加值：+1/2
强豁免：强韧，意志

喷吐武器：1级时，你获得一种喷吐武器，可作为标准动作随意使用。每次你可以选择15尺锥形或30尺线形。反射豁免DC为10 + 职业等级的一半 + 你的体质调整值，成功则伤害减半，造成1d6火焰伤害，每2级增加1d6.你对自己的喷吐武器免疫，但对其他同类型喷吐武器不免疫。10级时，吐息范围加倍。

龙触：1级时你获得此专长作为奖励专长。

吐息效果：在2,5,10,12,15和20级时，你可以选择一种吐息效果，允许你修改喷吐武器的伤害类型，区域，甚至用另一种效果替换伤害。有些只适用于锥形，有些只适用于线形，同类型的不能叠加。

鳞片：2级时你长出细鳞皮肤，颜色通常与专家的观念和阵营匹配。这给予你+2 AC，并在8,13和18级时各增加1 AC.

伤害减免：6级时你获得DR 2/+1,16级时增加到5/+1。

免疫：19级时你免疫睡眠和麻痹法咒。

邪术：这些是类法咒能力，利用专家的龙类能量。任何已知的邪术都可以随意使用，但在其他方面如同法咒，例如在战斗中施法或法术抗力。施法者等级为专家的职业等级，那些允许豁免的DC为10 + 等效法术等级 + 专家的魅力调整值。
它们分为4个等级：次级（2级）, lesser(4级)，高级（6级）和黑暗（8级）.专家初始知晓一个次级邪术，并在3,6,8,11,13,16和18级时获得更多。在6,11和16级时，他们还解锁下一级邪术，但他们可以选择任何等级等于或低于其最高访问等级的邪术。
邪术也受奥术失败率影响。
src:
(BASE CLASS)
Able to call upon a dragon's fiery breath and augment themselves with spell-like abilities, dragonfire adepts are imposing figures who command the magic of dragonkind.  They have no arcane or divine magic, nor do they rely on physical prowess.  Instead, they draw upon a direct link with the nature of draconic existence, infusing their souls with the raw magic of dragons.  The most obvious incarnation of this link is their breath weapon, but as the link deepens they also learn powerful invocations that allow them to access different draconic abilities.

- Hit Die: d8
- Proficiencies: Dragonfire adepts are proficient with simple weapons only.
- Skill Points: 4 + Int Modifier(x4 at 1st level)

CLASS SKILLS: Appraise, Bluff, Climb, Concentration, Craft(General), Craft(Poisonmaking), Craft Armor, Craft Trap, Craft Weapon, Intimidate, Jump, Listen, Lore, Persuade, Search, Sense Motive, Spellcraft, Spot, Truespeak, Use Magic Device


CLASS FEATURES:
Base Attack Bonus: +1/2
Strong Saves: Fortitude, Will

Breath Weapon: At 1st level, you gain a breath weapon you can use at will as a standard action.  Each time, you can choose between a 15' cone or a 30' line.  It has a Reflex save DC of 10 + half your class level + your Con modifier for half damage, and does 1d6 of fire damage, increasing by 1d6 every 2 levels.  You are immune to your own breath weapon, but not to other breath weapons of the same type.  At level 10, the breath range doubles.

Dragontouched:  At 1st level you gain this feat as a bonus feat.

Breath Effects: At 2nd, 5th, 10th, 12th, 15th, and 20th levels you can choose a breath effect, which allows you to modify your breath weapon's damage type, area, or even replace the damage with another effect.  Some only work with cones, while others only work with lines, and those of the same type cannot stack.

Scales: At second level you develop a hide of fine scales, the color usually matching the adept's outlook and alignment.  These give you a +2 to AC, and improve by 1 AC at levels 8, 13, and 18.

Damage Reduction: You gain DR 2/+1 at level 6, which increases to 5/+1 at level 16.

Immunities: At level 19 you become immune to sleep and paralysis spells.

Invocations: These are spell-like abilities tapping into the adept's draconic energy.  Any of them that are known can be used at will, but otherwise act like spells, such as in regards to casting in combat, or spell resistance.  Casting level is the adept's class level, and those that grant saves have a DC of 10 + the equivalent spell level + the adept's Cha modifier.
They come in 4 grades: least(2nd), lesser(4th), greater(6th), and dark(8th).  Adepts start with knowledge of a single least invocation, and gain access to more at levels 3, 6, 8, 11, 13, 16, and 18.  At levels 6, 11, and 16 they also unlock the next level of invocation, but they can select invocations of any level equal to or less than their highest level of access.
Invocations are also subject to arcane spell failure.

（进阶职业）
人群的欢呼，精彩表演后观众的赞美，迷人仰慕者送来的如雨礼物--为什么会有人用这一切去换取在树林里睡觉或在发臭的旧地牢里摸索？表演家把在黑暗走廊中潜行和与致命陷阱斗智的事留给别人。她的位置在舞台上，被崇拜的粉丝包围。对她来说幸运的是，她去的每个地方都变成舞台，只要周围有人让她 留下深刻印象，她就处于聚光灯下。

典型的表演家外向，有魅力，爱交际。她喜欢与人相处，并迅速以迷人的举止赢得朋友。有些人可能称她为喜怒无常的自大狂，但每个人在她面前都感觉好一点。

许多表演家是音乐家；其他人是熟练的舞者或演员。还有一些人选择专注于晦涩和不寻常的娱乐形式，如舞台魔术或杂耍。

由于艺人经常在路上，表演家可以去任何她喜欢的地方，在旅途中尽可能多地融入冒险。由于她赢得仰慕者的天赋，如果在她巡演的地方发生任何不光彩的事，她通常仍不受怀疑。

吟游诗人最常被这个进阶职业吸引，尽管游荡者，幻术师以及两者的兼职组合也能在其中表现出色。吟游诗人倾向于作为音乐家或演员表演，幻术师作为舞台魔术师，游荡者作为舞者，翻腾者或手法艺术家。大多数其他职业的角色要么不够外向，无法享受成为表演家，要么他们找到其他渠道来表现他们的外向性。

- 生命骰：d6。
- 擅长：表演家不获得任何额外的武器或护甲擅长。
- 技能点：4+ 智力调整值。

要求：

技能：表演 10 级，威吓或说服 6 级。
法咒：能够施放 0 级奥术法咒（戏法）.

职业特性：

等级
1：吟游诗人音乐（见下），表演家表演（维持之歌）
2：
3：表演家表演（诽谤）
4：表演家表演（刺耳之歌）
5：表演家表演（尖锐音符）
6：表演家表演（扭曲心智的旋律）
7：表演家表演（高等诽谤）
8：表演家表演（魔法旋律）
9：表演家表演（狂怒之歌）
10：表演家表演（揭示旋律）

每日法咒/已知法咒

由于表演家经常使用魔法来增强她的表演，保持魔法研究对她很重要。因此，每当她获得新的表演家等级时，她获得新的每日法咒和已知法咒，就像她在添加进阶职业之前所属的施法职业中也获得了一个等级一样。然而，她不获得该职业角色会获得的任何其他好处（超魔或物品制造专长，新魔宠能力等）.这意味着她将新的表演家等级加到她已经拥有的某个其他施法职业的等级上，然后相应地确定每日法咒，施法者等级和已知法咒（如果以前是吟游诗人或术士）.

吟游诗人歌曲

在第 1 级，如果表演家之前没有从其他职业获得吟游诗人歌曲能力，她获得该能力。在确定她的吟游诗人歌曲的威力时，表演家的职业等级与吟游诗人叠加。

表演家表演

通过激昂的独白或萦绕的旋律，表演家可以创造出超越吟游诗人歌曲能力的魔法效果。表演家表演每天可使用次数等于表演家等级。如果表演家有吟游诗人等级，这些等级与表演家等级叠加以确定每日使用次数。许多表演家表演效果需要超过一次该能力的每日分配使用次数。除非另有说明，表演家表演效果持续 10 轮。

src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
The roar of the crowd, the praise of spectators after a great performance, the showers of gifts from attractive admirers - why would anyone trade all that for sleeping in the woods or poking around in smelly old dungeons? The virtuoso leaves creeping down dark corridors and matching wits against deadly traps to others. Her place is on the stage, surrounded by adoring fans. Fortunately for her, every place she goes becomes a stage, and as long as there's anyone around for her to impress, she's in the spotlight.

The typical virtuoso is outgoing, charismatic, and gregarious. She loves to be around people and is quick to win friends with her charming manner. Some might call her a temperamental egomaniac, yet everyone feels a little better in her presence.

Many virtuosos are musicians; others are accomplished dancers or actors. Still others choose to specialize in obscure and unusual forms of entertainment, such as stage magic or juggling.

Since entertainers are often on the road, a virtuoso can travel wherever she likes, incorporating as much adventuring into her journeys as she wishes. Because of her talent for winning admirers, she usually remains above suspicion should anything underhanded occur in a place she is visiting on tour.

Bards are most often drawn to this prestige class, although rogues, illusionists, and multiclass combinations of both can also excel in it. Bards tend to perform as musicians or actors, illusionists as stage magicians, and rogues as dancers, tumblers, or sleight-of-hand artists. Characters of most other classes are either not outgoing enough to enjoy being virtuosos, or they find other channels for their extrovertism.

- Hit Die: d6.
- Proficiencies: A virtuoso does not gain any additional weapon or armor proficiencies.
- Skill Points: 4+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:

Skills: Perform 10 ranks, Intimidate or Persuade 6 ranks.
Spells: Able to cast 0-level arcane spells (cantrips).

CLASS FEATURES:

Level
1: Bardic Music (see below), Virtuoso performance (sustaining song)
2:
3: Virtuoso performance (calumny)
4: Virtuoso performance (jarring song)
5: Virtuoso performance (sharp note)
6: Virtuoso performance (mindbending melody)
7: Virtuoso performance (greater calumny)
8: Virtuoso performance (magical melody)
9: Virtuoso performance (song of fury)
10: Virtuoso performance (revealing melody)

SPELLS PER DAY/SPELLS KNOWN

Since the virtuoso often uses magic to enhance her performances, it's important for her to maintain her magical studies. Thus, whenever she gains a new virtuoso level, she gains new spells per day and spells known as if she had also gained a level in a spellcasting class she belonged to before adding the prestige class. She does not, however, gain any other benefit a character of that class would have gained (metamagic or item creation feats, new familiar abilities, and so on). This means that she adds her new level of virtuoso to the level of some other spellcasting class she has, then determines spells per day, caster level, and spells known (if formerly a bard or sorcerer) accordingly.

BARD SONG

At 1st level, the virtuoso gains the Bard Song ability if she did not already have it from a previous class. A virtuoso's class level stacks with Bard when determining the power of her Bard Song.

VIRTUOSO PERFORMANCE

With an impassioned soliloquy or a haunting melody, the virtuoso can create magical effects beyond even the capabilities of Bard Song. Virtuoso performance can be used once per virtuoso level per day. If the virtuoso has bard levels, those stack with virtuoso levels to determine uses per day. Many virtuoso performance effects require more than one of the ability's allotted daily uses. Virtuoso Performance effects last 10 rounds unless otherwise specified.

Sustaining Song: Stabilizes unconscious allies
Calumny: Makes others less friendly towards target [not implemented yet]
Jarring Song: Inhibits spellcasting (forces concentration check, 3 uses)
Sharp Note: Sharpens piercing and slashing weapons (adds keen property, 3 uses)
Mindbending Melody: Dominates target (2 uses)
Greater Calumny: Makes others hostile towards target [not implemented yet]
Magical Melody: Increases caster level of allies by 1 (2 uses)
Song of Fury: Enrages allies (3 uses)
Revealing Melody: Gives True Seeing effect (2 uses per round)

这本书汇集了关于被称为“三神”的三位善良盟友神祇——提尔、伊尔梅特和托姆——教义的神学思考。书中有一页被做了标记，上面的一段话吸引了你的注意：\n\n“许多人被伊尔梅特所教导的仁慈与怜悯的教义所吸引，却不理解该信仰苦修实践的目的。他们更看不出这样的教义如何能与托姆所教导的坚定不移的职责奉献，或提尔所教导的不屈不挠的正义要求相兼容。如果他们多了解一些历史，意识到善意多么经常出错，以及多少邪恶是以善良事业之名犯下的，这些困惑肯定不会产生。哪个暴君不曾声称他所犯下的暴行都是为了更大的善？我们总是看到，为了某种纯粹假设的未来之善，真实的罪行被犯下。只有通过苦修的自我克制来培养严格的自律，我们才能避免那些会欺骗我们、让我们以为自己的私欲能服务于众人之善的合理化借口。只有时刻坚守职责与正义，我们才能避免被‘有时目的证明手段正当’的观念所说服。因此，一个人从伊尔梅特开始，认识到对所有人的仁慈之责，但接着走向托姆，认识到如果我们的仁慈意图不被扭曲，就需要不惜一切代价忠于职责，最后认识到这一切如何融入一个由提尔主宰的超越性正义秩序之中……”
src: This book is a compilation of theological reflection on the teachings of the three good allied deities known as the "Triad": Tyr, Ilmater, and Torm. One page in the book is marked and the following passage on it catches your eye:\n\n"Many people are attracted to the doctrines of mercy and compassion taught by Ilmater, but do not understand the purpose of that faith's ascetical practices. Still less do they see how such a doctrine can be compatible with the unswerving devotion to duty taught by Torm or the unflinching demands of justice taught by Tyr. If only they knew enough history to realize how often good intentions go wrong, and how much evil is done in the name of good causes, surely these confusions would not arise. What tyrant has not claimed that the atrocities he commits are all for a greater good? Always, we see very real crimes perpetrated for the sake of some purely hypothetical future good. Only by developing rigorous self-discipline through ascetical self-denial can we avoid rationalizations that will delude us into thinking our own selfish desires can serve the good of all. Only by holding fast to duty and justice at all times can we avoid being convinced that the end sometimes justifies the means. Thus, one starts with Ilmater and the recognition of a duty of benevolence to all, but proceeds to Torm and the need for devotion to duty at all costs if our benevolent intentions are not to be perverted, and ends with recognizing how this all fits into a transcendent order of justice, over which Tyr presides..."

dst:
（进阶职业）
对于奥术施法者来说，死灵法咒通常是一个糟糕的选择。那些真正想要掌握不死技艺的人几乎总是追求神术手段。然而，对于那些渴望控制不死生物，又不想失去太多奥术力量的人来说，存在一种替代方案。这就是苍白之主，他汲取一种特殊知识的源泉，提供其独有的恐怖力量。

- 生命骰：d6。
- 擅长：苍白之主不会获得任何额外的武器或护甲擅长。
- 技能点：2+ 智力调整值。

要求：

阵营：任何非善良。
学识：8级。
专长：技能专攻：学识
法咒：能够施放3级或更高的奥术。

职业特性：

等级
1：骨肤 I - 防御等级增加 +2.每四级苍白之主，此加值再增加 +2。
2：操纵死尸 - 每日一次类法术能力。
3：黑暗视觉 - 获得黑暗视觉能力。
4：召唤不死生物 - 每日两次类法术能力，召唤一个不死生物。
5：不死活力术 - 每级 +3 生命值
6：不死嫁接 I - 获得不死手臂，每日两次可以麻痹。
7：坚如骨石 - 免疫定身，麻痹和震慑。
8：不死嫁接 II - 麻痹之触每日可使用三次。
9：召唤高等不死生物 - 每日一次类法术能力，召唤一个强大的不死生物。
10：不死精通 - 免疫重击。
  不死精通之触 - 不死手臂之触立即杀死目标（DC 17）.

奖励法咒

在苍白之主职业每获得一个奇数等级时，角色获得新的每日法咒，如同他在添加此进阶职业之前所属的施法职业也提升了一级。然而，除了增加的施法有效等级外，他不会获得该职业角色会获得的任何其他好处。
src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
Necromancy is usually a poor choice for arcane spellcasters. Those who really want to master the deathless arts almost always pursue divine means. However, an alternative exists for those who desire power over undead, without losing too much of their arcane power. Enter the pale master, who draws on a font of special lore that provides a macabre power all its own.

- Hit Die: d6.
- Proficiencies: A pale master does not gain any additional weapon or armor proficiencies.
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:

Alignment: Any nongood.
Lore:  8 ranks.
Feat: Skill Focus: Lore
Spells: Ability to cast arcane spells of 3rd level or higher.

CLASS FEATURES: 

Level
1: Bone Skin I - Add +2 to AC. This increases by another +2 for every four levels of Pale Master.
2: Animate Dead - Once per day spell-like ability.
3: Darkvision - Gain Darkvision ability.
4: Summon Undead - Twice per day spell-like ability summons an undead creature.
5: Deathless Vigor - +3 Hit Points per level
6: Undead Graft I - Gains undead arm that twice per day can paralyze.
7: Tough as Bone - Immune to hold, paralyze, and stunning.
8: Undead Graft II - Paralyze touch can be used three times a day.
9: Summon Greater Undead - Once per day spell-like ability summons a powerful undead.
10: Deathless Mastery - Immune to critical hits.
  Deathless Master Touch - Touch of the undead arm instantly kills (DC 17).

BONUS SPELLS

At every odd level gained in the pale master class, the character gains new spells per day as if he had also gained a level in a spellcasting class he belonged to before adding the prestige class.  He does not, however, gain any other benefit a character of that class would have gained, except for an increased effected level of spellcasting.

src:
Shedu Crown

Descriptors: Good, mind-affecting  
Classes: Totemist 
Chakra: Heart (totem) 
Saving Throw: See text

Glowing argent incarnum forms a shining crown that hovers slightly above your head. Its presence lends a regal air to your bearing, and you feel yourself become more calm, more dignified, and more stable-emotionally and even physically grounded.

You are immune to being pushed back as the result of a bull rush.

Essentia: You gain a competence bonus on saving throws against mind-affecting spells and effects equal to the number of points of essentia you invest in your shedu crown. 

Chakra Bind (Heart) 

The appearance of your shedu crown is unchanged, but when you use the power of this chakra bind, it briefly flares with brilliant silver light. 

You can shift from the Material Plane to the Ethereal Plane as a standard action. The effect lasts for a number of rounds equal to your meldshaper level. You can do this once per day.

Chakra Bind (Totem) 

Your hair grows into a bushy mane beneath your crown. If you are male, your beard likewise grows. Your body looks and feels more solid and strong.

You gain the ability to make a trample attack. As a full-round action, you can move up to twice your speed and literally run over any creature equal to your own size or smaller. Your trample attack deals 1d8 points of bludgeoning damage (or 1d6 points if you are Small) plus 1-1/2 times your Strength modifier. Opponents have a Reflex save for half damage.

“欢迎！从现在起，你可以把自己当作公会的一员了。在开始之前，关于执行我们指派的任务，这里有一些一般性建议：除非明确被告知，否则外出抢劫时尽量避免杀人。无谓的暴力会引来城市守卫过多的关注，而我们不需要那样。另一方面，除非明确被告知不许，否则除了指定目标之外，你在行动过程中发现的其它物品也可以随意偷走并自由出售。至于我们要求你弄到的东西，公会将拿走其价值的大部分，但剩下的仍然足够给你丰厚的报酬。现在，你准备好接受任务了，还是想先看看你的新公会之家？”
src: "Welcome! You may consider yourself a member of the guild now. Before you get started, here's some general advice about doing jobs we assign: unless you've specifically been told to, try to avoid killing anyone while you're out robbing. Gratuitous violence attracts a lot more interest from the City Watch than we need. On the other hand, unless you've been specifically told otherwise, feel free to steal other items you may find in the course of your work besides your assigned objective and sell them freely. As far as what we're asking you to get, the guild will get the better part of its value, but there will still be enough left over to reward you handsomely. Now, are you ready to be assigned a job now, or would you like to look around your new guild home a little first?"

学者们数百年来一直在争论变形怪的起源。这些变形者阴暗，神秘，难以捉摸，很久以前就学会了如何融入人类社会。因此，博学之士相信变形怪曾经是人类。变形怪如何获得其独特能力尚不清楚，甚至对他们自己也是如此。变形怪没有自己的社会。他们通过与其他种族的交往来满足对陪伴和社会互动的任何渴望。尽管变形怪独立行动，遵循自己的动机和目标，但仍有谣言称存在一个“秘密阴谋集团”的长老变形怪，他们渴望的正是控制世界。几乎没有证据证实这些谣言，这些谣言可能是变形怪自己散布的，以使其种族的名声更加神秘。

src:
Scholars have debated for centuries about the origin of the doppelgangers. Shadowy, mysterious, and enigmatic, these shapeshifters learned long ago how to integrate themselves into human society. For this reason, learned men and women believe that doppelgangers were once human. How doppelgangers gained their unique abilities is unknown, even to themselves. Doppelgangers do not have a society of their own. They fill any desire for companionship and social interaction through their association with other races. Although doppelgangers act independently, following their own motivations and goals, rumors persist of a �secret cabal?of elder doppelgangers who desire nothing less than control of the world. Little evidence corroborates these rumors, which may have been perpetuated by the doppelgangers themselves to lend evenmore mystery to their race's reputation.
  
Doppelganger Racial Traits:
+2 Strength, +2 Dexterity, +2 Constitution, +2 Intelligence, +4 Wisdom, +2 Charisma: Doppelgangers have improved their minds and bodies through centuries of mimicking humanoid forms.
Monstrous Humanoid (Shapechanger): Doppelgangers are monstrous humanoids with the shapechanger subtype. They retain this type and subtype regardless of any humanoid form they may assume.
Medium: As Medium creatures, doppelgangers have no special bonuses or penalties due to size.
Doppelganger base land speed is 30 feet.
Darkvision: Doppelgangers can see in the dark out to 60 feet.
Racial Hit Dice: A doppelganger begins with four levels of monstrous humanoid.
+4 natural armor bonus: Doppelganger skin is resilient and tough.
Racial Skills: +10 to Bluff, +8 Sense Motive, +2 Intimidate, +2 Persuade. Doppelgangers have a talent for deception.
Change Shape (Su): A doppelganger can assume the shape of any Small or Medium humanoid. 
Immunities: A doppelganger is immune to sleep and charm effects.
Favored Class: Rogue. A multiclass doppelganger's rogue class does not count when determining whether it takes an experience point penalty for multiclassing.
Level adjustment: +4

src: A Calimshan expedition exploring the jungles of Chult clashed with a native raiding party who put up a remarkable fight despite the primitive nature of their weapons. Ultimately victorious despite the unexpected difficulty, the Calishites investigated the weapons of their foes and found them to be heavily enchanted. A few members of the group were charged with the task of taking these valuable weapons back to the coast and eventually on to the markets of Calimport, but the bulk of the expedition pressed on into the jungle in the hope of finding the source of whatever magic had empowered the clubs and similar crude weapons found, assuming this would enrich them even further. They were never heard from again.

"总结一下，我要你做的事如下：首先，去那个‘泰坦’帮派那里，用任何必要的手段对付他们。你会在东南方找到他们的藏身处。进入那个区域时，要做好战斗准备。其次，留意凯勒姆·伊沙丁。虽然我担心最坏的情况，但我并不确定他遭遇了什么，任何消息，无论好坏，我都会感激。最后，虽然这个‘泰坦’帮派是我们最紧迫的问题，但我担心这可能不是唯一的问题。过去几周，住在这附近的一些人神秘失踪了。如果你能四处看看，找出这些失踪事件背后的原因，那就太好了。"
src: "To sum up, here is what I want you to do: First, go over to this 'Titan' gang and deal with them by whatever means necessary. You will find their hideouts southeast of here. Be prepared for a fight if you enter that region. Secondly, keep an eye out for Kelem Ishadin. While I fear the worst, I do not know for certain what has become of him, and would appreciate any news, good or bad. Finally, while this 'Titan' gang represents our most pressing problem, I fear it may not be the only one. A number of people who live about here have mysteriously gone missing over the last few weeks. It would be nice if you could look around and see if you cannot find whatever may be behind these losses."

Blacklight counters or dispels any light spell of equal or lower level, such as daylight.

Urdunnir are taught to live in harmony with the environment that they see as great sea of earth and stone, ever changing and always beautiful. dst: 索里克是一位技艺精湛的矮人铁匠，但为了生计，他常常不得不批量生产武器和护甲，无法在这些作品上花费他理想中的时间。尽管按照大多数铁匠的标准，即便是他的常规作品也属上乘，索里克却有着更高的追求。他时常会抽出时间，致力于打造一件真正代表铁匠艺术巅峰的杰作，使用诸如精金之类的稀有材料。这件武器便是这样一件作品，是索里克应一位半身人顾客的抱怨而制作的。那位顾客偏好持盾战斗，却对店里最好的武器都因尺寸过大而无法满足他的需求感到失望。索里克的设计巧妙而富有创意，锤头上看似常规的尖刺实际上是喷嘴，能喷射出腐蚀性酸液，对敌人造成额外伤害。
src: Thorik is a skilled dwarven smith, but the demands of making a living often force him to produce weapons and armor in quantity, on which he cannot spend as much time as he would like. While even his routine work is of high-quality by the standards of most smiths, Thorik aspires to more. Every now and then he seeks out time to devote to the production a true masterpiece of the smith's art, employing rare materials like adamantine. This weapon is one such work, made by Thorik in response to the complaints of a halfling customer, who preferred to fight with a shield equipped and was disappointed that the best weapons available in the shop were too large to enable him to do so. A clever and innovative desgin on Thorik's part, what look like conventional spikes on the macehead are actually nozzles that spray corrosive acid, inflicting additional damage on foes.

Now Kalomas hopes that years of failure, and years of witnessing the corruption and injustice of what passes for law here have modified my views somewhat. src: Kadzia has warned me that upon reaching the ground floor of the Zekar tower, I will be transported as I traverse it to the fiery planar trap I was in earlier. She has instructed me in the procedure I must follow to escape. To re-open the portal, I will need to press down the two glowing magical globes to the northwest and southeast of the portal. Unfortunately I will initially find them to be locked in place. To unlock them, I will need to head west, and flip the levers there a number of times in the correct order. To determine the correct order, I must locate the unlighted brazier, to the northeast of the poratl. Casting a spell on it that involves fire, such as Burning Hands or Fireball, will cause it to light up, and as it does I will see the flames take on the shape of numbers. These correspond to the numbers on the levers, and will indicate the correct sequence in which to flip them. Kadzia has given me a Burning Hands scroll to use for this purpose. Zarala should be able to use it if I am not.\n\nI was able to escape the trap by following Kadzia's instructions.

幽影信徒是字面和形而上学意义上的暗影学生。通过将灵能注入暗影，他可以利用世界的黑暗和自己灵魂的黑暗来实现他心中的任何目标。其他人可能会在黑暗的地方退缩，害怕光明消逝时蠢蠢欲动的生物，但幽影信徒凝视着夜晚的心脏而毫不畏缩。

与武僧非常相似，幽影信徒寻求探索自己的本性，并完美掌握他在自身内部发现的黑暗力量。他所培养的潜行，机动性和战斗能力的罕见组合使他成为出色的间谍，盗贼，魔法使用者或刺客。一些幽影信徒成为自由怪物猎人，或致力于寻找恶徒并让他们恐惧黑暗的义警。其他人则成为无情的杀手，利用他们的力量掠夺弱者和无助者。但无论他们的技能如何体现，所有幽影信徒都被暗影所吸引，在那里他们可以清楚地看到自己灵魂的潜力。

src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
The umbral disciple is a student of shadow in both a literal and a metaphysical sense. By infusing shadows with essentia, he can harness both the darkness of the world and the darkness of his own soul to meet whatever goals he has in mind. Others might shrink from dark places and dread the creatures that stir when the light fades, but the umbral disciple stares into the heart of the night without flinching.

Much like the monk, the umbral disciple seeks to explore his own nature and perfectly master the dark power he finds within himself. The rare combination of stealth, mobility, and combat prowess that he cultivates makes him an excellent spy, burglar, magic-wielder, or assassin. Some umbral disciples become freelance monster hunters or vigilantes dedicated to seeking out evildoers and teaching them to fear the dark. Others become heartless killers who use their powers to prey on the weak and the defenseless. But regardless of how their skills manifest, all umbral disciples are drawn to the shadows, where they can clearly see the potential of their own souls.

- Hit Die: d6
- Proficiencies: An Umbral Disciple does not gain any additional weapon or armor proficiencies.
- Skill Points: 6+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:

Skills: Concentration 4 ranks, Hide 8 ranks, Lore 2 ranks, Listen 8 ranks.
Essentia Pool: 1.

CLASS FEATURES:

Level
1:  Step of the Bodiless - Bonus to Balance, Climb, Jump, Tumble
2:  Sneak Attack 1d6
3:  Embrace of Shadow - Concealment, hide in plain sight
4:  
5:  Sneak Attack 2d6
6:  
7:  Sight of the Eyeless - See invisible, bonus to Spot
8:  Sneak Attack 3d6
9:  Soulchilling Strike - Attacks deal Strength damage
10: Kiss of the Shadows - Extended range on melee attacks

BONUS ESSENTIA:

The Umbral Disciple increases his essentia pool by 1 at levels 1-2, 2 at 3-4, 3 at 5-6, 4 at 7, 5 at 8, 6 at 9, and a max increase of 7 at 10th level.

你像龙一样扑向敌人并发动毁灭性攻击。你跃过她，在空中翱翔时释放出一连串毁灭性攻击。

作为此招式的一部分，你尝试进行跳跃检定以跃过目标。此跳跃检定的结果必须足以让你穿过对手的空间并越过她。如果你未能通过跃过敌人所需的跳跃检定，你会因跳跃的距离而引发借机攻击（如适用）. 如果你的跳跃太短无法越过对手，但足够远以至于你会落在她占据的空间，则你落在最接近你起始方格且与对手相邻的方格。
如果你的检定不足以跃过目标，只要目标在你的触及范围内，你也可以对敌人进行一次无特殊加值或减值的攻击。如果检定成功，你在跳跃期间离开威胁方格不会引发借机攻击。你的敌人对你的近战攻击失去 AC 上的敏捷加值。此攻击造成额外 10d6 点伤害，且目标必须成功通过强韧豁免（DC 等于你的跳跃检定结果） 否则被震慑 1 轮。
src:
Tiger Claw (Strike)
Level: Swordsage 7, warblade 7
Prerequisite: Three Tiger Claw maneuvers
Initiation Action: 1 standard action
Range: Melee attack
Target: One creature
Saving Throw: Fortitude partial

Like a dragon you swoop down upon you foe and let loose with a devastating attack. You leap over her and, as you soar through the air, unleash a devastating volley of attacks.

As part of this maneuver, you attempt a Jump check to leap over your target. The result of this Jump check must be sufficient to allow you to move through an opponent's space and over her. If you fail the Jump check needed to jump over your foe, you provoke attacks of opportunity for the distance you jump, if applicable. If your jump was too short to clear your opponent but far enough that you would land in a space she occupies, you land adjacent to your opponent in the square closest to your starting square.
If your check is insufficient to jump over your target, you can also make a single attack against your foe with no special benefits or penalties, as long as your target is within reach. If the check succeeds, you do not provoke attacks of opportunity for leaving threatened squares during your jump. Your foe loses her Dexterity bonus to AC against your melee attack. This attack deals an extra 10d6 points of damage, and the target must succeed on a Fortitude save (DC equal to your Jump check result) or be stunned for 1 round.

src:
Born of a union of mortal and elemental, a stonechild is a hardy entity grounded in soil and stone and gifted with incredible strength, fortitude, and a keen intellect. Although they are not the outcasts that half-orcs often are, stonechildren are rarely raised among others of their kind. Most stonechildren grow to maturity while living in dwarf or human communities, and those few who stay on the Material Plane often wander alone, taking up the mantle of adventurer. 
  
Stonechildren are most comfortable in and under the mountains; because of this preference, they usually end their wandering by settling with a community of dwarves. As they grow older, even the most adventurous stonechildren become more and more likely to seek a way to the Elemental Plane of Earth and surround themselves with others of their kind. 

Stonechild Ability Adjustments: +8 Str, +8 Con, +2 Int, -2 Cha
Favored Class (fighter): A multiclass Stonechild's fighter class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:
Darkvision
Natural Armor +4
Immune to Acid and Poison
Magic Stone - A stonechild can cast the magic stone spell three times a day at caster level 3.

Stonechild count as Outsider for spells and abilities. They have a Level Adjustment of +4, and 2 racial hit dice of Outsider that grants proficiency with all simple and martial weapons, light and medium armor, and shields.

亡魂之主是一个邪恶的施法者，她用魔法抓住虚体不死生物并让它们听从她的命令。愤怒的不死生物在发泄被打扰的怒火时散播恐惧和死亡。虽然亡魂之主有一些神术，但她的主要工具是召唤虚体不死生物为她服务的能力。邪恶牧师最常成为亡魂之主，不过前圣武士如果足够远离其守序善良根源并获得所需领域之一，也可能成为亡魂之主。

src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
The Master of Shrouds is an evil spellcaster who magically seizes incorporeal undead and sets them to do her bidding. The wrathful undead spread fear and death as they vent their anger at being disturbed. While a Master of Shrouds has some divine spells, her primary tool is the ability to summon incorporeal undead creatures to serve her. Evil clerics most often become Masters of Shrouds, though ex-paladins may do so if they turn far enough from their lawful good roots and gain access to one of the required domains.

- Hit Dice: d8.
- Proficiencies: Masters of Shrouds are proficient with all simple weapons, with all types of armor, and with shields.
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.


REQUIREMENTS:

Alignment: Evil
Skills: Concentration 10 ranks, Spellcraft 10 ranks.
Spells: Ability to cast divine spells, and access to at least one of these domains: Death, Evil, Protection

CLASS FEATURES:

Level
1: Turn Undead - As a cleric of the same class level as the Master of Shrouds. This stacks with any levels of Cleric and/or Paladin.
  Extra Turning - Character is now able to turn an additional six times per day.
  Death Domain - Master of Shrouds can summon a Negative Plane Avatar dependent upon level.
  Evil Domain - Player is able to turn outsiders.
  Protection Domain - Character gains access to certain protective spells.
3: Summon Undead I - The Master of Shrouds can summon an Allip.
5: Summon Undead II - Character can now summon a Wraith.
7: Summon Undead III - Spectre.
9: Summon Undead IV - Improved Spectre.

BONUS SPELLS:

When a new Master of Shrouds level is gained, the character gains new spells per day as if she had gained a level in the cleric class. She does not, however, gain any other benefit a character of that class would have gained (e.g., improved chance of rebuking or controlling undead).

Epic Master of Shrouds

As you gain epic levels, the undead summoned by Summon Undead I-IV continue to improve.

Bonus Feats:  The epic Master of Shrouds gains a bonus feat every three levels after 10th

Epic Master of Shrouds Bonus Feats List:
Automatic Quicken Spell, Automatic Silent Spell, Automatic Still Spell, Epic Spell Focus, Planar Turning, Armor Skin, Improved Combat Casting, Great Wisdom, Epic Divine Vigor, Epic Divine Resistance, Epic Divine Might.

Every now and then he seeks out time to devote to the production a true masterpiece of the smith's art, employing rare materials like adamantine. This weapon is one such work. Made by Thorik in honor of his craft, it unites two of the smith's chief tools, a hammer and fire, making it both symbolic and useful.

src: "I know one member of the Twisted Rune, and can tell you where to find him. Teroz Gan pretends to be a wizard of moderate power, and he can and does walk down the streets of Calimport appearing perfectly human and attracting no particular notice. This however is a result of his mastery of illusions. In actuality he is a lich and an archmage. He had frequent dealings with me when I was an agent of the Rune and eventually grew weary of always maintaining his disguise. Thus his true nature was revealed to me. He now lives in a small tower in the area called the Scholar's Corner, where he maintains the fiction of being human." Feyar shows you the location on your map. "That is doubtless where Hasin went."

图勒魔是尤斯魔中体型最大的。它们是独居生物，在荒野和偏僻小路上游荡，寻找食物或容易得手的猎物。当图勒魔受到伤害时，它的肉须会融合成覆盖全身的深红色甲壳。一个受过多次伤害的图勒魔看起来像一个有着光滑血红色皮肤的巨人。

src:
Turlemoi are the largest of the ushemoi. Solitary creatures, they wander the wilderness and the back roads in search of food or easy prey. As a turlemoi takes damage, its tendrils of flesh fuse into a crimson shell that covers its body. A turlemoi that has sustained several injuries looks like a giant with a smooth, blood-red hide.

A turlemoi's personality also changes as its body transforms. Though it starts out meek and fearful, it becomes more confident and wrathful the more damage it takes. Though other creatures might start a fight with confidence and flee when they are injured, turlemoi do the opposite. Once committed to combat, a turlemoi fights to the death.

Turlemoi Ability Adjustments: +6 Str, +4 Dex, +8 Con, -4 Int, +4 Wis, -4 Cha
Favored Class (Barbarian): A multiclass Turlemoi's barbarian class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

- Large Creature
- Low Light Vision
- Base movement of 40
- Natural Armor Bonus: Racial natural armor bonus of 3
- Damage Reduction: Innate damage reduction of 10/- to bludgeoning damage
- Two Slam Attacks (2d6)
- -4 penalty on saves against Fear
- Strength from Pain (Ex): Whenever a Turlemoi takes damage from any source, it gains a +1 bonus on attack rolls, a +2 bonus on damage rolls, and its natural armor bonus to AC increases by 2. These benefits last for 1 minute. Bonuses stack each time a Turlemoi takes damage, to a maximum of a +5 bonus on attack rolls, a +10 bonus on damage rolls, and a +10 natural armor bonus to AC. All bonuses reset after one minute from when they were first gained.
- Rising Courage (Ex): When a turlemoi's bonus on attack rolls from its strength from pain ability is +3 or higher, it becomes immune to all mind-affecting spells and abilities. 
- Rock Throwing (Ex): Turlemoi can throw rocks as a ranged weapon, as do giants
- Monstrous Humanoid: Turlemoi are considered Monstrous Humanoid for the purpose of spells

dst: 我再次见到了我以前的雇主萨曼·瓦拉迪，并因在沙漠中从强盗手中救下他而得到了丰厚的报酬。他还请我为他完成另一项小任务：与城市守卫总部的海关检查员交谈，并从他那里取得官方文件，证明萨曼正在运送的一些货物已通过检查。据萨曼说，我只需提到他的名字，并出示他给我的盖有他印章的文件，因为一切都已经安排好了。\n\n事实证明，这件事比萨曼所说的要稍微复杂一些，因为海关检查员期望得到一笔贿赂，作为完成安排的条件。不过，我仍然拿到了必要的证明，并把它带给了萨曼，得到了一点小报酬。
src: I have again met my former employer, Saman Waladi, and been generously rewarded for saving him from the bandits in the desert. He has also asked me to perform another small task for him: speaking to the Customs Inspector at City Watch Headquarters, and obtaining from him official papers indicating that some goods Saman is shipping have passed his inspection. According to Saman, I need only mention his name and display a paper he has given me with his seal, as arrangements have already been made.\n\nThe matter proved a bit more complicated than Saman indicated, as the Customs Inspector expected a bribe as a condition of completing the arrangements. However, I was still able to obtain the necessary certificate, and took it to Saman for a small reward.

The thirst for power drives some people to extreme lengths, regardless of the consequences. Though it is hard to believe that any living being would willingly bond the skin of a living demon to their own, that is exactly what the Acolyte of the Skin is willing to attempt in their pursuit for power.

Through this diabolic act of symbiosis, the Acolyte hopes to gain infernal power, heedless of the possible consequences to their own soul and psyche. For who knows what may happen as the bond between Acolyte and skin grows stronger and the full power of infernal darkness is unleashed.

- Hit Die: d4.

Alignment: Any non-good.

Level

3: Fiendish Glare - The Acolyte's glare can decrease a foe's abilities and even stun weak opponents.
4: Fiendish Knowledge - The Acolyte gains a free bonus feat.
5: Skin Adaptation - Grants +2 Natural Armor, +2 Constitution.
6: Cold Resistant - The Acolyte gains 20 cold resistance.

9: Summon Fiend - The Acolyte can summon a Vrock once per day.
10: Symbiosis - Grants (20/+1) damage reduction. This increases by +1 every 5 Epic levels.

BONUS SPELLS

Every other level in Acolyte of the Skin, the character gains new spells per day as if they had also gained a level in their highest arcane caster class. No new spells are learned through this ability, however.

（进阶职业）
暴风战士是致命刀刃旋风中的平静点。诗人用诸如舞者之类的华丽词汇来描述暴风战士和她的双刃的动作，但精通这种战斗风格不是关于舞蹈。也不是为了给任何人留下印象 - 尤其是诗人。暴风战士专注于学习双武器战斗的终极秘密，只为一个目的 - 摧毁她的敌人。

- 生命骰：d10。
- 武器和防具擅长：暴风战士不获得任何武器或防具擅长。
- 技能点：2+ 智力调整值。

要求：

基础攻击加值：+9。
专长：双巧手*，闪避，灵活移动，跳跃攻击，双武器战斗，以及武器娴熟（任意） 或武器专攻（任意）.巡林客在 1 级时视为拥有双武器战斗。

职业特性：

等级
1：精通双武器战斗 - 角色能够以 -5 攻击检定减值获得第二次副手攻击。
2：双武器防御 +1 - 暴风战士的闪避 AC 获得 +1 加值。
4：双武器防御 +2 - 加值提升至 +2。
5：高等双武器战斗 - 暴风战士每轮获得额外一次攻击，但攻击加值受 -2 减值。
7：双武器防御 +3 - 加值提升至 +3。
8：绝对双巧手 - 将双武器战斗减值降至 -0/-0，或副手使用非轻型武器时为 -2/-2。
10：至高双武器战斗 - 暴风战士每轮副手获得额外两次攻击，但攻击加值受 -4 减值。

注意：
暴风战士最适合穿轻甲。穿着重甲或中甲时，暴风战士失去所有加值能力。

*仅当模组未使用 3.5e 双武器战斗选项时需要。
src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
The Tempest is the point of calm within a whirling barrier of deadly blades. Poets use colorful terms such as dancer to describe the movement of a Tempest and her two blades, but mastery of this fighting style is not about dancing. Nor is it about impressing anyone - least of all poets. The Tempest focuses on learning the ultimate secrets of two-weapon fighting for a single purpose - the destruction of her enemies.

- Hit Die: d10.
- Proficiencies: Tempests gain no weapon or armor proficiencies.
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:

Base Attack Bonus: +9.
Feats: Ambidexterity*, Dodge, Mobility, Spring Attack, Two-Weapon Fighting, and Weapon Finesse (any) or Weapon Focus (any). Rangers are considered to have Two-Weapon-Fighting at Level 1.

CLASS FEATURES:

Levels
1: Improved Two-Weapon Fighting - Character is able to get a second off hand attack at a -5 penalty to attack roll.
2: Two-Weapon Defense +1 - The Tempest gains +1 bonus to her dodge AC.
4: Two-Weapon Defense +2 - Bonus improves to +2.
5: Greater Two-Weapon Fighting - Tempest gains another attack per round, but at a -2 penalty to her attack bonus.
7: Two-Weapon Defense +3 - Bonus improves to +3.
8: Absolute Ambidexterity - Decreases the two-weapon fighting penalties to -0/-0 or -2/-2 with a non-light weapon in the off-hand.
10: Supreme Two-Weapon Fighting - Tempest gains another two attacks per round in her off hand but at a -4 penalty to her attack bonus.

NOTE:
The Tempest is best in light armor. While wearing heavy or medium armor a tempest loses all bonus abilities.

*Only required if module is not using the 3.5e Two-Weapon Fighting option.

src: I have met the mage Ynal Mekazhan, who tells me that he has learned of an incantation that can teleport us to a long-lost refuge once occupied by the great wizard Zataroth. Such a place is sure to be full of magical treasures, but Ynal has discovered that there will be some difficulties to obtaining them. Firstly, breaking the wards on the entrance requires the simultaneous casting of both a breach spell and one dispelling magic. Therefore Ynal has found it necessary to recruit a second spellcaster, myself. Secondly, the place is supposed to be protected by guardian golems. Ynal is a scholar with little experience of battle magic and thus also wants me to clear these out out for him, along with any other hazards I might encounter. As a reward, I will get first pick of any treasures I find within, Ynal wants only Zataroth's notes and papers on magical research, which I should bring to him.\n\nYnal has magically transported us to this hidden refuge of Zataroth. I can now explore it and report back to him when it has been cleared.

Hybsil
Hybsils are woodland nomads devoted to deities of nature, their families, and crazy acts of bravery. They look like 3-foot-tall centaurs with the bodies of antelopes instead of horses. Coloration of their antelope bodies varies, covering the entire spectrum of browns, blacks, stripes, and spots found in normal antelopes. They live in tribes of twenty to eighty individuals and hunt across wide ranges of territory, often quite distant from their camps in order not to lead enemies to their families. Males have large forking antlers that molt in the dead of winter and grow back in the spring. Female hybsils have smaller straight or spiral antlers without branches, year round. 

Ability Adjustments -2 Strength, +6 Dexterity, +2 Constitution, +2 Intelligence

Fire: A missile of this energy type deals +1 point of damage per die.
Sonic: A missile of this energy type deals -1 point of damage per die and ignores an object's hardness.

This power's subtype is the same as the type of energy you manifest.

Augment: For every additional power point you spend, this power's damage increases by one die (d6) and its save DC increases by 1.

（进阶职业）
原始荒野的守护者和古树的捍卫者，森林大师是有感知自然的活化身。他们行走在森林的阴影下，摧毁那些会破坏荒野之地的人。德鲁伊掌握自然的所有方面；风和天气，动物和植物，草地和山脉，而森林大师认为森林比动物或人类的到来更古老，是世界上最神圣的地方。德鲁伊最常成为森林大师，但巡林客或自然神祇的牧师离开他们的亲属关系并追随这条道路也并非闻所未闻。

少数兼职野蛮人成为森林大师，尽管他们很少对自然的植物方面有献身精神来拥抱这种世界观。森林大师通常独自工作，但完全有能力作为团队的一部分工作。许多次冒险者与他们以为是年轻，小型的树人交谈，实际上他们是在与一位非常强大的森林大师交谈。森林大师群体之间没有竞争，尽管个人可能对执行树父意志的方法有分歧。

- 生命骰：d8。
- 熟练：森林大师不获得任何额外的武器或护甲熟练。
- 技能点：2+ 智力调整值。
- 每日法咒：在每个森林大师等级，角色获得新的每日法咒，如同他在添加此进阶职业等级之前所属的神术施法职业也提升了一级。然而，他不获得该职业角色会获得的任何其他好处（例如改善的驱散或斥责不死生物的机会）.

要求：

技能：动物感受情绪8级，专注4级，学识13级。
专长：警觉，坚忍，猛力攻击，技能专攻（学识），武器熟练（军用）或武器熟练（巨槌）.
法咒：能够施放纠缠术，植物生长*和命令植物*.

职业特性：
等级
1：	树兄弟（类法咒）：森林大师可以每天一次化为树形。
	自然感知*（特异）：森林大师可以完美准确地识别植物和动物。他可以确定水是否安全饮用或危险。
2：森林统治（超自然）：森林大师获得斥责或命令植物的能力，如同邪恶牧师斥责或命令不死生物。
    巨槌（超自然）：森林大师开始启蒙术构成其巨槌的木材和金属中的魔法能力。
3：天生护甲（特异）：森林大师的皮肤变成坚忍，树皮般的硬皮，给予他天生护甲+3
4：橡树之力（特异）：森林大师获得+2力量加值和进行猛击攻击的能力。
5：云杉生长（超自然）：每天一次，森林大师可以暂时增加他的体型和力量，如同使用正气如虹法咒。
7：橡树心（特异）：类型变为植物，获得火焰弱点。
8：深根（超自然）：每天一次，扎根变得无法移动并获得快速治疗5。
    森林长寿*（特异）：在第8级，森林大师因其持续的转变而获得魔法维持，并获得难以置信的长寿。
10：森林之力（特异）：原始森林将力量注入森林大师。他获得+2力量加值，+2体质加值，并且只受穿刺武器的一半伤害。他在自然环境中获得快速治疗1。

src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
Guardians of the pristine wilderness and defenders of the ancient trees, forest masters are the living embodiments of sentient nature. They walk the shadows under the woods and destroy those who would lay waste to the wild lands. Where druids hold all aspects of nature; wind and weather, animal and plant, meadows and mountains, the forest masters consider the forests more ancient than the coming of animals or humans the most sacred spots of the world.  Druids most often become forest masters, but it is not unheard of for rangers or clerics of nature deities to leave their kinships behind and follow this path.

A few multiclassed barbarians become forest masters, although they rarely have the dedication to the plant aspect of nature to embrace this worldview. Forest masters often work alone, but are more than capable of working as part of a group. Many times adventurers have spoken with what they thought was a young, small treant, when they were actually speaking with a very powerful forest master. There are no rivalries between groups of forest masters, although individuals may disagree on methods of enacting the will of the Treefather.

- Hit Die: d8.
- Proficiencies: A forest master does not gain any additional weapon or armor proficiencies.
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.
- Spells per Day: At each forest master level the character gains new spells per day as if he had also gained a level in a divine spellcasting class to which he belonged before adding the prestige class level. He does not, however, gain any other benefit a character of that class would have gained (such as an improved chance of turning or rebuking undead). 

REQUIREMENTS:

Skills: Animal Empathy 8 ranks, Concentration 4 ranks, Lore 13 ranks.
Feats: Alertness, Endurance, Power Attack, Skill Focus (Lore), Weapon Proficiency (martial) or Weapon Proficiency (maul).
Spells: Ability to cast entangle, plant growth*, and command plants*.

CLASS FEATURES:
Level
1: 	Tree Brother (Sp): The forest master may assume tree shape once per day.
	Nature Sense* (Ex): The forest master can identify plants and animals with perfect accuracy. He can determine whether water is safe to drink or dangerous.
2:  Forest Dominion (Su): The forest master gains the ability to rebuke or command plants as an evil cleric can rebuke or command undead.
    Great Mallet (Su): A forest master begins to awaken magical abilities within the wood and metal that make up his maul. 
3:  Natural Armor (Ex): The forest master's skin changes into a tough, barklike hide, granting him natural armor +3
4:  Oak Strength (Ex): The forest master gains a +2 bonus to Strength and the ability to make slam attacks. 
5:  Spruce Growth (Su): Once per day the forest master can temporarily increase his size and strength as if using a righteous might spell.
7:  Oakheart (Ex): Type changes to plant, gain weakness to fire.
8:  Deep Roots (Su): Once per day, sink roots to become immobile and gain Fast Healing 5.
    Forest Longevity* (Ex): At 8th level, the forest master is magically sustained by his continuing transformation and gains incredible longevity.
10: Forest Might (Ex): The primordial forest infuses the forest master with power. He gains a +2 bonus to Strength, a +2 bonus to Constitution, and he takes only half damage from piercing weapons. He gains Fast Healing 1 in natural environments.

*not implemented

(BASE CLASS)
Sometimes it is not enough to be a conquering warrior, a champion of all that's right, an experienced sellsword, or an elite foot soldier. Sometimes the circumstances require a solid commander of soldiers and situations. Sometimes the circumstances demand a marshal.

Marshals inspire trust in those they lead. They earn that trust by slogging through harsh landscapes, dangerous battlefields, and haunted catacombs along with those under their command. With a look, they can see where to best deploy their resources or come up with a sneaky ruse to fool their enemies. A marshal has a tactician's mind, a cartographer's overview of the disputed landscape (or dungeon warren), and a way with words that can inspire battle-hardened fighters to give it their all when melee breaks out.

- Hit Dice: d8.
- Proficiencies: Marshals are proficient with simple and martial weapons, all types of armor, and shields.

src: While wandering about the Docks District, I ran into Phanas Naseb, captain of a merchant ship. His specialty is transporting exotic animals. Unfortunately, a dire tiger in his hold has broken free of its cage, and is threatening to wreak havoc amongst the other animals down there. He has asked my assistance in getting the beast under control, giving me a dagger that has been enchanted to affect tigers specifically, putting them to sleep. I should only need to score one hit on the tiger, and should make a point not to kill so valuable a creature.\n\nUnfortunately, I ended up killing the tiger. Captain Naseb will doubtless be unhappy about this, though I suppose it should still be reported to him.

在找到圣戒的第二块碎片后，阿达拉斯告诉我，有了戒指的两块碎片，他可以施放一个预言法咒来定位最后一块碎片，然后打开一个临时界门，将人传送到那附近以取回最后一块碎片。他还承诺，如果我完成这次回收，将给予丰厚的奖励。我接受了这个任务，现在已经从它的不死守卫那里取回了这枚提尔圣戒的最后一块碎片。回到神殿后，我得知我的奖励就是这枚戒指本身，它将再次变得完整，并注入一套我可以自己选择的力量。

在选择了我希望戒指拥有的力量后，它通过神圣力量被重铸，并作为对我努力的奖励交给了我。
src:
In the lair of an undead monster, I found a broken piece of a magical ring inscribed with symbols of Tyr. When I showed it to Adaras, the head priest of the Temple of Tyr, he recognized it as part of a holy artifact of Tyr stolen some time ago. He rewarded me for returning the piece I found, and has told me that he would also like any other pieces of the ring that I should happen to find.

Having found a second piece of the holy ring, I was informed by Adaras that with two pieces of the ring, he could cast a divination spell that would locate the final piece, and then open a temporary portal that would transport one near that location to recover the last fragment. He also promised a substantial reward should I effect this recovery. I accepted this quest and have now recovered the final fragment of this holy ring of Tyr from its undead guardians. Returning to the temple, I was informed that my reward would be this very ring, made whole once more, and infused with a set of powers that I myself can choose.

After choosing what powers I wished the ring to have, it was reforged through divine power and given to me as a reward for my efforts.

With most of them around the fort you likely could profitably raid those caves. That would be bound to disrupt their logistical arrangements, and make it hard for them to carry on the siege. Of course, with you causing all this trouble in their rear the orcs will doubtless be sending out detachments to hunt you down, which will be most dangerous. That would not be altogether bad, however, as it would weaken their main force around the fort, perhaps eventually to the point where it could be attacked with some hope of success."

Muckdwellers are bipedal amphibians that dwell in swamps, marshes, and mud-bottomed bodies of still water. Many serve kuo-toa or lizardfolk tribes, surviving on the periphery of such societies and venerating their gods.

- Natural Armor: Muckdwellers have +3 natural armor bonus due to their scaly hides.
- Squirt: A muckdweller can squirt a jet of water into the eyes of a target up to 25 feet away.
- Simple Weapons: Muckdwellers are proficient with all simple weapons.
- Darkvision:  Muckdwellers are able to see in the dark as well as daylight.
- Humanoid: Muckdwellers are considered Humanoids for the purpose of spells.

src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
The famous Purple Dragons of Cormyr are regarded across Faerun as exemplars of disciplined, skilled, loyal soldiers. Their reputation is deserved partly because of the heroic actions of their leaders, the Purple Dragon Knights. Purple Dragon Knights develop uncanny skills relating to coordinating and leading soldiers. Most are fighters, rangers or paladins, but a few bards, clerics, and rogues have been known to become Purple Dragon Knights. Sorcerers and Wizards tend to join the War Wizards, Cormyr's elite brigade of fighting spellcasters, while barbarians are too undisciplined, and druids and monks too "uncivilized" in Cormyr to enter this career.

- Hit Die: d10.
- Proficiencies: A purple dragon knight gains no additional proficiencies.
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:

Alignment: Non-Evil and Non-Chaotic.
Base Attack Bonus: +4
Skills: Spot 2 ranks, Intimidate 1 rank, Listen 2 ranks, Persuade 1 rank, Ride 2.
Feat: Mounted Combat, Leadership (6th level minimum).

CLASS FEATURES:

Level
1: Rallying Cry - +1 Attack Bonus to all allies within 60 feet, can be used three times a day.
   Heroic Shield - Aid another for a +4 AC bonus
2: Inspire Courage - +2 saves vs. mind affecting, and +1 attack and damage, useable once a day.
3: Fear - As fear spell, useable once per day.
4: Inspire Courage - Can now be used twice a day.
    Oath of Wrath - +2 bonus to attack, damage, saves and skill vs. single enemy.
5: Final Stand - +2d10 HP to a number of allies equal to Purple Dragon Knight level + Charisma Bonus, once per day.

黑血教徒通过特殊训练强化手指并 toughen 指甲。结果，当狂暴时，你获得两次爪击，造成1d6点伤害加上你的力量调整值。

在3级时，你获得一次要咬击，造成1d4点伤害加上你力量调整值的一半。

在6级及更高时，每当你在狂暴期间用两次爪击都命中时，你撕扯对手的血肉，自动造成双倍爪击伤害，加上正常伤害。

精通擒抱：在2级时，你获得精通擒抱专长，即使你不满足其先决条件。

伤害减免（Ex）：在4级时，你获得伤害减免 3/+2.在9级时，这变为 5/+2。

精通天生攻击：在7级时，你的天生攻击变得更加致命。你的爪击现在造成1d8点伤害，你的咬击造成1d6点。

野蛮擒抱：从8级开始，如果你在成功的擒抱检定中处于狂暴状态，你造成伤害，如同你用所有天生武器命中（包括撕扯）.

野性形态：到10级时，你已经获得了对兽性的极大控制。你现在甚至可以在不狂暴时使用你的爪击，咬击和撕扯攻击。
src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
Worse things than wolves and orcs hunt the dark forests of the North. The beastly lycanthropes known as the People of the Black Blood venerate Malar with bloody rites that claim hundreds of human, elf, and dwarf lives every year. Black Blood cultists, worshipers of these lycanthropic horrors, are drawn from the totemic barbarian tribes scattered across the northern lands. They exhibit fearsome powers drawn from the veneration of the tainted animal spirits of their masters. That their reverence for the lycanthropes goes unrewarded does not matter to the unfettered spirits of the cultists they rage for their cruel masters and bring death to those who are not touched by the Beastlord's terrible power. 

- Hit Die: d12
- Proficiencies: A Black Blood Cultist gains no weapon or armor proficiencies
- Skill Points: 4 + Int Modifier

REQUIREMENTS
- Improved Unarmed Strike
- Track
- Lore 8
- Ability to Rage
- Chaotic Evil, Chaotic Neutral, or Neutral Evil

CLASS FEATURES:
Feral Rage (Ex): Black Blood cultist class levels stack with barbarian levels for purposes of determining your rage ability. Thus, an 8th-level barbarian/4th-level Black Blood cultist can use greater rage four times per day, just as a 12th-level barbarian could.

Black Blood cultists strengthen their fingers and toughen their nails with special training. As a result, when raging, you gain two claw attacks dealing 1d6 points of damage plus your Strength modifier. 

At 3rd level, you gain a secondary bite attack dealing 1d4 points of damage plus half your Strength modifier. 

At 6th level and higher, whenever you hit with both of your claw attacks during a rage, you rend your opponent's flesh, automatically dealing double claw damage in addition to normal damage.

Improved Grapple: At 2nd level, you gain the Improved Grapple feat even if you do not meet the prerequisites for it.

Damage Reduction (Ex): At 4th level, you gain damage reduction 3/+2. At 9th level, this becomes 5/+2.

Improved Natural Attacks: At 7th level, your natural attacks become even more deadly. Your claw attacks now deal 1d8 points of damage and your bite attack deals 1d6 points.

Savage Grapple: Starting at 8th level, you deal damage as if you had hit with all your natural weapons (including rend), if you are raging during a successful grapple check.

Feral Form: By 10th level, you have gained great control over your bestial nature. You can now use your claw, bite, and rend attacks even when you are not raging.

dst: "是的，但然后呢？你觉得这个<CUSTOM104>失踪后，尤其是哈辛也失踪后，没人会注意或在意吗？很可能一帮更强大的准英雄会追随<his/her>的脚步。当然我们也可以摧毁他们，但这可能实际上需要我们付出一些小小的努力，而且他们当然不会是最后一批。很快消息就会传开，卡林港地下的神秘区域是冒险者的死亡陷阱。而由于这些冒险蠢货都是疯子，那当然只会鼓励越来越多的人来烦我们。黑暗卡林港会变成另一个地下山，一个梦想冒险和荣耀的人来考验自己勇气的地方。那是你想要的吗？"
src: "Yes, but then what? Do you think no one will notice or care when this <CUSTOM104> goes missing, especially after Hasin did as well? Most likely a band of even more powerful would-be heroes will follow in <his/her> footsteps. Of course we could destroy them as well, but it might actually take some modest effort on our part, and they of course would not be the last. Soon word would get out that the mysterious regions beneath Calimport are a deathtrap for adventurers. And since these adventuring fools are all crazy, that of course would only encourage more and more of them to pester us. Dark Calimport would become another Undermountain, a place where those who dream of adventure and glory come to test their mettle. Is that what you want?"

拉玛苏斗篷

描述符：善良
职业：化身，图腾师
脉轮：手臂，肩部（图腾）
豁免检定：见正文

你将魂能塑造成一件由毛皮和羽毛制成的斗篷，在你的肩膀和背部周围闪耀着金棕色。斗篷在背后垂至膝盖，如果你愿意，它可以舒适地包裹你的身体并在前面合拢。在寒冷天气中它相当温暖，但在温暖温度下也不会太热。穿着它让你感到高贵和正义。

你的拉玛苏斗篷保护你免受邪恶生物的攻击。对抗邪恶生物进行的攻击或创造的效果时，你的护甲等级获得+2偏斜加值。

魂能：你每在拉玛苏斗篷中投入一点魂能，对抗邪恶生物使用的法咒和效果时，你的豁免检定获得+1抗力加值。
 
脉轮绑定（手臂）

你斗篷的金棕色毛皮向下延伸到你的上臂。同时，一股可感知的善良和力量光环围绕着你延伸，将斗篷给予你的同样保护笼罩在你的盟友身上。

拉玛苏斗篷提供的偏斜和抗力加值适用于你10英尺内的所有盟友。

脉轮绑定（肩部）

你的拉玛苏斗篷与你的肩膀融为一体，它的羽毛与毛皮分离，形成小而无效的翅膀，在你身后展开，仿佛要抵御攻击者。

除了善良阵营的召唤生物外，任何召唤生物都无法接近你。

脉轮绑定（图腾）

你肩膀周围的金棕色毛皮向上延伸，在你头部周围形成令人印象深刻的鬃毛。你的嘴里有一种感觉，仿佛你在品尝温暖的甜饮。

你可以作为一个标准动作喷出15英尺锥形的火焰。区域内的生物受到1d4点火焰伤害，加上每点投入魂能1d4点火焰伤害（反射减半）.
src:
Lammasu Mantle

Descriptors: Good  
Classes: Incarnate, Totemist  
Chakra: Arms, shoulders (totem) 
Saving Throw: See text

You form incarnum into a mantle of fur and feathers, shining golden brown around your shoulders and back. The cloak hangs down to your knees in back and wraps comfortably around your body to close in the front, if you wish. It is quite warm in cold weather, but not too hot in warmer temperatures. Wearing it makes you feel noble and righteous.

Your lammasu mantle protects you against the attacks of evil creatures. You gain a +2 deflection bonus to your Armor Class against attacks made or effects created by evil creatures. 

Essentia: For every point of essentia you invest in your lammasu mantle, you gain a +1 resistance bonus on saving throws against the spells and effects used by evil creatures. 
 
Chakra Bind (Arms)

The golden-brown fur of your mantle spreads down to your upper arms. At the same time, a palpable aura of goodness and power extends around you, cloaking your allies in the same protection the mantle gives you.

The deflection and resistance bonuses granted by the lammasu mantle apply to all allies within 10 feet of you.

Chakra Bind (Shoulders) 

Your lammasu mantle becomes one with your shoulders, and its feathers separate from its fur to form small, nonfunctional wings that spread behind you as if to ward off attackers.

No summoned creatures except those of good alignment can approach you.

Chakra Bind (Totem) 

The golden-brown fur around your shoulders extends upward into an impressive mane around your head. There is a sensation in your mouth as if you were savoring a warm, sweet drink.

You can breathe a 15-foot cone of fire as a standard action. Creatures within the area take 1d4 points of fire damage, plus 1d4 points of fire damage per point of invested essentia (Reflex half).
