src:
Mechanatrixes are planetouched who can trace their ancestry to one of the bizarre clockwork beings that reside on the plane of Mechanus.

Mechanatrixes are mostly human in appearance, but they have one or more mechanical or inorganic features. Most mechanatrixes have smooth skin with a faint metallic sheen.  They behave with cold rationality and have a no-nonsense attitude toward life.  As befitting their nature, mechanatrixes have an affinity for mechanical objects of all kinds. They have an innate understanding of engineering and all sorts of crafts. The more martial-minded mechanatrixes become excellent siege engineers.  Like other planetouched beings, mechanatrixes never quite fit into any society. Most human societies shun them, while those from the plane of Mechanus believe them to be tainted and impure. As a result, they are often loners, but they are rarely bothered by this lack of social contact.

Most mechanatrixes are firm believers in law and do whatever they can to fight chaos and bring order to tumultuous areas.

Mechanatrix Ability Adjustments: -2 Dex, +2 Con, +2 Int

Favored Class (Fighter): A multiclass mechanatrix's fighter class does not count when determining whether they suffer an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Racial Traits:
- An mechanatrix's base land speed is 30 feet.
- Darkvision:  Mechanatrixes are able to see in the dark as well as daylight.
- Proficiencies: Mechanatrixes are proficient with all simple and martial weapons, light armor, medium armor & shields.
- Shocking Grasp (Sp): A mechanatrix can use shocking grasp once per day as cast by a sorcerer of 1st level or the mechanatrix's character level, whichever is higher.
- Electricity Healing (Ex): Because of a mechanatrix's electricity affinity, any electricity attack directed at it cures 1 point of damage for each 3 points of damage it would otherwise deal. The mechanatrix gets no saving throw against electricity effects.
- Fire & Cold Resistance 5: Due to their body composition, Mechanatrixes are less susceptible to extremes of heat & cold.
- Skills: Mechanatrixes have a +2 racial bonus on Spot checks and a +4 racial bonus on Lore checks.
- Outsider: Mechanatrixes are outsiders for the purposes of spells and prerequisites.

Level Adjustment: +1

src:
Frostblood orcs trace their ancestry to ancient tribes that hunted and revered white dragons.  After a successful hunt, the hunters would performa  ritual where they drank the blood of their fallen foe, and over time this somehow managed to impart some traits of the white dragon into their bloodline.  They are physically similar to other orcs, but sport pale white skin, catlike eyes, and stringy white or grey hair that grows quickly.

Frostblood Orc Ability Adjustments: +4 Str, -2 Int, -2 Cha, -2 Wis.
Favored Class (Barbarian): A multiclass frostblood orc's barbarian class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

- Darkvision: Frostblood Orcs are able to see in the dark.
- Cold Resistance: Cold Resistance 10.
- Vulnerability to Fire: 50% more damage from fire.
- Endurance: Frostblood Orcs gain Endurance as a bonus feat.
- Light Sensitivity: Frostblood Orcs suffer -2 penalty to attack rolls, saves and checks while operating in bright light.
- Dragonblooded: Frostblood Orcs have the Dragonblood subtype.
- Orcish: Orcs are considered Orcish for the purpose of spells.

Goliaths are massive creatures unafraid of throwing their weight around in a fight. Highly competitive, these strong nomads can prove to be powerful allies and welcome additions to any adventuring party. 
  
Goliaths are known for their almost foolhardy daring. In their mountain homes, they leap from precipice to precipice, heedless of the fatal consequences of a misstep. They place great stock in clan and family; life in the mountains teaches even the youngest goliath to rely completely on his fellows for a hand across a crevasse. Because most goliaths are hunter-gatherers, they tend to be inquisitive, always curious about whether better hunting lies over the next ridge or a good water source can be found in the next canyon. 

Goliath Ability Adjustments: +4 Str, -2 Dex, +2 Con
Favored Class (Barbarian): A multiclass Goliath's barbarian class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

+2 racial bonus on Sense Motive
Powerful Build - The Goliath is treated as a Large creature for wielding weapons and combat maneuvers such as grappling and tripping
Running Jump - Goliaths treat all jump checks as running

Goliath count as monstrous humanoid for spells and abilities. They have a Level Adjustment of +1

dst: 音波抗力，强化
卷宗学者 变形自我

现已查明，卡洛玛斯·泽卡尔参与了变形蛛与噬火武僧及其各方盟友蹂躏卡林杉的阴谋。更有甚者，他最近背叛了自己的反奴隶制计划，泄露了由贾拉尔·马卡希看守的难民营地（这些人实际上是逃亡奴隶）的位置。他将这一反奴隶制行动的责任推给了哈马德·加尔哈德尔（后者确实有所参与，曾派我去协助保护营地），如今正准备集结兵力攻打加尔哈德尔庄园，而城市当局因加尔哈德尔参与非法解救奴隶而对他倒戈，对此予以默许。泽卡尔的动机尚不明确，但他构成的威胁十分严重。

返回庄园准备防御时，我发现哈马德和扎拉拉在一起，他们又透露了更多关于泽卡尔古怪而具毁灭性计划的信息。显然扎拉拉一直在与卡齐娅·泽卡尔通信，后者对父亲的奇怪行为感到担忧。她警告我们，他计划将泽法德之剑用于其最初的目的——释放卡利姆和门农，这很可能会给这片土地带来巨大的灾难。她还提出可以留一扇通往泽卡尔塔的门不锁，供我们用来挫败这一计划。扎拉拉相信自己是泽法德的后裔，因此如果我们能让她靠近那把剑，她就能控制它，因此我要护送她前往塔楼。

卡齐娅能在不被察觉的情况下留门不锁的唯一一扇门，位于塔楼下方的一个地下密室中，我们只能通过一条迂回的路线到达那里。首先，我们必须从庄园的一个后出口出去，找到通往下水道的铁栅。进入下水道后，我们必须用哈马德给我的钥匙进入主下水道系统，然后向南走，直到来到一个房间，里面有一扇通往暗黑卡林港废墟的活板门。这通向一个带有另一扇活板门的密室，通往更深处。穿过那扇门后，我们必须穿过那些下层废墟，直到找到东边的出口。那将带我们进入一条穿过幽暗地域的通道。我们要沿着它向南走，直到来到西侧的一个洞穴门。穿过它并穿过我们发现的废墟，向上走，最终会带我们到达泽卡尔塔正下方的一个密室。通往那里的门应该由卡齐娅解锁。从那里我们可以向上进入塔楼下方的下水道，然后进入塔楼本身。

卡齐娅已让我们进入泽卡尔塔，但首先逼我们发誓不杀她的父亲，只从他手中夺走那把剑。现在我们必须前往塔楼的最顶端找到他。
src:
It has now been revealed that Kalomas Zekar was involved in the plans of the aranea and the Consuming Fire monks and their various allies to ravage Calimshan. What's more, he has recently betrayed his own anti-slavery project by revealing the location of the camp of refugees (who were in fact escaped slaves) guarded by Jalar Makashi. He has placed the blame for this anti-slavery operation on Hamad Galhadr (who was indeed somewhat involved, sending me to help protect the camp), and is now preparing to gather forces to assault the Galhadr estate, with the tacit approval of the city authorities who have turned against Galhadr due to his involvement with illegal slave-rescuing. Zekar's motives are unclear but the threat he poses is serious.

Returning to the estate to prepare for its defense, I found Hamad and Zarala together and they revealed yet more information about Zekar's peculiar and destructive plans. Apparently Zarala has been in communication with Kadzia Zekar, who has become concerned about her father's strange behavior. She has warned us that he plans to use the Sword of Zefad for its original purpose of freeing Calim and Memnon, likely unleashing considerable devastation upon the land. She has also offered to leave unlocked a door into the Zekar tower that we could use to thwart this plan. Zarala believes she is a descendant of Zefad and thus able to control the sword if we can get her into proximity to it, and thus I am to escort her to the tower.

The only door Kadzia can leave unlocked without it being noticed is in a subterranean chamber beneath the tower, which we will reach only by a circuitous route. First, we must go out through one of the rear exits of the estate and find the grate leading to the sewers. Once in the sewers we must use the key Hamad has given me to enter the main sewer system and then head south until coming to a room containing a trap door leading down into the ruins of Dark Calimport. This leads to a chamber with another trap door, heading deeper. After going through that, we must travel through those lower ruins until we find an exit to the east. That will take us out into a passage through the Underdark. We are to follow it south, until coming to a cave door on the western side. Going through this and travel through the ruins we find, heading up, will eventually take us to a chamber directly beneath the Zekar tower. The door to it should be unlocked by Kadzia. From there we can go up into the sewers beneath the tower, and then into the tower itself.

Kadzia has let us into the Zekar tower, first extracting from us an oath not to kill her father, but only take the sword from him. Now we must proceed to the very top of the tower to find him.

src:
A rage mage can cast spells while in a rage. When she casts a spell of the abjuration, conjuration, evocation, necromancy, or transmutation school while in a rage, the rage mage uses her character level as her caster level. This ability only works when the rage mage is in a spell rage.

While in a spell rage, a rage mage becomes reckless and loses her some of her ability to defend herself. She temporarily takes a -2 penalty to Armor Class.

Unlike with a barbarian's rage, a rage mage can use any type of skill or feat while raging. A fit of rage lasts for a number of rounds equal to 3 + the character's Constitution modifier. A rage mage can end her rage voluntarily. At the end of the rage, the character is fatigued (-2 Strength, -2 Dexterity, can't charge or run) for the duration of the current encounter (unless the rage mage is 10th level, when this limitation no longer applies). A rage mage can only fly into a rage once per encounter, and only a certain number of times per day (determined by level). Entering a rage takes no time itself, but a rage mage can only do it during her action, not in response to somebody else's action.

你将受术者的汗水和水分化为冰，在皮肤下形成水泡和尖锐的冰晶。该法咒每轮造成累积的寒冷伤害：第 1 轮 1d6 点，第 2 轮 2d6 点，依此类推，第 3 轮造成 3d6 点，第 4 轮造成 4d6 点。

如果施法者至少 15 级，法咒持续到第 5 轮，造成 5d6 点寒冷伤害。在 20 级或更高时，增加第 6 轮，造成 6d6 点寒冷伤害。该法咒在任何一轮造成的伤害都不会超过 6d6，如果目标死亡则提前结束。

目标在施法时进行一次强韧豁免检定。成功则每轮伤害减半。

器材：一个价值至少 25 gp 的小玻璃或陶器容器，装满冰，雪或水。
src:
Transmutation [Cold]
Level: Drd 7
Components: V, S, F
Casting Time: 1 action
Range: Close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target: One creature
Duration: Up to 6 rounds (see text)
Saving Throw: Fortitude half
Spell Resistance: Yes

This spell functions like creeping cold, causing intense cold to accumulate inside the target's body, but with extended duration and increased damage.

You turn the subject's sweat and moisture to ice, creating blisters and sharp crystals beneath the skin. The spell deals cumulative cold damage each round: 1d6 points on the first round, 2d6 on the second, and so on, dealing 3d6 on the third round and 4d6 on the fourth.

If the caster is at least 15th level, the spell continues for a fifth round, dealing 5d6 cold damage. At 20th level or higher, a sixth round is added, dealing 6d6 cold damage. The spell never deals more than 6d6 damage in any round, and it ends early if the target dies.

The target makes a single Fortitude saving throw when the spell is cast. A successful save halves the damage each round.

Focus: A small glass or pottery vessel worth at least 25 gp, filled with ice, snow, or water.

(BASE CLASS)
Combining the dynamic powers of martial prowess and arcane might, the Hexblade presents a deadly challenge to opponents unused to such a foe. It balances talents in combat and arcane spellcasting. At lower levels, the Hexblade relies on melee ability augmented by his special power to curse his enemies. As he gains experience, he becomes capable of casting a limited number of spells while his curse ability becomes more potent and he gains the ability to warp the normal law of probability. He can also draw upon the service of a dark companion to further augment his abilities.

- Alignment Restrictions: non-good only

在我先前于卡林沙漠的冒险中，我发现了一些关于一个叫拉贾尔的人的信息，他是卡林港这里一些强盗劫掠者维持的一个联系人。这个拉贾尔究竟是谁并不完全清楚，但显然他能为任何参与犯罪活动的人提供许多有用的服务。我找到了一张纸，上面写着他藏身下水道的方向，并注意到我应该使用密码“Jaraj”才能进入。只要我随身保留这张纸以供参考，我就应该能够通过下水道系统找到去那里的路。不过，我必须决定，是应该独自去寻找这个拉贾尔，还是把我找到的关于他的信息交给城市守卫，希望他们能借此终结他的犯罪活动。

我已将我找到的信息交给了守卫，由达沙尔·扎伊内姆中尉代表。原来拉贾尔是卡林港某个盗贼公会的首领。扎伊内姆中尉请求我协助将拉贾尔绳之以法，因为他担心此事会牵连太多可能腐败的守卫，而他可以用得上一个有几分偷窃技能的人。他的计划要求我前往拉贾尔公会的区域，但避开入口。相反，我应该向左转，寻找一扇密门，它提供了一条进入迷宫的另一条路线，公会用它来测试潜在成员。如果我能闯过迷宫中的锁、陷阱和其他挑战，我就能从一个出人意料的方向进入公会。我还得到了一根法杖，一旦我进入公会，它就会召唤一个魔像来协助我对抗盗贼。扎伊内姆中尉还建议我去和卡姆·赛特夫谈谈，他是城市守卫地牢中的一名囚犯，也是提供这些关于迷宫信息的线人。他也许能给我一些提示，帮助我通过迷宫。我应该把拉贾尔的头带回去给扎伊内姆中尉以领取奖赏。

我已杀死拉贾尔，并把他的头带给了扎伊内姆中尉，他因我终结了这个凶残罪犯的生涯而给了我丰厚的奖赏。
src:
During my previous adventures in the Calim Desert, I discovered some information about one Rajar, a contact maintained by some bandit raiders here in Calimport. It was not entirely clear just who this Rajar is, but apparently he can provide many useful services to anyone involved in criminal activities. I found a paper containing directions to his hideout in the sewers, and notice that I should use the password "Jaraj" to gain access to it. So long as I keep this paper in my possession for reference, I should be able to find my way there by traveling through the sewer system. I must decide, however, whether I should seek out this Rajar on my own, or instead give what information I have found about him to the City Watch, in the hope that they can use it to put an end to his criminal activities.

I have turned over the information I found to the Watch, represented by Lieutenant Dashar Zaynem. It turns out Rajar is the head of one of Calimport's Thieves' Guilds. Lt. Zaynem has asked for my assistance in bringing Rajar to justice, as he fears involving too many of the possibly corrupt Watchmen in this matter, and could use someone with a few thieving skills. His plan calls for me to go to the area of Rajar's guild, but avoid the entrance. Instead, I should turn to the left and search for a secret door that provides an alternative route into a maze the guild uses as a test for prospective members. If I can work my way through the locks, traps and other challenges of the maze, I will gain entrance to the guild from a surprsing direction. I have also been given a rod that, once I gain access to the guild, will summon a golem to assist me in fighting the thieves. Lt. Zaynem has also suggested that I talk to Kam Saitef, a prisoner in the City Guard's dungeon, an informant who is the source of this information about the maze. He may be able to give me a few tips to help me get through it. I should bring Rajar's head back to Lt. Zaynem to be rewarded.

I have slain Rajar and brought his head to Lt. Zaynem, who rewarded me well for ending the career of this vicious criminal.

我遇到了法师伊纳尔·梅卡赞，他告诉我他得知了一种咒语，可以将我们传送到伟大巫师扎塔罗斯曾经占据的一个失落已久的避难所。这样的地方肯定充满了魔法宝藏，但伊纳尔发现获取它们会有一些困难。首先，打破入口的结界需要同时施放一个破除法咒和一个驱散魔法。因此伊纳尔认为有必要招募第二个施法者，也就是我。其次，这个地方据说由守卫魔像保护。伊纳尔是一位学者，几乎没有战斗魔法经验，因此也希望我为他清除这些魔像，以及我可能遇到的任何其他危险。作为奖励，我将优先挑选我在里面发现的任何宝藏，伊纳尔只想要扎塔罗斯关于魔法研究的笔记和文件，我应该带给他。这听起来是一笔非常好的交易，而且在我准备好后尽快与伊纳尔出发会很好。
src: I have met the mage Ynal Mekazhan, who tells me that he has learned of an incantation that can teleport us to a long-lost refuge once occupied by the great wizard Zataroth. Such a place is sure to be full of magical treasures, but Ynal has discovered that there will be some difficulties to obtaining them. Firstly, breaking the wards on the entrance requires the simultaneous casting of both a breach spell and one dispelling magic. Therefore Ynal has found it necessary to recruit a second spellcaster, myself. Secondly, the place is supposed to be protected by guardian golems. Ynal is a scholar with little experience of battle magic and thus also wants me to clear these out out for him, along with any other hazards I might encounter. As a reward, I will get first pick of any treasures I find within, Ynal wants only Zataroth's notes and papers on magical research, which I should bring to him. It sounds like a very good deal, and it would be good to depart with Ynal as soon as I have prepared myself.

Descriptors: None

Chakra: Brow (totem)

A hideous mask with red-brown scales forms around and over your face, actually floating about an inch in front of your nose. The visage is reptilian, with a protruding lower jaw and teeth jutting upward. Bony spines stick up from the top of the mask, completing the portrait of a basilisk.

While the basilisk is feared primarily for its petrifying gaze, totemists also revere it as a patron of vision. Your basilisk mask grants you ultravision

Essentia: Every point of essentia invested increases your Spot skill by 2 points. 

Chakra Bind (Brow) 

Your basilisk mask merges into your forehead, and your eyes are now clearly visible in the face of the basilisk. The visual effect is a little unsettling, but the improvement to your perception is dramatic.

You gain the benefit of the Blind-Fight feat.

Chakra Bind (Totem) 

Behind the mask, your eyes glow with a pale green radiance that is clearly visible through the eyes of the basilisk. There is a sense of weight in your forehead, but it is not entirely unpleasant-more like a power anxious to be exercised.

By directing your gaze on a creature within 30 feet, you can temporarily turn that creature to stone (as the flesh to stone spell, except that the duration is only 1 round). A successful Fortitude save negates this effect.

这把邪恶的武器最初由一名刺客使用，他被一位贵族雇佣来杀死贾拉尔，因为这位贵族憎恨像竖琴手这样的“惹是生非的干涉者”。然而最终死的是刺客，这让贾拉尔获得了这把武器。注入其中的魔法似乎源自死灵系，这会让许多冒险者避免使用它，以免被其中蕴含的黑暗力量污染。然而贾拉尔认为，如果可能的话，不把如此强大的武器用于正义将是一种浪费。他坚持认为魔法力量本身不可能是邪恶的，只有使用它们的方式才是。作为这一观点的证据，他指出这把剑的力量，它对负能量有亲和力，持用者可以用它来将通常与不死生物相关的吸取生命的力量用于对付常规敌人，或者在对抗不死生物时干扰这些同样的能量。
src: This sinister weapon was originally wielded by an assassin hired to kill Jalar by a noble who resented such "trouble-making meddlers" as the Harpers. It was the assassin who ended up dead, however, allowing Jalar to acquire this weapon. The magic infusing it appears to be necromantic in origin, which would cause many adventurers to refrain from using it, lest they be tainted by the dark powers it contains. Jalar, however, believes that it would be a waste not to use such a powerful weapon for good, if that is at all possible. He maintains that magical powers themselves cannot be evil, only the uses to which they are put. As evidence for this viewpoint he points to the powers of this sword, which has an affinity for negative energies that the wielder can use either to employ the life-draining forces associated with undead against conventional foes, or to disrupt those same energies when fighting undead.

埃克斯塔米纳尔是贵族家族埃克斯塔米诺斯的人类蛇血成员，该家族统治着赫隆德斯城超过八百年。在上个世纪，埃克斯塔米纳尔们已经走出赫隆德斯，在费伦各地的其他城市中建立据点。他们从下水道和阴影中活动，策划阴谋以增强家族势力，并寻找受害者进行他们邪恶的移植和繁殖实验。

src:
The extaminaars are the snake-blooded members of the human noble House Extaminos, which has ruled the city of Hlondeth for more than eight hundred years. During the last century, the extaminaars have gone beyond Hlondeth to set up operations in other cities across Faer�n. They operate from the sewers and the shadows, hatching schemes to increase the power of their house and finding victims on which to perform their vile grafting and breeding experiments. 
  
Extaminaar Racial Traits:
-2 Strength, +2 Dexterity: Extaminaar are agile but not as strong as other humanoids their size.
Humanoid (human): Extaminaar are humanoid creatures with the human subtype.
Medium: As Medium creatures, Extaminaar have no special bonuses or penalties due to size.
Extaminaar base land speed is 30 feet.
Low-Light Vision: Extaminaar can see in the dark out to 60 feet.
+2 racial bonus on Fortitude saves versus poison: Extaminaars do not easily succumb to venom of any kind.
+4 racial bonus on Climb checks: Extaminaar's light frames make it easier for them to ascend obstacles.
+2 racial bonus on Tumble checks: Extaminaars can wriggle their way out of sticky situations.
Spell-like Abilities: 3/day-charm animal. Extaminaar often fill their lairs with poisonous snakes to dissuade interlopers.
Favored Class: Rogue. A multiclass extaminaar's rogue class does not count when determining whether he takes an experience point penalty.
Level Adjustment +0.

src: In her magical researches, Zarala has come across a formula for forging a magical item known as the Lightning Lute. She wants my help in assembling the components she will need to fashion this item: an ordinary non-magical lute, a crystal of special blue quartz, and some wyvern blood. The lute should be available for purchase somewhere in the Merchant District, if I can find one nowhere else. The blue quartz might be found underground, in the upper sections of the Underdark. There is rumored to be a way to get to such regions in the sewers beneath the Merchant District. Zarala had no idea where I might find some wyverns, but it is possible I may come across such creatures at some point in my adventures. I should assemble these items and bring them to Zarala, if possible.

src:
Whirling Blade
Transmutation
Level: Bard 2, sorcerer/wizard 2,warmage 2
Components: V, S, F
Casting Time: 1 standard action
Range: 60 ft.
Effect: 60-ft. line
Duration: Instantaneous
Saving Throw: None
Spell Resistance: No

As you cast this spell, you hurl a single weapon at your foes, magically striking at all enemies along a line to the extent of the spell's range. You make a normal melee attack, just as if you attacked with the weapon in
melee, against each foe in the weapon's path, but you can choose to substitute your Intelligence or Charisma
modifier (as appropriate for your spellcasting class) for your Strength modifier on the weapon's attack rolls
and damage rolls. Even if your base attack bonus would normally give you multiple attack rolls, a whirling
blade gets only one attack (at your best attack bonus) against each target. The weapon deals damage just as if you had swung it in melee, including any bonuses you might have from ability scores or feats.

No matter how many targets your weapon hits or misses, it instantly and unerringly returns to your hand after attempting the last of its attacks.

修复心智伤害：你可以移除影响目标的任何胁迫和魅惑。

你还可以移除所有惩罚目标属性值的效应，治疗所有属性伤害，并移除影响目标的任何属性吸取。心灵手术抵消所有形式的疯狂，困惑，微观世界等异能的效果，等等。

转移知识：如果需要，你可以使用此异能直接将你所知的一个异能知识转移给另一个灵能角色。你可以让一个角色知晓她所能显能的任何等级的异能，即使该异能通常不在该角色的异能列表上。通过心灵手术获得的异能知识不计入角色每等级所能知晓的最大异能数量。

XP 消耗：每次你使用心灵手术将异能知识植入另一个生物时，你支付等于植入异能等级 x 1,000 的 XP 消耗。如果你和目标都愿意，你们可以平分此消耗。

Range: Close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target: One creature
Duration: Instantaneous
Saving Throw: None
Power Resistance: No
Power Points: 17, XP; see text

You can repair psychic damage or grant another creature knowledge of powers you know, depending on the version of this power you manifest.

Repair Psychic Damage: You can remove any compulsions and charms affecting the subject.

You can remove all negative levels affecting the subject.

You can also remove all effects penalizing the subject's ability scores, heal all ability damage, and remove any ability drain affecting the subject. Psychic chirurgery negates all forms of insanity, confusion, the effect of such powers as microcosm, and so on.

Transfer Knowledge: If desired, you can use this power to directly transfer knowledge of a power you know to another psionic character. You can give a character knowledge of a power of any level that she can manifest, even if the power is not normally on the character's power list. Knowledge of powers gained through psychic chirurgery does not count toward the maximum number of powers a character can know per level.

XP Cost: Each time you use psychic chirurgery to implant knowledge of a power in another creature, you pay an XP cost equal to 1,000 x the level of the power implanted. If you and the subject are both willing to do so, you can split this cost evenly.

src:
(BASE CLASS)
The hurts of the world are manifold. Minor accidents are common, and usually easily dealt with. However, when conflict and all-out warfare occur, they leave misery and hurt in their wake that can stagger the imagination. While good-aligned Clerics are called upon to heal, their complex obligations and abilities often get in the way of pure solace and remediation. Not so the Healer. One of the Healer's great purposes in life is to provide protection, and failing that, healing, to all good people who require her aid.
Empathetic, a Healer is adept both at detecting the ailments of allies and understanding the coarse, unruly thoughts of beasts. Her way with animals wins her friends among otherwise savage creatures of the wild.
A Healer is easy to spot. She moves about behind an adventuring company or combat unit, applying her divine skills to bring relief to the injured. After she passes, the wounded press forward with renewed vigor, and the fallen may yet rise again.

Ex-Healers
A Healer who grossly violates her ethos (such as by refusing to heal an ally or a good-aligned creature) loses all spells and class features. She cannot thereafter gain levels as a healer until she atones.

- Hit Die: d8
- Alignment: good only
- Proficiencies: A Healer gains proficiency with Simple Weapons and Light Armor. Wearing heavier armor and shields violates her oaths and suppresses her healer powers.
- Skill Points: 4 + Int Modifier

src: This set of dual blades has long been wielded by the chieftans and greatest champions of the Blazing Axes Orc Tribe, and it is widely believed that they constitute the original "blazing axes" from which the tribe tooks its name. dst:
沙拉基姆（这个名字在古老的人类方言中意为“被污染者”或“带有污点者”）曾经是人类。至少，他们的祖先是。传说声称，很久以前，所有人类都居住在德什村。他们和平地生活，直到一个名叫沙拉克的猎人杀死了一头神圣的雄鹿，所有吃了雄鹿肉的人都生病了。许多人死了，但其他人被他们犯下的邪恶所转化，扭曲成人类的丑陋漫画。逃脱诅咒的人类四散而去，让德什永远失落。那些曾经是人类的生物也聚集起来逃离，在世界中开辟自己的道路，但从此永远被人类憎恨，因为他们提醒着那桩罪孽。这些人成为了沙拉基姆。

沙拉基姆种族特性：
+2 力量，-2 敏捷，+2 智力，-2 魅力：沙拉基姆天生强壮，但他们的体型使他们笨拙。他们怪物的外表在社交场合对他们不利，但他们的文化迫使他们接受良好的教育。
类人生物（人类）：沙拉基姆是类人生物，具有人类亚种。
中型：作为中型生物，沙拉基姆没有因体型而获得特殊奖励或惩罚。
沙拉基姆基础陆地速度为30英尺。
黑暗视觉：沙拉基姆可以在黑暗中看到60英尺远。
+1 天生防御加值：沙拉基姆的皮肤坚韧且难以刺穿。
暗影亲和（特异能力）：在黑暗或暗影照明区域，沙拉基姆在躲藏，潜行，搜索和侦察检定上获得+2种族加值。
光线敏感（特异能力）：沙拉基姆在明亮阳光下或日光术半径内攻击检定受到-1惩罚。
对兽人攻击检定+1种族加值：沙拉基姆鄙视兽人，并学习特殊战斗技巧，使他们能更有效地对抗兽人。
天赋职业：法师。
等级调整 +1。
src:
The sharakim (the name means �the tainted?or �those with taint?in an old human dialect) were once human. At least, their forebears were. Legends claim that, long ago, all humans resided in the village of Desh. They lived peacefully until a hunter named Sharak killed a sacred stag, and all those who ate of the stag's flesh became ill. Many died, but others were transformed, twisted into hideous caricatures of humanity by the evil they had committed. The humans who escaped the curse scattered, leaving Desh to be lost forever. Those creatures who had once been human gathered together and fled as well, making their own way in the world but forever after hated by humans because they stood as a reminder of that sin. These became the sharakim.

Sharakim Racial Traits:
+2 Strength, -2 Dexterity, +2 Intelligence, -2 Charisma: Sharakim are naturally strong but their size makes them clumsy. Their monstrous appearance works against them in social settings, but their culture forces them to be well educated.
Humanoid (human): Sharakim are humanoid creatures with the human subtype.
Medium: As Medium creatures, sharakim have no special bonuses or penalties due to size.
Sharakim base land speed is 30 feet.
Darkvision: Sharakim can see in the dark out to 60 feet.
+1 natural armor bonus: Sharakim skin is tough and difficult to pierce.
Shadow Affinity (Ex): In areas of darkness or shadowy illumination, a sharakim gains a +2 racial bonus on Hide, Move Silently, Search, and Spot checks.
Light Sensitivity (Ex): Sharakim take a -1 penalty to attack rolls in bright sunlight or within the radius of a daylight spell.
+1 racial bonus on attack rolls against orcs: Sharakim despise orcs, and learn special combat techniques that enable them to fight them more effectively.
Favored Class: Wizard. 
Level Adjustment +1.

(PRESTIGE CLASS)
Stormlords are the agents of Talos, inflicting destructive rampages wherever they wander. Talos cares only that they call up storms or engage in spectacular acts of violence. Stormlords often live as brigands, indulging their personals desires for wealth, food, luxury and wanton behavior as they crave random, spectacular acts of violence.

- Hit Die: d8.
- Proficiencies: A Stormlord does not gain any additional weapon or armor proficiencies.
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:

Alignment: Non-Good and Non-Lawful.
Feats: Great Fortitude, Weapon Focus (Spear)
Divine Spellcasting: Can cast 3rd level spells.
Special: Must worship Talos. (Clerics taking this class must have two of the following domains: Destruction, Fire, Evil, Storm.)

CLASS FEATURES:

Level
1: Electrical Resistance 10 - Stormlord gains 10 points of Electrical resistance.
2: Shock Spear - Any spear used by a Stormlord is treated as a shock weapon (+1d6 electrical damage).
4: Electrical Resistance 15
5: Thundering Spear - Any spear used by a Stormlord is treated as a thundering weapon (+1d8 sonic damage on critical). This stacks with the Shock Weapon Ability.
7: Electrical Resistance 20
8: Shocking Spear - Any spear used by a Stormlord is treated as a shocking weapon (+1d10 electrical damage on critical). This stacks with the Shock and Thundering Weapon Abilities.
9: Electrical Immunity
10: Elemental Conflagration - A Stormlord gains the ability to summon a huge elemental once a day.

BONUS SPELLS

Upon gaining a level in Stormlord, the character gains new spells per day as if he had also gained a level in his highest divine caster class. He does not learn any new spells through his abilities.

dst: 在我先前于卡林沙漠的冒险中，我发现了关于一个叫拉贾尔的人的一些信息，他是卡林港这里一些强盗劫掠者维持的一个联系人。这个拉贾尔究竟是谁并不完全清楚，但显然他能为任何参与犯罪活动的人提供许多有用的服务。我找到了一张纸，上面写着他藏身处的方向，位于下水道中，并注意到我应该使用密码“Jaraj”来进入那里。只要我保留这张纸作为参考，我就应该能够通过下水道系统找到去那里的路。然而，我必须决定，是应该自己去找这个拉贾尔，还是把我发现的关于他的信息交给城市守卫，希望他们能利用这些信息来终结他的犯罪活动。\n\n我已经找到了通往拉贾尔藏身处的路。我想我会记住来这里的路，应该不再需要我为那个目的而找到的那张纸了。然而，现在改变主意，把那张纸交给守卫，而不是自己继续行动，还为时不晚。
src: During my previous adventures in the Calim Desert, I discovered some information about one Rajar, a contact maintained by some bandit raiders here in Calimport. It was not entirely clear just who this Rajar is, but apparently he can provide many useful services to anyone involved in criminal activities. I found a paper containing directions to his hideout, located in the sewers, and notice that I should use the password "Jaraj" to gain access to it. So long as I keep this paper in my possession for reference, I should be able to find my way there by traveling through the sewer system. I must decide, however, whether I should seek out this Rajar on my own, or instead give what information I have found about him to the City Watch, in the hope that they can use it to put an end to his criminal activities.\n\nI have found my way to Rajar's Hideout. I think I will remember my way here, and should have no more need for the paper I found for that purpose. However, it is not too late to change my mind and take said paper to the Watch, rather than going ahead on my own.

扎拉拉给了我一封信，让我交给伊纳斯·森卡尔，一位住在“学者角”的历史学家。扎拉拉希望他协助研究古代巨灵魔法，尤其是关于卡洛玛斯·泽卡尔所拥有的那把古老魔法剑，她小时候曾激活过它的力量。森卡尔要求我找到一些对历史研究有价值的东西作为他完成这项工作的报酬，我果然在黑暗卡林港找到了一块刻有文字的古老石板，他认为可以接受。

森卡尔花了几天时间研究此事，然后交给我一个据称包含研究结果的包裹。然而，当我把它交给扎拉拉时，却发现我拿到的东西是给别人的，并不是她想要的研究。森卡尔一定是把我的包裹和别的东西弄混了。我得回去找他换成正确的那个。

我回到森卡尔的住处，发现那里正遭到恶魔袭击。处理完此事后，我终于拿到了正确的包裹。现在该带着它回到扎拉拉那里了。
src:
Zarala has given me a letter to take to Inas Senkhar, a historian living in the "Scholar's Corner." Zarala wants his assistance in researching ancient djinni magic, particularly regarding the ancient magical sword owned by Kalomas Zekar whose powers she was able to activate as a child. Senkhar demanded that I find something of value to historical research as his price to carry out this job, and I duly found an ancient tablet with some writing on it in Dark Calimport, which he accepted as satisfactory.

Senkhar took a couple of days to research the matter and presented me with a packet allegedly containing the results. When I delivered it to Zarala, however, it turned out what I was given was intended for someone else and was not the research she wanted. Senkhar must have gotten my packet mixed up with something else. I will have to return to him to exchange it for the correct one.

I returned to Senkhar's residence to find the place being assailed by demons. That being dealt with, I was finally able to get the correct packet. Now to return with it to Zarala.

你将魂能塑造成一个雪白色的面具，形似狼头。一个布满尖牙的咆哮口鼻从面具前方突出，如蓝色冰晶般的眼睛挑衅地凝视着。

脉轮绑定（喉部）

白色毛皮从冬之面具向下蔓延，覆盖你的喉咙。你的嘴里充满愉悦的寒冷，就像在炎热的日子里含着一块冰。

你获得喷吐寒冷锥的能力。每1d4轮一次，你可以喷出15英尺长的寒冷锥。锥形区域内的目标受到2d6点寒冷伤害，每投入一点魂能再额外受到2d6点伤害（反射减半）.

脉轮绑定（图腾）

你的脸融入冬之面具，与它的狼形特征合并。你的眼睛出现在面具的眼窝中，变成冬狼眼睛那种苍白的冰蓝色。你的下颚也变成冬狼强有力的巨口，当你呼吸时，霜冻附着在你口鼻周围的白毛上。

你获得造成1d6点伤害的啮咬攻击。每投入一点魂能到此魂能融合，你的啮咬伤害就增加1d4点寒冷伤害。
src:
Winter Mask

Descriptors: Cold
Classes: Totemist
Chakra: Throat (totem)
Saving Throw: See text

You shape incarnum into a snow-white mask resembling the head of a wolf. A snarling muzzle filled with sharp teeth protrudes from the front of the mask, and eyes like blue ice crystals stare out in defiance.

You must make a successful melee touch attack. The target is fatigued unless it succeeds on a Fortitude save. 

Essentia: Your touch attack also deals 1d4 points of cold damage for every point of essentia you invest in your winter mask. 

Chakra Bind (Throat) 

White fur spreads down from your winter mask to cover your throat. Your mouth is filled with a pleasant cold, like sucking a piece of ice on a hot day.

You gain the ability to breathe a cone of cold. Once every 1d4 rounds, you can emit a 15-foot-long cone of cold. Targets in the cone take 2d6 points of cold damage plus 2d6 additional points of damage for every point of invested essentia (Reflex half). 

Chakra Bind (Totem) 

Your face blends into that of your winter mask, merging with its lupine features. Your eyes appear in the mask's eye sockets, and they become the pale ice-blue of a winter wolf's eyes. Your jaws become the powerful maw of a winter wolf as well, and frost clings to the white fur around your muzzle as you breathe.

You gain a bite attack that deals 1d6 points of damage. Every point of essentia invested in this soulmeld adds 1d4 points of cold damage to your bite damage.

src: This book is a guide to effective tactics that will aid an adventurer in combat. Naztharune Rakshasa are another breed of Rakshasa, oriented towards stealth rather than magic.  They typically work as spies and infiltrators for the more powerful of their kindred, and hire out as mercenaries or assassins to other creatures.  Unlike their related breeds, naztharune rakshasa don't mind not being the big boss of an operation, taking a more mercenary outlook.  Physically, they are similar to other rakshasa, with the same tiger head and backwards-bending hands.  The main distinctive feature is the black-as-night fur covering their body.

Naztharune Rakshasa Ability Adjustments: +4 Str, +10 Dex, +8 Con, +4 Int, +4 Cha.
Favored Class (Rogue): A multiclass naztharune rakshasa's rogue class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

- Darkvision: Naztharune Rakshasa are able to see in the dark.
- Base movement of 40.
- Weapon Proficiency (Simple): All rakshasa are proficient with simple weapons.
- Weapon Proficiency (Martial): All rakshasa are proficient with martial weapons.
- Weapon Proficiency (Creature): Rakshasa can make an unarmed attack with their claws.
- Spell Resistance: Innate spell resistance of 21, plus 1 per character level.
- Natural Armor Bonus: Racial natural armor bonus of 5.

白金护甲

我一直听到报告说，卡林港下水道中的鼠人种群最近不知为何变得非常具有攻击性，成群结队地组织起来，袭击任何进入下水道的人。这也许值得调查，但这也意味着我进入下水道时应该小心，因为那里已经变成了一个非常危险的地方。

这些新近变得具有攻击性的鼠人正在给一个以下水道为基地的盗贼公会制造麻烦。公会的首领拉贾尔提出，如果我能对鼠人的威胁做些什么，就会给我一笔非常丰厚的报酬。不幸的是，我到底能做什么还不完全清楚，但也许机会会出现。

看来这些鼠人是变形蛛正在集结的敌对生物联盟的一部分。我想这并不太令人意外，因为如果它们代表的是另一个同时制造麻烦的势力，那也太巧了。我已经杀死了敌对鼠人的首领，并攻占了它们在下水道中的主要基地。虽然仍有一些敌对鼠人团伙可能还在下水道中游荡，但我预计它们造成的威胁现在会逐渐消退。等我找到机会，应该把我的功绩报告给拉贾尔，这样我就能领取他承诺的报酬。
src:
I have been hearing reports that the wererat population of Calimport's sewers has recently, for unknown reasons, become very aggressive, organizing in bands and attacking anyone entering the sewers. This may be something worthy of investigation, though it also means I should be careful about entering the sewers, as they have become a very dangerous place.

The newly aggressive wererats are causing problems for a thieves' guild based in the sewers. The head of the guild, Rajar, has offered a very substantial reward if I can do something about the wererat threat. Unfortunately it is not entirely clear what I can do, but perhaps an opportunity will turn up.

It appears the wererats were part of the coalition of hostile creatures being assembled by the aranea. Not too much of a surprise, I suppose, as it would have been quite a coincidence if they represented some other faction causing trouble at the same time. I have slain the leader of the hostile wererats and overrun their main base within the sewers. While some bands of hostile wererats might still be wandering the sewers, I expect the threat they pose will now be receding. My accomplishments should be reported to Rajar when I get the chance, so that I can claim his offered reward.

玻曼星民是星界原生的类人种族，推测是人类的 descendants.  他们被一些人称为“呻吟僧侣”，不进行常规交谈，仅通过无声旋律交流。 他们以星界碎片建造的寺庙和神龛为家，他们认为这些是早已被遗忘或死亡的神祇的凡人形态。 在生理上他们类似拉长的人类，尽管实际上略矮且略重。

src:
Buommans are a race of humanoids native to the Astral plane, presumably descended from humans.  They are known by some as the "moaning monks" and do not speak conventionally, only through voiceless melody.  They make their homes in temples and shrines made of astral debris, which they believe to be the mortal forms of long forgotten or dead deities.  Physically they resemble stretched-out humans, despite actually being slightly shorter and heavier.

Buomman Ability Adjustments: +2 Wis, -2 Cha
Favored Class (Monk): A multiclass buomman's monk class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

- Low-Light Vision: Allows them to see better than normal in the dark.
- Skill Affinity (Listen): +2 racial bonus to Listen checks.
- Skill Affinity (Perform): +2 racial bonus to Perform checks.
- Vow of Silence: Buommans take a vow of silence at an early age, and thereafter do not ever speak conventionally again.  A Buomman spellcaster who wishes to cast spells with verbal components must have the Silent Spell feat to do so.
- Outsider: Buommans count as Outsiders for the purpose of spells.

src:
I have learned of the location of a forgotten section of the sewers that is said to connect to a cache of hidden treasure, but possibly dangers as well. Perhaps I should go there and see what there is to find.

I found my way to the appropriate section of the sewers, and from there to a hidden underground ruin. I should keep my eyes open for both valuables and threats.

As I approached a gate in the ruins, with piles of gold and chests of treasure visible on the other side, I fell through what turned out to be an illusory floor, dropping into a dungeon full of ravenous ghouls. The gate was apparently bait for a trap and it seems it is best to give the area surrounding it a wide berth. Now I shall have to find a way out. Doubtless the route will prove complicated and monster infested. This all seems familiar somehow...

Necrocarnum bends itself into a matte black crown that seems to consume light. The fractured remnants of souls broken by the power of necrocarnum float within this soulmeld. These forms barely surface in this dark and foreboding crown, yet even the faintest glimpse is unsettling

While this soulmeld is shaped, you unerringly detect the presence and position of undead creatures within 30 feet, as per detect undead.

Essentia: Undead within a 30-foot radius gain turn resistance equal to the number of points of essentia that you invest in the soulmeld. If you animated the undead, the turn resistance is equal to double the number of points of invested essentia.

Chakra Bind (Crown)

A matching coil of necrocarnum forms around the head of a corpse. Filled with the dark power of necrocarnum, the corpse shambles to its feet, its flesh and mind overtaken by the curse of undeath. 

When you shape this soulmeld and bind it to your crown chakra, you can animate an undead creature. This requires a full-round action and provokes attacks of opportunity; in addition, you take damage equal to the necrocarnum zombie's Hit Dice, which may not be healed as long as the zombie remains animated. You may only have one zombie.

src:
Sarcophagus of Stone
Conjuration (Creation) [Earth]
Level: Clr 6
Components: V S M DF
Casting Time: 1 standard action
Duration: Instantaneous
Range: Close (25 ft + 5 ft/2 lvls)
Target: 1 medium or smaller creature
Spell Resistance: No
Saving Throw: Reflex negates

This spell creates an airtight stone coffin that forms around the target. The stone is 1 inch thick, has hardness 8, and requires 15 points of damage to break through. Decreasing its size does not change the thickness of the walls; the coffin is always just large enough to hold the subject. This coffin is sealed upon formation and completely impervious to air and gas. A creature trapped within a sarcophagus of stone has 1 hour worth of air, and after that time begins to suffocate. A creature that has no need to breathe (such as a construct, elemental, or undead) needs not fear suffocation, but it remains trapped within the sarcophagus until it breaks free or is freed.

A creature within the coffin can attack the stone with a natural weapon or light melee weapon. A creature can
attempt a DC 26 Strength check to break free of the stone, and allies can also help to break the trapped creature
free.

dst: 眼魔侍者 默发操纵死尸

灰精灵是所有精灵中最高贵，最庄严的。他们的外表比同族的其他精灵更高大，更宏伟，灰精灵以冷漠和傲慢著称（即使以精灵的标准来看也是如此）.他们当然比高等精灵更隐遁，居住在孤立的山地堡垒中，只允许少数外来者进入。他们要么有银发和琥珀色眼睛，要么有淡金色头发和紫色眼睛。他们喜欢白色，银色，黄色或金色的衣服，搭配深蓝色或紫色的斗篷。

种族加值：+2 敏捷，+2 智力，-2 力量，-2 体质。
中型：作为中型生物，灰精灵没有因体型而获得的特殊加值或惩罚。
灰精灵基础陆地速度为 30 英尺。

免疫魔法睡眠效果，并且对附魔系法咒或效果有 +2 种族豁免加值。 

微光视觉：灰精灵在星光，月光，火炬光和类似昏暗照明条件下可以看到人类两倍远。她在这些条件下仍能分辨颜色和细节。    

武器熟练：灰精灵获得长剑，细剑，长弓（包括复合长弓）和短弓（包括复合短弓）的军用武器熟练专长作为奖励专长。

本书讲述了夜战的历史，这是一场卡林杉帝国与地表之下各种卓尔势力之间进行的可怕战争，始于 -790 DR，持续到大约 -530 DR。这些战争造成了大量的死亡和破坏，卓尔在地表夺取了许多立足点，并占据了许多地方长达数十年。在 -691 DR，发生了这场战争中最著名的灾难之一，当时卓尔袭击了卡林港本身，屠杀了统治家族（尽管军队指挥官以西尔-帕夏·阿基姆·埃尔·埃乔利克的身份登上了王位，开启了一个新王朝）。

这些战争中另一个值得注意的事件是，在 -741 DR，伟大的法师图兰·埃尔·阿卡达通过魔法创造了变形蛛这一种族。变形蛛是狼人般的变形生物，能够变成各种形态，其中最主要的是巨型蜘蛛的形态。由于侍奉女神罗丝的卓尔将蜘蛛视为不应伤害的神圣生物，这给他们以那种形态与敌人战斗造成了困难。变形蛛被证明是有效的卓尔战士，图兰在帝国中担心卓尔渗透的部分地区建立了它们的殖民地。

一个重大的转折点出现在 -620 DR，当时卡林杉与一个主要的卓尔城市通过谈判达成了和平与贸易协议。敌对行动又持续了将近一个世纪，因为没有任何单一权威控制所有以混乱著称的卓尔，但从那时起，事态开始逐渐平息。

直到今天，卡林杉的许多人仍记得他们对抗卓尔时遭受的可怕损失，并对该种族的任何人怀有极大的仇恨。
src:
This book recounts the history of the Night Wars, a terrible war waged between the Empire of Calimshan and various Drow powers beneath the surface of the land, beginning in -790 DR and lasting until about -530 DR. These wars caused a great deal of death and destruction, with the Drow seizing numerous footholds on the surface and holding many for decades. In -691 DR occured one of the most notable disasters of the war, when the Drow attacked Calimport itself and slaughtered the ruling family (albeit the commander of the armies assumed the throne as Syl-Pasha Akim el Ehjoliq, starting a new dynasty).

Another noteworthy event of these wars was the magical creation of the race of Aranea by the great mage Tulan el Akada, in the year -741 DR. The aranea were lycanthropic, shape-changing creatures able to assume various forms, chief among them being the form of a giant spider. Since Drow in service to the goddess Lolth regarded spiders as sacred creatures who should not be harmed, it created difficulties for them to fight foes in that form. The aranea proved effective as Drow-fighters and Tulan established colonies of them in parts of the empire where Drow infiltration was feared.

A major turning point came in -620 DR when peace and a trade agreement were negotiated between Calimshan and one of the major Drow cities. Hostilities still continued for almost another century, since no single authority controlled all the notoriously chaotic Drow, but from that point things began winding down.

To this day, many in Calimshan remember the terrible losses they suffered against the Drow, and bear a great hatred for anyone of that race.

dst: 奥兰施法（灵魂萨满）
选择副专攻武器（当前：%(CURRENT）)

现已查明，卡洛玛斯·泽卡尔参与了变形蛛与噬火武僧及其各方盟友蹂躏卡林杉的阴谋。更有甚者，他最近背叛了自己的反奴隶制计划，泄露了由贾拉尔·马卡希看守的难民营地（这些人实际上是逃亡奴隶）的位置。他将这一反奴隶制行动的责任推给了哈马德·加尔哈德尔（后者确实有所参与，曾派我去协助保护营地），如今正准备集结兵力攻打加尔哈德尔庄园，而城市当局因加尔哈德尔参与非法解救奴隶而对他倒戈，对此予以默许。泽卡尔的动机尚不明确，但他构成的威胁十分严重。

返回庄园准备防御时，我发现哈马德和扎拉拉在一起，他们又透露了更多关于泽卡尔古怪而具毁灭性计划的信息。显然扎拉拉一直在与卡齐娅·泽卡尔通信，后者对父亲的奇怪行为感到担忧。她警告我们，他计划将泽法德之剑用于其最初的目的——释放卡利姆和门农，这很可能会给这片土地带来巨大的灾难。她还提出可以留一扇通往泽卡尔塔的门不锁，供我们用来挫败这一计划。扎拉拉相信自己是泽法德的后裔，因此如果我们能让她靠近那把剑，她就能控制它，因此我要护送她前往塔楼。

卡齐娅能在不被察觉的情况下留门不锁的唯一一扇门，位于塔楼下方的一个地下密室中，我们只能通过一条迂回的路线到达那里。首先，我们必须从庄园的一个后出口出去，找到通往下水道的铁栅。进入下水道后，我们必须用哈马德给我的钥匙进入主下水道系统，然后向南走，直到来到一个房间，里面有一扇通往暗黑卡林港废墟的活板门。这通向一个带有另一扇活板门的密室，通往更深处。穿过那扇门后，我们必须穿过那些下层废墟，直到找到东边的出口。那将带我们进入一条穿过幽暗地域的通道。我们要沿着它向南走，直到来到西侧的一个洞穴门。穿过它并穿过我们发现的废墟，向上走，最终会带我们到达泽卡尔塔正下方的一个密室。通往那里的门应该由卡齐娅解锁。从那里我们可以向上进入塔楼下方的下水道，然后进入塔楼本身。
src:
It has now been revealed that Kalomas Zekar was involved in the plans of the aranea and the Consuming Fire monks and their various allies to ravage Calimshan. What's more, he has recently betrayed his own anti-slavery project by revealing the location of the camp of refugees (who were in fact escaped slaves) guarded by Jalar Makashi. He has placed the blame for this anti-slavery operation on Hamad Galhadr (who was indeed somewhat involved, sending me to help protect the camp), and is now preparing to gather forces to assault the Galhadr estate, with the tacit approval of the city authorities who have turned against Galhadr due to his involvement with illegal slave-rescuing. Zekar's motives are unclear but the threat he poses is serious.

Returning to the estate to prepare for its defense, I found Hamad and Zarala together and they revealed yet more information about Zekar's peculiar and destructive plans. Apparently Zarala has been in communication with Kadzia Zekar, who has become concerned about her father's strange behavior. She has warned us that he plans to use the Sword of Zefad for its original purpose of freeing Calim and Memnon, likely unleashing considerable devastation upon the land. She has also offered to leave unlocked a door into the Zekar tower that we could use to thwart this plan. Zarala believes she is a descendant of Zefad and thus able to control the sword if we can get her into proximity to it, and thus I am to escort her to the tower.

The only door Kadzia can leave unlocked without it being noticed is in a subterranean chamber beneath the tower, which we will reach only by a circuitous route. First, we must go out through one of the rear exits of the estate and find the grate leading to the sewers. Once in the sewers we must use the key Hamad has given me to enter the main sewer system and then head south until coming to a room containing a trap door leading down into the ruins of Dark Calimport. This leads to a chamber with another trap door, heading deeper. After going through that, we must travel through those lower ruins until we find an exit to the east. That will take us out into a passage through the Underdark. We are to follow it south, until coming to a cave door on the western side. Going through this and travel through the ruins we find, heading up, will eventually take us to a chamber directly beneath the Zekar tower. The door to it should be unlocked by Kadzia. From there we can go up into the sewers beneath the tower, and then into the tower itself.

一只被认为是大灾难先驱的巨兽，楚波克洛普斯在被凡人杀死后成为契灵。楚波克洛普斯赋予其召唤者啮咬攻击和超自然感官，以及扑击敌人，存在于以太位面和使敌人绝望的能力。

契灵等级：6级
绑定DC:25
特殊要求：楚波克洛普斯因某种未知原因憎恨阿蒙，如果你已经与他绑定，楚波克洛普斯将不会回应你的召唤。

影响：在楚波克洛普斯的影响下，你不由自主地悲观。最好的情况是你默默接受自己的失败，最坏的情况是你将疑虑传播给他人，试图让他们相信自己的目标毫无希望。此外，楚波克洛普斯要求你自愿在所有对抗恐惧效果的豁免检定中失败。

授予能力：
楚波克洛普斯赋予你停留在以太位面的力量，感知活物与亡灵，使敌人士气低落以及啮咬敌人的能力。

Chupoclops, Harbinger of Forever
  
A great monster believed to be a harbinger of the apocalypse, Chupoclops became a vestige when slain by mortals. Chupoclops grants its summoner a bite attack and unnatural senses, plus the ability to pounce on foes, to exist ethereally, and to make enemies despair.

Vestige Level: 6th
Binding DC: 25
Special Requirement: Chupoclops hates Amon for some unknown reason and will not answer your call if you are already bound to him.

In addition, Chupoclops requires that you voluntarily fail all saving throws against fear effects.

Granted Abilities: 
Chupoclops gives you the power to linger on the Ethereal Plane, sense the living and undead, demoralize foes, and bite enemies.

Ethereal Watcher: At will as a move action, you can become ethereal. You can remain on the Ethereal Plane indefinitely if you take no actions, but any movement or combat causes you to return to the Material Plane. Once you have returned to the Material Plane, you cannot use this ability again for 5 rounds.

src: Spells per Day: From 2nd level on, when a new eldritch knight level is gained, the character gains new spells per day as if she had also gained a level in whatever arcane spellcasting class she belonged to before she added the prestige class. She does not, however, gain any other benefit a character of that class would have gained (bonus metamagic or item creation feats, bard or assassin abilities, and so on). This essentially means that she adds the level of eldritch knight to the level of whatever other arcane spellcasting class the character has, then determines spells per day and caster level accordingly. If a character had more than one arcane spellcasting class before she became an eldritch knight, she must decide to which class she adds levels of eldritch knight for the purpose of determining spells per day.

这张纸条是在某个参与破坏塞露涅神殿的人身上发现的。上面写着：

“神殿是促进社会凝聚力的重要因素，如果规模庞大且历史悠久，必然既拥有广泛的影响力，也至少掌握一定程度的政治权力。因此，尽管它们声称在改善社会的弊病，它们仍是我们试图推翻的腐败社会的支柱之一。在我们对城中各宗教发起的更大战争中，你的任务是通过隐秘的破坏行为来扰乱新塞露涅神殿的建造。在适当的时候，我们会栽赃证据，表明莎尔神殿应对此事负责（如果塞露涅信徒自己没有得出这个结论的话）。我们组织的其他人很快将对提尔神殿采取类似行动，并安排让塔洛斯的追随者背锅。一旦我们能挑起各神殿之间的争斗，我们或许可以指望他们替我们完成大部分破坏工作。至少，当他们的争斗使他们成为内乱的源头而非和谐的源泉时，这些神殿将在民众和城市当局眼中名誉扫地。”

这封信没有署名，似乎也没有任何迹象表明作者可能是谁，或他代表哪个派系。
src:
This note was found in the possession of someone involved in vandalizing the Temple of Selune. It reads as follows:

"Temples are an important element contributing to societal cohesion, and if large and long-established inevitably possess both popular influence and at least some measure of political power. Thus, they are one of the bulwarks of the corrupt society we seek to bring down, despite their claims to be ameliorating its evils. Your task in our larger war against the religions of the city is to disrupt the building of the new Temple of Selune with stealthy acts of vandalism. In due course, we will plant evidence that the Temple of Shar is responsible for this (if the Selunites do not jump to that conclusion on their own). Others of our organization will soon be undertaking similar activities targeting the Temple of Tyr, and arranging for followers of Talos to take the blame. Once we can get the various temples fighting against each other we may hope they will do much of our work of destruction for us. At the least, once their fighting makes them a source of civil discord rather than harmony, the temples will be discredited in the eyes of both the people and the city authorities."

The letter is not signed, and their seems to be nothing indicating who the writer might be, or what faction he represents.

src: Zarala has given me a letter to take to Inas Senkhar, a historian living in the "Scholar's Corner." She has told me that in addition to taking him the letter detailing her wishes, I can offer him up to 5000 gold (to be paid later by Zarala) to secure his assistance.\n\nI have spoken to Inas Senkhar, but he is not willing to assist Zarala solely in exchange for money. Instead he wants me to search the old ruins known as "Dark Calimport" for something of value to historical research, preferably some kind of written record (perhaps to be found on a stone tablet or the like if it has survived this long). I am told that one can gain access to Dark Calimport at various points in the sewers. Perhaps somewhere in the sewer system there is access to a suitable set of ruins where I can find what Senkhar seeks. At any rate, it seems I must if any progress is to be made on this matter.

src:
Psychometabolism
Level: Psychic warrior 1
Manifesting Time: 1 standard action
Range: Personal
Target: You
Duration: 1 round/level
Power Points: 1
Metapsionics: Extend

This power causes instant diminution, halving your height, length, and width and dividing your weight by 8. This decrease changes your size category to the next smaller one. You gain a +2 size bonus to Dexterity, a -2 size penalty to Strength (to a minimum effective Strength score of 1), a +1 size bonus on attack rolls, and a +1 size bonus to Armor Class due to your reduced size. This power doesn't change your speed.

Multiple effects that reduce size do not stack, which means (among other things) that you can't use a second manifestation of this power to further reduce yourself.

Augment: You can augment this power in one or more of the following ways.
1. If you spend 6 additional power points, this power decreases your size by two size categories. You gain a +4 size bonus to Dexterity, a -4 size penalty to Strength (to a minimum effective Strength score of 1), a +2 size bonus on attack rolls, and a +2 size bonus to Armor Class due to your reduced size.
2. If you spend 2 additional power points, this power's duration is 1 minute per level rather than 1 round per level.

src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
Elite warriors trained to resist mental compulsions of all kinds, members of the Iron Mind class defend dwarf and gnome kingdoms against intrusions by mind flayers, dark elf enchanters, and the like. An Iron Mind becomes one with her armour, and its presence protects her from mental assault as thoroughly as it wards against physical blows. Iron Minds combine the protection and assurance that their armour provides with rigorous training to overcome physical injury through mental power into one seamless fighting technique.

- Hit Die: d10
- Proficiencies: An Iron Mind gains no additional proficiencies.
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:

Feats: Invest Armour, Armour Proficiency (Heavy), Iron Will.
Skills: Concentration 8 ranks.
Manifesting: Must be able to manifest 1st level powers.
Base Attack Bonus: +3.

CLASS FEATURES:

Level
1: Armoured Mind 1/day - Expend Psionic focus to add a bonus to a single saving throw.
2: Damage Reduction 1/-
3: Mind Over Body 1/day - The Iron Mind can use her Will save in place of a Fortitude or Reflex save.
4: Armoured Mind 2/day
5: Damage Reduction 2/-, Mettle of Will - If she succeeds on any spell with "Will half" or "Will partial", she suffers no effect from the spell or power.
6: Mind Over Body 2/day
7: Armoured Mind 3/day
8: Damage Reduction 3/-, Lend Resolve - You may expend psionic focus to grant an ally a bonus on Will saves equal to your class level.
9: Mind Over Body 2/day
10: Armoured Mind 4/day, Barbed Mind - Any time you succeed at a Will save against a mind-affecting effect, the caster takes 1d6 points of damage and 1 Wisdom damage.

BONUS MANIFESTING

Upon reaching levels 2, 3, 4, 5, 7, 8, 9, 10 the Iron Mind gains a new manifester level, increasing his power points, total powers known, and maximum power level.

src: Blimfin Zemquin, proprietor of a store in Calimport selling magical goods, has told me that he will pay well for certain special items that he can use in making magical potions or as spell components. The items he most needs at the moment are: fire beetle bellies, fenberries, fairy dust, ettercap silk glands, the ichor from a slime or ooze, gargoyle skulls, and the eyes of a basilisk. I should keep an eye out for such stuff, as there is no knowing what I might stumble across in the course of my adventures.\n\nI have found some of the above items, and sold them to Blimfin. If I find anymore, I can bring them to the same place.

src:
Sometimes, when the implanted eggs of slaadi are removed from their victim, they leave behind some remnants of chaos, which in turn affect said victim's descendants, resulting in the planetouched race of chaonds.  Their chaotic heritage leaves them whimsical and emotional, living for the present.  They seldom look past today, and while they are outgoing they also tend to be insensitive, making no excuses and expecting nothing from others.  Physically they typically appear as rough humans with thick chests and limbs, blocky faces, and skin and hair that slowly shifts in color.  They stand about 5'1" to 5'10" and are usually twice as wide as a normal human.  Other features showing their slaadi heritage vary from chaond to chaond as befits their chaotic nature, and could be anything from patches of hardened scales, to reptilian hands and feet.  Clothing-wise they just wear whatever is at hand, tending to leave them wearing wild and clashing colors.

Chaond Ability Adjustments: +4 Dex, +2 Con, -2 Cha.
Favored Class (Any): A multiclass chaond's highest class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

- 30' base speed
- Darkvision: Chaonds are able to see in the dark.
- Skill Affinity (Tumble): +2 racial bonus to Tumble checks.
- Resist Acid: Innate acid resistance of 5.
- Resist Sonic: Innate sonic resistance of 5.
- Resist Cold: Innate cold resistance of 5.
- Outsider: Chaonds count as Outsiders for the purpose of spells.

src:
(BASE CLASS)
The Favoured Soul follows the path of the cleric but is able to channel divine power with surprising ease. She is able to perform the same tasks as her fellow divine spellcasters but with virtually no study; to her, it comes naturally. Scholars wonder if Favoured Souls have traces of outsider blood from unions. holy or unholy, centuries ago and generations removed. Others suggest that divine training of the proper type awakens the ability, or that Favoured Souls are simply imbued with their gifts by their gods when they begin the cleric's path. In any case, Favoured Souls cast their spells naturally, as much through force of personality as through study. Though this gives them extraordinary divine abilities no normal person could ever match, they see their gift as a call to action, and so in some ways lag behind their more studious colleagues.

- Hit Die: d8
- Proficiencies: A Favoured Soul gains proficiencies with Simple Weapons, Light and Medium Armour, and Shields.
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

src: Spells per Day/Spells Known: A contemplative who was previously a spellcaster continues to gain access to more powerful divine magic while following the contemplative path. Thus, when a new contemplative level is gained, the character gains new spells per day (and spells known, if applicable) as if she had also gained a level in the spellcasting class she belonged to before she added the prestige class. She does not, however, gain any other benefit a character of that class would have gained (improved chance of controlling or rebuking undead, more frequent remove disease, and so on). This essentially means that she adds the level of contemplative to the level of whatever other spellcasting class the character has, then determines spells per day accordingly.

dst:
哈马德派我加入对蜘蛛沼泽中变形蛛总部的军事进攻。随后，我一路战斗穿过沼泽和总部，最终找到了一条通往卡林港下水道的界门，在那里我解决了敌对的鼠人，他们原来与变形蛛勾结。之后，我一路打进了吞噬火焰教团的营地，他们现在似乎也参与了摧毁卡林杉的联盟。

然而，即使经历了这一切，我们似乎仍未揭开这个阴谋的真相。在吞噬火焰的文件中，我发现了证据表明卡洛玛斯·泽卡尔是武僧、变形蛛以及我一直对抗的其他敌人的盟友。一封信表明，泽法德之剑的主人（卡洛玛斯）打算用它最初的目的——释放巨灵卡利姆和火巨灵门农，他们很可能会利用这种自由恢复他们的魔法战争，造成毁灭性后果。信中还表明，他期望这一事件导致的位面边界削弱能帮助他将一支恶魔大军释放到卡林港。这些信息可信吗？泽卡尔为什么会参与如此疯狂和毁灭性的阴谋？无论这些问题的答案是什么，我认为应该尽快将这一信息带给哈马德·加尔哈德尔。希望他能弄清楚这里发生了什么。

我离开前往蜘蛛沼泽后的进展已报告给哈马德，这个任务现在可能已经完成。变形蛛及其各种盟友构成的威胁应该不复存在了。然而，关于泽卡尔的信息无疑会带来新的麻烦。
src:
Hamad sent me to join the military assault being launched upon the headquarters of the aranea in the Spider Swamp. Subsequently, I fought my way through the swamp and the headquarters, eventually finding my way to a portal leading to the Calimport sewers, where I dealt with the hostile wererats who turned out to be in league with the aranea. After that I fought my way up into the compound of the Consuming Fire Order, who now also appear to have been part of this alliance to destroy Calimshan.

Even after all this, though, it seems we have not gotten to the bottom of this conspiracy. Amongst the papers of the Consuming Fire, I have found evidence implicating Kalomas Zekar as an ally of the monks, aranea, and other enemies I have been fighting. A letter indicates that the owner of the Sword of Zefad (Kalomas) intends to use it for its original purpose of freeing the djinni Calim and the efreeti Memnon, who presumably would use such freedom to resume their magical warring, with destructive consequences. The letter also indicates that he also expects the weakening of planar boundaries this event should cause to aid him in unleashing an army of demons upon Calimport. Can this information be trusted? Why would Zekar participate in such a wild and destructive plot? Whatever the answers to these questions, I think this information should be brought to Hamad Galhadr as soon as possible. Hopefully he can sort out whatever is happening here.

My progress since departing for the Spider Swamp has been reported to Hamad, and this quest may now be completed. The threat posed by the aranea and their various allies should be no more. The information about Zekar will doubtless lead to new troubles however.

src: While fighting through the Forest of Mir against the goblins within it, I came across some pixies. Their leader, Zeepa, warned me that to the north there is a grove with some Dryads in it. Unfortunately, Gorav, a lieutenant of the goblin leader Ulaz, is also there and is threatening to cut down the dryad's trees, which they need to survive, if they do not fight alongside the goblins. Zeepa has asked me not to kill the dryads, who are being forced to work with the goblins against their will. The dryads are found in the center of the grove, so Zeepa suggests I sneak around the edges to locate Gorav's camp in the northeast, and kill him. Once Gorav is dead the dryads will no longer be hostile and may even assist us. In any case Zeepa will have a reward.

src:
Deep gnomes, known also as svirfneblin, have become understandably distrustful of all strangers after centuries of living with the everyday perils the Underdark. With strangers, most deep gnomes are sullen, reserved and suspicious, almost to a fault. Their skin is the color of the rocks among which they live. They have dark gray eyes, tending towards black. Their hair is of similar color, although it's only seen in a woman as the men are entirely bald and beardless.

Svirfneblin Ability Adjustments: +2 Dex, +2 Wis, -2 Str, -4 Cha.
Favored Class (Wizard): A multiclass svirfneblins wizard class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

- Stonecunning: +2 racial bonus on Search checks made in subterranean areas.
- Darkvision: Svirfneblin are able to see in the dark.
- Small Stature
 +1 size bonus to attack rolls.
 +1 size bonus to AC.
 +4 size bonus to Hide checks.
- Hardiness vs. Illusions: +2 racial bonus on saving throws against mind-affecting spells.
- Offensive Training vs. Reptilians: +1 racial bonus on attack rolls against reptilian humanoids.
- Offensive Training vs. Goblinoids: +1 racial bonus on attack rolls against goblinoids (goblins, hobgoblins, and bugbears).
- Dodge +4: +4 racial dodge armor class bonus.
- Skill Affinity (Listen): +2 racial bonus to Listen checks.
- Skill Affinity (Concentration): +2 racial bonus to Concentration checks.
- Skill Affinity (Hide Underground): +2 racial bonus to Hide checks; +4 when underground.
- Spell Focus (Illusion): Svirfneblin add +2 DC to any Illusion spells they cast. This is identical to the feat.
- Very Heroic: +2 racial bonus to all saving throws.
- Spell Resistance: Spell Resistance of 11, plus 1 per level.
- Spell-like Abilities: 1/day - Blindness and Deafness (DC 16), Blur, Disguise Self. Caster level is equal to the svirfneblin's character level, DC is Charisma-based with +4 racial bonus.
- Gnomish: Svirfneblin count as Gnomes for the purpose of spells.

Master, Ebon Walls 
Level/School: 8th/Conjuration (Creation) 
Range: Close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels) 
Target: One Huge or smaller creature 
Duration: 1 round/level
Saving Throw: Fortitude negates; see text 
Spell Resistance: Yes

You solidify extraplanar shadow, creating a solid prison of darkness.

This mystery immobilizes the subject in a prison of shadowstuff. This prison blocks both line of effect and line of sight to the creature inside it, and is impenetrable from the outside. The creature inside the prison takes 3d6 points of cold damage at the beginning of each round that it remains inside the prison. Once each round as a standard action, a creature caught in the prison can attempt a Fortitude saving throw against the spell's original DC to break out of the prison. Success means that the creature can move out of the prison, and it fades to nothingness. Failure means that the creature gains a negative level and remains trapped.

dst: 埃尔加姆是一名战士，当他从一群暴徒手中保护他认为是无辜受害者的人时，陷入了麻烦。一旦“受害者”安全了，他显露出自己实际上是暴徒们追捕的凶残罪犯，并击打埃尔加姆的头部，以便带着他的装备逃走。这只是埃尔加姆麻烦的开始，因为不久之后，一个善良阵营神殿的审判官出现了，并逮捕了他，由于他先前的辩护，他们认为他是罪犯的同谋。他遭受了长时间的拘留、激进的审讯和其他侮辱，一段时间后事情才得以澄清。由于这次经历，埃尔加姆得出结论，善良和邪恶的极端都应该避免，并致力于平衡和中立。他让人打造了这把反映他新哲学的刀刃，并挥舞它多年，对抗善良和邪恶事业的冠军。他的职业生涯最终结束，当他听说一个偏远小镇将自身的统治权提供给任何哲学能在战斗审判中胜出的冠军。一名圣武士和一名黑暗卫士都出现了，试图赢得比赛，埃尔加姆也来了，希望击败他们两人，从而为平衡事业赢得一场伟大的胜利。对埃尔加姆（以及小镇）来说不幸的是，尽管他战胜了圣武士，但他败给了黑暗卫士，后者随即让这个地方陷入了恐怖统治。当然，黑暗卫士无法使用埃尔加姆的剑，所以他扔掉了它，它丢失了许多年。
src: Elgarm was a warrior who got into trouble when he defended what he took to be an innocent victim from a rampaging mob. Once the "victim" was safe, he revealed himself to be in fact the vicious criminal the mob was after, and struck Elgarm on the head so he could make off with his equipment. This was only the beginning of Elgarm's troubles, for soon after inquisitors from a good-aligned temple showed up, and placed him under arrest, assuming him to be an accomplice of the criminal due to his earlier defense. He was subjected to prolonged detention, aggressive interrogation, and other indignites for some time before the matter was cleared up. As a result of this experience Elgarm concluded that the extremes of both good and evil were to be avoided and dedicated himself to balance and neutrality. He had this blade, reflecting his new philosophy, crafted, and wielded it for many years against champions of both good and evil causes. His career finally came to an end when he heard of a remote town offering rulership of itself to the champion of whatever philosophy could prevail in a trial by combat. A paladin and a blackguard both showed up attempting to win the contest, and Elgarm came as well, hoping to defeat them both and so win a great victory for the cause of balance. Unfortunately for Elgarm (and for the town), though he prevailed over the paladin, he fell against the blackguard, who promptly subjected the place to a reign of terror. The blackguard was unable to make use of Elgarm's sword, of course, so he threw it away, and it was lost for many years.

src:
Tenebrous, the Shadow That Was
  
Tenebrous, once a powerful demon prince, offers dominion over darkness and death.

Vestige Level: 4th
Binding DC: 21
Special Requirement: You must draw Tenebrous's seal at night.

Influence: While influenced by Tenebrous, you are filled with a sense of detachment and an aching feeling of loss and abandonment. Tenebrous requires that you never be the first to act in combat. If your initiative check result is the highest, you must delay until someone else takes a turn.

Granted Abilities: 
Tenebrous grants you power over undead and shadows. He gives you the ability to chill your foes.

Deeper Darkness: You can cloak an area in shadows as though using the deeper darkness spell (caster level equals your effective binder level), with the effect always centered on you. Using the ability again will cancel the darkness effect. Both uses are a standard action.

See in Darkness: You can see perfectly through darkness of any kind.

Touch of the Void: As a swift action, you can charge a melee attack with cold energy. Your next melee attack deals an extra 1d8 points of cold damage, plus 1d8 points of cold damage for every four effective binder levels beyond 7th that you possess. When you attain an effective binder level of 11th, you can charge your weapon for an entire round. Once you have used this ability, you cannot do so again for 5 rounds.

Turn/Rebuke Undead: You can turn or rebuke undead as a cleric of your effective binder level. As with a cleric, you turn if you are good and rebuke if you are evil. Once you have used this ability, you cannot do so again for 5 rounds.

Vessel of Emptiness: You can use the flicker shadow magic mystery once per day. At 13th level, you can use this ability two times per day, and at 19th level, you can use it three times per day.

拉贾尔又给我指派了一项任务。我要偷取塞尔哈德圣甲虫，它位于塞尔哈德贵族庄园的宝库中。为了进去，我应该进入贵族庄园下方的下水道，在那里我会找到通往这座庄园地下室的通道。进去之后，我需要搜查庄园，找到两把钥匙，一把用于宝库外门，一把用于内门。找到这些后，我就能进入庄园地下室里的宝库，但我必须迅速找到圣甲虫并离开，因为内门在打开一分钟后会自动锁上。我还必须确保不伤害庄园里的任何人，因为如果这种事发生在一座显赫贵族的庄园里，当局绝不会轻描淡写地处理。\n\n我已经拿到了塞尔哈德圣甲虫。现在我需要把它交还给拉贾尔。
src: Rajar has assigned me yet another mission. I am to steal the Serkhad Scarab, located in the treasure vault of the Serkhad Noble Estate. To get in I should enter the sewers beneath the noble estates, where I will find a passage to the basement of this estate. Once in, I will need to search the estate for two keys, one for the outer, and one for the inner door to the vault. Once I find these I can enter the vault in the estate basement, but I will need to find the scarab quickly and get out, since the inner door will autolock one minute after it is opened. I should also be sure not to harm anyone on the estate, as the authorities will not be able to take any such incident lightly if it occurs on the estate of a prominent noble.\n\nI have acquired the Serkhad Scarab. Now I need to return it to Rajar.

dst: “这当然是真的，但情况比你想象的还要糟糕。我父亲只在乎增加自己的权力和财富，而我只是帮助他实现这一目标的棋子。他打算把我嫁入某个他想结盟的贵族的后宫：一个愚蠢又残忍的畜生，但我父亲不在乎这些，只在乎他的政治关系。”

LEGACY ITEM ABILITIES
Drowseeker (Su): At 5th level and higher, while wielding the Bow of the Black Archer, you can detect any drow within 60 feet, although you must concentrate (a standard action) to do so. 
Eyes of Shadow (Sp): Beginning at 6th level, once per day on command, you can use darkvision as the spell. Caster level 5th. 
Longstrider (Sp): At 8th level and higher, three times per day on command, you can use longstrider as the spell. Caster level 5th. 
Hidden Hunter (Su): At 9th level, you gain a +5 competence bonus on Hide and Move Silently checks. 
Solace from Weakness (Sp): You gain power against the poisons and necromancy so commonly used by drow. Starting at 12th level, two times per day on command, you can use lesser restoration as the spell (self only). Caster level 5th. 
Friend to Shadows (Sp): In near-lightless conditions, you can strike with relative impunity and then vanish without a trace. At 13th level and higher, once per day on command, you can use teleport as the spell. Caster level 11th. 
Shocking Shot (Su): Beginning at 14th level, as a standard action, you can imbue an arrow nocked on the Bow of the Black Archer with electricity. If your shot with this arrow hits, the arrow deals an extra 5d6 points of electricity damage. This ability can be used five times per day, and a use is wasted if the charged arrow misses. 
Deny the Demonweb Pits (Sp): Lolth's servants have many powerful allies in the Abyss. At 16th level and higher, you gain a measure of defense against them. Two times per day on command, you can use protection from evil as the spell. Caster level 10th. 
Escape the Spider's Bonds (Su): Webs and other entanglements hold no more fear for a wielder of the Bow of the Black Archer. Starting at 17th level, you constantly benefit from the effects of freedom of movement while you hold the bow in hand. Caster level 15th.
Mindarmor (Su): At 18th level, you gain a +3 insight bonus on Will saving throws to resist mindaffecting and compulsion effects. 
Fast Movement (Su): Once you attain 18th level, your base land speed increases by 10 feet. 
Pierce the Black Heart (Su): You and the Bow of the Black Archer become the ultimate expression of Shevarash's fury. At 20th level and higher, once per day, you can fire an arrow from the Bow of the Black Archer that kills any drow struck by it, as if by a finger of death spell. You must declare that you are using this ability before making the attack. If the arrow misses, the effect is wasted for the day. The save DC is 20, or 17 + your Charisma modifier, whichever is higher. Caster level 15th.

dst:
哈马德正在准备对变形蛛的总部发动袭击，因为我们已经掌握了其位置的情报。然而，他还有另一个任务要我在此期间完成。他的老朋友卡洛玛斯·泽卡尔，因在反对奴隶贸易应采取何种方法上的分歧而与他闹翻，最近因我拜访他的庄园而受到启发，联系了哈马德并试图和解。哈马德已被说服在卡洛玛斯涉及的一件事上提供帮助。卡洛玛斯一直在卡林沙漠中维持一个营地，据我所知，他正在帮助一些人离开卡林杉（我没有被告知这些人究竟是谁，并被警告不要过多询问他们的情况）。这个营地在夜间遭到暗中袭击，其中一些人被掳走，天命未知。哈马德正派我和他雇用的其他一些冒险者前往那里调查此事。要到达营地，我应先去卡洛玛斯的庄园见他。他将能够打开一个魔法界门，将我传送到营地，或许还能告诉我更多关于情况的信息。

卡洛玛斯将我传送到了营地，在那里我遇到了贾拉尔·马卡希，一位巡林客兼竖琴手成员，负责管理这个地方。我们一起追踪到了袭击营地的源头：一个龙教使用的基地，被那些变成吸血鬼的教徒占据，以便更永久地服务于该教派试图使其统治降临的不死龙类。吸血鬼袭击营地是为了获取血液。我们已与吸血鬼战斗过，但似乎前方某处仍有一条龙类，也许我们之间还有更多爪牙。我们发现了一些信息，表明这条龙相对年轻，尚未转化为龙巫妖，这意味着如果发生战斗，我们或许有机会对抗他。

我们面对了那条龙类，名叫瓦拉夏兹·卡尔夫佐尔，并幸存了下来。那条龙在受重伤时逃走了，不想在这种状态下冒险继续战斗。我认为我们已经尽力结束了营地的威胁，龙已逃走恢复，基地中其他人均已被杀。我们应返回营地，然后我应通过界门回去向卡洛玛斯和哈马德报告。
src:
Hamad is preparing an assault upon the headquarters of the aranea, now that we have information on its location. However, he has another quest for me to complete in the meantime. His old friend Kalomas Zekar, with whom he had a fallin out over their disagreements about what methods should be employed in opposing the slave trade, has been inspired by my recent visit to his estate to contact Hamad and attempt a reconciliation. Hamad has been persuaded to lend assistance in a matter with which Kalomas is involved. Kalomas has been maintaining a camp in the Calim Desert for people who I am told he is assiting in leaving Calimshan (I have not been told just who these people are, and been warned against asking too many questions about them). This camp has been stealthily attacked during the night and some of the people in it carried off to some unknown fate. Hamad is sending me, and some of the other adventurers in his employ there to investigate the matter. To reach the camp I should first go see Kalomas at his estate. He will be able to open a magical portal transporting me to the camp, and perhaps tell me a little bit more about the situation.

Kalomas teleported me to the camp, where I met up with Jalar Makashi, a ranger and member of the Harpers who is running the place. Together we have tracked down the source of the raids upon the camp: a base used by the Cult of the Dragon, occupied by cultists who had become vampires so as to more permanently serve the undead dragons whose rule the cult seeks to bring about. The vampires were raiding the camp as a source of blood. We have fought through the vampires, but it seems there is still a dragon to be found somewhere ahead of us, perhaps with further minions still between us as well. We have found some information indicating that this dragon is relatively young, and not yet transformed into a dracolich, which means that we might have a chance in combat against him, if it comes to that.

We have faced the dragon, one Varaxazh'kalvzor by name, and survived. The dragon fled when he became severely wounded, not wanting to risk further combat in such a state. I think we have done what we can to end the threat to the camp, with the dragon gone to recover and everyone else in the base slain. We should return to the camp, and then I should return through the portal to report to Kalomas and Hamad.

src: "Senkhar does mention a book on the Sword of Zefad written by some scholar called Darzeth Shemal a couple centuries ago, that should have even more information than what he could find out, including more details about how a descendant of Zefad could utilize its full powers. Unfortunately there's only one copy of that book known to exist, and it was donated to the Library of Candlekeep some time ago. Candlekeep lies hundreds of miles to the north, and isn't exactly the easiest place to get into, so I don't think we can expect to do much with that source. I guess we'll just have to hope some more information turns up."

dst: "我的魔宠。"

既然我们已经掌握了变形蛛总部的信息，哈马德正准备对其发动袭击。然而，在此期间他还有另一个任务要我去完成。他的老朋友卡洛玛斯·泽卡尔——两人曾因在反对奴隶贸易应采取何种方法上的分歧而闹翻——因我最近造访他的庄园而受到启发，主动联系哈马德并试图和解。哈马德已被说服，愿意协助卡洛玛斯处理一桩事务。卡洛玛斯一直在卡林沙漠中维持一个营地，据说是为了帮助一些人离开卡林杉（我没有被告知这些人究竟是谁，并被警告不要过多打听他们的事）。这个营地在夜间遭到暗中袭击，其中一些人被掳走，天命不明。哈马德派我和他雇用的其他一些冒险者前往那里调查此事。要到达营地，我应先去他的庄园见卡洛玛斯。他能够打开一个魔法界门将我送到营地，或许还能告诉我更多关于当前局势的情况。
src: Hamad is preparing an assault upon the headquarters of the aranea, now that we have information on its location. However, he has another quest for me to complete in the meantime. His old friend Kalomas Zekar, with whom he had a fallin out over their disagreements about what methods should be employed in opposing the slave trade, has been inspired by my recent visit to his estate to contact Hamad and attempt a reconciliation. Hamad has been persuaded to lend assistance in a matter with which Kalomas is involved. Kalomas has been maintaining a camp in the Calim Desert for people who I am told he is assiting in leaving Calimshan (I have not been told just who these people are, and been warned against asking too many questions about them). This camp has been stealthily attacked during the night and some of the people in it carried off to some unknown fate. Hamad is sending me, and some of the other adventurers in his employ there to investigate the matter. To reach the camp I should first go see Kalomas at his estate. He will be able to open a magical portal transporting me to the camp, and perhaps tell me a little bit more about the situation.

Once I find these I can enter the vault in the estate basement, but I will need to find the scarab quickly and get out, since the inner door will autolock one minute after it is opened. I should also be sure not to harm anyone on the estate, as the authorities will not be able to take any such incident lightly if it occurs on the estate of a prominent noble.\n\nI acquired the Serkhad Scarab, but when I attempted to leave, I found the route through which I entered securely locked and guarded. Perhaps the guards detected some sign of my presence on the estate and have taken measures to insure I will not escape. I will have to find some alternative means of getting out.

In Eberron, magic is almost technology. Spellcasters specialize in certain forms of that technology, while artificers tinker with its fundamental workings. Artificers understand magic on a different level from spellcasters, and do not cast spells as wizards and clerics do. They have an amazing facility with magic items and constructs, and in many ways, they keep the magical world of Eberron running.
