哈马德一直在筹备对变形蛛总部的进攻，如今我们已掌握其位置情报，进攻几乎准备就绪，军队正集结于蜘蛛沼泽的一处集结地。哈马德指示我前往该集结地，为进攻贡献我的能力。抵达后，我需向那里的指挥官——卡拉德·杰拉因将军报到，并以其认为合适的方式提供协助。该前往城门了，在那里带上我想带的任何随从，然后出发前往沼泽。

我已抵达沼泽中的集结地，并向杰拉因将军报到。他的部队已与服务于我们变形蛛敌人的类人生物（此处多为蜥蜴人）交战。他预计最终会获胜，但担心等到胜利之时，我们敌人的首领早已逃离总部，以便从其他地点继续他们的战争。为防止这种情况，他计划派我沿斥候发现的一条向北的小路前进，这条小路能让我绕过敌军主力抵达基地。我将沿此路行进，并与驻扎在小路开始再次向南拐弯处之前的军队斥候会合。随后，我和斥候们将一路杀穿敌军后方——希望那里抵抗薄弱——以抵达基地。一旦到达，我需在变形蛛首领策划逃脱之前将其杀死。

虽然与军队斥候的会合并未按计划进行，但我仍抵达了基地并深入其中。是时候执行将军的计划了，在变形蛛及其可能在场的任何盟友设法逃脱之前，将他们尽数杀死。

抵达基地下层后不久，我用来到达那里的通道在我身后坍塌了。看来此时我只能继续前进。这次坍塌很可能是变形蛛为阻止追击、便于自己逃脱而制造的，因此抢在他们前面可能对完成此任务至关重要。
src:
The assault Hamad has been preparing upon the headquarters of the aranea, now that we have information on its location, is nearly ready to be launched, with military forces converging upon a staging area in the Spider Swamp. Hamad has instructed me to travel to this staging area to add my abilities to the attack. Once there, I am to report to the commander there, a General Kalad Jra'ein, and assist in whatever way he deems appropriate. Time to head to the city gates, pick up any henchmen I want with me there, and then head off to the swamp.

I have reached the staging area in the swamp, and reported to General Jra'ein. His forces are already in battle against the humanoids (here, mostly lizardmen) in service to our aranea enemies. He expects eventual victory but fears that by the time it is achieved the leaders of our foes will have fled their headquarters in order to carry on their war from some other location. To prevent this, he plans to send me along a path to the north his scouts have discovered that will allow me to bypass their main force and reach the base. I am to follow this path and link up with a body of the army's scouts stationed just before the point where it starts heading south again. The scouts and I are then to fight our way through the hopefully light opposition we will find in the enemy's rear areas to reach the base. Once there I am to slay the aranea leaders before they can engineer an escape.

While the rendezvous with the army's scouts did not go as planned, I have nevertheless reached the base and penetrated within. It is time to proceed with the general's plan by killing the aranea here, along with any of their allies who may be present, before they can effect some sort of escape.

Soon after reaching the lower level of the base, the passage I took to reach it collapsed behind me. It would appear I can only go forward at this point. Likely this collapse was engineered by the aranea to block pursuit while they escape, so getting ahead of it may well have been crucial to the accomplishment of this quest.

dst:
穆尔霍兰德叛逆巫师打开的一道界门通向一个由野蛮兽人居住的世界。这些兽人利用界门入侵费伦，席卷了许多北方定居点，杀害了数千人。穆尔霍兰德与恩瑟两地的神王化身与兽人交战，兽人则召唤自己神祇的神力化身进行报复。在这些被称为兽人门战争的冲突中，兽人神祇格乌什杀死了穆尔霍兰德的太阳神雷，这是已知的国度中第一起弑神事件。许多恩瑟神祇也被杀害。人类神祇最终获胜，兽人被杀或被迫北迁。

神祇赛特与奥西里斯争夺继承雷之位，赛特谋杀了他的对手。荷鲁斯吸收了雷的神力，成为荷鲁斯-雷，击败了赛特，并将这位邪神抛入沙漠。伊西斯复活了奥西里斯。除赛特外，穆尔霍兰德万神殿全体联合支持荷鲁斯-雷。这两个古老国家暂停下来重建力量、舔舐伤口。在此期间，劳玛萨与纳菲尔帝国在北方的战场领土上崛起。在恩瑟，他们的主神恩利尔让位给其子吉尔吉姆后消失，而伊什塔尔，唯一幸存的另一位恩瑟神祇，将她的化身之力交给伊西斯后也消失了。吉尔吉姆作为恩瑟的统治者，开始了长达2000年的衰落，沦为专制暴君。
src:
One portal opened by Mulhorand's rebellious wizards led to a world populated by savage orcs. These orcs used the portal to invade Faer�n, overrunning many northern settlements and slaying thousands. The manifestations of the god-kings of both Mulhorand and Unther battled the orcs, and the orcs retaliated by summoning divine avatars of their own deities. During these conflicts, known as the Orcgate Wars, the orc god Gruumsh slew the Mulhorandi sun god Re, the first known deicide in the Realms. Many of the Untheric deities were slain as well. The human deities eventually prevailed and the orcs were slain or driven northward.

The deities Set and Osiris battled to succeed Re, and Set murdered his rival. Horus absorbed the divine power of Re and became Horus-Re, defeated Set, and cast the evil god into the desert. Isis resurrected Osiris. All of the Mulhorandi pantheon but Set united in support of Horus-Re. The two old nations paused to rebuild their power and lick their wounds. During this time the empires of Raumathar and Narfell rose in the battlefield territories to the north. In Unther, their chief god Enlil abdicated in favor of his son Gilgeam and vanished, and Ishtar, the only other surviving Untheric deity, gave the power of her manifestation to Isis and vanished as well. Gilgeam began his 2,000-year decline into despotic tyranny as the ruler of Unther.

当被称为卡苏斯的残魂还作为强大的法师活着时，他在奴隶和恳求者中生育了许多子女。后来他试图从魔法之神那里窃取力量失败，摧毁了他族人的帝国，使他们流散到世界各地。因此，在一千多年里，他的血脉几乎污染了每一个人类族群，有时它变得足够强大，使一个人类能够生下一个卡赛特。当两个卡赛特交配时，他们能稳定遗传。卡赛特人整体上看起来像人类，但他们有两个显著特征。首先，每个人都有一只淡蓝色的眼睛和一只人类常见的其他颜色的眼睛。卡赛特人的头上还有一撮白发。这些特征在普通人类中很少出现，而且几乎从不同时出现。在卡赛特人只彼此交配的社群中，其他特征也变得常见，例如直的金发或黑发，明显的寡妇峰以及小巧的鼻子和嘴巴。卡赛特婴儿看起来像正常人类，但随着他们成熟，他们奇怪的外貌和力量就会出现。大多数卡赛特人在进入青春期时获得他们的天赋权利，但对某些人来说会更早或更晚。迷信的人类常常将正在显现的卡赛特人外貌变化视为祝福或诅咒的迹象，但很少有人怀疑它两者皆是。卡苏斯的血脉使成熟的卡赛特人能够抵抗非魔法打击，并将针对他施放的法咒转化为治疗魔法，但这也阻止他施放任何法咒。在人类中出生的卡赛特人可能一生都不知道他们不寻常的外貌伴随着奇妙的能力，但其他人在尝试走上施法者之路时，或在暴力使他们受到的伤害比应有的少时，会发现他们的天赋权利。卡赛特人的社群常常寻找这样的“弃儿”来灌输他们的哲学，希望壮大他们的人数并推进他们邪恶的议程。
  
卡赛特种族特性：
人类特性：卡赛特人是人类，获得人类奖励专长和额外技能点
+2 体质，+2 魅力：卡赛特人异常坚韧，他们的血脉赋予他们威严的存在感。
伤害减免：卡赛特人拥有伤害减免 5/+1。
法术抗力：卡赛特人的法术抗力等于 10 + 他的职业等级。
魔法吸取攻击（Su）：卡赛特人的近战攻击可以削弱敌人的魔法护甲，武器或盾牌。如果一个生物被卡赛特人近战击中且未通过意志豁免（DC 10 + 魅力调整值），其拥有的一件战斗导向魔法物品（护甲，盾牌或武器）将被压制 1 轮。
法咒治疗（Su）：每当卡赛特人的法术抗力阻止一个法咒影响他时，他每法术等级治疗 2 点伤害。
无法施法：卡赛特人不能施放奥术或神术，即使他们在授予施法能力的职业中升级。他们可以正常使用灵能能力和魔法物品。
擅长：卡赛特人擅长轻甲和中甲，以及军用武器。

src:
When the vestige called Karsus yet lived as a powerful wizard, he fathered many children among his slaves and supplicants. Then his failed attempt to steal power from the deity of magic shattered his people's empire and spread them across the world. Thus, over more than a thousand years, his bloodline has tainted nearly every human population, and at times it grows strong enough for a human to give birth to a karsite. When two karsites mate, they breed true. Karsites appear human overall, but they have two distinguishing traits. First, each has one pale blue eye and one eye of another color common to humans. A karsite also has a shock of white hair on his head. These traits appear infrequently among normal humans, and almost never at the same time. In communities where karsites mate exclusively with one another, other features also become common, such as straight blond or black hair, a sharp widow's peak, and a small nose and mouth. Karsite infants appear as normal humans, but as they mature, their strange appearances and powers appear. Most karsites gain their birthright by the time they reach puberty, but for some it comes sooner or later. Superstitious humans often view the change in an emerging karsite's appearance as a sign of a blessing or curse, but few suspect that it is both. Karsus's bloodline allows a matured karsite to resist nonmagical blows and to turn spells cast against him into healing magic, but it also prevents him from ever casting any spell. Karsites born among humans might live and die without ever knowing that their unusual appearance comes with wondrous abilities, but others discover their birthright when they attempt to take up the path of a spellcaster, or when violence leaves them less harmed than it should. Communities of karsites often seek out such �foundlings?to indoctrinate into their philosophy, hoping to swell their numbers and advance their evil agenda.
  
Karsite Racial Traits:
Human Traits: Karsites are humans, and gain the human bonus feat and extra skill point
+2 Constitution, +2 Charisma: Karsites are exceptionally hardy, and their bloodline gives them a commanding presence.
Damage Reduction: A karsite has damage reduction 5/+1.
Spell Resistance: A karsite's spell resistance equals 10 + his class levels.
Magic Draining Attacks (Su): A karsite's melee attacks can weaken a foe's magic armor, weapon, or shield. If a creature struck in melee by a karsite fails a Will save (DC 10 + Cha modifier), one of the combat-oriented magic items (armor, shield, or weapon) in its possession is suppressed for 1 round. 
Spell Healing (Su): Whenever a karsite's spell resistance prevents a spell from affecting him, he heals 2 points of damage per spell level.
Spellcasting Inability: Karsites cannot cast arcane or divine spells, even if they take levels in a class that grants spellcasting ability. They can use psionic powers and magic items normally.
Proficiencies: Karsites are proficient with light and medium armor, and with martial weapons.
Favored Class: Binder.
Level Adjustment: +2

你变成与你正常形态同类型的生物形态。新形态必须在你正常体型的1个体型类别之内。所采用形态的最大生命骰等于你的施法者等级，在5级时最大为5生命骰。你可以变成你自己种族的一员，甚至变成你自己。

你保留自己的能力值。你的职业和等级，生命值，阵营，基础攻击加值和基础豁免加值都保持不变。你保留正常形态的所有超自然和类法咒特殊攻击和特性，除了那些需要新形态没有的身体部位（例如喷吐武器需要嘴或凝视攻击需要眼睛）.

你保留所有来自职业等级的非凡特殊攻击和特性，但失去任何非来自职业等级的正常形态特性。

如果新形态能够说话，你可以正常交流。你保留原始形态的任何施法能力，但新形态必须能够清晰说话（即说一种语言）才能使用语言成分，并且必须有能够精细操作的分肢才能使用姿势或材料成分。

你获得新形态的物理特性，同时保留自己的心智。物理特性包括自然体型，天生防御加值，天生武器（如爪，咬等）以及任何总体物理特性（有无翅膀，肢体数量等）.有额外肢体的身体不允许你进行比正常更多的攻击（或更有利的双武器攻击）.

你不会获得任何上述物理特性中未注明的非凡特殊攻击或特殊特性，如黑暗视觉，微光视觉，盲视，盲视，快速治疗，再生，灵敏嗅觉等。

你不会获得新形态的任何超自然特殊攻击，特殊特性或类法咒能力。你的生物类型和亚种（如果有）无论新形态如何都保持不变。你不能变成任何有模板的生物形态，即使该模板不改变生物类型或亚种。

当变化发生时，你的装备（如果有）要么保持穿戴或由新形态持有（如果能够穿戴或持有该物品），要么融入新形态并变得无法使用。当你恢复真实形态时，任何先前融入新形态的物品会重新出现在你身体上它们先前占据的相同位置，并再次可用。你在所采用形态中穿戴但在正常形态中不能穿戴的任何新物品会脱落并落在你脚下；任何你在两种形态中都能穿戴或在恢复时两种形态共有的身体部位携带的物品仍以相同方式持有。任何与整体分离的身体部位或装备部分恢复其真实形态。
src:
Transmutation
Level:        Brd 2, Sor/Wiz 2
Components:   V, S
Casting Time: 1 standard action
Range:        Personal
Target:    You
Duration:    10 min./level (D)

You assume the form of a creature of the same type as your normal form. The new form must be within one size category of your normal size. The maximum HD of an assumed form is equal to your caster level, to a maximum of 5 HD at 5th level. You can change into a member of your own kind or even into yourself.

You retain your own ability scores. Your class and level, hit points, alignment, base attack bonus, and base save bonuses all remain the same. You retain all supernatural and spell-like special attacks and qualities of your normal form, except for those requiring a body part that the new form does not have (such as a mouth for a breath weapon or eyes for a gaze attack).

You keep all extraordinary special attacks and qualities derived from class levels, but you lose any from your normal form that are not derived from class levels.

If the new form is capable of speech, you can communicate normally. You retain any spellcasting ability you had in your original form, but the new form must be able to speak intelligibly (that is, speak a language) to use verbal components and must have limbs capable of fine manipulation to use somatic or material components.

You acquire the physical qualities of the new form while retaining your own mind. Physical qualities include natural size, natural armor bonus, natural weapons (such as claws, bite, and so on), and any gross physical qualities (presence or absence of wings, number of extremities, and so forth). A body with extra limbs does not allow you to make more attacks (or more advantageous two-weapon attacks) than normal.

You do not gain any extraordinary special attacks or special qualities not noted above under physical qualities, such as darkvision, low-light vision, blindsense, blindsight, fast healing, regeneration, scent, and so forth.

You do not gain any supernatural special attacks, special qualities, or spell-like abilities of the new form. Your creature type and subtype (if any) remain the same regardless of your new form. You cannot take the form of any creature with a template, even if that template doesn't change the creature type or subtype.

When the change occurs, your equipment, if any, either remains worn or held by the new form (if it is capable of wearing or holding the item), or melds into the new form and becomes nonfunctional. When you revert to your true form, any objects previously melded into the new form reappear in the same location on your body they previously occupied and are once again functional. Any new items you wore in the assumed form and can't wear in your normal form fall off and land at your feet; any that you could wear in either form or carry in a body part common to both forms at the time of reversion are still held in the same way. Any part of the body or piece of equipment that is separated from the whole reverts to its true form.

矮人战狂，或称库尔德贾格（斧头白痴），是传说中的狂战士，能通过仪式性的歌唱进入战斗狂怒。

据信他们曾受矮人战神触碰，战神教导他们，战死沙场将作为公正的奖赏，让他们以更强大的姿态回归。因此，这些战士无惧死亡。

战狂在矮人社会中赢得勉强（且恐惧）的尊重，并被认为创造了诸如“头朝前！”和“会动就杀！”等哲学复杂的矮人格言。

大多数战狂过着短暂而荣耀的一生。

- 生命骰：d12。
- 武器防具擅长：战狂不获得任何额外的武器或防具擅长。
- 技能点：2+ 智力调整值。

要求：

职业特性：狂暴
阵营：任意非守序
种族：矮人
专长：顺势斩，坚忍，猛力攻击
基础攻击加值：+5
技能：威吓（8级），学识（2级），表演（2级）

职业特性：

等级
1：战斗狂怒 - 每日1次（如野蛮人狂暴）.
   抗毒 - 对毒素的所有强韧豁免检定获得+4加值。
   专长 - 技能专攻：威吓 - 所有涉及威吓的技能检定获得+3加值。
2：勇气光环 - 战狂免疫恐惧。
   专长 - 精通绊摔。
3：战斗狂怒 - 每日2次。
   专长 - 精通徒手击打。
4：专长 - 大顺势斩。
   专长 - 献身攻击。
5：战斗狂怒 - 每日3次。
   天生防御 - 战狂的皮肤硬化，天生防御获得+2加值。
src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
Dwarven Battleragers, or Kuldjargh (Axe Idiots), are legendary berserkers who can enter a battle frenzy through ritualistic singing.

They are believed to have been touched by the dwarven gods of war, who taught them that by dying in battle they will return even stronger than before as a just reward. As a consequence, these warriors have no fear of death.

Battleragers command a grudging (if fearful) respect within dwarven society and are credited with having coined such philosophically complex dwarven maxims as "Head first!" and "If it moves, kill it!"

Most Battleragers live short, glorious lives.

- Hit Die: d12.
- Proficiencies: A Battlerager does not gain any additional weapon or armor proficiencies.
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:

Class Feature: Rage
Alignment: Any non-lawful
Race: Dwarven
Feats: Cleave, Endurance, Power Attack
Base Attack Bonus: +5
Skills: Intimidate (8 ranks), Lore (2 ranks), Perform (2 ranks)

CLASS FEATURES:

Level
1: Battle Rage - 1/day (as per Barbarian Rage).
   Resist Poison - Bestows a +4 bonus to all Fortitude saving throws vs. poison.
   Feat - Skill Focus: Intimidate - Provides a +3 bonus to all skill checks involving Intimidate.
2: Aura of Courage - The Battlerager becomes immune to fear.
   Feat - Improved Trip.
3: Battle Rage - 2/day.
   Feat - Improved Unarmed Strike.
4: Feat - Great Cleave.
   Feat - Reckless Offense.
5: Battle Rage - 3/day.
   Natural Armor - The Battlerager's skin hardens, granting a +2 bonus to natural AC.

You can make any one of the following special attacks: bull rush, disarm, or trip. For purposes of adjudicating these attacks, make your touch attack as normal, if one is necessary. Because the attack is made at a distance, it does not draw an attack of opportunity that such an attack would draw under normal circumstances, nor can your foe attempt to perform the same maneuver on you in turn, even if such is normally allowed.

You will be given a feat on your class radial to allow you to make these attacks.

The caster creates a slightly concave circular plane of force that will follow him carrying what is placed upon it. The disk can hold 100 pounds of weight per caster level (if used to transport a liquid, the capacity is 2 gallons). The disk floats approximately 3 feet above the ground and 5 feet behind the caster at all times and remains level. Some adjustment can occur due to stairs or other consideration (concentration necessary for caster to direct disk), but the disk will remain level and cannot change in size, so that tight steep shaft might not be accessibly by the disk.

The disk will wink out of existence when the spell duration expires, returning all items to casters inventory. The disk moves at 30 feet per round, and the spell also ends if the caster moves away from the disk further than the maximum range of the spell. The caster needs to assure a stable path for the spell, as the disk will wink out if the floor suddenly drops away beneath it.

我得到警告，贫民区东北部的一栋房子据说被危险的幽灵所萦绕，那些进入这座古老破败建筑的人有时再也无法出来。这似乎是一个需要提防的危险，或者，对于像我这样的冒险追寻者来说，也许是一个机会。

我进入了这栋房子，到达二楼后，被困在了一个幻象迷宫中——据我与之交谈的一个幽灵所说。要逃脱，我必须在我进入任何门后随机被传送到的某个房间里找到一个界门，并在受益于真知术效果的情况下进入它。要施放这样的法咒，我应该寻找某种魔法神器的四块碎片，并找到一个有铁砧的房间，在那里我可以将它们组装起来。

我已经通过界门逃脱，最初将我困在那个幻象迷宫中的强大幽灵也已被击败。我只需与协助我的幽灵交谈，并找到这里可能散落的任何宝藏，即可完成此事。
src:
I have been warned that a house in the northeast of the Slums district is believed to be haunted by dangerous spirits, and that those who enter this old and decrepit structure sometimes fail to come out again. This would seem a danger to beware, or perhaps, for seekers of adventure such as myself, an opportunity.

I have entered the house, and upon reaching the second floor have become trapped in what according to a ghost I talked to is a maze of illusions. To escape, I must find a portal in one of the rooms to which I am randomly transported upon entering any door and enter it while benefitting from the effects of a True Seeing spell. To cast such a spell, I should look for four fragments of some kind of magical artifact, and find a room with an anvil in which I can assemble them.

I have escaped through the portal, and the mighty spectre who entrapped me within that maze of illusions to begin with has been defeated. I need only speak with the ghost who assisted me, and find whatever treasures may be lying about here, to complete this matter.

dst: 卷宗学者定发群体蛮牛之力

萨曼·瓦拉迪告诉我，如果我想找活干，就应该去找一个叫纳马尔·萨拉坎的人，他是“闪耀探寻者”号的船长，目前可以在码头区找到他。这位萨拉坎船长显然想找一位冒险者帮忙调查他发现的一件神秘神器。萨曼已经向他提过我可能是合适的人选，所以他应该准备好在我提出愿意帮忙时接受我的协助。

我已经和萨拉坎船长谈过，并了解了一些他交给我的任务。他找到了一种魔法手段，可以创造一道通往某处水下废墟的界门，并希望我帮忙探索那里。我和任何穿过界门（或之后被召唤）的同伴都会获得防溺水的魔法保护。这种保护会持续四个小时，而且在完成任务之前我不应该从界门返回，因为那会打断法咒。在水下行动会让我变慢并降低攻击效果，阻止使用远程武器，并使任何涉及火焰的法咒效果有限（最多如此）。我只要准备好就可以直接进入界门。当我穿过时，必要的法咒会自动施放。

不幸的是，在有限的时间内，我未能找到任何能满足萨拉坎船长要求的东西，因此无法领取奖励。至少这个任务是一次有趣的经历，即使它以失败告终。
src:
Saman Waladi has told me that if I am looking for work I should seek out one Namal Sarakan, captain of the ship Shining Searcher, currently to be found in the Docks District. This Captain Sarakan apparently wants the help of an adventurer in investigating some mysterious artifact he has found. Saman has already mentioned to him that I might be a suitable person for his needs, so he should be prepared to accept my assistance at such time as I offer it.

I have spoken to Captain Sarakan, and learned something about the task he has for me. He has found a magical means of creating a portal to some underwater ruin, and wants my help in exploring it. I and any companions who go through (or are later summoned) will be provided magical protection against drowning. This will last four hours, and I should not return through the portal until I have accomplished the task, as this will disrupt the spell. Operating underwater will slow me down and reduce the effectiveness of attacks, prevent the use of missile weapons, and render any spells that involve the use of fire of limited effectiveness (at best). I should simply enter the portal whenever I am ready. The necessary spells will be automatically cast as I go through.

Unfortunately I was unable to locate anything that would meet Captain Sarakan's requirements in the limited time available, and so will not be able to claim the reward. At least this quest was an interesting experience, even if it ended in failure.

src:
Silver dragons are well known for taking humanoid form and living among them.  Long ago, communities of humans welcomed silver dragons into their homes, not knowing the nature of their disguised visitors.  In these communities, often secluded and small, half-dragon children became common as the dragons married their human friends.  The silvers did their best to protect these children form discovery, eventually teaching them to assume full human form magically, and thus the mingling of human and silver dragon blood continued.  Over time, the draconic features disappeared, and the dragons moved on as well, leaving communities of humans with dragonblood heritage.  They came to be known as Silverbrow humans due to the white streaks or highlights displayed in the hair of these descendants.  Physically they are otherwise indistinguishable from normal humans.

Silverbrow Human Ability Adjustments: None
Favored Class (Any): A multiclass silverbrow human's highest class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

- Quick To Master: Silverbrow Humans gain a bonus feat at first level.
- Dragonblooded: Silverbrow Humans have the dragonblood subtype.
- Human: Silverbrow Humans count as Human for the purpose of spells.

src:
These dragonets are known for their habit of following ships in order to feed on the fish disturbed by the vessel's passing, much like sea gulls. Sailors sometimes call them crow's nest dragons, since they tend to swoop around the crow's nest of a ship and sometimes perch on it. In Sharn, they build their nests on the very tops of the city's towers, giving them their local name. They are often encountered as companions or familiars.  A spiretop dragon is about 18 inches long, with an additional 18 inches of tail. Its wingspan is about 3 feet, and it weighs about 2 pounds.

Spiretop Dragon Ability Adjustments: -4 Str, +8 Dex, +2 Con, -4 Int, -2 Cha.  Spiretop Dragons are quick in action but fairly dim.

Favored Class (Rogue): A multiclass spiretop dragon's rogue class does not count when determining whether they suffer an XP penalty for multiclassing.

- A spiretop dragon's base land speed is 10 feet and they also have a fly speed of 60.
- Dragon: Spiretop dragons are dragons and thus are not subject to sleep and paralysis effects.
- Tiny: As tiny creatures, spiretop dragons have a +2 bonus to Armor Class, a +2 bonus on attack rolls, and a +8 bonus on Hide checks.
- Breath Weapon: A spiretop dragon can exhale a Fog Cloud as if cast by a 3rd level sorcerer.  The spiretop dragon must wait 1d4 rounds between uses of this breath weapon. 
- Natural Armor: Spiretop dragons receive a +2 natural armor bonus due to their hard scales.
- Evasion: If a spiretop dragon is exposed to any effect that normally allows it to attempt a Reflex saving throw for half damage, it takes no damage with a successful saving throw.
- Bite Attack: A spire dragon can inflict a nasty (1d3) bite for their size.

Level Adjustment: +2
Racial Hit Dice: 2 levels of dragon

(PRESTIGE CLASS)
Each beholder believes that it represents a state of true perfection. Among the desperate wastrels of decadent cities and debased explorers of the subterranean Underdark can be found humanoids who agree, and who have entered into a surgical pact with the beholder race in an attempt to achieve even a sliver of that perfection.

These so-called Ocular Adepts, outcasts to their own societies, have pledged their services to one or more eye tyrants and pledged their religious devotion to the alien entity known as the Great Mother, the deity matron of all beholders.

- Hit Die: d6.
- Proficiencies: An Ocular Adept does not gain any additional weapon or armor proficiencies.
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:

Alignment: Lawful Evil or Neutral Evil
Skills: Concentration 8 ranks
Feats: Endurance
Base Save Bonus: Fort +4

CLASS FEATURES:

Level
1: Charm Person Ray - 2/day (spell-like ability).
2: Sleep Ray - 2/day (spell-like ability).
3: Inflict Moderate Wounds Ray - 2/day (spell-like ability).
4: Slow Ray - 2/day (spell-like ability).
5: Fear Ray - 2/day (spell-like ability).
6: Charm Monster Ray - 2/day (spell-like ability).
7: Telekinesis Ray - 2/day (spell-like ability).
8: Flesh to Stone Ray - 2/day (spell-like ability).
9: Disintegrate Ray - 2/day (spell-like ability).
10: Finger of Death Ray - 2/day (spell-like ability).

Spellcasting: The Ocular Adept knows spells and has spells per day as if he was a cleric of equivalent class level, except that he cannot spontaneously cast Cure or Inflict spells. He gains two domains from the following list: Evil, Hatred, Strength, or Tyranny. If he does not select these domains, he will not be able to level in this class. These domains will not stack with those gained from the Cleric class.

dst: 萨满 定发造成致命伤

在探索卡林港地下的废墟时，我从一只恐蛛手中救下了一个不寻常的半兽人，名叫赫兰加拉克。这个赫兰加拉克是海姆的牧师，看起来直到最近，他的部落“血刃”一直崇拜这位神祇，并试图避免像半兽人通常那样与其他种族交战。然而最近部落的领导层发生了变化，前任领袖冈克鲁泽尔公主被驱逐，并被卖给了一个邪教，他们需要拥有皇室血统的人进行某种奇怪的仪式献祭。新领袖是格鲁扎尔，他试图恢复对格乌什的崇拜，并与鼠人结盟对抗卡林港的人类。赫兰加拉克希望我与他联手救出冈克鲁泽尔，并让她重新领导部落，挫败这个计划。

我同意了赫兰加拉克的计划。拯救公主是冒险者的经典任务，即使老故事里的公主通常不是半兽人。与赫兰加拉克一起，我应该向西前往血刃镇，然后向南找到邪教巢穴。

我们已经找到并救出了冈克鲁泽尔，并处理了邪教徒，他们不再构成威胁。我们还杀死了格鲁扎尔，让冈克鲁泽尔重新成为她人民的领袖。任务完成。与这些半兽人的现任领袖成为朋友后，如果愿意，我可以将他们的城镇作为休息或交易的地方。
src:
While exploring the subterranean ruins beneath Calimport, I rescued from a dire spider an unusual orc named Hrangarak. This Hrangarak is a cleric of Helm, and it seems that until recently his tribe, the Bloody Blades, was worshiping this deity and seeking to avoid warring with other races as is typical of orcs. Recently however the tribe has had a change of leadership, with their former leader Princess Gunkruzelle being ousted and sold to a cult who needed someone with royal blood for some sort of strange ritual sacrifice. Its new leader is Gruzhaur, who seeks to restore worship of Gruumsh and form an alliance with the wererats against the humans of Calimport. Hrangarak wants me to join with him to rescue Gunkruzelle and restore her to leadership of the tribe, frustrating this plan.

I have agreed to Hrangarak's plan. Rescuing a princess is a classic quest for adventurers, even if the princess is not usually an orc in the old stories. Together with Hrangarak, I should head west towards the Bloody Blades town, but then head south to find the Cultist's Lair.

We have found and rescued Gunkruzelle, and dealt with the cultists, who will no longer be any threat. We have also slain Gruzhaur, restoring Gunkruzelle as leader of her people. Mission accomplished. Having befriended the current leaders of these orcs, I can use their town as a place to rest or trade, if I wish.

src:
Type of Feat: Combat Form, Fighter Bonus Feat.

The way of the warrior requires more than simple, brute strength. Some warriors bring their minds to such keen focus during the heat of battle that they can attain superhuman levels of endurance, perception, and mental toughness. Through intense mental exercise and training, you learn to enter a state of perfect martial clarity.

Prerequisite: WIS 13
Specifics: In battle, you push aside the chaos of the fight and attain a focused state that grants you a keen, clear picture of the battle. Fear and pain ebb away as you focus solely on defeating your enemy. The first time you make a successful attack during an encounter, you gain your combat focus. In this state, your mind and body become one, allowing you to overcome mundane physical limits. You can maintain your combat focus for 10 rounds after entering it, +1 additional round per combat form feat you possess aside from this one. You can only gain your combat focus once per encounter. While you are maintaining your combat focus, you gain a +2 bonus on Will saves. If you have three or more combat form feats, this bonus increases to +4.
Use: Automatic.
Special: A fighter can select Combat Focus as one of his fighter bonus feats.

Psychic Theurges access both the divine mysteries of spellcasting and the psionic powers of the mind. 我遇到了法师伊纳尔·梅卡赞，他告诉我他得知了一种咒语，可以将我们传送到伟大的巫师扎塔罗斯曾经居住过的一处失落已久的避难所。这样的地方肯定充满了魔法宝藏，但伊纳尔发现获取它们会有一些困难。首先，打破入口处的结界需要同时施放一个破除法咒和一个解除魔法。因此伊纳尔认为有必要招募第二个施法者，也就是我。其次，这个地方据说有守卫魔像保护。伊纳尔是个学者，几乎没有战斗魔法经验，因此也希望我为他清除这些魔像，以及我可能遇到的任何其他危险。作为报酬，我可以优先挑选在里面找到的任何宝藏，伊纳尔只想要扎塔罗斯关于魔法研究的笔记和文件，我应该把它们带给他。\n\n伊纳尔用魔法把我们传送到了扎塔罗斯的这个隐秘避难所。我现在已经探索了这个地方，我相信已经清除了危险，也找到了一些扎塔罗斯的笔记和文件。然而，当我把它们带给伊纳尔时，他攻击了我！原来他想把这里的所有宝藏都据为己有，而我只是一个被带来做获取宝藏苦工的傻瓜。不过，我笑到了最后，因为我击败并杀死了他。
src: I have met the mage Ynal Mekazhan, who tells me that he has learned of an incantation that can teleport us to a long-lost refuge once occupied by the great wizard Zataroth. Such a place is sure to be full of magical treasures, but Ynal has discovered that there will be some difficulties to obtaining them. Firstly, breaking the wards on the entrance requires the simultaneous casting of both a breach spell and one dispelling magic. Therefore Ynal has found it necessary to recruit a second spellcaster, myself. Secondly, the place is supposed to be protected by guardian golems. Ynal is a scholar with little experience of battle magic and thus also wants me to clear these out out for him, along with any other hazards I might encounter. As a reward, I will get first pick of any treasures I find within, Ynal wants only Zataroth's notes and papers on magical research, which I should bring to him.\n\nYnal has magically transported us to this hidden refuge of Zataroth. I have now explored the place and I believe cleared it of dangers, as well as locating some of Zataroth's notes and papers. However, when I brought them to Ynal, he attacked me! It turns out he wanted all the treasures here for himself, and I was just a dupe brought on to do the hard work of obtaining them. I have the last laugh, however, having defeated and slain him.

埃雷伍德
"别误会，我并非不同情这些不幸生物的困境，但重要的是要认识到，其中相当一部分是他们自己造成的。我怀疑这个位面上没有人能完全不受来自魔鬼与恶魔领域的影响，人类历史确实充满了罪行，但事实仍然是，我们所对抗的这些生物的历史更是如此。他们憎恨自己被憎恨这一事实，只会让他们的处境更糟，并犯下与他们所谴责的同样严重的罪行。不如接受世界永远不完美、充满苦难，并现实地努力减轻我们所能减轻的。"
src: "Don't misunderstand me, I am not unsympathetic to the plight of these unfortunate creatures, But it is important to realize that a considerable part of it is of their own making. I suspect no one on this plane is entirely free of influences stemming from the devilish and demonic realms, and it is certainly true that human history is full of crimes, but the fact remains that the history of these creatures we fight is even more so. By hating the fact that they are hated, they have only made their situation worse, and carried out crimes as great as any they condemn. Better to accept that the world will always be imperfect and full of suffering, and work realistically to alleviate what we can."

src:
Deep halflings are shorter, stockier versions of their lightfoot cousins. The are miners by trade and take pleasure in gems and fine masonry. They rarely mix with humans or elves, but enjoy the company of dwarves, with whom they share much in common. Deep halflings stand a little less than half as high as humans, and have stocky builds with ruddy skin, black hair and dark eyes.

Deep Halfling Ability Adjustments: +2 Dex, -2 Str.
Favored Class (Rogue): A multiclass deep halfling's rogue class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

- Small Stature:
 +1 size bonus to attack rolls.
 +1 size bonus to AC.
 +4 size bonus to Hide checks.
- Darkvision: Deep halflings are able to see in the dark.
- Stonecunning: +2 racial bonus on Search checks made in subterranean areas.
- Skill Affinity (Listen): +2 racial bonus to Listen checks.
- Skill Affinity (Craft): +2 racial bonus to Craft Armor and Craft Weapon checks.
- Skill Affinity (Appraise): +2 racial bonus to Appraise checks.
- Lucky: +1 luck bonus to all saving throws.
- Fearless: +2 morale bonus to saving throws against spells and effects of the 'Fear' subtype.
- Good Aim: +1 racial bonus to attack rolls made with throwing weapons.
- Halfling: Deep Halflings are considered Halflings for the purpose of spells.

Special: Halflings are small creatures and as such they can never use the following Large weapons: bastard sword, dire mace, two-bladed sword, double axe, greataxe, greatsword, halberd, heavy flail, quarterstaff, scythe and spear.

虹光墙创造一道垂直的，不透明的墙；一个闪烁的，多彩的光平面，保护你免受所有形式的攻击。这面墙闪烁着七种颜色，每种颜色都有独特的力量和用途。这面墙无法移动，你可以穿过并停留在墙附近而不受伤害。然而，任何其他生命骰少于 8 的生物，如果在墙 20 英尺范围内
看向这面墙，会被这些颜色致盲 2d4 轮。

墙中的每种颜色都有特殊效果。随附的表格显示了墙的七种颜色，
它们出现的顺序，它们对试图攻击你或穿过
墙的生物的效果，以及抵消每种颜色所需的魔法。

法术抗力对虹光墙有效，但必须对每种
存在的颜色重复进行施法者等级检定。

颜色   顺序   颜色的效果

红色     第1    造成 20 点火焰伤害（反射减半）.
橙色  第2    造成 40 点强酸伤害（反射减半）.
黄色  第3    造成 80 点电击伤害（反射减半）.
绿色   第4    毒素（杀死；强韧部分则改为 1d6 点体质伤害）.
蓝色   第5    变为石头（强韧否定）.
靛色  第6    意志豁免否则发疯（如同摄魂术法咒）.
紫色  第7    生物被送往另一个位面（意志否定）.
src:
Prismatic Wall
Abjuration
Level: Sor/Wiz 8
Components: V, S
Casting Time: 1 standard action
Range: Close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Effect: Wall 4 ft./level wide, 2 ft./level high
Duration: 10 min./level (D)
Saving Throw: See text
Spell Resistance: See text

Prismatic wall creates a vertical, opaque wall; a shimmering, multicolored plane of light that protects you from all forms of attack. The wall flashes with seven colors, each of which has a distinct power and purpose. The wall is immobile, and you can pass through and remain near the wall without harm. However, any other creature with less than 8 HD that is within 20 feet of the wall is blinded for 2d4 rounds by the colors if it
looks at the wall.

Each color in the wall has a special effect. The accompanying table shows the seven colors of the
wall, the order in which they appear, their  effects on creatures trying to attack you or pass
through the wall, and the magic needed to negate each color.

Spell resistance is effective against a prismatic wall, but the caster level check must be repeated for each
color present.

Color   Order   Effect of Color

Red     1st     Deals 20 points of fire damage (Reflex half).
Orange  2nd     Deals 40 points of acid damage (Reflex half).
Yellow  3rd     Deals 80 points of electricity damage (Reflex half).
Green   4th     Poison (Kills; Fortitude partial for 1d6 points of Con damage instead).
Blue    5th     Turned to stone (Fortitude negates).
Indigo  6th     Will save or become insane (as insanity spell).
Violet  7th     Creatures sent to another plane (Will negates).

一条绿松石水晶项链环绕在你的脖子上。当你展现一道造成伤害的心灵异能时，水晶会散发出微弱的光芒，并随着心灵异能的展现而增强亮度。

此魂融不影响不造成伤害的心灵异能。

几乎看不见的魂能细丝从你的心灵异能集束中扭动而出，这些灵魂能量的卷须在你展现心灵异能时扭曲成心灵异能符文。当你展现一道造成伤害的心灵异能时，该心灵异能会伴随着一股蓝绿色的原始魂能能量速度爆发。

你攻击性心灵异能背后的能量可以暂时压制你的对手。每当你展现一道对单个活物造成伤害的心灵异能时，该生物必须成功通过强韧豁免（使用魂融的豁免DC，而非心灵异能的），否则会晕眩1轮。如果该心灵异能对多个生物造成伤害，或者目标生物未受到该心灵异能的伤害（无论是因为成功通过豁免，灵能抗力，还是对该心灵异能造成的伤害有抗力），则此效果无效。
src:
Psychic Focus
Descriptors: None
Classes: Incarnate, soulborn
Chakra: Throat
Saving Throw: See text

A necklace of turquoise crystals fits around your neck. The crystals shed a faint glow that increases in brightness when you manifest a damaging power.

Drawing upon soul energy of those using psionics, meldshapers who manifest psionic powers can use the incarnum energy to intensify powers that cause harm to others.

You shape incarnum into a periapt or other trinket, known as a psychic focus, which you then wear about your neck. When you manifest a psionic powers that deal damage, your power's damage is increased by 1 point. Powers that divide their damage among multiple targets, such as energy burst, deal the extra damage to each affected target.

This soulmeld does not affect powers that do not deal damage.

Essentia: Every point of essentia you invest in your psychic focus increases the damage by 1 point.

Chakra Bind (Throat)

Barely visible wisps of incarnum writhe from your psychic focus, and these tendrils of soul energy twist into psionic glyphs as you manifest psionic powers. When you manifest a damaging power, the power is accompanied by a blue-green burst of raw incarnum energy.

The energy behind your offensive powers can temporarily overcome your opponents. Whenever you manifest a power that deals damage to a single living creature, that creature must succeed on a Fortitude save (using the soulmeld's save DC, not the power's) or be dazed for 1 round. If the power deals damage to more than one creature, or if the target creature takes no damage from the power (whether because of a successful saving throw, power resistance, or resistance to the damage dealt by the power), this has no effect.

dst: 呼唤坐骑

"你无疑认为能预知未来事件的人可以轻易避开这样的天命？在大多数情况下确实如此，但有些力量强大到足以扭曲天命之路，模糊甚至暂时蒙蔽我们的特殊视觉，而我的俘获者卡洛玛斯·泽卡尔正与这样一股力量合作。凭借可支配的如此资源，他竟能在我们毫无预知的情况下突袭乌尔·萨哈布！"
src: "No doubt you think one able to predict future events could easily avoid such a fate? Under most circumstances that would be true, but there are powers great enough to warp the paths of fate, blurring or even temporarily blinding our special vision, and my captor, Kalomas Zekar, is working in conjunction with such a power. With such resources at his disposal, he was actually able to raid Ul'Sahab without the act being predicted by us!"

dst: "我女儿与卡齐娅的联络为我们创造了一个机会。如果我们能派人前往泽卡尔之塔，她表示愿意为我们打开一扇门，让我们得以进入。此外，我女儿告诉我，根据她对泽法德之剑的研究，她相信只要我们能让她与那把剑同处一室，她就能控制它，并阻止它被用于泽卡尔所图谋的用途。"
src: "My daughter's communications with Kadzia have created an opportunity for us. If we can get a group to the Zekar tower, she has expressed a willingness to open a door for us, giving us access. What's more my daughter informs me that based on her studies of the Sword of Zefad, she believes that if we can only bring her into the same room with it, she can control it and prevent it from being used as Zekar intends."

dst:
牛头人是强壮，领地意识极强的生物，常出没于广阔的地下迷宫。他们是双足行走的，长着牛头，体重超过 700 磅。牛头人天生的狡猾和野性本能使他们能够轻松找到穿越即使最令人困惑的隧道复合体的路。由于感官敏锐，牛头人很少被突袭，也从不陷入措手不及。

牛头人属性调整：+8 力量，+4 体质，-4 智力，-2 魅力
天赋职业（野蛮人）：在判断兼职牛头人是否因兼职而受到经验值惩罚时，其野蛮人职业等级不计入其中。

特殊能力：

- 黑暗视觉：牛头人能够在黑暗中视物。
- 灵敏嗅觉：敏锐感官，搜索，侦察和聆听检定获得 +4 种族加值。

src:
Minotaurs are strong, fiercely territorial creatures often found in vast underground labyrinths. They are bipedal, with the head of a bull, and weigh over 700 pounds. A minotaur's natural cunning and feral instincts enable it to find its way easily though even the most confusing tunnel complexes. Because of the acuity of their sense, minotaurs are seldom surprised and never caught flat-footed.

Minotaur Ability Adjustments: +8 Str, +4 Con, -4 Int, -2 Cha
Favored Class (Barbarian): A multiclass minotaur's barbarian class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

- Darkvision: Minotaurs are able to see in the dark.
- Scent: Keen Senses and +4 racial bonus to Search, Spot and Listen checks.
- Track: +1 racial bonus to Search, Spot and Listen checks.
- Natural Armor Bonus: Racial natural armor bonus of 5.
- Weapon Proficiency (Simple): All Minotaurs are proficient with Simple Weapons.
- Weapon Proficiency (Martial): All Minotaurs are proficient with Martial Weapons.
- Natural Weapon: Minotaurs can make an unarmed gore attack with their horns.
- Powerful Charge: Minotaurs can make a charging gore attack at +2 to hit, -2 to AC for an additional 4d6+6 damage.
- Uncanny Dodge: Minotaurs retain their dexterity bonus to AC, even if caught flat-footed or attacked by a hidden or invisible creature.
- Large Creature: Minotaurs suffer -1 penalties to their Attack and Armor Class, and -4 to their Hide skill.
- Monstrous: Minotaurs count as Monstrous Humanoids for the purpose of spells.

dst: 在城市下方的某些洞穴中探索时，我遇到了一位名叫巴拉兹的矮人雇佣兵战士，他在与一些石化蜥蜴的战斗中被石化了。我成功将他恢复。他已经离开，去向他以前的冒险伙伴复仇，因为他们背叛了他，把他丢给了石化蜥蜴。但他告诉我，鉴于我给予他的帮助，如果我们再次相遇，他愿意以优惠的价格为我提供雇佣兵战士的服务。我不知道未来是否还能再遇到他，但我会记住这一点，以防万一。\n\n我在沙漠巨龙酒馆再次遇到了巴拉兹。他已经追踪到他以前那些背信弃义的伙伴，他们就在那家酒馆的二楼。他想要我帮忙对付他们，并提出了一项交易：如果我在这里协助他，我就可以以更便宜的价格——只需300金币——半永久性地雇佣他作为雇佣兵，这比他原先计划的还要便宜。我接受了这个提议。是时候上楼去处理他以前的伙伴了。
src: While exploring some caverns beneath the city, I came across a dwarven mercenary warrior named Barazh who had been petrified in combat with some basilisks. I was able to restore him. He has departed to seek vengeance against his former adventuring companions who betrayed him and left him for the basilisks, but has told me that on account of the assistance I gave him, he will be willing to offer his services as a mercenary warrior to me at a bargain rate, should we ever meet again. I do not know if I can expect to run into him again at some future date, but I will keep this in mind in the event I do.\n\nI met Barazh again at the Desert Dragon Tavern. He has tracked down his former treacherous partners to the second floor of that establishment. Desiring my help in dealing with them, he has proposed a deal whereby I can hire him on as a mercenary semi-permanently for an even cheaper rate, only 300 gold, than he had already planned, if I assist him here. I accepted this offer. Time for us to head upstairs and see about his former companions.

dst: 我再次见到了我以前的雇主萨曼·瓦拉迪，并因在沙漠中从强盗手中救下他而得到了丰厚的报酬。他还请我为他完成另一项小任务：与城市守卫总部的海关检查员交谈，并从他那里取得官方文件，证明萨曼正在运送的一些货物已通过检查。据萨曼说，我只需提到他的名字，并出示他给我的盖有他印章的文件，因为一切都已经安排好了。\n\n事实证明，这件事比萨曼所说的要稍微复杂一些，因为海关检查员期望得到一笔贿赂，作为完成安排的条件。我不愿意支付，因此未能完成这项任务。萨曼不太高兴，但也理解这不是我的错。
src: I have again met my former employer, Saman Waladi, and been generously rewarded for saving him from the bandits in the desert. He has also asked me to perform another small task for him: speaking to the Customs Inspector at City Watch Headquarters, and obtaining from him official papers indicating that some goods Saman is shipping have passed his inspection. According to Saman, I need only mention his name and display a paper he has given me with his seal, as arrangements have already been made.\n\nThe matter has proved to be a bit more complicated than Saman indicated, as the Customs Inspector expected a bribe as a condition of completing the arrangement. I was unwilling to pay it, and so was not able to complete this mission. Saman was not happy, but understood that it was not my fault.

src:
Type of Feat: Exalted
Prerequisite: Nimbus of Light, Good Alignment*.
Specifics:  You can heal the wounds and ailments of others' using your own life energy. When you activate this ability, as a free action, you immediately take at least 2 points of temporary Constitution damage. You can take as many points of Constitution damage as you wish**, as long as you remain alive and conscious.
 Once you have activated your stigmata, you can touch your allies to heal them of 1 point of constitution damage per level they possess for every 2 points of Constitution damage you take. In addition, any character you touch who is suffering from a disease is cured of it.***
 You can use this touch on one ally per point of Constitution damage you take.***
 When you use this ability, the wounds on your body bleed in proportion to the Constitution damage you take. The bleeding persists for 1 hour and the Constitution damage cannot be restored by any means until the bleeding has stopped. Once the bleeding has stopped, you can freely activate your stigmata again, whether or not you have recovered your lost constitution, as long as you have enough Constitution to use the ability and survive.
Use: Selected.

Notes:
*: You can select this feat even when evil or neutral, but it will not give you any benefits, so be smart and don't choose it if you can't use it.
**: Limited to 2, 4, 6 and 8 points due to technical limits.
***: Due to technical limits, one cannot "hold the charge" on the stigmata. To make up for that, diseases will always be cured.

Level:        Brd 1, Sor/Wiz 1
Components:   V, S
Casting Time: 1 standard action
Range:        Personal
Target:    You

You make yourself (including clothing, armor, weapons, and equipment) look different. You can seem 1 foot shorter or taller, thin, fat, or in between. You cannot change your body type. 这是大学者卡帕达尔的《卡林杉史》第六卷，也是最后一卷，旨在成为该主题的权威著作。

 本卷将卡林杉的历史叙述到几乎当今，主要关注该国自舒恩王朝以来的衰落。在此期间，该国饱受苦难，1018 DR 蓝龙萨菲拉克塔对该领域的蹂躏或许是最严重的灾难。
 尽管它仍是该地区最杰出的强权，卡林杉已不再是曾经的伟大帝国。其边界已大幅收缩，如今大多数卡林杉人对商业的兴趣远大于战争与膨胀术。毕竟，卡林杉一直是一个商业强权，是南越闪耀海通往楚尔特与费伦北方之间的天然十字路口。
 其早期帝国主义的明显放弃并未完全解决与外国势力的紧张关系。最大的问题可能是卡林杉商人拒绝放弃奴隶贸易，这一活动为许多北方国家所憎恶。 
 尽管经济实力是当今卡林杉精英的主要关注点，过去的帝国荣耀并未被遗忘。
src:
This is the sixth and final volume of the great scholar Kapadal's History of Calimshan, intended to be the definitive work on the subject.

 This volume, which brings the history of Calimshan down almost to the present day, is primarily concerned with that nation's decline since the days of the Shoon Dynasty. The nation has suffered in this period, with the ravaging of the realm by the blue dragon Sapphiraktar in 1018 DR being perhaps the worst disaster.
 Although it remains the preeminent regional power, Calimshan is no longer the great empire that it once was. It borders have contracted considerably, and most Calishites today are far more interested in commerce than in war and expansion. Calimshan has after all always been a mercantile power, being a natural crossroads between Chult, to the South across the Shining Sea, and the North of Faerun.
 The apparent abandonment of its earlier imperialism has not altogether resolved tensions with foreign powers. The biggest problem is probably the refusal of Calishite merchants to abandon the slave trade, an activity despised by many of the nations to the north. 
 While economic power is the primary focus of Calimshan's elites at the present day, the imperial glories of the past have not been forgotten.

哈马德正在准备对阿然尼亚的总部发动袭击，因为我们已经掌握了其位置的情报。然而，在此期间他还有另一个任务要我去完成。他的老朋友卡洛玛斯·泽卡尔，因在反对奴隶贸易应采用何种方法上的分歧而与他闹翻，最近因我造访他的庄园而受到启发，主动联系哈马德试图和解。哈马德已被说服协助处理卡洛玛斯卷入的一件事。卡洛玛斯一直在卡林沙漠中维持一个营地，据我所知，他正在帮助一些人离开卡林杉（我没有被告知这些人究竟是谁，并被警告不要过多打听他们的事）。这个营地在夜间遭到暗中袭击，其中一些人被掳走，天命不明。哈马德派我和他雇用的其他一些冒险者前往调查此事。要到达营地，我应先到他的庄园去见卡洛玛斯。他能够打开一道魔法界门将我送到营地，或许还能告诉我更多关于当前局势的信息。\n\n卡洛玛斯将我传送到了营地，在那里我遇到了贾拉尔·马卡希，一位巡林客，也是竖琴手同盟的成员，负责管理这个地方。贾拉尔告诉我，几天前他曾与营地的一名神秘袭击者遭遇，对方将他击倒后逃走，并掳走了一名难民。贾拉尔追踪他的足迹足够远，确定他向东逃往山区，但在没有支援的情况下不愿追得太远。现在他已与我同行，并提议我们一起向东进发，试图追踪这一威胁的源头。
src: Hamad is preparing an assault upon the headquarters of the aranea, now that we have information on its location. However, he has another quest for me to complete in the meantime. His old friend Kalomas Zekar, with whom he had a fallin out over their disagreements about what methods should be employed in opposing the slave trade, has been inspired by my recent visit to his estate to contact Hamad and attempt a reconciliation. Hamad has been persuaded to lend assistance in a matter with which Kalomas is involved. Kalomas has been maintaining a camp in the Calim Desert for people who I am told he is assiting in leaving Calimshan (I have not been told just who these people are, and been warned against asking too many questions about them). This camp has been stealthily attacked during the night and some of the people in it carried off to some unknown fate. Hamad is sending me, and some of the other adventurers in his employ there to investigate the matter. To reach the camp I should first go see Kalomas at his estate. He will be able to open a magical portal transporting me to the camp, and perhaps tell me a little bit more about the situation.\n\nKalomas teleported me to the camp, where I met up with Jalar Makashi, a ranger and member of the Harpers who is running the place. Jalar told me that a few days ago he had an encounter with one of the camp's mysterious assailants, who knocked him down and fled, carrying off one of the refugees. Jalar followed his tracks long enough to determine that he fled east towards the mountains, but was unwilling to go too far in pursuit without support. Now he has joined with me, and proposed that together we head east in an attempt to track down the source of this menace.

蜘蛛般的奇提恩体现了借助邪恶魔法对人形生物所能造成的非自然改变。他们的祖先曾是人形形态，但他们对卓尔的强制奴役不仅仅意味着简单履行职责。切德·纳萨德的卓尔对其奴隶进行选择性繁殖和魔法干预，融入了可怕的“改进”以及失败实验的结果。最终这些改变成为永久性的，产生了一支蜘蛛般，四臂的人形种族，能像人类使用石头或木材一样用蛛网建造。奇提恩原先只存在于费伦西北地区，在逃离卓尔压迫者的过程中已遍布幽暗地域。

src:
The spiderlike chitines exemplify the unnatural changes that can be incorporated into a humanoid with the aid of evil-inspired magic. Once their ancestors were humanoid in form, but their enforced slavery to the drow entailed more than simple execution of duty. The drow of Ched Nasad selectively bred and magically meddled with their slaves, incorporating ghastly "improvements" as well as the results of fumbled experiments. Eventually these alterations became permanent, resulting in a race of spiderlike, four-armed humanoids that can build with webbing in the same way that humans employ stone or wood. Formerly found only in the northwest regions of Faer�n, chitines have spread throughout the Underdark in the course of their flight from their drow oppressors. 

Chitine Ability Adjustments: +2 Dexterity, +2 Constitution, +2 Intelligence, -4 Charisma. Chitines are quick, tough, and smart, but not particularly endearing. 
Favored Class (Rogue): A multiclass chitine's rogue class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

- Small size
- A chitine's base land speed is 30 feet
- +8 racial bonus on Climb checks
- Grappling Bonus (Ex): A chitine's four arms grant a +4 bonus on grapple checks
- Difficult to Disarm (Ex): Because of the hooks in a chitine's palm, he gains a +4 bonus on his opposed check to avoid being disarmed
- Sensitive to Sunlight (Ex): In sunlight or bright magical light (such as a daylight spell), chitines are dazzled. 
- Racial Hit Dice: A chitine character begins with two levels of monstrous humanoid
- Racial Feats: A chitine character has Two-Weapon Fighting and Ambidexterity as bonus feats
- Weapon Familiarity: A chitine treats short swords as simple weapons rather than martial weapons
- Favored Class: Rogue
- Level Adjustment: +2

"There, I've altered the wards binding the door to permit your entrance. So if you change your mind you can enter whenever you like. You will find most of the golems in the basement, though a few may have found their way upstairs to lurk near the entrance. The higher levels of the tower will be sealed off, so you needn't worry about anything above you. I hope you will be able to get to it at some point. Perhaps I should go find some other mercenaries..."

这件斗篷增强了佩戴者的感知和洞察力，同时还提供了一定的保护。在一些容易获得魔法物品的富裕魔法国家中，父亲们习惯在儿子成年并准备闯荡世界时赠送这样的斗篷作为礼物，以保护他们免受旅途危险，以及在没有长辈明智建议的情况下可能陷入的麻烦。然而，这些斗篷已经传遍了整个国度，因为许多这样的儿子习惯于一有机会就把它们卖掉换取现金，这表明他们中的许多人本可以受益于更强大的附魔。
src: This cloak increases the perception and insight of the wearer, in addition to providing a certain amount of protection. In some wealthy magocracies with easy access to magical items, it is customary for fathers to give such cloaks as gifts to their sons when they come of age and become ready to make their way in the world, to protect them both from the hazards of the road and the trouble they are likely to get into in the absence of wise counsel from their elders. The cloaks have spread throughout the realms, however, on account of the habit of many of these sons of selling them for quick cash at the first opportunity, which suggests that many of them could have used a more powerful enchantment.

"My blade and my magic are one and the same."

The Duskblade blurs the line between spellcaster and warrior, marrying the power of magic with hand-to-hand combat prowess.
A student of arcane spellcasting techniques, the Duskblade combines arcane spellcasting with the combat skills of a fighter. While the ability to cast arcane spells in armor originated with the elves, over the millenia the secrets of the Duskblade have been disseminated to the other races, and today members of any race can become a Duskblade.

- Alignment Restrictions: none

A Duskblade's caster level is equal to his class level. He casts spells as a Sorcerer does. He initially does not suffer arcane spell failure chance when casting in light armor, later on he learns to cast without arcane spell failure in medium armor and with shields, however failure chance from heavy armor applies normally.

战俑最初被建造为无意识的战争机器，一支无需食物和水就能战斗的构装体军队。然而，作为创造它们所用过程的副作用，它们获得了自我意识。起初这是一种恩惠，因为现在不再需要活着的将军随行，但最终战争结束了，正如所有战争一样。由于无法摧毁这个如今已有意识的活体构装体种族，它们反而被释放，任由自己在世界上寻找出路。在外观上它们类似魔像，金属和矿物制成的装甲板覆盖着活体木质框架。它们被创造时没有性别，尽管少数具有更典型女性思维方式的个体修改了自己的设计和装甲板，以拟形怪类人女性的体形。战俑无法繁殖，只能在使用被发掘的古代图纸建造的特殊创造熔炉中制造。它们也不会衰老，它们的心态有时使类人种族的活动对它们来说是个谜。

战俑属性调整：+2 体质，-2 感知，-2 魅力。
偏好职业（战士）：兼职战俑的战士职业在决定他是否因兼职而受到经验值惩罚时不计入。

- 30 英尺基础速度
- 复合装甲板：护甲等级 +2，不能穿戴护甲，5% 奥术法咒失败几率。
- 活体构装体亚种：
  免疫睡眠，麻痹，毒素，能量吸取和疾病
- 轻度护命（Ex）：当战俑受到重击或偷袭时，有 25% 几率该重击或偷袭被抵消，伤害改为正常掷骰。
  不能自然治疗，治疗法咒只能治疗正常量的一半。
- 构装体：就法咒而言，战俑被视为构装体。
src:
Warforged were originally built as mindless war machines, an army of constructs able to fight without food and water.  As a side-effect of the processes used to create them, however, they gained sentience.  At first this was a boon, as now there was no need for a living general to travel with them, but eventually the war came to an end, as all wars do.  As they couldn't destroy the now-sentient race of living constructs, they were instead freed and left to find their own way in the world.  Physically they look similar to golems, with plating made of metal and mineral covering a living wooden frame.  They were created without gender, though a few with a more typically feminine mindset have modified their design and plating to mimic a humanoid female's shape.  Warforged cannot reproduce, but can only be made at special Creation Forges built using uncovered ancient plans.  They do not age either, and their mindset sometimes leaves the activities of the humanoid races a puzzle to them.

Warforged Ability Adjustments: +2 Con, -2 Wis, -2 Cha.
Favored Class (Fighter): A multiclass warforged's fighter class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

- 30' base speed
- Composite Plating: +2 to AC, cannot wear armor, and 5% arcane spell failure chance.
- Living Construct subtype:
  Immune to sleep, paralyze, poison, energy drain, and disease
- Light Fortification (Ex): When a critical hit or sneak attack is scored on a warforged, there is a 25% chance that the critical hit or sneak attack is negated and damage is instead rolled normally.  
  Does not heal naturally, healing spells only heal half the normal amount.
- Construct: Warforged count as Constructs for the purpose of spells.

The subject develops an internal spherical sac that contains fluid or semisolid necrotic flesh. The internal cyst is noticeable as a slight bulge on the subject's arm, abdomen, face (wherever you chose to touch the target) or it is buried deeply enough in the flesh of your target that it is not immediately obvious-the subject may not realize what was implanted within her.

From now on, undead foes and necromantic magic are particularly debilitating to the subject-the cyst enables a sympathetic response between free-roaming external undead and itself. Whenever the victim is subject to a spell or effect from the school of necromancy, she makes saving throws to resist at a -2 penalty. Whenever the subject is dealt damage by the natural weapon of an undead (claw, bite, or other attack form), she takes an additional 1d6 points of damage.

Protection from evil prevents the necrotic cyst from forming. Once a necrotic cyst is implanted, spells that manipulate the cyst and its bearer are no longer thwarted by protection from evil.

Focus: The caster must possess a Mother Cyst.

src: This book is a guide to the procedures that should be followed when exploring ancient ruins. While written with an audience of archaeologists in mind, much of the information within would be useful to a dungeon-crawling adventurer as well, as it includes tips on avoiding traps, finding loot, dealing with monsters, and the like. An adventurer who reads this book will find what he learns quite useful, the equivalent of the lessons that can be learned through dangerous experience in real dungeons. However, while an inexperienced adventuerer would surely learn much from this book, those who already possess extensive experience will find little in it which they do not already know.

dst: 在我先前于卡林沙漠的冒险中，我发现了关于一个叫拉贾尔的人的一些信息，他是卡林港这里一些强盗劫掠者维持的一个联系人。这个拉贾尔究竟是谁并不完全清楚，但显然他能为任何参与犯罪活动的人提供许多有用的服务。我找到了一张纸，上面写着他藏身处的方向，位于下水道中，并注意到我应该使用密码“Jaraj”来进入那里。只要我保留这张纸作为参考，我就应该能够通过下水道系统找到去那里的路。然而，我必须决定，是应该自己去找这个拉贾尔，还是把我发现的关于他的信息交给城市守卫，希望他们能利用这些信息来终结他的犯罪活动。\n\n我已经找到了通往拉贾尔藏身处的路。我想我会记住来这里的路，应该不再需要我为那个目的而找到的那张纸了。我已经进入了公会，现在可以在其黑市商店购物。如果我愿意，我也可以考虑加入它。有人告诉我，在这个阶段去找城市守卫是浪费时间，因为公会收买了一些守卫，既然他们现在知道我是谁，就会留意我泄露的任何关于公会的事情，并且有能力确保不会有什么结果。
src: During my previous adventures in the Calim Desert, I discovered some information about one Rajar, a contact maintained by some bandit raiders here in Calimport. It was not entirely clear just who this Rajar is, but apparently he can provide many useful services to anyone involved in criminal activities. I found a paper containing directions to his hideout, located in the sewers, and notice that I should use the password "Jaraj" to gain access to it. So long as I keep this paper in my possession for reference, I should be able to find my way there by traveling through the sewer system. I must decide, however, whether I should seek out this Rajar on my own, or instead give what information I have found about him to the City Watch, in the hope that they can use it to put an end to his criminal activities.\n\nI have found my way to Rajar's Hideout. I think I will remember my way here, and should have no more need for the paper I found for that purpose. I have gained entrance to the guild, and can now shop at its blackmarket store. I can also look into joining it if I so desire. I've been told that going to the City Watch at this stage would be a waste of time, as the guild has some Watchmen in its pay, who, now that they know who I am, will be on the lookout for anything I let slip about it, and are in a position to see that nothing much comes of it.

现已查明，卡洛玛斯·泽卡尔参与了变形蛛与噬火武僧及其各方盟友蹂躏卡林杉的计划。他还打算利用泽法德之剑或其最初的目的——释放卡利姆与门农，这很可能会给这片土地带来巨大的灾难。他的女儿卡齐娅对他的计划感到不安，将此事告知了我们，并提出如果我们能穿过下水道和黑暗卡林港抵达泽卡尔塔，就让我们进入。

卡齐娅让我们进入了泽卡尔塔，但事先要我们发誓不杀她父亲，只从他手中夺走那把剑。此后我们便一路向塔顶前进寻找他。途中，我们遇到了乌尔·萨哈卜的阿巴亚拉之一拉梅尔·加尼尔布，据说他们能预见未来，而他正被囚禁着。他告诉了我们许多关于泽卡尔和那把剑的有趣信息。显然，当那把剑被用来击败恶魔阿兹古尔卡时，它将他困在了某种口袋位面中。此后他一直待在那里，但仍保留了一些通过那把剑影响这个位面的能力（并且保留了更多能力去影响各种与火相关的位面的事件，因为他在那里早已有联系）。这意味着剑的持有者往往会受到恶魔的影响并最终被其控制。这就是泽卡尔的天命，也很大程度上解释了他那些疯狂毁灭性的行为。他还告诉我们，恶魔即将挣脱其位面牢笼并返回主物质位面，一旦发生，很可能会带来灾难。希望我们按计划从泽卡尔手中夺走那把剑，能阻止此事，也能阻止泽卡尔和恶魔利用那把剑挑起的其他麻烦。拉梅尔提到的最后一点，是关于阿巴亚拉们对扎拉拉的各种预言（泽卡尔绑架她是为了了解更多关于这些预言的信息），根据预言，她注定会干扰泽卡尔和阿兹古尔卡两人的阴谋，这也导致两人都想要她死。

当我们在他的塔顶与泽卡尔对峙时，结果发现恶魔阿兹古尔卡已部分返回这个位面，并能将其力量施加于此。尽管如此，我们还是成功夺走了泽法德之剑，尽管在此过程中它断成了两截，现在由扎拉拉持有。任务完成后，我们便传送回了加尔哈德尔庄园。
src:
It has now been revealed that Kalomas Zekar was involved in the plans of the aranea and the Consuming Fire monks and their various allies to ravage Calimshan.  He also plans to use the Sword of Zefad or its original purpose of freeing Calim and Memnon, likely unleashing considerable devastation upon the land. His daughter Kadzia, disturbed by his plans, inofrmed us of this and has offered to give us access to the Zekar tower, if we can reach it by traversing a route leading through the sewers and Dark Calimport.

Kadzia has let us into the Zekar tower, first extracting from us an oath not to kill her father, but only take the sword from him. Since then we have been proceeding to the very top of the tower to find him. Along the way, we came across one Ramel Ganirb, one of the Abbayalar of Ul'Sahab, who are reputed to be able to see the future, being held prisoner. He told us much interesting information about Zekar and the sword. Apparently when the sword was used to defeat the demon Azghulkar, it trapped him in some sort of pocket plane. There he has been ever since, but has retained some ability to influence this plane through the sword (and retained even more ability to influence events of various fire-related planes where he already had connections). This means that wielders of the sword tend to come under the demon's influence and eventually control. This has been the fate of Zekar, and explains much about his otherwise madly destructive actions. He has also told us that the demon is on the verge of breaking free of his planar prison and returning to the Prime, an event likely to be disastrous if it occurs. Hopefully taking the sword from Zekar, as we already plan, will prevent this as well as the other trouble Zekar and the demon are using the sword to stir up. A final point Ramel made concerned various prophecies of the Abbalayar concerning Zarala (Zekar kidnapped him to find out more about these), according to which she is fated to interfere with the schemes of both Zekar and Azghulkar, and which has caused both to desire her death.

When we confronted Zekar at the top of his tower, it turned out that the demon Azghulkar was partially returned to this plane and able to exert his power into it. Nevertheless, we succeeded in taking the Sword of Zefad, although it was broken into two pieces, now held by Zarala, in the process. Our mission accomplished, we then teleported back to the Galhadr Estate.

学术传说中关于魔蝠人的起源有两种不同的说法。一种说法是，魔蝠人是很久以前魔蝠与某种不确定的类人种族结合所生的位面后裔。另一种则是关于一个狂妄自大的法师试图将自己的本质烙印在另一个种族上的更黑暗的故事。

事实是，魔蝠人偶尔会由魔蝠父母所生。魔蝠人比他们的魔蝠祖先更弱小，因此被魔蝠社群视为不受欢迎的劣种而驱逐。他们被遗弃在恶劣的位面中自生自灭。厌恶自己类人孩子的魔蝠父母会将婴儿留在充满敌意的位面上。善良的父母则会将孩子放在一个适宜居住的位面上，以便容易被其他生物发现。有时其他生物会收养这个被遗弃的婴儿，并将其抚养至成年。

作为由与自己截然不同的父母抚养长大的弃儿，魔蝠人常常感到格格不入。他们通常是孤独者，渴望一种难以捉摸的归属感。尽管如此，他们富有魅力且讨人喜欢，通常受到周围人的喜爱。

魔蝠人总体上看起来像是他们魔蝠父母的较不丑陋版本，但翅膀发育不全。典型的魔蝠人身高不到3英尺，体重约30磅，女性比男性略高略重。水魔蝠人形似一个长有鱼鳞的小型人类，眼睛呈黑色且凸出。

火魔蝠人属性调整：+2 体质，-2 智力，+2 魅力。水魔蝠人健壮而耐久。

天赋职业（武僧）：在判断兼职经验值惩罚时，兼职水魔蝠人的武僧职业不计入其中。

种族特性：
- 水魔蝠人的基础陆地速度为30英尺。
- 类人生物：魔蝠人原生于元素位面。他们属于类人生物类型，当不在各自祖先的位面时获得跨位面亚种。与他们的魔蝠祖先不同，魔蝠人没有元素亚种。
- 小型：作为小型生物，魔蝠人获得+1护甲等级加值，+1攻击检定加值，以及+4躲藏检定加值。
- 喷吐武器：每个魔蝠人都拥有一种喷吐武器，其效果因魔蝠人的血统而异。
- 元素施法：魔蝠人施展带有与其种类相符（风，土，火或水）的元素描述符的法咒时，施法者等级+1。
- 简易武器：魔蝠人擅长所有简易武器。

等级调整：+1
src:
Scholarly lore contains two different origin stories for the mephlings. In one, mephlings are planetouched offshoots of long-ago unions between mephits and an indeterminate race of humanoids. The other is a darker tale of a megalomaniacal mage seeking to imprint his essence on another race.

What is true is that a mephling will occasionally be born to mephit parents. Weaker than their mephit ancestors, mephlings are put out of mephit communities as undesirable runts. They're left to the mercies of the inhospitable planes. Mephit parents revolted by their humanoid child will leave the babe on a hostile plane. Kindly parents will place the child on a habitable plane where it will easily be found by other creatures. Sometimes other creatures adopt the abandoned baby and it grows to reach adulthood.

As foundlings raised by parents very different from themselves, mephlings frequently feel out of place. They usually are loners who desire an elusive sense of belonging. Nevertheless, they're attractive and personable, generally liked by people around them.

Mephlings in general look like less homely versions of their mephit parents with stunted wings. A typical mephling stands less than 3 feet tall and weighs around 30 pounds, with females slightly taller and heavier than males.  A water mephling resembles a small, fish-scaled human with black, bulbous eyes.

Fire Mephling Ability Adjustments: +2 Con, -2 Int, +2 Cha.  Water mephlings are sturdy and durable.

(PRESTIGE CLASS)
The Society of the Sanctified Mind is a collection of elite clerics, fighters, monks, paladins, psions, psychic warriors, soulknives, and others who view the threat posed by the presence and goals of evil psionic using creatures to be the most dire menace facing civilized races today.

(PRESTIGE CLASS)
The Disciple of Asmodeus is a lordly, domineering sort who craves unlimited power. He is ruthless in his pursuits and uncaring of any who might get in his way. He uses his power and influence to gain secrets, which in turn gain him more power, manipulate and command others, and enhance his own physical aspect.

Level

Initiate, Black Magic 
Level/School: 4th/ Abjuration 
Range: Close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)

You reach out with shadowy energies, banishing your foe's spell or mystery into the Plane of Shadow while replacing it with its dark reflection.

You can cast this mystery as an immediate action to warp another caster's spell or mystery. In this case, warp spell must be used at the moment of the other caster's casting. To be successful, you must beat the other caster on an opposed caster level check (1d20 + caster level). If you do not, you have failed to take control of his spell or mystery, and it manifests normally. If you succeed on the opposed check, the other caster's mystery or spell is countered, and you gain one additional use of an apprentice-path mystery that you know. You can keep this additional use until a later turn (requiring a standard action to activate), but it must be used within 1 hour or it is lost.

src: In the sewers beneath the temple district, I have encountered a wererat named Querzat, who does not share the hostile tendencies of the other wererats about, and in fact seeks a cure for his lycanthropic condition. I have agreed to help him achieve this goal. He wants me to obtain a number of items he will need to effect a cure: some belladonna, a book detailing the proper preparation for the belladonna before he dare actually ingest it, and some alchemical equipment to actually carry out said preparations. This last can be obtained from a merchant named, according to Querzat, "Blimfin Nemquin or Temquin or something." I have been given a list of items to present to this Blimfin when I locate him. Querzat is not sure where the other two items might be found, but suggests I check out the various stores in the city.\n\nI have given Querzat the belladonna and the alchemical equipment. I still need to bring him the book.

src:
The aquatic elves, also known as sea elves, are civilized and good hearted people who inhabit the seas. Most aquatic elves hail from underwater cities but small settlements of this race can be found in the seas along the coast. Aquatic elves hair is usually stringy and thick, cut short for warriors but otherwise worn long. Sea elves have radiant skin of deep green or blue with irregular thin brown or white stripes and patches. Eye colors for aquatic elves come in blue, green, green and gold shades.

Aquatic Elven Ability Adjustments: +2 Dex, -2 Int.
Favored Class (Fighter): A multiclass aquatic elf's fighter class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

- Sleeplessness: Immune to spells and effects of the 'Sleep' subtype.
- Hardiness vs. Enchantments: +2 racial bonus on saving throws against mind-affecting spells.
- Water Breathing: Creature can breath water and is therefore immune to the effects of Drown and Mass Drown.
- Skill Affinity (Listen): +2 racial bonus to Listen checks.
- Skill Affinity (Search): +2 racial bonus to Search checks.
- Skill Affinity (Spot): +2 racial bonus to Spot checks.
- Keen Senses: Aquatic Elves make active Search checks automatically and with no movement penalties.
- Low-Light Vision: Allows them to see better than normal in the dark.
- Elven: Aquatic Elves are considered Elven for the purpose of spells.

src: "The Titans were supposed to disrupt Ilmaterian activities and reduce their effectiveness, not burn and pillage everything. Such a violent attack naturally provoked a violent response. First this Tiefling tries to sneak in and kill the Big Titan, as their boss is called, and now you show up. The agents in the Poverty Relief Office who were supervising and paying the Titans apparently decided they weren't getting their money's worth. So they cut the Titans off and refused to have anything further to do with them. The Big Titan responded to this with his usual calm and restraint: He's taken a good part of his gang through a tunnel in the sewers that connects to the Relief Office with the objective of killing everyone there."

你的霜冻头盔融合到你的头部并似乎向下蔓延，改变你上半张脸的外观，使其类似霜虫的头部。你的眼睛融入头盔的奇怪结节，你的脸颊扭曲成块状突起，你面部的皮肤变得厚实且呈蓝白色。

作为一个标准动作，你可以发出一种颤音，使20英尺内的对手震慑。你可以瞄准一个生物，外加每点投入霜冻头盔的魂质额外一个生物。目标必须成功通过意志豁免，否则被震慑1d4轮。
src:
Frost Helm

Descriptors: Cold, sonic
Classes: Totemist
Chakra: Crown (totem)
Saving Throw: See text

Incarnum forms into a bluewhite helm resembling the bizarre head of a frost worm. It floats above the top of your head, its strange lumpy shape rising to a tall nodule at the front and top.

While wearing a frost helm, you gain the Cold Endurance feat.

Essentia: If you invest essentia in your frost helm, it also protects you from cold damage. You gain resistance to cold equal to 5 times the number of points of essentia you invest in this soulmeld. 

Chakra Bind (Crown) 

Your frost helm fuses to the top of your head, actually opening a breathing channel in the strange nodule at the helm's crown.

As a standard action, you can project a ray of cold energy from your forehead, reminiscent of a frost worm's breath weapon. You must make a ranged touch attack to hit a creature with this ray. If you hit, the ray deals 1d6 points of cold damage plus an additional 1d6 points for every point of essentia you invest in your frost helm. 

Chakra Bind (Totem) 

Your frost helm fuses to your head and seems to spread downward, changing the appearance of your upper face to resemble the head of a frost worm. Your eyes meld into the helm's strange nodule, your cheeks twist into lumpy protrusions, and the skin of your face grows thick and blue-white.

As a standard action, you can produce a trilling sound that stuns opponents within 20 feet. You can target one creature plus one additional creature per point of essentia you invest in your frost helm. Targets must succeed on a Will save or be stunned for 1d4 rounds.

src: I have met with Zagash the Terrible, a lich who I discovered occupying a room at the Desert Dragon Inn, of all places. He had an interesting offer to make me. Apparently the aranea who are seemingly orchestrating a war against Calimshan somehow discovered his phylactery. They have used their control of it to weaken Zagash and reduce his power, and intend to use the threat of destroying it (and therefore him) for good to blackmail him into serving their cause. Zagash however has no intention of letting them order him around and has conceived a plan to travel in disguise with a group of adventurers to fight against them. As a result, he is prepared to join with me on my quests outside the city to fight the various humanoid allies of the aranea.\n\nI am not certain if I want to work with such a creature. I have turned down his offer for now, but may reconsider.

This invocation (Lesser; 4th; Eldritch Essence), learned at 3rd level, allows you to place an arcane spell that affects an area upon your eldritch blast. If the eldritch blast hits its target, the spell's area is centered on any corner of the target's space, even if the spell could normally be centered only on the caster. If the eldritch blast misses its target, the spell is lost with no effect.

It takes a full-round action to cast the spell and fire the eldritch blast. Only an area spell with a casting time no greater than 1 standard action can be placed upon your eldritch blast.

Only the first target of your eldritch blast is affected by the spell (for example, an eldritch chain spellblast centers the spell on the initial target, not on any of the secondary targets). If your eldritch blast doesn't specify a target, you can't apply this invocation to the blast.

Treat spellblast as a spell whose level is equal to the area spell placed upon the eldritch blast (minimum 4th level).

This spell causes instant diminution of a humanoid creature, halving its height, length, and width and dividing its weight by 8. This decrease changes the creature's size category to the next smaller one. The target gains a +2 size bonus to Dexterity, a -2 size penalty to Strength (to a minimum of 1), and a +1 bonus on attack rolls and AC due to its reduced size.
A Small humanoid creature whose size decreases to Tiny has a space of 2-1/2 feet and a natural reach of 0 feet (meaning that it must enter an opponent's square to attack). A Large humanoid creature whose size decreases to Medium has a space of 5 feet and a natural reach of 5 feet. This spell doesn't change the target's speed.  Multiple magical effects that reduce size do not stack.

Reduce person counters and dispels enlarge person.
Reduce person can be made permanent with a permanency spell.

Material Component: A pinch of powdered iron.

Satyrs are a hedonistic race of creatures that frolic in the wilds.  They love fine food, strong drink, and passionate romance.  They are more likely to be found carrying a bottle of wine or a musical instrument than a weapon, but they are more than a little mischievous and sometimes seek fun at the expense of others.  Physically about the size of a half-elf, satyrs resemble horned men with the legs and hooves of a goat.  Their hooves and horns are jet black in color, while their hair and fur is usually red or chestnut brown.

Spirit folk are the descendants of humans and various spirits of nature.  They come in three specific subtypes, each of which has a slight affinity to a different element, granting a bonus to saves vs that element and another additional ability.  They tend to be serene and calm, in tune with their surroundings, and show little desire of manipulating them with magic.  Physically they look human, with small mouths and slender eyes.  They tend to have a fair or golden complexion, and no body hair, though the hair on their head is fairly luxurious.

Spirit Folk Ability Adjustments: None.
Favored Class (Any): A multiclass spirit folk's highest class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:
- Low-Light Vision: Allows them to see better than normal in the dark.
- Human: Spirit Folk are considered Human for the purpose of spells.

Choose one type of Spirit Folk:
- Bamboo: +2 bonus to Lore, +2 saves against acid spells, Trackless Step. +4 to hide in wilderness settings.
- River: Immune to drowning, +2 to save vs cold spells.
- Sea: Immune to drowning, +2 to save vs fire spells.
- Mountain: +8 bonus to Climb, +2 bonus to Balance, Jump, and Tumble.

src:
Zagan, Duke of Disappointment
  
On the cusp of deification, Zagan lost all he had worked for. As a vestige, he offers his summoners a snake's sense of smell, the power to cause an enemy flee his presence, the ability to immobilize an opponent, and more effective combat abilities against snakes and their ilk.

Vestige Level: 6th
Binding DC: 25
Special Requirement: No

Influence: While influenced by Zagan, you become domineering and aggressive. Zagan requires that you slay any snake or snakelike being you meet, and deface any representations of snakes or snakelike beings other than Zagan that you find.

Granted Abilities: 
Zagan grants you a snake's ability to detect creatures by scent, the ability to grapple and constrict as a snake, increased combat ability against snakes and their cousins, and the power to cause your foes to avoid your mere presence.

Aversion: As a standard action, you can create a compulsion effect targeting any creature within 30 feet. The target must succeed on a Will save or gain an aversion to you. An affected creature must stay at least 20 feet away from you; if already within 20 feet, the target moves away. Aversion is a mind-affecting compulsion ability. After using this ability, you must wait 5 rounds before using it again.

Improved Grapple: You gain the benefit of the Improved Grapple feat. In addition, you are considered to be of Large size for the purpose of making grapple checks.

Scent: You gain the scent special quality.

Constrict: You gain a giant constrictor's ability to crush the life from its prey. You deal damage equal to 1d8 + 1-1/2 * your Str modifier with a successful grapple check, in addition to your normal unarmed damage.

Reptile Bane: Zagan's grants you +2 melee attack and +2d6 damage on melee attacks against reptilian creatures.

src:
Type of Feat: Binding
Prerequisite: None
Benefit: To contact a vestige, you must draw its unique seal visibly on a surface (generally the ground), making the image at least 5 feet across. Drawing a seal requires the ability to mark a surface and 1 minute of concentration, and the act provokes attacks of opportunity. A vestige might also have other requirements for contact, as noted in its entry.

Once the seal is drawn, you must perform a ritual requiring a full-round action to summon the corresponding vestige. The ritual fails if you cannot be heard (for example, if you are within the area of a silence spell).

To make a pact with your summoned vestige, you must make a binding check (1d20 + your effective binder level + your Cha modifier). This process requires 1 minute, but you can choose to make a rushed binding check as a full-round action at a -10 penalty. The DC for this check is provided in the description of each vestige.

Whether the binding check succeeds or fails, you gain the powers granted by the vestige for 24 hours. During that time, you cannot rid yourself of the vestige unless you possess the Expel Vestige feat. Success or failure does, however, determine other aspects of the pact. If you fail the binding check, you have made a poor pact, and take a -1 penalty on attack rolls, saving throws, and checks until that vestige leaves you. If you fail multiple binding checks, the penalties stack.

The Difficulty Class for a saving throw against any power granted by a vestige is 10 + 1/2 your effective binder level + your Cha modifier.
Special: Binding a vestige via this feat only grants one vestige ability

等级：心灵术士 3
显能时间：1 个标准动作

目标：一个呼吸的类人生物

你迫使目标在一次速度爆发性的呼气中排空其全部空气，从而扰乱目标的自主呼吸循环。在异能持续时间内，目标的肺不会自动恢复功能。

如果目标在呼吸危机显能时通过意志豁免，则不受此异能影响。如果意志豁免失败，它仍可以通过留在原地喘气来继续呼吸。

受影响的生物可以尝试正常行动（而不是有意识地控制呼吸），但从意志豁免失败的那一轮开始，它每这样做一轮，目标就有因缺氧而昏厥的风险。在它没有有意识地呼吸的任何回合结束时，它必须通过强韧豁免。在第一次没有呼吸之后的每一连续轮中，此豁免的 DC 增加 1；如果目标花费一个动作来呼吸，DC 降回其原始值。

如果目标强韧豁免失败，它降至 1 点生命值。在下一轮，它降至 -1 点生命值并濒死。

增幅：你可以通过以下一种或多种方式增幅此异能。
1. 如果你额外花费 2 点异能点，此异能也可以影响动物，精类，巨人，魔法兽或人形怪物。
2. 如果你额外花费 4 点异能点，此异能除上述生物类型外，还可以影响异怪，龙类，元素或异界生物。
3. 如果你额外花费 6 点异能点，此异能可以影响至多四个生物，全部位于 20 尺半径速度爆发范围内。
此外，你每额外花费 2 点异能点来实现上述任何效果，此异能的豁免 DC 增加 1。
src:
Telepathy (Compulsion) [Mind-Affecting]
Level: Telepath 3
Manifesting Time: 1 standard action
Range: Medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./ level)
Target: One breathing humanoid
Duration: 1 round/level
Saving Throw: Will negates, Fortitude partial; see text
Power Resistance: Yes
Power Points: 5
Metapsionics: Extend, Twin, Widen

You compel the subject to purge its entire store of air in one explosive exhalation, and thereby disrupt the subject's autonomic breathing cycle. The subject's lungs do not automatically function again while the power's duration lasts.

If the target succeeds on a Will save when crisis of breath is manifested, it is unaffected by this power. If it fails its Will save, it can still continue to breathe by remaining in place and gasping for breath.

An affected creature can attempt to take actions normally (instead of consciously controlling its breathing), but each round it does so, beginning in the round when it failed its Will save, the subject risks blacking out from lack of oxygen. It must succeed on a Fortitude save at the end of any of its turns in which it did not consciously take a breath. The DC of this save increases by 1 in every consecutive round after the first one that goes by without a breath; the DC drops back to its original value if the subject spends an action to take a breath.

If a subject fails a Fortitude save, it falls to 1 HP. In the following round, it drops to -1 hit points and is dying.

Augment: You can augment this power in one or more of the following ways.
1. If you spend 2 additional power points, this power can also affect an animal, fey, giant, magical beast, or monstrous humanoid.
2. If you spend 4 additional power points, this power can also affect an aberration, dragon, elemental, or outsider in addition to the creature types mentioned above.
3. If you spend 6 additional power points, this power can affect up to four creatures all within a 20-ft.-radius burst.
In addition, for every 2 additional power points you spend to achieve any of these effects, this power's save DC increases by 1.
