“巫妖”是一个后天模板，可以添加到任何类人生物（以下称为基础生物）上，前提是它能够制造所需的命匣。

除非另有说明，巫妖拥有基础生物的所有数据和特殊能力。

体型和类型
该生物的类型变为不死生物。不要重新计算基础攻击加值，豁免或技能点。体型不变。

生命骰
将所有当前和未来的生命骰提升为d12。

防御等级
巫妖拥有+5天生防御加值或基础生物的天生防御加值，取较高者。

攻击
巫妖拥有一次接触攻击，每轮可以使用一次。如果基础生物能够使用武器，巫妖保留此能力。拥有天生武器的生物保留那些天生武器。不使用武器战斗的巫妖使用其接触攻击或其主天生武器（如果有的话）.装备武器的巫妖可以根据意愿使用其接触攻击或武器。

伤害
没有天生武器的巫妖拥有一次接触攻击，使用负能量对活物造成1d8+5点伤害；一次意志豁免（DC 10 + 1/2 巫妖的生命骰 + 巫妖的魅力调整值）可以减半伤害。拥有天生武器的巫妖可以根据偏好使用其接触攻击或天生武器。如果它选择后者，它可以在一次天生武器攻击中造成1d8+5点额外伤害。

特殊攻击
巫妖保留基础生物的所有特殊攻击，并获得以下描述的能力。除非另有说明，豁免DC等于10 + 1/2 巫妖的生命骰 + 巫妖的魅力调整值。

恐惧灵光（超自然）
巫妖被死亡和邪恶的可怕灵光所笼罩。60英尺半径内生命骰少于5的生物如果看到巫妖，必须成功通过意志豁免，否则将如同受到巫妖等级术士施展的恐惧术影响。成功通过豁免的生物在24小时内不会再次受到同一巫妖灵光的影响。

麻痹之触（超自然）
任何被巫妖的接触攻击击中的活物必须成功通过强韧豁免，否则将永久麻痹。移除麻痹或任何可以移除诅咒的法咒可以解救受害者（见降咒法咒描述）.

该效果无法被驱散。被巫妖麻痹的人看起来像死了，但DC 20的侦察检定或DC 15的医疗检定可以揭示受害者仍然活着。

法咒
巫妖可以施展其生前能施展的任何法咒。

特殊品质
巫妖保留基础生物的所有特殊品质，并获得以下描述的能力。

驱散抗力（特异）
巫妖拥有+4驱散抗力。

伤害减免（超自然）
巫妖的不死躯体坚韧，赋予该生物伤害减免15/钝击和魔法。其天生武器在克服伤害减免时视为魔化武器。

免疫（特异）
巫妖免疫寒冷，电击，变形（尽管它们可以对自己使用变形效果）和影响心智攻击。

属性
从基础生物提升如下：智力+2，感知+2，魅力+2.作为不死生物，巫妖没有体质值。

技能
巫妖在躲藏，聆听，潜行，搜索，察言观色和侦察检定上拥有+8种族加值。其他方面与基础生物相同。

挑战等级
与基础生物相同+2。

阵营
任意邪恶。

等级调整
与基础生物相同+4。

巫妖角色
成为巫妖的过程邪恶得难以言表，只能由自愿的角色进行。巫妖保留其生前拥有的所有职业能力。

巫妖的命匣
成为巫妖的一个关键部分是制造一个魔法命匣，角色在其中储存其生命力量。通常，确保摆脱巫妖的唯一方法是摧毁其命匣。除非找到并摧毁其命匣，否则巫妖会在其表面死亡后1d10天重新出现。
每个巫妖必须制造自己的命匣，这需要制造奇物专长。角色必须能够施展法咒并且施法者等级达到11级或更高。制造命匣需要花费120,000金币和4,800经验值，其施法者等级等于创造者在创造时的等级。
最常见的命匣形式是一个密封的金属盒子，里面装有羊皮纸条，上面抄录着魔法短语。盒子为微型，拥有40点生命值，硬度20，破坏DC 40.其他形式的命匣也可能存在，例如戒指，护符或类似物品。
src:
"Lich" is an acquired template that can be added to any humanoid creature (referred to hereafter as the base creature), provided it can create the required phylactery.

A lich has all the base creature's statistics and special abilities except as noted here.

Size and Type
The creature's type changes to undead. Do not recalculate base attack bonus, saves, or skill points. Size is unchanged.

Hit Dice
Increase all current and future Hit Dice to d12s.

Armor Class
A lich has a +5 natural armor bonus or the base creature's natural armor bonus, whichever is better.

Attack
A lich has a touch attack that it can use once per round. If the base creature can use weapons, the lich retains this ability. A creature with natural weapons retains those natural weapons. A lich fighting without weapons uses either its touch attack or its primary natural weapon (if it has any). A lich armed with a weapon uses its touch or a weapon, as it desires.

Damage
A lich without natural weapons has a touch attack that uses negative energy to deal 1d8+5 points of damage to living creatures; a Will save (DC 10 + 1/2  lich's HD + lich's Cha modifier) halves the damage. A lich with natural weapons can use its touch attack or its natural weaponry, as it prefers. If it chooses the latter, it deals 1d8+5 points of extra damage on one natural weapon attack.

Special Attacks
A lich retains all the base creature's special attacks and gains those described below. Save DCs are equal to 10 + 1/2  lich's HD + lich's Cha modifier unless otherwise noted.

Fear Aura (Su)
Liches are shrouded in a dreadful aura of death and evil. Creatures of less than 5 HD in a 60-foot radius that look at the lich must succeed on a Will save or be affected as though by a fear spell from a sorcerer of the lich's level. A creature that successfully saves cannot be affected again by the same lich's aura for 24 hours.

Paralyzing Touch (Su)
Any living creature a lich hits with its touch attack must succeed on a Fortitude save or be permanently paralyzed. Remove paralysis or any spell that can remove a curse can free the victim (see the bestow curse spell description).

The effect cannot be dispelled. Anyone paralyzed by a lich seems dead, though a DC 20 Spot check or a DC 15 Heal check reveals that the victim is still alive..

Spells
A lich can cast any spells it could cast while alive.

Special Qualities
A lich retains all the base creature's special qualities and gains those described below.

Turn Resistance (Ex)
A lich has +4 turn resistance.

Damage Reduction (Su)
A lich's undead body is tough, giving the creature damage reduction 15/bludgeoning and magic. Its natural weapons are treated as magic weapons for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction.

Immunities (Ex)
Liches have immunity to cold, electricity, polymorph (though they can use polymorph effects on themselves), and mind-affecting attacks.

Abilities
Increase from the base creature as follows: Int +2, Wis +2, Cha +2. Being undead, a lich has no Constitution score.

Skills
Liches have a +8 racial bonus on Hide, Listen, Move Silently, Search, Sense Motive, and Spot checks. Otherwise same as the base creature.

Challenge Rating
Same as the base creature + 2.

Alignment
Any evil.

Level Adjustment
Same as the base creature +4.

Lich Characters
The process of becoming a lich is unspeakably evil and can be undertaken only by a willing character. A lich retains all class abilities it had in life.

The Lich's Phylactery
An integral part of becoming a lich is creating a magic phylactery in which the character stores its life force. As a rule, the only way to get rid of a lich for sure is to destroy its phylactery. Unless its phylactery is located and destroyed, a lich reappears 1d10 days after its apparent death.
Each lich must make its own phylactery, which requires the Craft Wondrous Item feat. The character must be able to cast spells and have a caster level of 11th or higher. The phylactery costs 120,000 gp and 4,800 XP to create and has a caster level equal to that of its creator at the time of creation.
The most common form of phylactery is a sealed metal box containing strips of parchment on which magicalphrases have been transcribed. The box is Tiny and has 40 hit points, hardness 20, and a break DC of 40.  Other forms of phylacteries can exist, such as rings, amulets, or similar items.

描述符：邪恶

你将魂能塑造成一条金棕色毛皮腰带，围在你的腰间。如果你用裸露的皮肤触碰它，有时会捕捉到残忍和愤怒的精神回响。当你进入战斗时，你脑海中的某一部分对击败对手的兴趣不如对造成痛苦的兴趣大。

当你佩戴拉米亚腰带时，你在唬骗和躲藏检定上获得 +4 能力加值。

魂能点：你投入到拉米亚腰带中的每一点魂能点使你在躲藏和唬骗检定上的能力加值增加 2. 
 
脉轮绑定（腰部） 

不再是物理的毛皮腰带，你的拉米亚腰带表现为从你的皮肤上长出的毛皮，从腰部一直延伸到膝盖。你的双腿也变得略微更加肌肉发达。

你获得 +10 英尺的陆地速度增强加值，并且你获得跳跃攻击专长的好处。

脉轮绑定（图腾） 

你拉米亚腰带以下的身体下半部分呈现出狮子的形态，四条腿末端长着锋利的爪子，一条长而带毛簇的尾巴，以及粗糙的金棕色毛皮。你的上半身没有变化，尽管也许你心中的邪恶火花变得更加强烈。

你可以在使用武器或其他天生攻击（如啮咬） 攻击后，进行两次爪击作为天生次要攻击。这些攻击从你的完整基础攻击加值中受到 -5 减值，并造成 1d4 点伤害。
src:
Lamia Belt

Descriptors: Evil  
Classes: Totemist  
Chakra: Waist (totem) 
Saving Throw: None

You form incarnum into a belt of golden-brown fur at your waist. If you touch it with your bare skin, you sometimes catch mental echoes of cruelty and anger. When you enter combat, some part of your mind is less interested in defeating your opponents than in causing them pain.

While you wear your lamia belt, you gain a +4 competence bonus on Bluff and Hide checks. 

Essentia: For every point of essentia you invest in your lamia belt, your competence bonus on Hide and Bluff checks increases by 2. 
 
Chakra Bind (Waist) 

Instead of a physical belt of fur, your lamia belt manifests as fur sprouting from your skin, from your waist down to your knees. Your legs also become slightly more muscular.

You gain an enhancement bonus of +10 feet to your land speed, and you gain the benefit of the Spring Attack feat. 

Chakra Bind (Totem) 

The lower part of your body below your lamia belt takes on the shape of a lion, with four legs ending in sharp claws, a long, tufted tail, and coarse golden-brown fur. The upper portion of your body is unchanged, though perhaps a spark of evil grows stronger in your heart.

You can make two claw attacks as natural secondary attacks after attacking with a weapon or another natural attack (such as a bite). These attacks take a -5 penalty from your full base attack bonus and deal 1d4 points of damage.

要使用此招式，你必须与预定目标相邻。作为此招式的一部分，进行一次跳跃检定，DC 等于对手的 AC.如果检定成功，你可以作为此招式的一部分，对敌人进行一次近战攻击。目标在对抗此攻击时视为措手不及。如果你的攻击造成伤害，你的目标必须尝试一次强韧豁免（DC19 + 你的力量调整值）.如果此豁免失败，你的目标立即死亡（其生命值降至 -10）.如果豁免成功，除了你的正常武器伤害外，你还对目标造成额外 20d6 点伤害。免疫重击的生物免疫此打击的死亡效果。
如果你的跳跃检定失败，你可以正常进行一次攻击。此招式仍视为已消耗。
src:
Tiger Claw (Strike)
Level: Swordsage 9, warblade 9
Prerequisite: Four Tiger Claw maneuvers
Initiation Action: 1 full round action
Range: Melee attack
Target: One creature
Saving Throw: Fortitude partial

With a primal howl, you leap into the air and land on your opponent, hacking and clawing at his neck.

To use this maneuver, you must be adjacent to your intended target. As part of this maneuver make a Jump check with a DC equal to your opponent's AC. If the check succeeds, you can then make a single melee attack against your foe, also as part of this maneuver. The target is  considered flat-footed against this attack. If your attack deals damage, your target must attempt a Fortitude save (DC19 + your Str modifier). If this save fails, your target is instantly slain (his hit points drop to -10). If the save is successful, you deal an extra 20d6 points of damage to the target in addition to your normal weapon damage. Creatures immune to critical hits are immune to the death effect of this strike.
If your Jump check fails, you can make a singe attack normally. The maneuver is still considered expended.

战俑最初是作为无意识的战争机器建造的，是一支无需食物和水就能战斗的构装体军队。战俑中最小的半身人-sized斥候被建造来充当间谍，轻步兵和侦察部队。它们比更大的种类少见得多，因为在战争中它们比类人斥候优势不大。然而，作为创造它们的过程的副作用，它们获得了感知能力。起初这是一个福音，因为现在不需要活着的将军随行，但最终战争结束了，就像所有战争一样。由于无法摧毁这个现在有感知能力的活体构装体种族，它们反而被释放，让它们在世界中寻找自己的道路。在物理上，它们看起来类似魔像，金属和矿物制成的装甲板覆盖着活体木制框架。它们被创造时没有性别，尽管少数具有更典型女性思维模式的个体修改了它们的设计和装甲板，以拟形怪类人女性的形状。战俑不能繁殖，只能在特殊的创造熔炉中制造，这些熔炉使用未覆盖的古代蓝图建造。它们也不会衰老，它们的心态有时使类人种族的活动对它们来说是个谜。

战俑斥候属性调整：-2 力量，+2 敏捷，-2 感知，-2 魅力。
天赋职业（游荡者）：在判断兼职经验值惩罚时，战俑斥候的游荡者职业等级不计入。

特殊能力：

- 20英尺基础速度
- 小型体型：
 +1 体型加值到攻击检定。
 +1 体型加值到防御等级。
 +4 体型加值到躲藏检定。
- 复合装甲：+2 防御等级，不能穿甲，有5%奥术法咒失败几率。
- 活体构装体亚种：
  免疫睡眠，麻痹，毒素，能量吸取和疾病
- 轻度护命（Ex）：当战俑斥候被重击或偷袭时，有25%几率重击或偷袭被抵消，伤害改为正常掷骰。 
  不能自然治疗，治疗法咒只治疗正常量的一半。
- 构装体：在法咒方面，战俑斥候视为构装体。
src:
Warforged were originally built as mindless war machines, an army of constructs able to fight without food and water.  The smallest of the warforged, the halfling-sized scouts were built to serve as spies, light infantry, and reconnaissance troops. They are far less common than the larger varieties, since they offer little advantage over humanoid scouts in warfare. As a side-effect of the processes used to create them, however, they gained sentience.  At first this was a boon, as now there was no need for a living general to travel with them, but eventually the war came to an end, as all wars do.  As they couldn't destroy the now-sentient race of living constructs, they were instead freed and left to find their own way in the world.  Physically they look similar to golems, with plating made of metal and mineral covering a living wooden frame.  They were created without gender, though a few with a more typically feminine mindset have modified their design and plating to mimic a humanoid female's shape.  Warforged cannot reproduce, but can only be made at special Creation Forges built using uncovered ancient plans.  They do not age either, and their mindset sometimes leaves the activities of the humanoid races a puzzle to them.

Warforged Scout Ability Adjustments: -2 Str, +2 Dex, -2 Wis, -2 Cha.
Favored Class (Rogue): A multiclass warforged scout's rogue class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

- 20' base speed
- Small Stature:
 +1 size bonus to attack rolls.
 +1 size bonus to AC.
 +4 size bonus to Hide checks. 
- Composite Plating: +2 to AC, cannot wear armor, and have a 5% arcane spell failure chance.
- Living Construct subtype:
  Immune to sleep, paralyze, poison, energy drain, and disease
- Light Fortification (Ex): When a critical hit or sneak attack is scored on a warforged scout, there is a 25% chance that the critical hit or sneak attack is negated and damage is instead rolled normally.  
  Does not heal naturally, healing spells only heal half the normal amount.
- Construct: Warforged scouts count as Constructs for the purpose of spells.

dst: 学徒法师哈尔丁·卡达什因扎塔罗斯之书被盗而极为苦恼，这本珍贵的魔法知识汇编是他的导师托付给他保管的。幸运的是，他确定这本书并未离开旅店，想必是被昨晚书被盗时住在这里的某位客人拿走了。不幸的是，他并不确切知道哪一个是窃贼，而且他不信任当局来调查此事。他请求我找出窃贼并找回这本书。为此，我需要调查住在旅店二楼房间里的所有客人。也许我能找到揭示窃贼身份的线索。这本书或许可以通过威胁或欺骗窃贼、扒窃他，或者干脆杀了他来取回，不过若是最后一种情况，我应当确信自己找对了人。
src: The apprentice wizard Haldin Khadash has been greatly distressed by the theft of the tome of Zataroth, a valuable compilation of magical lore entrusted to his care by his master. Fotunately, he has determined that this book has not left the inn, and is presumably being held by one of the guests here last night when it was stolen. Unfortunately, he does not know exactly which one is the thief, and he does not trust the authorities to investigate the matter. He has asked me to locate the thief and recover the book. To do this, I need to investigate all the guests staying in the rooms on the Inn's second floor. Perhaps I can find some clue revealing the thief's identity. The book might be recoverable by either threatening or tricking the thief, pickpocketing him, or simply killing him, though in the latter case I should be certain I have found the right person.

I was an acquaintance of Aladar and I knew he was interested in finding anything he could about the Twisted Rune. I know next to nothing myself, but one time I was in this tavern, I heard one of the sailors there telling some story about how he had found one of their lairs. Most likely it was just a wild tale, but I mentioned it to Aladar just in case there was something to it. He went off to try and find this sailor and that's the last I saw of him."

哀伤咏叹者唱的不是庆祝和欢乐的旋律，而是悲伤和哀痛的旋律。他们试图将这种忧郁的 见解 传播到远方，相信只有那些屈服于悲伤的人才能真正理解世界。哀伤咏叹者在痴迷死亡的文化中占据高位。作为秘密公会的一员或死亡祭司阶层的一部分，他们被赋予为死者创作合适挽歌的重大责任。死者越重要，她的挽歌就被期望越悲伤和感人。几代人之后没有人会记得死去的女王，但一首伟大的挽歌可能会在千年之后被唱起。

- 生命骰：d6
- 武器和防具擅长：哀伤咏叹者不获得额外的武器和防具擅长。
- 技能点：4 + 智力调整值

要求：

阵营：非善良。
专长：安魂曲（表演8，吟游诗人音乐职业能力）
技能：知识4级，表演8。
特殊：必须拥有吟游诗人音乐职业能力。

职业特性：

等级
1：悲伤之歌 - 所有生物在意志豁免，攻击和伤害上受到-2惩罚。
2：鼓舞之歌 - 所有不死生物在驱散抗力上获得加值。
3：悲痛之歌 - 目标生物陷入困惑。
4：恐惧之歌 - 所有敌人在力量和敏捷上受到1d6点伤害。
5：觉醒之歌 - 哀伤咏叹者短暂地操纵一具尸体。

吟游诗人音乐

哀伤咏叹者与吟游诗人职业叠加，以确定每天使用次数和吟游诗人音乐职业能力的效果。
src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
Dirgesingers voice melodies not of celebration and joy, but of sorrow and grief. They seek to spread this melancholy outlook far and wide, believing that only those who give in to their sadness can truly understand the world. Dirgesingers hold high positions in death-obsessed cultures. Serving as members of a secret guild or as part of a hierarchy of death priests, they are entrusted with the serious responsibility of composing suitable laments for the dead. The more important the deceased, the more sorrowful and moving her lament is expected to be. No one will remember the dead queen in a few short generations, but a great lament might be sung a thousand years hence.

- Hit Die: d6
- Proficiencies: A Dirgesinger gains no additional proficiencies.
- Skill Points: 4 + Int Modifier

REQUIREMENTS:

Alignment: Non-Good.
Feats: Requiem (Perform 8, Bardic Music class feature)
Skills: Lore 4 ranks, Perform 8.
Special: Must possess the Bardic Music class feature.

CLASS FEATURES:

Level
1: Song of Sorrow - All creatures take a -2 penalty to Will saves, attack and damage.
2: Song of Bolstering - All undead gain a bonus to turn resistance.
3: Song of Grief - Target creature is confused.
4: Song of Horror - All enemies take 1d6 points of Strength and Dexterity damage.
5: Song of Awakening - The Dirgesinger animates a corpse for a short time.

BARDIC MUSIC

The Dirgesinger stacks with the Bard class to determine both the number of uses per day and the effect of the Bardic Music class ability.

描述符：无

魂能形成一条蓝色火焰的绳索，你将其系在腰间。它的火焰触感冰凉。松散的末端像有自己意志的火舌般在你腿边舞动。当你暴露于火焰中时，你腰带的火焰会明亮地闪耀，仿佛在吞噬周围的火焰。

src:

Descriptors: None
Classes: Incarnate, Soulborn
Chakra: Waist
Saving Throw: See text

Incarnum forms into a cord of blue fire, which you wear tied around your waist. Its flames are cool to the touch. The loose ends dance around your legs like tongues of flame with wills of their own. When you are exposed to fire, the flames of your belt flare brightly, as if feeding on the fire around you.

When you shape flame cincture, you gain resistance to fire 10.

Chakra Bind (Waist) 

Energy attacks are not simply absorbed and dispersed, but instead the energy is bound within the belt, eagerly awaiting release.

You can release a blast of fire from your flame cincture equal 1d6 plus 1d6 per point of essentia invested in the meld. A successful Reflex save reduces the damage by half.

You must cast this spell outdoors, in a place where clouds are visible. It calls forth a spirit of elemental air, binds it to a nearby cloud (either a normal cloud or storm cloud), and gives it a dragon-like form. Upon forming, the dragon-shaped
cloud swoops toward you, arriving in 1 minute regardless of the actual distance from you. (The time it takes to reach you counts toward the spell's duration.) Once it arrives, you can command the dragon cloud like a summoned creature. The dragon

At the end of the spell's duration, the dragon cloud evaporates into nothingness as the bound elemental spirit returns to its home plane. The dragon cloud cannot pass through liquids or solid objects.

"我也是这么想的。我得以追踪我敌人的足迹一小段路。他向东去了，朝着群山方向，但我不敢追得太远，因为那会让营地失去防御，而且我不确定单凭自己能否应付发现的东西。不过，既然现在有你们的支持，我希望继续前进，沿着那些足迹追到它们通向的任何地方。即使我们不知怎么失败了，卡洛玛斯也会在接下来几天保持这个界门开启，必要时给难民一条逃生之路，这能让我安心。但我毫不怀疑，我们联手应该能够永远终结这些事件所代表的任何威胁。"
src: "That is my own thinking as well. I was able to follow my foe's tracks for a bit. He went eastwards, toward the mountains, but I was nervous about going too far after him, for it would leave the camp without defense, and I was not sure if I alone could deal with whatever I found. Now that I have your support, however, I hope to continue on and follow those tracks wherever they lead. Even if we somehow fail, Kalomas will be keeping this portal open over the next few day, giving the refugees an avenue of escape if need be, which will set my mind at ease. But I do not doubt that together we should be able to end forever whatever menace these events represent."

在守卫总部，我遇到了一个叫塞卡娅·哈辛的人，她正徒劳地试图说服守卫队派人搜寻她失踪的丈夫阿拉达尔。阿拉达尔是一本关于名为扭曲符文的邪恶组织的书的作者，几天前他在研究一本后续著作时失踪了。我已同意去寻找他。如果我发现了什么，我可以去商业区东北部她家中向她报告。

经过大量调查，我发现了阿拉达尔·哈辛的下落。他被巫妖泰罗兹·甘抓走了，后者显然是扭曲符文的成员，反对他的调查。然而，同样属于该符文的另一条龙巫妖辩称，他的死亡或失踪只会引来不必要的关注，比仅仅允许他发表他的故事所引来的关注更多，因为如果没有像失踪这样的事件所引发的宣传，他的故事很可能会被忽视或不被相信。两个巫妖同意直接放了他。

我应该去和阿拉达尔谈谈。
src:
At Watch Headquarters, I ran into one Sekaya Hasin, who was futilely attempting to convince the Watch to initiate a search for her missing husband, Aladar. Aladar is the author of a book on the sinister organization known as the Twisted Rune, and disappeared a few days ago when he was engaged in researching a follow-up book. I have agreed to search for him. If I discover anything I can report it to Sekaya at her home in the northeast of the Merchant District.

After much investigation, I have discovered the fate of Aladar Hasin. He was captured by the lich Teroz Gan, apparently a member of the Twisted Rune, who objected to his investigation. However, a dracolich also belonging to the Rune argued that his death or disappearance would only bring unwanted attention, more than would be brought on if he were simply permitted to publish his stories, which are likely to be ignored or disbelieved absent the publicity that would be generated by something like a disappearance. The two liches agreed to simply free him.

I should go speak to Aladar.

Favored Class: Soulborn. A multiclass Azurin's Soulborn class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

- Essentia Pool: An azurin's essentia pool is permanently increased by 1. If he doesn't have an essentia pool, this trait grants him one with a single point of essentia.

- Human: Azurin count as Humans for spells and abilities.

Armor Skin, Automatic Quicken Spell, Automatic Silent Spell, Automatic Still Spell, Blinding Speed, Devastating Critical, Energy Resistance, Epic Prowess, Epic Spell Focus, Epic Spell Penetration, Focused Spell Penetration, Epic Spellcasting, Fast Healing, Great Charisma, Great Wisdom, Ignore Material Components, Improved Combat Casting, Overwhelming Critical, Perfect Health, Tenacious Magic.

Addiction: Sannish has an addiction rating of Medium (DC 10).  Failing to take a drug you are addicted to once per 24 hours and failing the resulting Fort save results in ability damage.

src:
Type of Feat: Racial
 Natural Spikes (Ex): A spiker's skin is replete with sharp, jagged spikes. A spiker can deal extra piercing damage on a successful grapple check, or deal piercing damage with a melee attack, as if she wore armor spikes. Because of their spiked skin, spikers have a difficult time wearing armor. The maximum Dexterity bonus of the armor is reduced by 1, and the armor check penalty is worsened by 2. For instance, a chain shirt worn by a spiker has a maximum Dexterity bonus of +3 (instead of +4) and an armor check penalty of -4 (rather than -2). These changes don't affect the armor's arcane spell failure chance, nor do they apply to shields used by the spiker.  
 Damage reduction 2/slashing or piercing: A spiker's spiny skin grants resistance to bludgeoning attacks, though piercing or slashing attacks slip through normally.

Evocation [Light]
Level:  Brd 3, Clr 3, Drd 3, Pal 3, Sor/Wiz 3
Components:     V, S
Casting Time:   1 standard action
Range:  Touch
Target:         Object touched
Duration:       10 min./level

The object touched sheds light as bright as full daylight in a 60-foot radius, and dim light for an additional 60 feet beyond that. Creatures that take penalties in bright light also take them while within the radius of this magical light. Despite its name, this spell is not the equivalent of daylight for the purposes of creatures that are damaged or destroyed by bright light.

Daylight brought into an area of magical darkness (or vice versa) is temporarily
negated, so that the otherwise prevailing light conditions exist in the overlapping
areas of effect.

Daylight counters or dispels any darkness spell of equal or lower level, such as darkness.

src:
Shadow Hand (Strike)
Level: Swordsage 6
Initiation Action: 1 standard action
Range: 6 ft.
Target: One flat-footed creature
Duration: 1 round
Saving Throw: Fortitude partial

As your foe struggles to ready his defenses, you make a subtle gesture in the air. A noose formed of shadow drops from above him, wraps around his throat, and hoists him aloft. His limbs flail as he struggles to free himself from the strangling noose.

As part of this maneuver, you form a noose of shadow that wraps around your target and strangles him. This maneuver only works against a flat-footed target. As part of this maneuver, you make a ranged touch attack against a flat-footed creature within range. If it hits, your opponent takes 8d6 points of damage. In addition, he must make a Fortitude save (DC 16 + your Wis modifier) or be stunned for 1 round. A successful save negates the stun, but not the extra damage. This strike has no effect against non-living creatures, such as constructs and the undead.
This maneuver is a supernatural ability.

dst: 天佑者睡眠徽记

在探索卡林港地下的废墟时，我从一只恐蛛手中救下了一个不寻常的半兽人，名叫赫兰加拉克。这个赫兰加拉克是海姆的牧师，似乎直到最近，他的部落“血刃”一直崇拜这位神祇，并试图避免像半兽人通常那样与其他种族交战。然而最近部落发生了领导层变动，前任领袖冈克鲁泽尔公主被驱逐，并被卖给了一个邪教，他们需要拥有王室血统的人进行某种奇怪的仪式献祭。新任领袖是格鲁扎尔，他试图恢复对格乌什的崇拜，并与鼠人结盟对抗卡林港的人类。赫兰加拉克希望我与他联手救出冈克鲁泽尔，并让她重新领导部落，挫败这个计划。

我已同意赫兰加拉克的计划。拯救公主是冒险者的经典任务，即使老故事里的公主通常不是半兽人。与赫兰加拉克一起，我应向西前往血刃镇，然后向南寻找邪教巢穴。

我们袭击了邪教徒，找到并救出了冈克鲁泽尔。既然她已加入我们，我们必须杀穿剩余的邪教徒，然后返回半兽人镇对付格鲁扎尔。
src:
While exploring the subterranean ruins beneath Calimport, I rescued from a dire spider an unusual orc named Hrangarak. This Hrangarak is a cleric of Helm, and it seems that until recently his tribe, the Bloody Blades, was worshiping this deity and seeking to avoid warring with other races as is typical of orcs. Recently however the tribe has had a change of leadership, with their former leader Princess Gunkruzelle being ousted and sold to a cult who needed someone with royal blood for some sort of strange ritual sacrifice. Its new leader is Gruzhaur, who seeks to restore worship of Gruumsh and form an alliance with the wererats against the humans of Calimport. Hrangarak wants me to join with him to rescue Gunkruzelle and restore her to leadership of the tribe, frustrating this plan.

I have agreed to Hrangarak's plan. Rescuing a princess is a classic quest for adventurers, even if the princess is not usually an orc in the old stories. Together with Hrangarak, I should head west towards the Bloody Blades town, but then head south to find the Cultist's Lair.

We have assailed the cultists, and found and rescued Gunkruzelle. Now that she has joined with us, we shall have to fight our way through the remaining cultists and then return to the orc town to deal with Gruzhaur.

"我看不见了！发生了什么？"
"当我们带着战利品返回文明世界时，我抱怨了几句，说我应该分到更大一份，毕竟大部分活儿都是我干的。说真的，我不是认真的，我向来遵守契约。他们立刻答应的时候我就该察觉到不对劲，但我太高兴他们认识到了自己的不足并打算弥补，所以没多想。可没过多久，那游荡者突然抢过我背着的财宝袋，把我推倒在地。我还没来得及站起来，他们三个就突然隐身了！原来他们留着法咒就是为了这个：背叛我！"
src: "As we were making our way back to civilization with the plunder, I complained about it and said I should get a larger share of the loot, seeing as I did most of the work to get it. I wasn't serious, mind you, I stick to my contracts. I should have realized something was up when they immediately agreed, but I was so pleased they recognized their failings and planned to make up for it that I didn't. It wasn't much later, though, that the rogue suddenly grabbed the bag of treasure I was lugging out and shoved me to the ground. Before I could get up the three of them suddenly turned invisible! That's what they were saving their spells for: double-crossing me!"

这些腰带由深受传统巨人敌人困扰的矮人氏族制作，希望能借此与这些强大的对手抗衡。根据某些说法，它们是用被杀巨人的皮制成的，之后再由矮人牧师的祝福增强其魔法属性。许多矮人强烈否认这些故事，有些人不愿被指责从事许多人认为道德上有问题的做法，而另一些人则只是不愿承认“无用的巨人”能产出任何有价值的东西。无论这些传言真假如何，佩戴这条腰带都会赋予佩戴者一些与巨人相关的巨大力量，以及其矮人制造者的一些传奇韧性。
src: These belts are produced by dwarf clans hard beset by their traditional giant foes, in hopes of evening the odds against these powerful opponents. According to some accounts they are made out of the hides of slain giants before their magical properties are enhanced by the blessings of dwarven clerics. Many dwarves vociferously deny these stories, some unhappy to be accused of what many think an ethically questionable practice, while others are simply unwilling to admit that "worthless giants" could produce anything of value. Whatever the truth of such rumors, wearing the belt will confer some of the tremendous strength associated with giants, and also some of the legendary toughness of their dwarven makers.

在码头区闲逛时，我遇到了商船船长法纳斯·纳塞布。他的专长是运输异域动物。不幸的是，他货舱里的一头凶暴虎挣脱了笼子，正威胁着要在下面其他动物中大肆破坏。他请求我帮忙制服这头野兽，并给了我一把专门附魔用来影响老虎的匕首，能让它们入睡。我只需要击中老虎一次，并且应该注意不要杀死这么珍贵的生物。\n\n老虎已经被制服，此事也已向纳塞布船长报告。不过他又给了我另一个任务，找到在码头区域各处传送的闪现犬，告诉它们回到他的船上。原来它们最初就是从那里来的，直到被老虎吓跑。他给了我一根法杖，可以证明我是他的代理人。装备它之后，我应该与那些犬交谈，告诉它们老虎的威胁已经结束。总共有七只犬，而且它们不停地传送，要全部找到可能有点困难。我需要搜索整个码头区域以及相邻的建筑内部。
src: While wandering about the Docks District, I ran into Phanas Naseb, captain of a merchant ship. His specialty is transporting exotic animals. Unfortunately, a dire tiger in his hold has broken free of its cage, and is threatening to wreak havoc amongst the other animals down there. He has asked my assistance in geting the beast under control, giving me a dagger that has been enchanted to affect tigers specifically, putting them to sleep. I should only need to score one hit on the tiger, and should make a point not to kill so valuable a creature.\n\nThe tiger has been rendered harmless, and this has been reported to Captain Naseb. He has given me another task, however, to find the various blink dogs teleporting about the docks area and tell them to return to his ship. It turns out that was where they orignally came from, until scared away by the tiger. He has given me a rod which will identify me as his agent. With it equipped, I should speak to the dogs and tell them that the threat from the tiger is over. There are seven dogs in total and it may prove a bit difficult to find them all as they keep teleporting about. I will need to look all around the docks area as well as inside adjoining structures.

You solidify extraplanar shadow, creating a solid prison of darkness.

This mystery immobilizes the subject in a prison of shadowstuff. This prison blocks both line of effect and line of sight to the creature inside it, and is impenetrable from the outside. The creature inside the prison takes 1d6 points of cold damage at the beginning of each round that it remains inside the prison. Once each round as a standard action, a creature caught in the prison can attempt a Fortitude saving throw against the spell's original DC to break out of the prison. Success means that the creature can move out of the prison, and it fades to nothingness. Failure means that the creature takes 1d4 points of Constitution damage and remains trapped.

src: Crossbows are frequently mass-produced for armies, since it has been found that new recruits can learn to use these weapons with reasonable competence more quickly than they can master a regular bow. One king tried to make up for this deficiency by equiping his soldiers with crossbows that allowed the wielders to shield themselves against a hail of arrows. This insured that the slow, but steady and accurate, fire of the crossbowmen would easily counter any enemy archers, whose shots, however numerous, would now mostly miss.

<CUSTOM0> 驱散火系生物。

一个被称为马鲁的种族曾在此世界生活和战斗，但他们的文明早已消逝于荒原，被可怕规模的内部战争摧毁。由于这些所谓的血肉战争，马鲁转向一种鲜为人知的艺术称为衍生技艺，并以此创造活体武器来进行战斗。这些spawncrafted生物被统称为马鲁的spawn，但更常被称为马鲁造物.马鲁在其他领域也很先进，但所有艺术都无法拯救他们免于自我毁灭。然而，马鲁造物在许多世界的被遗忘和荒芜废土中存留。
  
在古代，marrusaults的军队使曾经绿色的平原变暗，为马鲁的意志而战。每个玛鲁战仆为战斗而生，知道自己在任何冲突中的价值。作为顽强的幸存者，marrusaults在许多较弱或更专业的马鲁 spawncrafted造物随主人灭亡的地方勉强生存。尽管如此，玛鲁战仆依赖通过宣誓服务marrutact获得的装备和其他资源。有时玛鲁战仆会叛变--这些生物常在荒原中死亡，其骨骼对发现它们的旅行者构成谜团。

src:
A people known as the marru once lived and warred in the world, but their civilization has long since passed into the waste, devastated and destroyed by internecine wars of terrible magnitude. As a result of these so-called Flesh Wars, the marru turned to a little-understood art called spawncraft, and in so doing created living weapons to wage their battles. These spawncrafted creatures have come to be known collectively as the spawn of marru, but are more commonly referred to as marruspawn. The marru were advanced in other areas as well, but all their arts couldn't save them from destroying themselves. However, marruspawn linger on in forgotten and blasted wastelands across many worlds.
  
In ancient days, armies of marrusaults darkened the once-green plains, fighting for the will of the marru. Bred for fighting, each marrusault knows its worth in any conflict. Hardy survivors, marrusaults eked out existence where many of the weaker or more specialized spawncrafted creations of the marru perished with their masters. Still, a marrusault depends on the equipment and other resources it gains from swearing service to a marrutact. Sometimes a marrusault goes rogue-these creatures often find death in the waste, their bones posing a mystery to travelers who come upon them.

Ability Adjustments: +10 Strength, +2 Dexterity, +6 Constitution, -4 Intelligence, +4 Charisma
Favored Class (Fighter): A multiclass Marrusault's fighter class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

- Large creature
- 30' base speed
- Level Adjustment: +2

- Fire resistance 5
- +4 Listen

- Armor Proficiency (Light)
- Armor Proficiency (Medium)
- Armor Proficiency (Heavy)
- Diehard
- Howl of Defiance - 1/day howl of exhaustion or fatigue
- Monstrous Humanoid: Marrusault count as Monstrous Humanoid for the purpose of spells.

dst: 我遇到了法师伊纳尔·梅卡赞，他告诉我他得知了一种咒语，可以将我们传送到伟大的巫师扎塔罗斯曾经居住过的一处失落已久的避难所。这样的地方肯定充满了魔法宝藏，但伊纳尔发现获取它们会有一些困难。首先，打破入口处的结界需要同时施放一个破除法咒和一个解除魔法。因此伊纳尔认为有必要招募第二个施法者，也就是我。其次，这个地方据说有守卫魔像保护。伊纳尔是个学者，几乎没有战斗魔法经验，因此也希望我为他清除这些魔像，以及我可能遇到的任何其他危险。作为报酬，我可以优先挑选在里面找到的任何宝藏，伊纳尔只想要扎塔罗斯关于魔法研究的笔记和文件，我应该把它们带给他。\n\n伊纳尔用魔法把我们传送到了扎塔罗斯的这个隐秘避难所。我现在已经探索了这个地方，我相信已经清除了危险，也找到了一些扎塔罗斯的笔记和文件。我应该把这些带给他。
src: I have met the mage Ynal Mekazhan, who tells me that he has learned of an incantation that can teleport us to a long-lost refuge once occupied by the great wizard Zataroth. Such a place is sure to be full of magical treasures, but Ynal has discovered that there will be some difficulties to obtaining them. Firstly, breaking the wards on the entrance requires the simultaneous casting of both a breach spell and one dispelling magic. Therefore Ynal has found it necessary to recruit a second spellcaster, myself. Secondly, the place is supposed to be protected by guardian golems. Ynal is a scholar with little experience of battle magic and thus also wants me to clear these out out for him, along with any other hazards I might encounter. As a reward, I will get first pick of any treasures I find within, Ynal wants only Zataroth's notes and papers on magical research, which I should bring to him.\n\nYnal has magically transported us to this hidden refuge of Zataroth. I have now explored the place and I believe cleared it of dangers, as well as locating some of Zataroth's notes and papers. I should bring these to Ynal.

在矮人语中，“奥兰”一词意为老师。矮人人民的教育被视为一项神圣的职责，那些被认为精通矮人历史和传说 - 并被认为拥有高于常人的常识 - 的人经常被召唤来担任社区中受人尊敬的老师角色。虽然其他文化可能将此视为年轻女孩或老人的工作，但矮人将奥兰视为他们珍视文化的保护者。矮人社区中没有人轻视这个职位。

In Dwarven, the word "ollam" means teacher. The education of the dwarf people is considered a sacred duty, and those are considered knowledgeable in dwarf history and legend - and thought to possess above average common sense - are often called upon to take up the respected role of teacher in the community. While other cultures might see this as a job for young girls or old men, the dwarves see an ollam as a protector of their cherished culture. No one in the dwarf community takes that position lightly.

- Hit Die: d8.
- Proficiencies: An Ollam does not gain any additional weapon or armor proficiencies.
- Skill Points: 6+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:

Alignment: Lawful Good
Skills: Perform 5 ranks, Lore 10 ranks
Race: Dwarf

CLASS FEATURES:

Level
1: Lore - The Ollam adds his class bonus to Lore checks.
3: Inspire Confidence - The Ollam grants an ally +2 to skills for 1 round per class level. If the ally is a dwarf, he gains +3.
5: Inspire Resilience - The Ollam grants a dwarf ally +4 Fortitude and damage reduction 5/-. A non-dwarf ally gains +2 Fortitude and is fatigued at the end of the duration. This effect lasts 1 minute.

BONUS SPELLS

Every other level in Ollam, the character gains new spells per day as if he had also gained a level in his highest divine caster class.

这把剑曾由冒险者奥登·塔恩使用，尽管他面对大多数敌人都很英勇，但他患有蜘蛛恐惧症，讨厌对抗巨型蜘蛛。为了克服自己的恐惧，他接受了一项任务，要清除蜘蛛沼泽外围的这些怪物，并获得了这把剑来帮助他完成。在奥登看来，这把剑最大的优势不是其强大的魔法增强，而是它的巨大尺寸，这让他有机会在蜘蛛靠得太近之前杀死它。在沼泽中取得成功后，奥登因击败了这么多长期以来是他宿敌的生物而欢欣鼓舞，也许过于自信，很快又在米尔森林接受了另一项任务。不幸的是，他再也没有从后一项任务中回来，他强大的剑也失落了很长时间。
src: This sword was wielded by the adventurer Orden Tarn, who, though he faced most foes heroically, was an arachnophobe who hated to go up against giant spiders. Determined to conquer his fears, he accepted a quest to cleanse the outskirts of the Spider Swamp of these very monsters, and obtained this blade to help him do it. In Orden's opinion, the greatest advantage of this sword was not its powerful magical enhancements, but its sheer size, which gave him a good chance to kill a spider before it could get too close to him. Successful in the swamp, Orden, jubilant and perhaps overconfident at having vanquished so many of the creatures that had long been his nemesis, soon took on another quest in the Forest of Mir. Unfortunately he never returned from this latter mission, and his mighty sword was lost for a long time.

dst: 我遇到了法师伊纳尔·梅卡赞，他告诉我他得知了一种咒语，可以将我们传送到伟大的巫师扎塔罗斯曾经居住过的一处失落已久的避难所。这样的地方肯定充满了魔法宝藏，但伊纳尔发现获取它们会有一些困难。首先，打破入口处的结界需要同时施放一个破除法咒和一个解除魔法。因此伊纳尔认为有必要招募第二个施法者，也就是我。其次，这个地方据说有守卫魔像保护。伊纳尔是个学者，几乎没有战斗魔法经验，因此也希望我为他清除这些魔像，以及我可能遇到的任何其他危险。作为报酬，我可以优先挑选在里面找到的任何宝藏，伊纳尔只想要扎塔罗斯关于魔法研究的笔记和文件，我应该把它们带给他。\n\n伊纳尔用魔法把我们传送到了扎塔罗斯的这个隐秘避难所。我现在已经探索了这个地方，我相信已经清除了危险，也找到了一些扎塔罗斯的笔记和文件。然而，当我把它们带给伊纳尔时，他攻击了我！原来他想把这里的所有宝藏都据为己有。
src: I have met the mage Ynal Mekazhan, who tells me that he has learned of an incantation that can teleport us to a long-lost refuge once occupied by the great wizard Zataroth. Such a place is sure to be full of magical treasures, but Ynal has discovered that there will be some difficulties to obtaining them. Firstly, breaking the wards on the entrance requires the simultaneous casting of both a breach spell and one dispelling magic. Therefore Ynal has found it necessary to recruit a second spellcaster, myself. Secondly, the place is supposed to be protected by guardian golems. Ynal is a scholar with little experience of battle magic and thus also wants me to clear these out out for him, along with any other hazards I might encounter. As a reward, I will get first pick of any treasures I find within, Ynal wants only Zataroth's notes and papers on magical research, which I should bring to him.\n\nYnal has magically transported us to this hidden refuge of Zataroth. I have now explored the place and I believe cleared it of dangers, as well as locating some of Zataroth's notes and papers. However, when I brought them to Ynal, he attacked me! It turns out he wanted all the treasures here for himself.

（进阶职业）
科米尔战争法师是费伦最受尊敬的战斗法师之一。他们由经验丰富的战斗法师训练，为战场带来强大的力量。在对图坎部落的战争中，他们在保护寡不敌众的盟军对抗部落时发挥了关键作用。在最近科米尔对抗巨龙及其地精爪牙的战争中，许多战争法师在抵御猛攻时牺牲。自创立以来，他们一直是科米尔对抗外国或敌对势力颠覆的最有效工具之一。他们为达成此目标所走的道路漫长，艰难且常常孤独，但走上这条道路的特殊人物拥有能够承受如此艰辛的品质。他们的回报？同伴和科米尔人民的尊敬，以及国王的感激。

- 生命骰：d4
- 武器与防具擅长：科米尔战争法师不获得额外的武器与防具擅长。
- 技能点：2+ 智力调整值。

要求：

阵营：非混乱，非邪恶。
专长：任意军用武器擅长，法术强效，法术极效。
技能：法咒辨识 10 级。
奥术施法：能够施放 4 级法咒。

职业特性：

等级
1：武器专攻 - 选择一个奖励军用武器专攻
2：超魔专长 - 选择一个奖励超魔专长。
3：法术扩展 - 增加法咒区域
4：超魔专长
5：扩大法咒区域 - 大幅增加法咒区域。

施法

科米尔战争法师每提升一个等级，角色获得新的每日法咒，如同他在其最高施法职业（吟游诗人，术士或法师）上也提升了等级。他不会通过此能力学习任何新法咒。
src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
The Cormyrean War Wizards are some of the most respected battlemages in all of Faerun. Trained by experienced combat mages, they bring great power to the battlefield. In the war against the Tuigan horde, they were instrumental in protecting the outnumbered allied troops fighting against the horde. In the recent war in Cormyr against the dragon and her goblin minions, many War Wizards lost their lives holding back the onslaught. Since their creation, they have been one of Cormyr's most effective tools against subversion by foreign or hostile powers. The road they must travel to achieve such ends is long, difficult, and often lonely, but the special people who follow this path are made of the stuff that can endure such hardships. Their reward? The respect of their peers and the people of Cormyr, and the gratitude of kings.

- Hit Die: d4
- Proficiencies: A War Wizard of Cormyr gains no additional proficiencies.
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:

Alignment: No Chaotic, No Evil.
Feats: Any Martial Weapon Proficiency, Empower Spell, Maximize Spell.
Skills: Spellcraft 10 ranks.
Arcane Spellcasting: Able to cast 4th-level spells.

CLASS FEATURES:

Level
1: Weapon Focus - Choose a bonus Martial Weapon Focus
2: Metamagic Feat - Choose a bonus Metamagic feat.
3: Widen Spell - Increase spell area
4: Metamagic Feat
5: Enlarge Spell Area - Greatly increased spell area.

SPELLCASTING

Every level in War Wizard of Cormyr, the character gains new spells per day as if he had also gained a level in his highest caster class (bard, sorcerer, or wizard). He does not learn any new spells through his abilities.

"很简单。帕夏加尔哈德尔提出，在我们完成任务后给我们一个永久职位。其他人对为一位圣武士工作感到不安，但我抓住了这个机会。早些时候我曾向他坦白了我的血统，担心他从别人那里得知后会有什么反应，结果令我印象深刻的是，他对此相当平静。他告诉我，他能看出我内心并不邪恶，即使我真是邪恶的，他也仍然愿意给我改过自新的机会，如果他没有当场斩杀一个恶人的理由，他同样乐意将其置于自己的监视之下。在我看来，这正是像我这个叛逃的蛇人需要找到的那种人，所以我就来了。"
src: "Simply enough. Pasha Galhadr offered to give us a permanent position upon the completion of our task. The rest were uncomfortable at the idea of working for a paladin, but I seized the chance. Earlier I had confessed my lineage to him, fearing his reaction if he learned of it from others, and been impressed that he was quite undisturbed by it. He told me that he could tell I was not evil at heart, and that even if I had been, he would still have been willing to give me opportunity to redeem myself, that if he lacked cause to slay an evil man on the spot, he would be just as happy to keep him under his scrutiny. That seemed to me to be just the sort of man a renegade Yuan-ti needed to find, and so here I am."

Level

6: Fear Aura - 1/day (spell-like ability).

dst: "再见。"

在一个不死怪物的巢穴中，我发现了一枚魔法戒指的碎片，上面刻有提尔的符号。当我把它拿给莎尔神殿的首席女祭司费拉莎看时，她认出这是不久前被盗的提尔圣物的一部分。她因我交出找到的碎片而奖赏了我，并告诉我，如果我再找到戒指的其他碎片，她也想要，以便莎尔神殿可以玷污他们敌人提尔的这件圣物。\n\n找到圣环的第二块碎片后，费拉莎告诉我，有了两块戒指碎片，她就能施放一个预言法咒来定位最后一块碎片，然后打开一个临时界门，将人传送到那附近以取回最后一块碎片。她还承诺，如果我完成这次回收，将给予丰厚的奖赏。我接受了这个任务，并被传送到了某个隐蔽的墓穴。最后一块戒指碎片无疑就在附近，但和前两块一样由不死生物守卫着，所以我必须谨慎行事。我还必须记住，当我返回时界门会崩塌，所以在取回最后一块碎片之前我不应该回去。
src: In the lair of an undead monster, I found a broken piece of a magical ring inscribed with symbols of Tyr. When I showed it to Ferazha, the head priestess of the Temple of Shar, she recognized it as part of a holy artifact of Tyr stolen some time ago. She rewarded me for giving her the piece I found, and has told me that she would also like any other pieces of the ring that I should happen to find, so that the Temple of Shar might defile this artifact of their enemy Tyr.\n\nHaving found a second piece of the holy ring, I was informed by Ferazha that with two pieces of the ring, she could cast a divination spell that would locate the final piece, and then open a temporary portal that would transport one near that location to recover the last fragment. She also promised a substantial reward should I effect this recovery. I have accepted this quest and been transported to a hidden tomb somewhere. The final ring fragment is doubtless about, but is guarded by undead as the first two were so I must proceed with caution. I must also remember that the portal will collapse when I return, so I should not do so until the final piece is recovered.

dst: 纳西拉克告诉过我，有一位名叫伊拉姆的伊尔梅特修士，是一位隐士，住在城墙外的一个洞穴里。这位伊拉姆有时会为其他修士提供训练和指导，纳西拉克建议我，作为一名修士，最好去找他。他给了我一把钥匙，可以打开贫民窟下方下水道北墙附近的一个格栅，我之前没有理由注意到它，它通向一系列向北延伸的通道和洞穴，最终通向隐士洞穴附近的沙漠。这是去那里最快的路线，但纳西拉克警告我说这也可能很危险。\n\n我沿着指定的路径前进，在洞穴中找到了伊拉姆大师。他已经开始了我的训练计划，并给了我几项任务。首先，我要去他洞穴西南角的一个袋子里拿到粗毛衬衣，我在训练期间要穿着它。接下来，他要我从我来这里时穿过的隧道里一具尸体上找到的四件修士装备中拿一件，带到洞穴外的悬崖边，扔进那里的深渊。他相信这将有助于我培养对物质财富的漠不关心。
src: Nasirak has told me of an Ilmaterian monk named Iram who is a hermit living in a cave just outside the city walls. This Iram sometimes offers training and instruction to other monks, and Nasirak has recommended that, as a monk, I would be well-advised to seek him out. He has given me a key to a grate near the north wall of the sewers beneath the slums, which I would have no reason to notice earlier, that leads to a series of passages and caves heading north, terminating out in the desert near the hermit's cave. This is the quickest route there, but Nasirak has warned me it can also be hazardous.\n\nI have followed the path laid out and located Master Iram in his cave. He has commenced my training program and given me a couple of tasks. Firstly, I am to get the hair shirt in a bag in the southwest corner of his cave, which I am to wear during my training. Next, he wants me to take one of four items of monk gear I found on a corpse in the tunnel I traversed coming here, bring it to the cliff outside the cave, and throw it into the chasm there. He believes this will assist me in developing a lack of concern for material possessions.

dst: "是啊，滚开。"

（进阶职业）
褪为红色，然后什么都没有。发生了什么？你在哪里？没有声音，没有光，什么都没有。你看不见也听不见，甚至感觉不到自己的身体。你处境的可怕真相悄然袭来……你死了！永恒流逝，然后你感觉到来自这虚无之外的呼唤。某物在召唤，你被从无尽的灰色漩涡中拉起，乐于让你的最终天命悬而未决。一团色彩向你袭来，包裹着你，沐浴着你。你回来了！一个声音传入你的耳中，这是你将听到的最甜美的声音。这是血液通过你血管的重新搏动 - 血液之乐：你生命的声音。你能感觉到它为你身体的每一个粒子重新注入能量，将死亡从你身上冲走，留下生命。它浓稠而温暖，你贪婪地拥抱它。血灵师是曾经死去的施法者，当他们复活时，获得了对其血液重要性的理解，这是由他们的濒死经历所赋予的。他们学会从这种维持他们生命的生命液体中唤起魔法。

- 生命骰：d6。
- 擅长：血灵师不获得任何武器，护甲或盾牌擅长。
- 技能点：2+ 智力调整值。

要求：

阵营：非守序
技能：专注 4 级。
专长：坚韧，强韧加强。
法咒：必须能够施放至少 3 级奥术法咒。

职业特性：

等级
1：血液成分 - 血灵师可以承受 1 点伤害，使法咒的 DC 提高 1。
    持久施法 - 血灵师在专注检定上获得等于其职业等级的加值。
2：疤痕化 - 血灵师可以在其身体上储存最多 5 个法咒。除此之外与抄写卷轴相同。
3：死亡丧钟 - 每天一次，血灵师可以尝试从濒死生物身上吸取生命，获得增强的力量，生命和施法者等级。
4：血液药剂 - 血灵师可以在其血液中储存等于其职业等级加体质调整值的法咒数量，最多 10 个。除此之外与酿造药水相同。
5：魔像 - 你可以创造一个魔像。通过触摸它，你可以将每等级 1 点生命值的伤害从你转移到它身上。魔像随你提升等级，在 9 级时最多 6HD.如果魔像死亡，血灵师受到 2d10 伤害。你一次只能拥有一个魔像。
6：寻血法咒 - 血灵师可以承受 3 点伤害，使其法咒造成额外 1d6 伤害。
7：血浓于水 - 血灵师获得对挥砍和穿刺伤害的 DR 1/-.
8：启蒙术血液 - 每天一次，通过近战接触攻击，血灵师可以使目标的血液爆炸性喷出，造成 10d10 伤害。免疫重击的目标免疫此能力。
9：灌注 - 血灵师获得永久 +2 体质。
10：血行 - 每天一次，血灵师可以通过两个活物在同一平面上传送到任何距离。如果传送终点的生物是敌对的，血灵师将对其造成 10d6 点伤害，除非它通过 DC 10 + 职业等级 + 体质调整值的豁免。

奖励法咒：
在血灵师每获得两个等级时，角色获得新的每日法咒，如同他在其最高施法职业（吟游诗人，术士或法师）中也获得了等级。他不会通过其能力学习任何新法咒。
src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
Fade to red, then nothing. What happened? Where are you? No sound, no light, no nothing. You can't see or hear, or even feel your own body. The awful truth of your plight steals over you... you're dead! An eternity passes, then you feel a call from beyond this nothingness. Something beckons, and you are drawn up out of the endless gray swirl, happy to leave your final fate undecided. A swirl of color streaks towards you, enveloping, bathing you. you have come back! A sound breaks in your ears, the sweetest sound you will ever hear. It is the renewed pulse of blood through your veins - blood music: the sound of your life. You can feel it re-energizing every particle of your form, flushing death from you and leaving life in its place. It is thick and warm, and you greedily embrace it. Blood Magi are formerly deceased spellcasters who, when returned to life, gain an understanding of their blood's importance, bequeathed by their close call. They learn to evoke magic from this vital fluid that sustains their lives.

- Hit Dice: d6.
- Proficiencies: A Blood Magus gain no weapon, armor or shield proficiencies.
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:

Alignment: Non Lawful
Skills: Concentration 4 Ranks.
Feats: Toughness, Great Fortitude.
Spells: Must be able to cast at least 3rd level Arcane spells.

CLASS FEATURES:

Level
1: Blood Component - The Blood Magus can take 1 point of damage to give a 1 DC boost to a spell.
    Durable Casting - The Blood Magus gains a bonus to his concentration checks equal to his class level.
2: Scarification - The Blood Magus may store up to 5 spells on his body. This is otherwise the same as Scribe Scroll.
3: Death Knell - Once per day, the Blood Magus may attempt to suck the life from a nearly dead creature, gaining increased strength, life, and caster level.
4: Blood Draught - The Blood Magus may store a number of spells equal to his class level plus his Constitution modifier, up to a maximum of 10, in his blood. This is otherwise the same as Brew Potion.
5: Homunculus - You may create a homunculus. By touching it, you can transfer 1/hp a level of damage from you to it. The homunculus advances in levels with you, to a maximum of 6HD at level 9. If the homunculus dies, the Blood Magus takes 2d10 damage. You may only have one homunculus at a time.
6: Bloodseeking Spell - The Blood Magus can take 3 points of damage to have his spells deal 1d6 more damage.
7: Thicker than Water - The Blood Magus gains DR 1/- to Slashing and Piercing damage.
8: Awaken Blood - Once per day, with a melee touch attack, the Blood Magus can cause the blood of a target to explosively escape, dealing 10d10 damage. A target immune to criticals is immune to this ability.
9: Infusion - The Blood Magus gains a permanent +2 to Constitution.
10: Bloodwalk - Once per day, the Blood Magus can teleport any distance on the same plane by means of two living creatures. If the creature at the end of the teleport is hostile, the Blood Magus will deal it 10d6 points of damage unless it makes a save of DC 10 + Class level + Con modifier.

BONUS SPELLS:

src:
Totem Avatar

Descriptors: None 
Classes: Totemist 
Chakra: Arms, feet, heart, or shoulders (totem) 
Saving Throw: None

You shape incarnum into an imposing avatar of bestial power. This corporeal shape fits over your clothing and armor, but it makes you seem like a hulking gray render in outline and features. Your actual body is only barely visible within the gray, hairless form. The render's broad shoulders and sinewy arms encompass yours and extend beyond them to translucent clawed hands scraping the ground.

The totem avatar grants you temporary hit points equal to your meldshaper level. 

Essentia: You gain an enhancement bonus to your natural armor bonus equal to the number of points of essentia you invest in your totem avatar. 

Chakra Bind (Arms) 

Your totem avatar resembles an owlbear-no less hulking and stooped than the gray render form, but covered in a shaggy coat of feathers and fur.

You gain the benefit of the Improved Grapple feat. 

Chakra Bind (Feet) 

Your totem avatar resembles a rampager, with four elephantine legs, two muscular arms with hooked claws, a headless body with a gaping maw planted on the forward part of the torso, and a thick tail dragging behind.

You gain stability as if you were a four-legged creature, giving you a +4 bonus on checks to resist a bull rush, overrun, or trip attack. You are also treated as if you were one size category larger than normal when making a check to resist a bull rush, grapple, overrun, or trip attack (effectively granting you an additional +4 on such checks). 

Chakra Bind (Heart) 

Your totem avatar resembles the legendary tarrasque, though on a much smaller scale. Its hulking form leans forward of your own, its back covered with a thick, spiny carapace. Two mighty horns sprout from its head, and its jaw opens wide to reveal dozens of knifelike teeth.

You gain damage reduction 5/+1. The amount of this damage reduction increases by 1 for every point of essentia you invest in the soulmeld. 

Chakra Bind (Shoulders) 

Your totem avatar resembles a blood ape, taking on the appearance of a red-furred gorilla.

Your natural weapons (whether from soulmelds or other sources) deal an extra 2 damage. 

Chakra Bind (Totem) When you bind your totem avatar to your totem chakra, you become a little more like the gray render it represents. In particular, your body alters to better fill the musculature of the mighty beast avatar, lending you strength to smite your foes.

Your totem avatar grants you a morale bonus on damage rolls made with natural weapons (whether from soulmelds or other natural sources) equal to the number of points of essentia you invest in it.

dst: 熟练施法者（战法师）

在守卫总部，我遇到了一个叫塞卡娅·哈辛的人，她正徒劳地试图说服守卫队开始搜寻她失踪的丈夫阿拉达尔。阿拉达尔是一本关于名为扭曲符文的邪恶组织的书的作者，几天前他在研究一本后续书籍时失踪了。我已同意去寻找他。塞卡娅告诉我，她最后一次见到他时，他正要去找一个叫拉玛什·卡萨特的人，此人住在贵族区西侧，所以我应该从那里开始调查。如果我发现了任何线索，我可以去塞卡娅在商业区东北部的家中向她报告。

我和拉玛什·卡萨特谈过了，他让我去找水手科拉努·乌马尔。现在我已经和科拉努谈过了，他告诉了我阿拉达尔可能调查过的两条线索：第一，他以前的一个船友德拉沙姆·埃纳尔，科拉努认为他曾是符文的特工，现在住在商业区西南部；第二，一个隐藏的房间，通过贵族区东北部一堵墙上的暗门进入，科拉努认为那是符文使用的藏身处。既然我已经知道该往哪里找，这扇门应该不会太难找到。

我已经和德拉沙姆·埃纳尔谈过了，他又把我引向了一个叫费亚尔·泰塞纳尔的人。泰塞纳尔曾是符文的特工，他告诉了我其中一名成员：泰罗兹·甘，他利用自己精湛的幻术将自己伪装成一个普通的中等实力人类法师，但实际上他是一名巫妖和大法师。甘住在学者角区的一座小塔里。如果我要找到阿拉达尔，那就是我接下来必须去的地方，尽管我不确定如果真的打起来，我能对一个强大的巫妖做什么。好吧，我一直都知道冒险不是最安全的工作。
src:
At Watch Headquarters, I ran into one Sekaya Hasin, who was futilely attempting to convince the Watch to initiate a search for her missing husband, Aladar. Aladar is the author of a book on the sinister organization known as the Twisted Rune, and disappeared a few days ago when he was engaged in researching a follow-up book. I have agreed to search for him. Sekaya told me that when she last saw him, he was going to speak to one Lamash Kasat, who lives along the western side of the Noble District, so that is where I should begin the investigation. If I discover anything I can report it to Sekaya at her home in the northeast of the Merchant District.

I spoke to Lamash Kasat, who in turn sent me to seek out the sailor Kolanu Umal. Now I have spoken to Kolanu, and he in turn has told me of two paths that Aladar might have investigated: first, a former shipmate of his, Drasham Enar, who Kolanu believes was an agent of the Rune, and who now lives in the southwest part of the Merchant District, and secondly, a hidden chamber accessed through a secret door in a wall in the northeastern part of the Noble District, that Kolanu believes to be a hideout used by the Rune. This door should not be too difficult to find now that I have been directed where to look.

I have spoken to Drasham Enar, who in turn led me to one Feyar Tesenal. Tesenal was once an agent of the Rune, and has told me of one of its members: Teroz Gan, who uses his mastery of illusion to disguise himself as a conventionally human wizard of moderate power, but who is in fact a lich and an archmage. Gan lives in a small tower in the Scholar's Corner District. That is where I must go next if I am to find Aladar, though I am not sure what I could do against a powerful lich if it comes to a fight. Well, I always knew adventuring wasn't the safest job around.

This ability of devourers to occupy and control host bodies not only permits them to assume many of the host body's powers, but also allows them to stealthily infiltrate societies of many diverse kinds of creatures.

Level: Psion/wilder 6
Manifesting Time: 1 swift action
Range: Personal
Target: You
Duration: 1 round (in apparent time); see text

You enter another time frame, speeding up so greatly that all other creatures seem frozen, though they are actually still moving at normal speed. You are free to act for 1 round of apparent time. You can manifest powers, cast spells, move, or perform other types of actions.

When your temporal acceleration expires, you resume acting during your current turn in the standard time frame. You are shaken for 1 round upon your return to the standard time frame.

这本书包含了许多关于费伦常见怪物种族的信息，重点在于最有效地杀死它们的方法。因此，对于任何能接受作者争议性论点的冒险者来说，这本书将非常有帮助：作者认为他所讨论的种族本质上是邪恶的，应当被彻底消灭——这种极端观点使这本书不受欢迎且难以找到。当然，人们不必一定同意书中更激进的提议，也能从其提供的知识中受益。\n\n注意：使用这本书将给予玩家一些经验值，其数量与玩家的等级成反比。
src: This book contains much information on some of the common monstrous races of Faerun, with the emphasis being on the most effective ways to kill them. As a result, it would be very helpful to any adventurer who can stomach the author's controversial thesis that the races he discusses are inherently evil and should be utterly exterminated: an extreme view that has made this book unpopular and hard to find. Of course, one need not necessarily agree with the book's more radical proposals to benefit from the knowledge it provides.\n\nNote: Using this book will provide some experience to the player, the amount being inversely proportional to his level.

Unfortunately, fine weapons and dwarven courage were no match for the sheer number of orc invaders. The clan was extinguished, and their weapons were scattered throughout the known world. Ironically, they often turn up in the hands of goblin or orc warriors, since many were captured in the clan's defeat.

src:
In most lands, half-drow are quite rare. Since many drow are irredeemably evil, they only mate with humans by way of rape or slavery. Half-drow are often as dark-hearted as their elven parents, but with a bitter resentment that comes from being treated as inferior members of drow society. Despite this, good half-drow are much less rare than good drow. Half-drow have dusky skin, silver or white hair and a broad range of eye colors.

Half-Drow Ability Adjustments: none
Favored Class: Any

Special Abilities:

- Sleeplessness: Immune to spells and effects of the 'Sleep' subtype.
- Hardiness vs. Enchantments: +2 racial bonus on saving throws against mind-affecting spells.
- Partial Skill Affinity (Listen): +1 racial bonus to Listen checks.
- Partial Skill Affinity (Search): +1 racial bonus to Search checks.
- Partial Skill Affinity (Spot): +1 racial bonus to Spot checks.
- Darkvision: Half-Drow can see in the dark.
- Elven: Half-Drow are considered Elven for the purpose of spells.

They came here because we'd been sending reports about increased goblin activity and asking for help. I was quite relieved when the regiment showed up, thought our troubles were over. However, the commander started receiving reports of goblin activity from other villages, too. He didn't know where the goblins would ultimately strike and didn't want to weaken his force by spreading it all over, so not too long ago, he decided to march into the woods and hunt the goblins down."

Sunmantle
Abjuration
Level: Sanctified 4
Components: S, Sacrifice
Casting Time: 1 standard action
Range: Touch
Target: One creature touched
Duration: 1 round/level
Saving Throw: None
Spell Resistance: Yes

This spell cloaks the target in a wavering cloak of light that illuminates an area around the target (and dispels darkness) as a daylight spell. However, its ability to generate bright light is not the spell's primary function.

The sunmantle grants the target damage reduction 5/-. Furthermore, if the target is struck by a melee attack that deals hit point damage, a tendril of light lashes out at the attacker, striking unerringly and dealing 5 points of damage.

Because of the brilliance of the sunmantle, creatures sensitive to bright light (such as dark elves) take the usual attack penalties when in the light radius of the sunmantle.

Sacrifice: 1d4 points of Strength damage.

Casters of evil alignment cannot cast Sanctified spells.

抵达米尔森林附近的特布纳斯村，准备增援本应保护该村的军团时，我发现此地已陷入火海，正遭到一大群地精的袭击。我击败了附近的地精，并与村长交谈。他告诉我，我本应增援的军团已经进入森林，显然已被周围异常庞大且强悍的地精部队击败，因为不久之后村庄就遭到了攻击。然而，森林中仍能听到战斗的声音，想必是军团残部仍在进行抵抗。看来我必须深入森林，营救军团的幸存者，并希望能找到办法阻止地精对这个防御薄弱的地区采取侵略行动。\n\n我已攻入地精用作基地的旧堡垒，并迫使他们的首领乌拉斯和戈拉夫逃走。不幸的是，我无法将他们永久杀死，因为他们拥有乌拉斯所称的“召回石”。这些石头，或者不管它们是什么，必定代表着某种非常强大的魔法。我担心这对危险的家伙可能还会卷土重来。然而，尽管我未能杀死这些大地精首领，我相信我已对地精军队造成了足够的打击，使其在很长一段时间内不会构成重大威胁。很可能我已在此地区做了我能做的一切，应该转向其他任务了。
src: Upon arriving in the village of Tebnas, near the Forest of Mir, to reinforce the army regiment supposed to be protecting it, I found the place in flames and under assault by a horde of goblins. I defeated the goblins in the immediate vicinity, and spoke to the mayor of the village. He informed me that the regiment I was supposed to reinforce had already entered the forest, and apparently been defeated by the unusually large and capable goblin forces about, since shortly afterwards came the attack on the village. However, sounds of fighting can still be heard coming from the forest, presumably from remnants of the regiment still offering some resistance. It would seem I must head further into the forest to rescue any survivors of the regiment and hopefully find some way of discouraging the goblins from aggressive action against this poorly defended region.\n\nI have penetrated the old fortress the goblins were using as a base and forced their leaders, Ulaz and Gorav. to flee. Unfortunately I was unable to slay them permanently due to their possession of what Ulaz referred to as "recall stones." These stones, or whatever they are, must reperesent some very powerful magic. I fear I may not have heard the last of this dangerous pair. However, though I failed to slay the hobgoblin leaders, I expect I have done enough damage to the goblin army that it will not constitute a signficant threat for a long time. Likely I have done all I can do in this region and should move on to some other task.

dst: "卡洛玛斯似乎因此受到启发，试图重新与我建立联系，寻求和解。我们曾经是遏制卑劣奴隶制行径斗争中的盟友，但后来在应采用的方法上产生了分歧。我不愿像他那样绕开法律。现在卡洛玛斯希望多年的失败，以及多年目睹这里所谓法律的腐败和不公，已经在一定程度上改变了我的观点。我必须承认，我对自己的立场不如从前那样确定了。无论如何，卡洛玛斯请求我在他涉及的某件事上提供帮助。我被说服应该提供帮助。"
src: "Kalomas seems to have been inspired by this to attempt to reopen communications with me, seeking a reconciliation. We were once allies in the struggle to curb the vile practice of slavery, but came to disagree about the methods to be employed. I was not prepared to skirt the law as he was. Now Kalomoas hopes that years of failure, and years of witnessing the corruption and injustice of what passes for law here has modified my views somewhat. I must admit I am less certain of my position than I once was. At any rate, Kalomas has asked for my help on a certain matter with which he is involved. I am persuaded that I should provide it."

src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
Thrallherds manipulate the minds of others as if they were clay in the hands of a sculptor. some creatures are more susceptible than others to the thrallherd's unconscious, but continual, call to service. And so they come, eager to be led, happy to follow, and completely under the thrallherd's control. In this way, thrallherds keep a minor menagerie of enthralled servants that are anxious to do their will.

- Hit Die: d4
- Proficiencies: A Thrallherd gains no additional proficiencies.
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:

Feats: Narrow Mind (This feat requires 13 Wisdom)
Skills: Persuade 4 ranks, Lore 8 ranks.
Manifesting: Must be able to manifest 3rd level powers.
Special: Must be a Telepath Discipline Psion and able to manifest a Telepath Discipline Power.

CLASS FEATURES:

Level
1: Thrallherd - Gain a thrall whose level is based upon Thrallherd's leadership score.
2:
3: Psionic Charm - Add Psionic Charm to the list of powers the Thrallherd can manifest. Once per day, he can manifest this power at a reduced cost.
4:
5: Psionic Dominate - Add Psionic Dominate to the list of powers the Thrallherd can manifest. Once per day, he can manifest this power at a reduced cost.
6:
7: Greater Dominate - Thrallherd no longer has to augment Dominate for animals, fey, giants, magical beasts, or monstrous humanoids.
8:
9: Superior Dominate - Thrallherd no longer has to augment Dominate for aberrations, dragons, elementals, and outsiders.

src:
Wild elves, also known as green elves, are insular and savage. As a result they are rarely seen outside their forest homes. The green elves were always close to nature, even more than other elves, but they have forgotten many of the high arts and lore of their people, choosing stealth and survival over learning and enlightenment. Their skin tends to be brown and their hair ranges from black to light brown, lightening to silvery white with age.

Wild Elven Ability Adjustments: +2 Dex, -2 Int
Favored Class (Sorcerer): A multiclass wild elf's sorcerer class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

- Sleeplessness: Immune to spells and effects of the 'Sleep' subtype.
- Hardiness vs. Enchantments: +2 racial bonus on saving throws against mind-affecting spells.
- Bonus Proficiencies (Longsword, Rapier, Shortbow, Longbow)
- Skill Affinity (Listen): +2 racial bonus to Listen checks.
- Skill Affinity (Search): +2 racial bonus to Search checks.
- Skill Affinity (Spot): +2 racial bonus to Spot checks.
- Keen Senses: Wild Elves make active Search checks automatically and with no movement penalties.
- Low-Light Vision: Allows them to see better than normal in the dark.
- Elven: Wild Elves are considered Elven for the purpose of spells.

src: It is unclear why this bizarre shield was ever made. Some say it was built by a now vanished legendary race of creatures with three arms. Others, more prosaically, suggest that its crafter was intoxicated at the time of its forging. Whatever the reason, the enchantment placed on this shield provides the bearer with the ability to fight skillfully with two weapons wielded simultaneously. Of course, the difficulty is that if someone were to equip the shield to gain the benefit of this enchantment, he would not have a free hand for wielding the second weapon. As far as actual use goes, it is of no more value to an adventurer than an ordinary, non-magical shield. However, it could still be sold for a respectable sum since it is of interest to certain collectors as a curiousity.

dst: 哈马德对我向他讲述的我在气元素位面的经历的意义感到好奇，在那里我得知有些存在想要保护他的女儿扎拉拉免受某种神秘威胁。他请他的一位法师朋友，名叫拉达扎尔·法塞夫的人，通过询问各种可召唤的位面存在来调查此事。法塞夫则想亲自与我谈谈我的位面外遭遇，我猜是为了指导他的行动。因此哈马德派我去和他谈谈。法塞夫可以在提尔神殿的东北塔楼找到。我应该去那座神殿（自然是在神殿区），在东北方找到向上的楼梯。法塞夫在等我，必要的门应该已经解锁，等待我的到来。\n\n我已经与拉达扎尔会面，并参与了他对几个被召唤的位面生物的询问。我不确定我们是否真的从他们那里了解到很多，但我们已经做了目前能做的，我应该把结果，不管怎样，报告给哈马德。
src: Hamad is curious about the significance of what I related to him concerning my experiences on the Plane of Air, where I was informed that some entities there wished to protect his daughter Zarala against some mysterious threat. He has asked a mage fried of his, one Radazal Faseph, to investigate the matter by inquiring among various summonable planar entities. Faseph in turn wants to speak to me personally about my extra-planar encounter, I suppose to guide his activities. Hamad has therefore dispatched me to talk to him. Faseph can be found in the northeast tower of the Temple of Tyr. I should go to that temple (in the Temple District, naturally) and find an upward-leading staircase in the northeast. Faseph is expecting me and the necesary doors should be unlocked in anticipation of my arrival.\n\nI have met with Radazal and participated in his inquiries directed to a couple of summoned planar creatures. I am not sure we have actually learned all that much from them, but we have done what we can for the time being and I should report the results, such as they are, to Hamad.

(PRESTIGE CLASS)
Part reconnaissance expert, part border guard, part spy and part diplomat, the vigilant is a highly trained warrior who can be confidently sent into any situation, no matter how grim the odds. Recruits who survive the harsh training and deadly initiation tests required to become a vigilant are assigned to one of the elite corps of these warriors, called a Vigil.

- Proficiencies: A vigilant does not gain any additional weapon or armor proficiencies.
- Skill Points: 4+ Int Modifier.

Base Attack Bonus: +5
Feats: Endurance, Track
Skills: Lore 4 ranks, Listen 5 ranks, Persuade 5 ranks.

CLASS FEATURES:

Level
1: Sprint - Can move for a brief period of time as Hasted, three times per day.
2: Favored Enemy - Gains a Favored Enemy as the Ranger ability.
4: Great Fortitude - A character with this feat is tougher than normal, gaining a +2 bonus to all Fortitude saving throws.
5: Iron Will - The character's strong presence of mind gives him a +2 bonus to all Will saving throws.
6: Lightning Reflexes - The character's reflexes are faster than normal, granting him a +2 bonus to all Reflex saving throws.
7: Toughness - A character with this feat is tougher than normal, gaining one bonus hit point per level.
9: Vigilant Natural Armor - Gains plus 2 to his natural armor class.
10: Vigilant Natural Healing - Regenerates hit points at a rate of one per round.

src: "You will have noticed how the stairs you came up by vanished behind you and that this room is not falling apart and littered with rubbish, like those downstairs. What you see is not real, but an elaborate illusion, created by the dread spirit who haunts this place, and you will not find it easy to escape. Every time you enter a door or staircase, you will simply be transported to some other room like this, some other random section of this maze of illusions. Once I came here as you, seeking to purge this place of evil, but found myself unable to escape, and as I wandered hopelessly was continually assaulted by phantoms until I eventually fell. Now my corpse rots downstairs and my spirit is trapped here."

幻象（虚假幻觉，魅影幻觉）
等级：吟游诗人 5，幸运 6，术士/法师 6，诡术 6
成分：姿势
施法时间：1 标准动作
距离：近距（8M）
目标/效果：你/一个幻影替身
持续时间：1 轮/等级（可解消） 和 专注 + 3 轮；见文本
豁免检定：无 或 意志不相信（若互动）；见文本
法术抗力：否

你变为隐形（如同进阶隐形，一种魅影幻觉），同时，一个你的幻影替身（如同高等幻影，一种虚假幻觉） 出现。然后你可以自由地去别处，而你的替身则移开。替身出现在范围内，但此后按你的指示移动。你可以使虚假幻觉完美地叠加在你自己的身体上，以便观察者不会注意到一个影像出现而你变为隐形。替身以你的速度移动，可以像真的一样说话和做手势，但它不能攻击或施法，尽管它可以假装这样做。

你可以像给随从一样给它下达动作指令：“跟随” “什么都不做（原地待命）” “攻击（假装攻击）”.

幻影替身持续到你专注于它为止，再加上额外的 3 轮。在你停止专注后，幻影替身继续执行相同的活动直到持续时间结束。进阶隐形持续每等级 1 轮，无论是否专注。
src:
Illusion (Figment, Glamer)
Level: Brd 5, Luck 6, Sor/Wiz 6, Trickery 6
Components: S
Casting Time: 1 standard action
Range: Close (8M)
Target/Effect: You/one illusory double
Duration: 1 round/level (D) and concentration + 3 rounds; see text
Saving Throw: None or Will disbelief (if interacted with); see text
Spell Resistance: No

You become invisible (as improved invisibility, a glamer), and at the same time, an illusory double of you (as major image, a figment) appears. You are then free to go elsewhere while your double moves away. The double appears within range but thereafter moves as you direct it. You can make the figment appear superimposed perfectly over your own body so that observers don't notice an image appearing and you turning invisible. The double moves at your speed and can talk and gesture as if it were real, but it cannot attack or cast spells, though it can pretend to do so.

Actions you can give it as a henchmen is "Follow" "Do nothing (stand ground)" "Attack (Pretend to attack)".

The illusory double lasts as long as you concentrate upon it, plus 3 additional rounds. After you cease concentration, the illusory double continues to carry out the same activity until the duration expires. The improved invisibility lasts for 1 round per level, regardless of concentration.

Azer are dwarf-like beings native to the Elemental Plane of Fire. They wear kilts of brass, bronze or copper and speak an ancient language known as Ignan. Although unfriendly and taciturn, Azer rarely provoke a fight except to relieve a foe of much-treasured gems. Their society is a heavily-regimented one wherein everyone has a designated place. Somewhat xenophobic, only fighters among their kind are likely to venture out among the other planes.

src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
Scions of Dantalion trace their lineage to an ancient, long-forgotten human empire-a civilization in which justice, love, and art reigned supreme. They maintain that the rulers of this realm led their people to such a height of beauty and righteousness that they rivaled the stars of the heavens in the awe they could inspire. The gods saw their accomplishments and grew envious. In their jealous rage, they destroyed the empire and cursed its nobility, decreeing that no one from that line could ever join them in the afterlife. Scions of Dantalion believe themselves to be part of this line, cursed by the gods but blessed by association with Dantalion, the vestige that is the conglomeration of all their ancestors' souls. The scions believe that their destiny is to one day take up the crown, bear the scepter of rulership, and rebuild the empire that could rival the stars.

- Hit Die: d8
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:
Race: Human, Half-elf, or Half-orc
Skills: Lore 2 ranks
Special: Ability to bind Dantalion

CLASS FEATURES:
Level
1:  Favored of Dantalion - Always make a good pact with Dantalion
    Scholarship of Dantalion - Once per day, double the Lore bonus Dantalion grants for one round
2:  Swift Awe of Dantalion - Awe of Dantalion is now a swift action instead of a move action
3:  Overwhelming Thoughts - Daze target of Read Thoughts
4:  Dantalion's Glare - Blind creatures in 30 ft. cone
    Improved Thought Travel - Thought Travel is now a move action
5:  Read Multiple Thoughts - Target multiple enemies at a time with Read Thoughts and Overwhelm Thoughts

Soul Binding: At each level, you gain new soul binds as if you had gained a level in both your soul binding-using class.

Aura of the Sun
Abjuration [Light]
Level: Cleric 4, Paladin 4,
Components: V, S, DF,
Casting Time: 1 standard action
Range: 10 ft.
Area: 10-ft.-radius emanation centered on you
Duration: 1 round/level (D)
Saving Throw: No
Spell Resistance: None

By casting aura of the sun, you fill the area around you with warm, glowing light that eliminates natural shadows and hampers magical darkness. Any creature attempting to cast a spell from the shadow subschool or a spell with the darkness descriptor within an aura of the sun must succeed on a caster level check (DC 11 + your caster level), or the spell fails. Areas of magical darkness originating from 3rd-level or lower spells and effects are temporarily suppressed when overlapping with an aura of the sun. Creatures that take penalties in bright light also take them while within an aura of the sun, and an undead creature takes 1d6 points of positive energy damage at the end of its turn every round that it spends within the spell's area.Furthermore, any creature attempting to hide within the aura takes a -4 penalty on Hide checks.

This effect is centered on you and moves with you.

Anyone who enters the aura immediately becomes subject to its effect, but creatures that leave are no longer affected.

Luminous armor sheds light equivalent to a daylight spell and dispels darkness spells of 2nd level or lower with which it comes into contact.  In addition, the armor causes opponents to take a -4 penalty on melee attacks made against the target.  This penalty stacks with the penalty suffered by creatures sensitive to bright light (such as dark elves).

Sacrifice: 1d2 points of Strength damage.

src:

Descriptors: Mind-Affecting  
Classes: Totemist 
Chakra: Hands (totem) 
Saving Throw: None

A powerful set of retractable, catlike claws forms over your hands. These magical claws seem almost alive, and they perfectly follow every move of your own hands and fingers.

While wearing sphinx claws, you gain a +1 competence bonus on Strength checks and Strength-based skill checks, such as Climb and Jump checks and checks made to bull rush an opponent. 

Essentia: Every point of essentia you invest in your sphinx claws increases the competence bonus by 1. 

Chakra Bind (Hands) 

Your hands become one with the claws that surround them, overlarge for your size. The most profound change, however, is in your proficiency in combat-a powerful urge grows within you to leap at your foes, tearing with claws and teeth until your prey lies motionless in your savage grip.

When you use the charge action, at the end of your charge you can make a full attack using any natural weapons you possess.

Chakra Bind (Totem)

Your hands become one with the claws that surround them, overlarge for your size. You find you can use them to tear at your foes, and with that ability comes a powerful desire to put these tools to use. Will you temper that bloodlust with the wisdom of the gynosphinx or the nobility of the androsphinx? Or will you give in to it completely, rampaging like a hieracosphinx?

You can use your sphinx claws as natural weapons that deal 1d8 points of damage plus your Strength modifier. For every point of essentia you invest in your sphinx claws, you gain a +1 enhancement bonus on your attack rolls and damage rolls with the claws.

src:
Psychokinesis [see text]
Level: Psion/wilder 2
Manifesting Time: 1 standard action
Range: Medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./ level)
Duration: Instantaneous
Saving Throw: Reflex half or Fortitude half; see text
Power Resistance: Yes
Power Points: 3
Metapsionics: Chain, Empower, Maximize, Twin

Upon manifesting this power, you choose cold, electricity, fire, or sonic. You project a solid blast of energy of the chosen type at a target, dealing it 2d6 points of damage. In addition, if a subject of up to one size category larger than you fails a Strength check (DC equal to the save DC of this power), the driving force of the energy blast pushes it back 5 feet plus another 5 feet for every 5 points of damage it takes. If a wall or other solid object prevents the subject from being pushed back, the subject instead slams into the object and takes an extra 2d6 points of damage from the impact (no save).

Cold: A blast of this energy type deals +1 point of damage per die (damage from impact remains at 2d6 points). The saving throw to reduce damage from a cold push is a Fortitude save instead of a Reflex save.
Electricity: Manifesting a blast of this energy type provides a +2 bonus to the save DC and a +2 bonus on manifester level checks for the purpose of overcoming power resistance.
Fire: A blast of this energy type deals +1 point of damage per die (damage from impact remains at 2d6 points).
Sonic: A blast of this energy type deals -1 point of damage per die (damage from impact remains at 2d6 points) and ignores an object's hardness.

This power's subtype is the same as the type of energy you manifest.

Augment: For every 2 additional power points you spend, this power's damage increases by one die (d6) and its save DC increases by 1. The damage increase applies to both the initial blast and any damage from impact with an object.

dst: 哈马德终于把注意力转向了我发现的关于变形蛛组建邪恶类人生物军队攻击卡林杉的阴谋。他收到了证实我发现的报告：地精在米尔森林集结，兽人在行进山脉集结。他建议了两个受到威胁的地点，我可以前往那里增援已经驻扎在那里的士兵：米尔森林附近的特布纳斯村，以及行进山脉山麓的阿哈兹堡。我应该前往城门，从那里向东前往其中一个或另一个地点，最终或许两个都去。\n\n米尔森林的地精和来自行进山脉的兽人都已经解决，这两群生物都不应该再构成太大威胁。此外，在其中一支军队的残骸中，我发现了一张地图，标记了蜘蛛沼泽中的一个位置，被指示为策划这场战争的变形蛛的主要基地。有了这些信息，我也许能够消灭变形蛛的首领，或许能一劳永逸地结束这个威胁。我应该把这个情报带给哈马德，看看他想让我怎么处理。
src: Hamad has finally turned his attention to the plot I discovered of aranea raising armies of evil humanoids to attack Calimshan. He has received reports confirming my discoveries: goblins massing in the Forest of Mir, and orcs in the Marching Mountains. He has suggested two threatened points that I could travel to in order to reinforce the soldiers already there: the village of Tebnas, near the Forest of Mir, and Fort Akhaz, in the foothills of the Marching Mountains. I should make my way to the city gates and from there travel east to one or the other of these locations, and in time perhaps both.\n\nBoth the goblins in the Forest of Mir and the orcs coming from the Marching Mountains have been dealt with, and neither group should pose much of a threat anymore. What's more, amongst the wreckage of one of these armies, I found a map marking a location in the Spider Swamp that is indicated as the main base of the aranea orchestrating this war. With this information, I may be able to take out the aranea leaders and perhaps end this threat once and for all. I should bring this intelligence to Hamad and see what he wants me to do with it.

When we leave, we're heading out towards the Nelanther Isles to raid a pirate base whose location we've recently discovered. You might even want to help us with that, seeing as you're adventurers. Once we've taken care of that, we'll head to Zazesspur in Tethyr. We could drop you off there if you like and you could make your own way north from there. I don't know where we'll be headed after that, though, depends on what news we hear and what bounties on pirates get posted. So we might be able to get you even further north than that."

dst: <StartHighlight>[愿意使用道德上可疑的手段：无序邪恶 +1]</Start> "我不得不对这种态度表示同情。为了改革这座城市，我几乎没有什么不愿意做的。哈马德的想法不同。他决心在法律框架内行事，但他也不愿为了通过这种手段真正获得政治影响力而虚与委蛇。我不太愿意遵循这种愚蠢而矛盾的道路，所以我们走上了不同的路。但你提起过去的回忆，让我分心了。我想我已经说得比你需要知道的更多了。"他转向他的仆人。"去通知卡齐娅我们有客人。"
src: <StartHighlight>[For a willingness to use morally dubious methods: Lawless Evil +1]</Start> "I cannot but sympathize with such an attitude. There is very little I would not be willing to do to reform this city. Hamad felt differently. He was determined to work within the law, yet he also had no stomach for the dissembling needed if one is actually to gain political influence by such means. I was less willing to follow such a foolish and contradictory course, and so we went on different paths. But you have distracted me by bringing up memories of the past. I think I have already said more than you need to know." He turns to his servant. "Go inform Kadzia of our guest."
