dst: 扎拉拉和我逃离了加尔哈德尔庄园，穿过下水道前往一个码头，据说那里有一艘友好的船在等我们。虽然我们眼前的目的地是这艘船“瓦尔库尔之剑”所前往的地方，但扎拉拉认为我们最终应该设法进入烛堡的大图书馆。烛堡内有一本学者达尔泽斯·谢马尔所著的书，其中包含了关于泽法德之剑最完整的信息。扎拉拉相信这本书能让她重铸目前断裂的剑，然后以最大力量挥舞它。我们很可能需要剑的力量来面对阿兹古尔卡，他很快就会自由并寻求扎拉拉的死亡。\n\n要进入烛堡，我们首先需要找到一本价值极高的书卷捐赠给图书馆，因为这是进入的条件。目前还不清楚在哪里能找到合适的书，但我们必须先做到这一点，才能实现我们的目标。现在，我们只能登上瓦尔库尔之剑，看看有什么机会出现。我应该去和船长谈谈。
src: Zarala and I have fled the Galhadr Estate, heading through the sewers to a dock where, I am told, we will find a friendly ship waiting for us. While our immediate destination will be wherever this ship, the Sword of Valkur, is headed, Zarala believes that ultimately we should seek to enter the Great Library of Candlekeep. Within Candlekeep is a book by the scholar Darzeth Shemal that constitutes the most complete repository of information concerning the Sword of Zefad. Zarala believes that this book will enable her to reforge the currently broken sword, and then wield it at maximum power. We are likely to need the power of the sword to face Azghulkar, who will soon be free and seeking Zarala's death.\n\nTo get into Candlekeep we will first need to find a tome of great value we can donate to the library, since that is a requirement of entrance. It is not clear where we can find a suitable book, but we will have to do this first before we can can gain access to our objective. For now, we can only board the Sword of Valkur and see what opportunities develop. I should go speak to the ship's captain.

化身圣像

描述符：混乱，邪恶，善良，或秩序  
职业：化身 
脉轮：灵魂 
豁免检定：无

你在自己周围聚集魂能，形成一个包裹你自身的第二躯体，一个叠加在你身体，衣物和护甲之上的实体形态。在形态上，它类似于你阵营中最强大的勇士之一：史拉蟾，制裁者，天使，或尤格罗斯。它的动作--甚至面部表情--都与你的完美同步，因此在各方面你都显得是你阵营理想的威严化身。

与其他魂融物不同，化身圣像在不投入魂能时不会提供任何好处。

魂能：将魂能投入你的化身圣像会根据你的阵营给予你特定的好处。
混乱：你在此魂融物中投入的每点魂能都会使你的远程攻击检定获得+1洞察加值。
邪恶：你在此魂融物中投入的每点魂能都会使你的近战伤害检定获得+2洞察加值。
善良：你在此魂融物中投入的每点魂能都会使你的护甲等级获得+1洞察加值。
秩序：你在此魂融物中投入的每点魂能都会使你的近战攻击检定获得+1洞察加值。

脉轮绑定（灵魂） 

你的身体转变为你的化身圣像的外观。它的手与你的手，它的脚与你的脚，它的心与你的心之间不再有任何区别。你被灌注了你阵营最纯粹的本质--它充满你的灵魂并激励你行动。同时，它赋予你更强大的力量来帮助你践行你的信念。

你根据你的阵营获得一项能力。
混乱：你的基础陆地速度获得+30英尺的增强加值。
邪恶：你的基础陆地速度获得+30英尺的增强加值。
善良：你的基础陆地速度获得+30英尺的增强加值。
秩序：你获得对眩晕，麻痹和震慑的免疫，以及对任何会使你减速的魔法效果的免疫。
src:
Incarnate Avatar

Descriptors: Chaotic, evil, good, or lawful  
Classes: Incarnate 
Chakra: Soul 
Saving Throw: None

You gather incarnum around you to form a second body encasing your own, a physical form superimposed over your body, clothing, and armor. In form, it resembles one of the most powerful champions of your alignment: a slaad, inevitable, angel, or yugoloth. Its movements-even its facial expressions-are in perfect synchronization with your own, so that in every way you appear to be the imposing avatar of your alignment's ideals.

Unlike other soulmelds, the incarnate avatar provides no benefit without the investment of essentia. 

Essentia: Investing essentia in your incarnate avatar gives you a specific benefit depending on your alignment. 
Chaos: You gain a +1 insight bonus on ranged attack rolls for every point of essentia that you invest in this soulmeld. 
Evil: You gain a +2 insight bonus on melee damage rolls for every point of essentia that you invest in this soulmeld. 
Good: You gain a +1 insight bonus to your Armor Class for every point of essentia that you invest in this soulmeld. 
Law: You gain a +1 insight bonus on melee attack rolls for every point of essentia that you invest in this soulmeld.

Chakra Bind (Soul) 

Your body transforms into the appearance of your incarnate avatar. There is no longer any distinction between its hands and yours, its feet and yours, its heart and yours. You are imbued with the purest essence of your alignment-it fills your soul and spurs you to action. At the same time, it grants you greater power to help you live out your convictions.

You gain an ability based on your alignment. 
Chaos: You gain an enhancement bonus of +30 feet to your base land speed. 
Evil: You gain an enhancement bonus of +30 feet to your base land speed. 
Good: You gain an enhancement bonus of +30 feet to your base land speed. 
Law: You gain immunity to daze, paralysis, and stun, as well as to any magical effect that would slow you.

Prerequisite: Scout level 10
Using nonvisual senses, such as acute smell or hearing, a creature with blindsense notices things it cannot see. The creature usually does not need to make Spot or Listen checks to pinpoint the location of a creature within range of its blindsense ability, provided that it has line of effect to that creature. Any opponent the creature cannot see still has total concealment against the creature with blindsense, and the creature still has the normal miss chance when attacking foes that have concealment. Visibility still affects the movement of a creature with blindsense. A creature with blindsense is still denied its Dexterity bonus to Armor Class against attacks from creatures it cannot see.

Githyanki are tall, gaunt humanoids from an ancient line of being from the Astral Plane. Built roughly like humans, they are elaborate dressers and have a passion for fine weapons. They have yellowish skin and russet hair, with pointed ears that resemble those of an elf but are serrated at the back. The gith empire arose from slave rebellion against their master mind flayers. Once free, the gith split into two distinct races - the githyanki and githzerai. The githyanki live within massive fortresses adrift in the Astral Plane and have been known to form alliances with Red Dragons.

Favored Class (Fighter): A multiclass githyanki's fighter class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

- Darkvision: Githyanki are able to see in the dark.
- Spell Resistance: Innate spell resistance of 5, plus 1 per character level.
- Spell-like Abilities: 3/day - Blur, Daze. Caster level 3rd. The DC is Charisma-based.
- Outsider: Githyanki are considered Outsiders for the purpose of spells.

src:
Leraje, the Green Herald
  
Once a favored servant of the primary deity of the elves, Leraje allowed her pride to become her downfall. Leraje gives her summoners the ability to bring a bow to hand at will, to fire it with accuracy, and to damage a foe's sense of self with it. In addition, she gives her hosts keen vision in darkness and skill at hiding.

Vestige Level: 1st
Binding DC: 15
Special Requirement: To summon Leraje, you must break an arrow (by having one in your arrow slot). In addition, Leraje hates Amon for some unknown reason and will not answer your call if you are already bound to him.

Influence: While influenced by Leraje, she requires that you not attack any elf or creature of elven blood, including half-elves and members of the various elf subraces, such as drow.

Granted Abilities: 
You gain supernatural powers related to Leraje's skills in life, as well as the ability to fire arrows that literally wound your target's pride.

Hide Bonus: You gain a +4 competence bonus on Hide checks.

Low-Light Vision: You gain low-light vision. 

Point Blank Shot: You gain the benefit of the Point Blank Shot feat.

Ricochet: As a standard action, you can make a ranged attack against two adjacent targets. 

Weapon Proficiency: While bound to Leraje, you are proficient with the longbow and shortbow. If you were already proficient with any of these weapons, you instead gain a +1 competence bonus on attack rolls with them.

"你的理由无疑足够充分，因为我曾经是符文会的代理人，但我不再是了。我最初为他们工作时并不知道我的雇主是谁，但最终我得知了，然后……好吧，这么说吧，虽然我算不上最讲道德的人，但为那个组织里的怪物工作，即使对我这样的人来说也太过分了。这就是为什么我必须如此警惕：我以前的一些雇主可能会担心我知道得太多，而乐于看到我死。这也是我住在神殿附近的原因：这样的圣地对任何可能想来拜访我的不死生物来说都会非常不舒服。"
src: "Your reasons are doubtless good enough for I was once an agent of the Rune, but I am no longer. When I first went to work for them I did not know who my employers were, but I eventually learned and then...well let's just say that though I have not been the most scrupulous of men, working for the monsters found in that organization became too much even for someone like me. This is why I must be so wary: some of my former employers might worry that I know too much, and be happy to see me dead. It is also why I live so near a Temple: such holy ground would be most uncomfortable for any undead who might wish to pay me a visit."

阿加雷斯，被背叛的真相
  
阿加雷斯因一项他并未犯下的罪行而死于盟友之手。作为一名残魂，他不仅赋予缚灵者削弱敌人并将其击倒的能力，还使他的召唤者无所畏惧。

残魂等级：4级
缚灵DC: 22
特殊要求：你必须在土地或一片未加工的石地上绘制阿加雷斯的印记。

影响：阿加雷斯生前的忠诚以及他对副官们背叛的愤怒已化为对虚假的仇恨。当受阿加雷斯影响时，你说话直率且充满自信。你无法使用唬骗技能，当被直接提问时，你必须真实而直接地回答。

授予能力：
阿加雷斯赋予你提升自己和盟友的力量，使你脚下的土地震颤，并让敌人变得虚弱。

土与气精通：你在攻击检定和武器伤害检定上获得+1加值。

震地之踏：作为一个标准动作，你可以跺脚，使10尺范围内的所有生物进行反射豁免，否则倒地。一旦你使用了此能力，5轮内无法再次使用。你和你召唤的土元素（见下文）永远不会因使用此能力而倒地。

元素伙伴：你可以召唤一个土元素来陪伴你并为你战斗。如果你失去了你的元素，1小时内无法再次召唤。你能召唤的土元素体型取决于你的有效缚灵者等级。11级以下，小型。15级以下，中型。19级以下，大型。19级及以上，超大型。

恐惧免疫：你免疫恐惧。
src:
Agares, Truth Betrayed
  
Agares died at the hands of his allies for a wrong he did not commit. As a vestige, not only does he give binders the ability to weaken foes and knock them prone, but he also makes his summoner fearless.

Vestige Level: 4th
Binding DC: 22
Special Requirement: You must draw Agares's seal upon either the earth or an expanse of unworked stone.

Influence: Agares's loyalty in life and his anger at the betrayal perpetrated by his lieutenants has become a hatred of falsehood. When influenced by Agares, you speak forthrightly and with confidence. You cannot use the Bluff skill, and when asked a direct question, you must answer truthfully and directly.

Granted Abilities: 
Agares gives you the power to exalt yourself and your allies, to make the earth tremble beneath your feet, and to render foes weak.

Earth and Air Mastery: You gain a +1 bonus on attack rolls and weapon damage rolls.

Earthshaking Step: As a standard action, you can stomp on the ground, causing every creature within 10 feet of you to make a Reflex save or fall prone. Once you have used this ability, you cannot do so again for 5 rounds. You and your summoned earth elemental (see below) are never knocked prone by the use of this ability.

Elemental Companion: You can summon an earth elemental to accompany you and fight for you. If you lose your elemental, you cannot summon it again for 1 hour. The size of the earth elemental you can summon depends on your effective binder level. Below 11th, small. Below 15th, medium. Below 19th, large. 19th and above, huge.

Fear Immunity: You have immunity to fear.

原生于霜落之地和极北地区的半身人被称为苔原半身人。他们在外貌和生活方式上与典型的半身人相似，但在他们通常的流浪路线上，会以永久性建筑来补充他们的游牧生活方式。苔原半身人随着季节变化从一个空无一人的村庄迁移到另一个空无一人的村庄，这并不罕见。

苔原半身人属性调整：+2 敏捷，-2 力量。
偏好职业（巡林客）：兼职苔原半身人的巡林客职业在决定是否因兼职而受到经验值惩罚时不计入。

特殊能力：

- 小型体型：
 攻击检定获得 +1 体型加值。
 AC 获得 +1 体型加值。
 躲藏检定获得 +4 体型加值。
- 技能亲和（潜行）：潜行检定获得 +2 种族加值。
- 技能亲和（聆听）：聆听检定获得 +2 种族加值。
- 技能亲和（跳跃）：跳跃检定获得 +2 种族加值。
- 幸运：所有豁免检定获得 +1 幸运加值。
- 无畏：对抗 '恐惧' 子学派的法咒和效果的豁免检定获得 +2 士气加值。
- 精准投掷：使用投掷武器进行的攻击检定获得 +1 种族加值。
- 半身人：在法咒效果方面，苔原半身人被视为半身人。

特殊：半身人是小型生物，因此他们永远无法使用以下大型武器：重剑，巨锤，双刃剑，双头斧，巨斧，巨剑，戟，重型连枷，长棍，镰刀和矛。
src:
Halflings native to the frostfell and far northern regions are known as tundra halflings.  They are like the typical halfling in both appearance and lifestyle, but supplement their nomadic ways with permanent structures along their normal paths of wandering.  It's not uncommon for tundra halflings to move from empty village to empty village along with the change in seasons.

Tundra Halfling Ability Adjustments: +2 Dex, -2 Str.
Favored Class (Ranger): A multiclass tundra halfling's ranger class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

- Small Stature:
 +1 size bonus to attack rolls.
 +1 size bonus to AC.
 +4 size bonus to Hide checks.
- Skill Affinity (Move Silently): +2 racial bonus to Move Silently checks.
- Skill Affinity (Listen): +2 racial bonus to Listen checks.
- Skill Affinity (Jump): +2 racial bonus to Jump checks.
- Lucky: +1 luck bonus to all saving throws.
- Fearless: +2 morale bonus to saving throws against spells and effects of the 'Fear' subtype.
- Good Aim: +1 racial bonus to attack rolls made with throwing weapons.
- Halfling: Tundra Halflings are considered Halflings for the purpose of spells.

Special: Halflings are small creatures and as such they can never use the following Large weapons: bastard sword, dire mace, two-bladed sword, double axe, greataxe, greatsword, halberd, heavy flail, quarterstaff, scythe and spear.

src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
Though incarnum is a potent tool, it is still a physical medium-an abstraction that stands between its wielder and the true power of the soul. The incandescent champion seeks to dispense with barriers and obstacles both tangible and intangible so that she can touch the cosmic soul with her unveiled body, mind, and spirit. By embracing the ultimate, irreducible energy of the multiverse in this manner, she becomes a living flame-a brilliant spirit whose body is little more than a shell for her true form. The strength of her soul allows her to withstand almost any peril, scour her foes with deadly luminous blasts, and overcome the physical shackles of the world around her toaccomplish miraculous feats. An incandescent champion acknowledges that every creature harbors a spark of the universal spirit, and she believes that the beings known as deities simply possess a greater share of this precious spark than most others. She reveres and respects the gods but does not offer them worship. The incandescent champion considers it her responsibility to protect and aid less enlightened creatures and to serve as aforce for good in the world.

- Hit Die: d10
- Proficiencies: Incandescent Champions gain no new proficiencies
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:
Alignment: Any good
Base Attack Bonus: +6
Essentia Pool: 1
Skills: Concentration 4 ranks

CLASS FEATURES:

Level
1:  Incandescent Strike - Invest essentia to increase damage
2:  Fast Healing (self) - Invest essentia to heal self
3:  Unbearable Countenance - Invest essentia to shake enemies
4:  Incarnum Overload 1/day - Increase max essentia capacity by charisma modifier 
5:  Incandescent Ray - Invest essentia to shoot ray
6:  
7:  Incarnum Overload 2/day
8:  Incandescent Aura - Invest essentia to damage enemies every round
9:  Fast Healing (allies) - Invest essentia to heal self and allies
10: Transcendence - Change race to outsider, become incorporeal 1/day
    Incarnum Overload 3/day
    
Essentia: The Incandescent Champion gains one extra point of essentia at 1st, 2nd, 3rd, 5th, 6th, 7th, 9th, and 10th levels, for a total of 8 points at level 10. It does not increase meldshaping level, melds known, meld binds, or any other aspect of meldshaping.

提尔神殿已派遣一队牧师和圣武士进入神殿区下方的下水道，试图对抗最近变得具有攻击性、在那里制造麻烦的鼠人。他们至今未归。提尔神殿的高级牧师阿达拉斯·埃夫岑要求我进入下水道，查明他们遭遇了什么，并在必要时协助他们。莎尔神殿的女祭司费拉莎希望我跟随他们之后，查明他们的天命，并确保他们无一能活着离开下水道。我必须决定是帮助这些提尔信徒还是杀死他们。

被派往下水道的提尔信徒队伍已全军覆没。费拉莎听到这个消息很高兴，并给了我丰厚的奖励。此事仍可报告给阿达拉斯。
src:
The Temple of Tyr has dispatched a group of clerics and paladins into the sewers beneath the temple district in an attempt to fight the newly aggressive wererats causing trouble there. They have yet to report back. Adaras Efzen, a high-ranking cleric in the Temple of Tyr, has asked me to enter the sewers and determine what has happened to them, assisting them if necessary. Ferazha, priestess at the temple of Shar, wants me to follow in their wake, determine their fate, and insure that none of them make it out of the sewer alive. I will have to decide whether I wish to assist these Tyrrans or kill them.

The entire party of Tyrrans dispatched to the sewers has met its end. Ferazha was happy to hear of this, and rewarded me well. It could still be reported to Adaras.

dst:
“黑暗”是一个后天或先天模板，可以添加到任何生物（以下称为基础生物）. 

黑暗生物的颜色通常比其物质位面版本暗淡得多，皮肤色调和毛发高光更偏灰色和黑色。一般来说，它们的重量也更轻，仿佛其本体的一部分只是阴影物质。

黑暗生物拥有基础生物的所有统计数据和特殊能力，除非此处另有说明。

体型和类型：类型和体型不变。

速度：所有移动方式 +10 英尺。

特殊性质：黑暗生物保留基础生物的所有特殊性质，并获得以下内容。
- 黑暗视觉 60 英尺。
- 在视线内躲藏（Ex）
- 寒冷抗力 10
- 微光视觉。

技能：躲藏 +8 和潜行 +6. 

等级调整：+1。
src:
"Dark" is an acquired or inherited template that can be added to any creature (referred to hereafter as the base creature). 

Dark creatures tend to be much duller in color, with more gray and black skin tones and hair highlights, than their Material Plane versions. In general, they also weigh less, as if part of their very substance was mere shadow stuff. 

A dark creature has all the base creature's statistics and special abilities except as noted here. 

Size and Type: Type and size are unchanged. 

Speed: +10 feet to all modes of movement. 

Special Qualities: A dark creature retains all the special qualities of the base creature and also gains the following. 
- Darkvision 60 ft. 
- Hide in Plain Sight (Ex)
- Resistance to cold 10
- Low-light vision. 

Skills: Hide +8 and Move Silently +6. 

Level Adjustment: +1.

src:
School: Necromancy
Level: Clr 1, sor/wiz 1
Components: V S, F
Range: 60 ft.
Area: Cone-shaped emanation
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 min./level (D)
Saving Throw: None
Spell Resistance: No

You can sense the presence of creatures who bear a necrotic cyst (see spell of the same name). The amount of information revealed depends on how long you remain within range of a creature that triggers your cyst awareness:

1st Round: Presence or absence of creatures with necrotic cysts.
2nd Round: Number of creatures bearing necrotic cysts in the area.
3rd Round: The location of each creature bearing a necrotic cyst. If a cyst-bearer is outside your line of sight, then you discern its direction but not its exact location.

Focus: The caster must possess a Mother Cyst.

永恒的折磨
死灵系 [邪恶]
等级：痛苦 9
成分：言语，姿势，法器
施法时间：1 动作
距离：近距（25 英尺 + 5 英尺/2 等级）
目标：一个生物
持续时间：永久
豁免检定：强韧部分
法术抗力：是

受术者的身体被扭曲变形，永远遭受着极度痛苦的折磨。受术者陷入无助状态，但只要法咒持续，它就会被维持生命，无需食物，饮水或空气。受术者不会衰老--这更能确保真正永恒的难以想象的折磨。受术者直到所有属性值降至 0（除了体质，保持在 1）.受术者无法治疗或再生。最后，受术者完全无法感知周围环境，除了极度的痛苦外对一切毫无感觉。

一次强韧豁免检定就是目标与这个可怕法咒之间的唯一屏障。然而，即使豁免检定成功，目标
仍会感到可怕（但暂时）的痛苦。目标立即受到 5d6 点伤害，并在攻击检定，豁免检定，
技能检定和属性检定上承受 -4 环境减值，持续每施法者等级 1 轮。
src:
Eternity of Torture
Necromancy [Evil]
Level: Pain 9
Components: V, S, DF
Casting Time: 1 action
Range: Close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target: One creature
Duration: Permanent
Saving Throw: Fortitude partial
Spell Resistance: Yes

The subject's body is twisted and warped, wracked forever with excruciating pain. The subject is rendered helpless, but-as long as the spell continues -it is sustained and has no need for food, drink, or air. The subject does not age-all the better to ensure a true eternity of unimaginable torture. The subject until all scores are reduced to 0 (except Constitution, which stays at 1). The subject cannot heal or regenerate. Lastly, the subject is completely unaware of its surroundings, insensate to anything but the excruciating pain.

A single Fortitude saving throw is all that stands between a target and this horrible spell. However, even if the saving throw is successful, the target
still feels terrible (but temporary) pain. The target takes 5d6 points of damage immediately and takes a -4 circumstance penalty on attack rolls, saving throws,
skill checks, and ability checks for 1 round per level of the caster.

src:
Stone Dragon (Stance)
Level: Crusader 5, swordsage 5, warblade 5
Prerequisite: Two Stone Dragon maneuvers
Initiation Action: 1 swift action
Range: Personal
Target: You
Duration: Stance

You swing your weapon in an wide, deadly arc that slams into your foe with incredible force. Only your mastery of the Stone Dragon techniques allows you to make such reckless blows without losing your footing.

While you are in this stance, you deal damage as if you were one size larger than normal, to a maximum of Large. This benefit improves your weapon and unarmed strike damage. If does not confer any of the other benefits or drawbacks of a change in size, such as a modifier to ability scores or AC, or an improved reach.
This stance immediately ends if you move more than 5 feet for any reason such as from a bull rush attack, a telekinesis spell, and so forth.

A rough stone of blazing red hangs at the center of a loose belt around your waist. You feel warmth spreading from the stone into your body, though it is not enough to ward off extreme cold. Chakra Bind (Totem)

The heat of the blazing stone at your waist spreads through your body, lashing out through your attacks at any opponent you face. When you enter combat, your skin glows red with the fiery power coursing through your veins.

Your natural weapons or unarmed strikes deal an additional 1d4 points of fire damage per point of essentia you invest in your heart of fire.

It might be good to hold on to this paper. The information it contains would surely be of interest to the Calimport authorities. Alternatively, it would help someone expecting to be involved in illegal activities in that city to make a useful contact.

dst: 当一个古老的王国受到一名指挥着骷髅战士军团的巫妖威胁时，一队英雄被派出去寻找一件神器。根据更古老的传说，这件神器能赋予王国击退亡灵大军所需的力量。寻找这件神器的任务十分危险。只有一位英雄返回，而他很快就因伤势过重而死。临终前，他声称任务成功了，尽管他什么也没带回来。人们认为他因磨难而发疯，王国陷入绝望。直到这位英雄被抬往坟墓时，他的部分血液碰巧洒在了田里的一把连枷上。连枷立刻燃起火焰，显示出它新获得的力量。虽然英雄无法带回神器本身，但它的力量不知怎么转移到了他的体内。由于冒险队伍中无人生还，神器本身为何无法被带回，以及为何找到了这种替代方法，确切原因永远无法查明。无论如何，许多士兵纷纷将武器浸入英雄的血液中，装备了这些被转化的武器后，王国的军队得以将巫妖的骷髅砸成碎片。王国得救了，尽管这仅仅是通过牺牲它最伟大的勇士们换来的。
src: When an ancient kingdom was threatened by a lich commanding legions of skeletal warriors, a band of heroes was sent out on a quest to recover an artifact that, according to an even more ancient legend, would give the kingdom the power needed to fight off an undead army. The quest for this artifact proved perilous. Only one hero returned, and he soon died of his wounds. Before his death, he claimed that the quest had succeeded, even though he had brought nothing back with him. It was assumed that he had been driven mad by his ordeals, and the kingdom despaired, until, while the hero was being carried to his grave, some of his blood happened to spill onto a threshing flail left lying in the fields. The flail burst immediately into flame, a sign of its new powers. While the hero was unable to bring back the artifact itself, its power had somehow been transferred into his body. As there were no survivors of the adventuring party, the precise reasons why the artifact could not itself be returned, and how this alternative was found instead, could never be determined. Regardless, many more soldiers came to dip their weapons in the hero's blood, and, armed with these transformed implements, the kingdom's armies were able to bash the lich's skeletons to pieces. The realm was saved, albeit only by the sacrifice of its greatest champions.

src: A pool of sewer water, filthy and filled with trash, laps at your feet. You will also not be able to swim if you are carrying too much weight.\n\n<StartAction>[Note: To attempt escape by this method, the total weight in your inventory must not exceed 20 lbs. multiplied by your Strenghth Modifier (with a modifier of less than 1 treated as 1), so you may need to temporarily drop some of what you are carrying. (If you get out, you can re-enter by using the external lever, and recover any discarded items.) You risk a death by drowning on a failed CON check. Even if successful, you will end up covered with sewage, which will reduce your charisma for 24 hours (or until rested or restored).]</Start>

src:
Eye of the Beholder
Transmutation [Evil]
Level: Sor/Wiz 7
Components: V S
Casting Time: 1 action
Range: Personal
Target: Caster
Duration: 1 round/level

One of the caster's eyes grows out of her head on an eyestalk, becoming like that of a beholder. Due to the mobility of the eye, the caster gains a +2 circumstance bonus on Spot checks. More important, the eye has one of the beholder's eye powers,
determined randomly. The caster can use this power as a standard action during the spell's duration.

Each type of eye produces an effect identical to that of a spell cast by a 13th level caster, but it follows the rules for a ray (see Aiming a Spell in Chapter 10 of the Player's Handbook). All of these effects have a range of 150 feet and a save
DC of 18.

Roll 1d10 to see which eye the caster gains.

1d10     Eye Effect

1        Charm Person: Target must make a Will save
         or be affected as though by the spell.

2        Charm Monster: Target must make a Will save
         or be affected as though by the spell.

3        Sleep: As the spell, except that it affects
         one creature with any number of Hit Dice.
         Target must make a Will save to resist.

4        Flesh to Stone: Target must make a Fortitude
         save or be affected as though by the spell.

5        Disintegrate: Target must make a Fortitude
         save or be affected as though by the spell.

6        Fear: As the spell, except that it targets
         one creature. Target must make a Will save
         or be affected as though by the spell.

7        Slow: As the spell, except that it affects
         one creature. Target must make a Will save
         to resist.

8        Inflict Moderate Wounds: As the spell, dealing
         2d8+10 points of damage (Will half).

9        Finger of Death: Target must make a Fortitude
         save or be slain as though by the spell. The
         target   takes 3d6+13 points of damage if his
         save succeeds.

src:
Abjuration
Level: Clr 2, Pal 2, Protection 2
Components: V, S, F
Casting Time: 1 standard action
Range: Close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target: One creature
Duration: 1 hour/level (D)
Saving Throw: Will negates (harmless)
Spell Resistance: Yes (harmless)

This spell wards the subject and creates a mystic connection between you and the subject so that some of its wounds are transferred to you. The subject gains a +1 deflection bonus to AC and a +1 resistance bonus on saves. Additionally, the subject takes only half damage from all wounds and attacks (including that dealt by special abilities) that deal hit point damage. The amount of damage not taken by the warded creature is taken by you. Forms of harm that do not involve hit points, such as charm effects, temporary ability damage, level draining, and death effects, are not affected. If the subject suffers a reduction of hit points from a lowered Constitution score, the reduction is not split with you because it is not hit point damage. When the spell ends, subsequent damage is no longer divided between the subject and you, but damage already split is not reassigned to the subject.

If you and the subject of the spell move out of range of each other, the spell ends.

Focus: A pair of platinum rings (worth at least 50 gp each) worn by both you and the warded creature.

NOTE: This spell does not stack and applies damage to the last caster (I think, actually depends on the order of the applied effects).

src: As I was approaching Fort Akhaz in the Marching Mountains, I came across a messenger traveling from there with dire news: the fort is being besieged by a horde of orcs of the Blazing Axes tribe and their ogre allies. It is doubtful that I could break through the siege cordon to reach the fort, so if I am to do anything useful here it would be best to operate on the flanks of the orc army, reached either by traveling along the nearby river to the west or the woods to the east, attacking patrols and outlying forces. I also might be able to make my way to the north and raid the caves the orcs came from in the first place, with most of them absent and around the fort. This should induce the main orc army to send out detachments to try to hunt me down, and perhaps weaken it enough that the siege could be broken.

奥索斯，呼啸黑暗之主
    
古老而不可知，奥索斯赋予其召唤者感知不可见之物的力量，愚弄他人视觉，并将呼吸化为能言语或剥皮蚀骨的风。
  
残灵等级：8级
束缚DC: 35
特殊要求：你必须在明亮光照区域内召唤奥索斯。
  
影响：受奥索斯影响时，你厌恶黑暗区域和巨大噪音。虽然你能忍受这些情况，但它们会给你带来恐慌感并让你呼吸短促。奥索斯要求你始终携带一个亮度至少等同于蜡烛的活跃光源，并且不得遮盖它或让它变暗超过1轮。此外，奥索斯要求你只能低声说话。
  
授予能力：
奥索斯赋予你盲视，移位，以及可作为武器使用的喷吐武器。

盲视：你获得盲视。

移位：你以弯曲光线的幻术包围自己，使他人难以推测你的真实位置。任何针对你的近战或远程攻击都有50%的失手几率。

旋风吐息：作为一个标准动作，你可以呼出一道60尺锥形的蚀骨风暴。你的旋风吐息造成每束缚者等级1d6点伤害。区域内的每个生物都可以尝试反射豁免以减半伤害，并且还必须成功通过强韧豁免，否则被击倒并远离你1d4?0尺。一旦你使用了此能力，你在5轮内无法再次使用。
src:
Orthos, Sovereign of the Howling Dark
    
Ancient and unknowable, Orthos gives its summoners the power to sense what they cannot see, to fool the sight of others, and to turn their breath into wind that can speak or scour flesh from bones.
  
Vestige Level: 8th
Binding DC: 35
Special Requirement: You must summon Orthos within an area of bright illumination.
  
Influence: While influenced by Orthos, you are averse to darkened areas and loud noises. Although you can endure such conditions, they give you a sense of panic and make you short of breath. Orthos requires that you always carry an active light source with a brightness at least equal to that of a candle, and that you not cover it or allow it to be darkened for more than 1 round. Additionally, Orthos requires that you speak only in a whisper.
  
Granted Abilities: 
Orthos gives you blindsight, displacement, and a breath weapon that you can use as a weapon.

Blindsight: You gain blindsight.

Displacement: You surround yourself with a light-bending glamer that makes it difficult for others to surmise your true location. Any melee or ranged attack directed at you has a 50% miss chance.

Whirlwind Breath: As a standard action, you can exhale a scouring blast of wind in a 60-foot cone. Your whirlwind breath deals 1d6 points of damage per binder level you possess. Every creature in the area can attempt a Reflex save to halve the damage, and must also succeed on a Fortitude save or be knocked prone and moved 1d4?0 feet away from you. Once you have used this ability, you cannot do so again for 5 rounds.

dst: 夜术士
苏尔奥术机械秘法眼
闪避加值 +4
秘法共鸣抗力
"干得漂亮。以后我们得仔细检查笼子的锁，确保不会再发生这种事。我们经常运送拥有特殊能力或魔法属性的生物，需要特殊安排，所以我想我们在运送一只虽然强大但很普通的野兽时大意了……让我想起有一次我们对付石化蜥蜴时遇到的所有麻烦。普通的笼子当然对付不了这种怪物，除非你想要一队石像。我们不得不建造一个看不见里面的特殊容器。听起来当然很容易，但如果你决心让里面的生物活着，那可真没那么简单。"
src: "Excellent work. We'll have to double check cage locks in the future to make sure nothing like this happens again. So often we are transporting creatures with special powers or magical properties, who require special arrangements, that I think we got careless transporting what was just an ordinary, if powerful, beast...reminds me of all the trouble we had with a basilisk, one time. Naturally an ordinary cage won't do for such a monster, unless you want a crew of statues. We had to build a special container that one couldn't see through. School: Transmutation
Level: Earth 8, Sor/Wiz 8
Components: V, S, M/DF
Casting Time: 1 standard action
Range: Personal
Target: You
Duration: 1 min./level (D)

This spell transforms your body into living iron, which grants you several powerful resistances and abilities.
You gain damage reduction 15/adamantine. You are immune to blindness, critical hits, ability score damage, deafness, disease, drowning, electricity, poison, stunning, and all spells or attacks that affect your physiology or respiration, because you have no physiology or respiration while this spell is in effect. You take only half damage from acid and fire of all kinds. However, you also become vulnerable to all special attacks that affect iron golems.
You gain a +6 enhancement bonus to your Strength score, but you take a -6 penalty to Dexterity as well (to a minimum Dexterity score of 1), and your speed is reduced to half normal. You have an arcane spell failure chance of 50% and a -8 armor check penalty, just as if you were clad in full plate armor. You cannot drink (and thus can't use potions) or play wind instruments.
Your unarmed attacks deal damage equal to a club sized for you (1d4 for Small characters or 1d6 for Medium characters), and you are considered armed when making unarmed attacks.
Your weight increases by a factor of ten, causing you to sink in water like a stone. However, you could survive the crushing pressure and lack of air at the bottom of the ocean - at least until the spell duration expires.

Arcane Material Component: A small piece of iron that was once part of either an iron golem, a hero's armor, or a war machine.

src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
Clad in bone-white armor and wreathed in righteous conviction, shadowbane inquisitors battle incessantly against evil in whatever form it takes. Every shadowbane inquisitor belongs to a fellowship of religious knights called the Order of Illumination. The order advocates merciless aggression against evil, and its members train to detect and destroy evil creatures and individuals. Filled with fervor, an inquisitor knows only one solution to an infestation of evil: the sword. The purifying flame and the clean cut of a holy blade are his tools. Along with their comrades (as members of the order refer to one another) the shadowbane stalkers, inquisitors find and confront evil wherever it hides. Unlike shadowbane stalkers, however, inquisitors emphasize purging evil rather than finding it. Their relentless zeal and their overwhelming belief in their own righteousness allow shadowbane inquisitors to root out evil cleanly, even if it costs the lives of a few good creatures, without the moral doubt that other knights might feel. The Order of Illumination expounds that it is better to sacrifice a village that hides a powerful demon than it is to risk letting the demon escape or the evil spread. Although inquisitors remain devoted to the cause of good, this conviction allows them to use their  abilities against enemies regardless of their alignment. 

- Hit Die: d10
- Proficiencies: Shadowbane inquisitors are proficient with all simple and martial weapons, with all types of armor, and with shields.

水妖精-宁芙是自然界形体之美的化身，也是荒野圣地的守护者。她们憎恨邪恶，对破坏自然者持鄙夷态度。然而，尊重荒野者往往会受到善待，但水妖精-宁芙的性情变幻莫测，随时可能改变。她们对精灵，半精灵和德鲁伊最为友善，视其为自然之友。从外表上看，水妖精-宁芙的体型与体重与女性精灵相仿，且始终为女性。她们美得令人难以承受，若不采取预防措施，足以令旁观者目盲，而愤怒水妖精-宁芙的一瞥几乎能震慑任何生物。

- 精类：在法咒效果方面，水妖精-宁芙视为精类。

src:
Nymphs are nature's embodiment of physical beauty, and are the guardians of the sacred places of the wild.  They hate evil, and take a dim view on those who despoil nature.  Those who respect the wilds however are often shown kindness, but a nymph's demeanor is mercurial and could change at a moment's notice.  They are most friendly towards elves, half-elves, and druids, knowing them for friends of nature.  Physically nymphs are about the size and weight of a female elf, and are always female themselves.  They are so unbearably lovely they can blind onlookers if the nymph does not take precautions, and the glance of an angry nymph can stun almost any creature.

Nymph Ability Adjustments: +6 Dex, +2 Con, +6 Int, +6 Wis, +8 Cha.
Favored Class (Druid): A multiclass nymph's druid class does not count when determining whether she suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

- Base movement of 30'
- Low-Light Vision: Allows them to see better than normal in the dark.
- Fey Damage Reduction: DR 10/cold iron
- Wild Empathy: +6 racial bonus to animal empathy checks.
- Unearthly Grace: A nymph's Charisma modifier is added to their AC and all saving throws.
- Blinding Beauty: All creatures within 30' must make a Fort save vs DC 13+Cha or be blinded.
- Stunning Glare: One creature within 30' must make a Fort save vs DC 13+Cha or be stunned for 2d4 rounds.
- Spell-like Abilities: Dimension Door 1/day
- Fey: Nymphs count as Fey for the purpose of spells.

src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
The Disciple of Dispater is a war-like general of evil. He is defensively minded and eager to have others fight for him. When he must fight, he does so on his terms and on his chosen battleground. Disciples of Dispater verge on paranoia and are thus distrustful of everyone. They have mystical power over iron that allows them to grant themselves even greater abilities in battle.

- Hit Die: d10
- Proficiencies: Disciple of Dispater is proficient in all simple and martial weapons, all armor and shields.
- Skill Points: 4+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:

Alignment: Any Evil
Base Attack Bonus: +6
Feats: Disciple of Darkness, Expertise, Power Attack.

CLASS FEATURES:

Level
1: Device Lore - A +2 Bonus to Disable Device checks.
2: Iron Hews - Once per day the Disciple of Dispater may add a +3 divine bonus on damage from attacks for 1 round per Constitution modifier.
3: Rusting Grasp - Once per day, Disciple can attempt to grab an opponents weapon and if it is mostly metal destroy it.
4: Iron Power - When using an iron or steel weapon, gain +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls. Furthermore his threat range is doubled as if the weapon were keen. At 8th level the bonus improves to +2. This does not stack with Keen Weapons but does with the Improved Critical feat.
5: Summon Erinyes - Disciple can summon 1 erinyes once per day.
6: Greater Iron Hews - Once per day per point of Constitution bonus a Disciple of Dispater may add a +6 divine bonus on damage from attacks made that round.
7: Iron Skin: Once per day a Disciple of Dispater can produce an effect identical to the stone skin spell.
10: Iron Body - Once per day a disciple can produce an effect identical to that on an Iron Body spell.

dst: 贫民窟中一位贫穷的平民为我指了她地板上一个洞，我可以从那里下到一个坍塌的地下室。她最近一直听到那里传来奇怪的声响，担心有某种怪物搬了进去。我应当调查此事。\n\n看来那些声响实际上并非由任何怪物造成，而是贫民窟的一位居民，当上面他的房子在一场火灾中坍塌时，他被困在了这个区域。我已将他从困住他的瓦砾中救出，并告知了上面房子里的那位女人，她所听到的声响实际上是由什么造成的。
src: A poor commoner in the slums pointed me towards a hole in her floor through which I could descend into a collapsed basement. She has been hearing strange noises coming from there recently and fears a monster of some kind may have moved in. I should investigate this matter.\n\nIt seems the noises were actually not being caused by any monster, but by an inhabitant of the slums who was trapped in this area when his house above collapsed in a fire. I have freed him from the rubble he was trapped behind, and informed the woman in the house above has been informed of what was actually causing the noises she heard.

"我明白了。虽然你可能是一名武僧，但我不确定你是否是我通常愿意指导的那种武僧。有些教团所信奉的原则与伊尔梅特所教导的任何东西都截然不同，而你似乎就是这样一个教团的成员。尽管如此，我对纳西拉克极为敬重，所以如果他认为你能从我所能提供的这点微薄指导中受益，我会尽力而为。我曾听人说，修行的训练本质上必定会增长智慧，即便对那些出于愚蠢目的而修行的人也是如此。我希望在你身上也能证明这一点。"
src: "I see. While you may be a monk, I am not sure you are the kind of monk I would normally be willing to instruct. Some orders are devoted to principles radically divergent from anything Ilmater teaches, and you seem to be a member of one such. Nevertheless, I have great respect for Nasirak, so if he thinks you would benefit from such meager instruction as I can provide, I will do what I can. I have heard it said that the discipline of monastic training must by its nature increase wisdom even in those who undertake it for foolish purposes. I shall hope that proves to be true in your case."

dst: “因为那儿几乎所有东西都靠钱，这就是原因。就说最基本的，为什么有人有房子住、有饭吃？因为他们用钱换来了这些。几乎所有做过的好事都是因为有人付了钱才做的，否则根本不会有人去做。贪婪为这个世界做的事，比所有那些说教的、反对贪婪的傻瓜们多得多。”
src: "Because most everything there is depends on money, that's why. Just to stick with basics, why does anyone have a place to live or food to eat? Because they were provided with such in exchange for money. Most any good that's ever been done was done because it was paid for, and wouldn't have been done at all otherwise. Greed's done a lot more for the world than all the moralizing fools who preach against it."

src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
The Duelist is a nimble, intelligent fighter trained in making precise attacks with light weapons, such as the rapier. Also known as the swashbuckler, the Duelist always takes full advantage of his quick reflexes and wits in a fight. Rather than wearing bulky armor, Duelists feel that the best way to protect themselves is to not get hit at all.

- Hit Die: d10
- Proficiencies: A Duelist is proficient with all simple and martial weapons, but does not gain any armor or shield proficiencies.
- Skill Points: 4+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:

Base Attack Bonus: +6
Feats: Dodge, Weapon Finesse, Mobility.
Skills: Tumble 5 ranks. Perform 3 ranks.

CLASS FEATURES:

Level
 1: Canny Defense - Dodge bonus to AC based on intelligence bonus, limited by class level.
 2: Thug - +2 initiative, +2 Persuade
 3: Spring Attack - No longer incurs Attacks of Opportunity for moving in combat.
 4: Grace - +2 Bonus to reflex saves.
 5: Precise Strike +1d6 - Bonus damage while wielding a light piercing weapon.
 6: Acrobatic Charge - Ignore impediments while charging
 7: Elaborate Parry - Bonus to Armor Class when Fighting Defensively
 8: Blooded - +2 initiative, +2 Spot
 9: Deflect Arrows
10: Precise Strike +2d6

NOTES:

Duelist loses Canny Defense, Precise Strike, and Grace while wearing any armor or shield.

Could not implement PnP's Improved Reaction, +2 bonus to initiative. So I gave them the Thug and Blooded feats, as they are very close in bonus.

Could not implement PnP's Enhanced Mobility, +4 AC vs. Attacks of Opportunity. That bonus would stack with mobility... I gave them Spring Attack instead as that was the closest thing to it.

src:
Shadowswyft are planetouched beings with ancestry from the Plane of Shadow. They are mercurial in temperament and delight in living in the moment. As a result, they are poor planners and have little patience for strategy. Shadowswyfts bear little resemblance to other races, although they are lean with chiseled features, much like elves. The average male stands about 6 feet tall and weights 165 pounds. They have skin ranging from brown to black, with blackened, slanted eyes - a build perfectly suited for hiding amongst shadows. Unlike most species, shadowswyfts are amiable towards most other races, seeing individual actions as more important than blood lineage.

Shadowswyft Ability Adjustments: +2 Dex, -2 Con.
Favored Class (Rogue): A multiclass shadowswyft's rogue class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

- Darkvision: Shadowswyfts can see in the dark.
- Weapon Proficiency (Simple): All shadowswift are proficient with Simple Weapons.
- Weapon Proficiency (Martial): All shadowswift are proficient with Martial Weapons.
- Armor Proficiency (Lightl): All shadowswift are proficient with Light armor.
- Base movement of 40.
- Skill Affinity (Hide): +4 racial bonus to Hide checks.
- Skill Affinity (Move Silently): +4 racial bonus to Move Silently checks.
- Blooded: +2 racial bonus to Initiative and Spot checks.
- Light Blindness: Abrupt exposure to light blinds a shadowswyft for 1 round. In addition shadowswyft suffer -1 circumstance penalty to attack rolls, saves and checks while operating in bright light.
- Outsider: Shadowswyfts are considered Outsiders for the purpose of spells.

魂能在你脖子上形成一个大而深蓝色的护领，就像板甲的一部分。背面的颜色较深，前面渐变为淡蓝色，顶部和底部有灰棕色的条纹。护喉在胸骨上方逐渐变细成一个尖点。

魂能点：你获得等于你投入此魂能融合中的魂能点数量5倍的电击抗力。

脉轮绑定（喉部） 

你的装甲护领融入你的喉咙，你的脖子略微变长。你能感觉到脖子两侧持续刺痛，说话时嘴里偶尔会喷出小火花--尤其是当你兴奋或愤怒时。

你获得以一个标准动作投射一道电击线的能力。每分钟一次，你可以发射一道5英尺长加每点投入魂能点5英尺长的电击线。线中的目标受到2d6点电击伤害加每点投入魂能点1d6点伤害。他们可以通过成功的反射豁免将伤害减半。

脉轮绑定（图腾） 

当你将贝希尔护喉绑定到你的图腾脉轮时，其坚硬的蓝色甲片沿着你的脖子向上蔓延，覆盖你的整个头部。你的脸变长，下颚变得巨大。锋利的牙齿充满你的口腔，让你能在战斗中野蛮地咬噬敌人。每当你张嘴咬噬--甚至说话时，嘴里都会噼啪作响。

你获得一次造成1d8点伤害的咬噬攻击。你可以将此咬噬作为主要攻击使用。投入此魂能融合中的每点魂能点使你的咬噬伤害增加1d4点电击伤害。
src:
Behir Gorget

Descriptors: Electricity 
Classes: Totemist 
Chakra: Throat (totem) 
Saving Throw: See text

Incarnum forms a large, deep blue collar around your neck, like part of a suit of plate armor. The color is darker on the back and fades to pale blue in the front, and bands of gray-brown line the top and bottom. The gorget tapers to a sharp point above your breastbone.

Your behir gorget gives you a +4 bonus to resist being bull rushed or tripped. 

Essentia: You gain resistance to electricity equal to 5 times the number of points of essentia you invest in this soulmeld. 

Chakra Bind (Throat) 

Your armored collar merges into your throat, and your neck lengthens very slightly. You can feel a constant tingling in the sides of your neck, and tiny sparks occasionally spit from your mouth when you speak - particularly when you get excited or angry.

You gain the ability to project a line of electricity as a standard action. Once per minute, you can emit a line of acid that is 5 feet long plus 5 feet per point of invested essentia. Targets in the line take 2d6 points of electricity damage plus 1d6 points for every point of invested essentia. They can reduce this damage by half with a successful Reflex save. 

Chakra Bind (Totem) 

As you bind your behir gorget to your totem chakra, its hard blue plating spreads up your neck to incorporate your entire head. Your face lengthens, and your jaw grows monstrous. Sharp teeth fill your mouth, allowing you to bite your foes savagely in combat. Sparks crackle in your mouth whenever you open it to bite-or even to speak.

You gain a bite attack that deals 1d8 points of damage. You can use this bite as a primary attack. Every point of essentia invested in this soulmeld adds 1d4 points of electricity damage to your bite damage.

“很好，很好。不过，我听说他家里不止死了一个人。没人会太在意某个老商人被暗杀，但那样的大屠杀会引来我们不需要的注意。以后，专心完成任务，不要杀任何非必要的人。你会失去我原本打算给你的那点金币奖励，但你做得还算不错，所以我仍然会让你拿到报酬的主要部分：去找公会商人，问问他的刺客特供商店。你会发现那里有些特殊物品，对干‘清除麻烦’这一行的人很有帮助，而且卖给你的价格只是别处要价的零头。办完那里的事，你可以来找我接下一个活儿。”
src: "Good, good. However, I've been hearing reports that there was more than one death at his house. Nobody's going to worry much about some old merchant being assassinated, but a massacre like that draws attention we don't need. In future, stick to the job and don't kill anyone you don't have to. You'll lose the little gold bonus I was planning to give you for that, but you did well enough, so I'll still let you have the main part of your reward: talk to the guild merchant and ask about his special store for assassins. You'll find it has some special items helpful to people in the business of, shall we say, removing the troublesome, and they'll be sold to you for a small fraction of the price they would command anywhere else. src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
Wizards and sorcerers have been an integral part of the Harpers since the organization's inception. Indeed, many of its senior members today are powerful mages.

Among the organization's principal allies are several influential wizards and sorcerers who have made some of their accumulated knowledge available to the Harpers.

Mystra, the deity of magic, is one of the patron deities of the Harpers; her predecessor being one of the deities who met at the Dancing Place centuries ago to inspire the founding of the Harpers organization. With such a rich magical tradition, it was inevitable that the Harpers would develop some of their own magical lore and techniques to pass on to their agents.

- Hit Die: d4.
- Proficiencies: A Harper Mage is proficient with simple weapons.
- Skill Points: 4+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:

Feats: Alertness, Extend Spell.
Alignment: Any non-evil.
Skills: Concentration (4 ranks), Spellcraft (8 ranks), Lore (8 ranks), Persuade (2 ranks).
Spells: Able to cast 3rd level arcane spells.

CLASS FEATURES:

Level
1: Feat - Skill Focus: Lore - Provides a +3 bonus to all Lore skill checks.
2: Feat - Skill Focus: Spellcraft - Provides a +3 bonus to all Spellcraft skill checks.
3: Feat - Still Spell.
4: Feat - Silent Spell.
5: Hardiness vs. Spells - The Harper Mage gains a +2 bonus to saving throws vs spells.

BONUS SPELLS

Upon gaining a level in Harper Mage, the character gains new spells per day as if they had also gained a level in their highest Arcane spellcasting class. No new spells are learned through this ability, however.

Tallfellow halflings are slightly bigger than their lightfoot cousins. They stand more than half as high as humans, and have athletic builds, fair skin and fair hair. Tallfellows are somewhat rare among halfling folk, generally preferring the company of elves where they are known to exist. They are less athletic than their kin, despite their builds, and share some of the traits of their elf companions.

 +1 size bonus to attack rolls.

 +4 size bonus to Hide checks.
- Skill Affinity (Search): +2 racial bonus to Search checks.
- Skill Affinity (Spot): +2 racial bonus to Spot checks.
- Skill Affinity (Listen): +2 racial bonus to Listen checks.
- Keen Sense: Tallfellow Halflings make active Search checks automatically and with no movement penalties.
- Lucky: +1 luck bonus to all saving throws.
- Fearless: +2 morale bonus to saving throws against spells and effects of the 'Fear' subtype.
- Good Aim: +1 racial bonus to attack rolls made with throwing weapons.
- Halfling: Tallfellow Halflings are considered Halflings for the purpose of spells.

Special: Halflings are small creatures and as such they can never use the following Large weapons: bastard sword, dire mace, two-bladed sword, double axe, greataxe, greatsword, halberd, heavy flail, quarterstaff, scythe and spear.

一个发光的，彩虹色调的，交织色彩的图纹会迷住其中的生物。虹彩图纹最多能迷住 24 个生命骰的生物。生命骰最少的生物先受影响。在生命骰相同的生物中，最靠近法咒源点的生物先受影响。受影响且豁免失败的生物会被图纹迷住。
通过一个简单的手势（一个自由动作），你可以让虹彩图纹每轮移动最多 30 英尺（移动其有效源点）.所有被迷住的生物会跟随移动的彩虹光芒，试图进入或保持在效果范围内。被迷住但被束缚并移出图纹的生物仍会试图跟随它。如果图纹将其目标引入危险区域，每个被迷住的生物获得第二次豁免。如果光芒的视线被完全阻挡，看不见光芒的生物不再受影响。
该法咒不影响无视觉的生物。

言语成分：法师或术士无需发出声音来施放此法咒，但吟游诗人必须唱歌，演奏音乐或朗诵韵文作为言语成分。

src:
School: Illusion (Pattern) [Mind-Affecting]
Level: Brd 4, Sor/Wiz 4
Components: V (Brd only), S, M, F; see text
Casting Time: 1 standard action
Range: Medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Effect: Colorful lights with a 20-ft.-radius spread
Duration: Concentration +1 round/ level (D)
Saving Throw: Will negates
Spell Resistance: Yes

A glowing, rainbow-hued pattern of interweaving colors fascinates those within it. Rainbow pattern fascinates a maximum of 24 Hit Dice of creatures. Creatures with the fewest HD are affected first. Among creatures with equal HD, those who are closest to the spell's point of origin are affected first. An affected creature that fails its saves is fascinated by the pattern.
With a simple gesture (a free action), you can make the rainbow pattern move up to 30 feet per round (moving its effective point of origin). All fascinated creatures follow the moving rainbow of light, trying to get or remain within the effect. Fascinated creatures who are restrained and removed from the pattern still try to follow it. If the pattern leads its subjects into a dangerous area each fascinated creature gets a second save. If the view of the lights is completely blocked creatures who can't see them are no longer affected.
The spell does not affect sightless creatures.

Verbal Component: A wizard or sorcerer need not utter a sound to cast this spell, but a bard must sing, play music, or recite a rhyme as a verbal component.
Material Component: A piece of phosphor.
Focus: A crystal prism.

src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
Elemental Savants study the basic building blocks of existence - air, earth, fire, water - learning to harness their powers. Eventually they transcend their mortal form and become elemental beings. Most Elemental Savants start out as wizards, although clerics and druids are not unknown. Sorcerers occasionally take this prestige class, but since metamagic feats are of less utility to them, they have difficulty using the class's strengths to the fullest.

- Hit Die: d4.
- Proficiencies: An Elemental Savant does not gain any additional weapon or armor proficiencies.
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:

Spellcasting: Able to cast 3rd-level arcane spells
Skills: Lore 8 ranks.

CLASS FEATURES:

Level
1: Elemental Transition 1 - Grants Immunity to Sleep.
  Resistance +5 - Grants 5 resistance to chosen element.
2: Elemental Focus +1 - Grants a DC increase for spells of the chosen element.
3: Elemental Penetration +1 - Grants a Spell Penetration increase for spells of the chosen element.
4: Elemental Transition 2 - Grants Darkvision and Immunity to Paralysis.
  Resistance +10 - Grants 10 resistance to chosen element.
5: Elemental Focus +2 - Spell DC increase improves.
6: Elemental Penetration +2 - Spell Penetration bonus improves.
7: Elemental Transition 3 - Grants Immunity to Stun.
  Resistance +15 - Grants 15 resistance to chosen element.
8: Elemental Focus +3 - Spell DC increase improves.
9: Elemental Penetration +3 - Spell Penetration bonus improves.
10: Elemental Perfection - Gain all benefits of being an elemental, including immunity to poison, sleep, paralysis, stunning, critical hits and sneak attacks. Gain the special attacks and special qualities of a medium elemental of the chosen type. Gain immunity to the chosen element, but take double damage from all spells of the opposing element.

BONUS SPELLS

Upon gaining a level in Elemental Savant, the character gains new spells per day as if he had also gained a level in his highest caster class (bard, sorcerer, or wizard). He does not learn any new spells through his abilities.

src:
Type of Feat: General
  Prerequisite: Can only take this feat at 1st-level.
  Specifics: You can use spellfire to absorb spell energy, fire destructive blasts, or heal others.
  A spellfire wielder can ready an action to absorb spells targeted at her as if she were a rod of absorption. She gains one level of spellfire energy for every spell level absorbed and can store a number of spellfire energy levels equal to her Constitution. If she has reached her limit, she cannot absorb spells until she expends some of her stored spellfire levels. If her Constitution decreases so that her number of stored spellfire levels is greater than her current Constitution, the excess levels discharge at a random creature in range as destructive spellfire.
  As a standard action, a spellfire wielder may expend stored spellfire energy as a melee or ranged touch attack (maximum range 400 feet), dealing 1d6 points of spellfire damage per level expended (Reflex half, DC 20). Spellfire damage is half fire damage and half raw magical power. Creatures with immunity, resistance, or protection against fire effects apply these to only half the damage, but not the other half. A creature can also choose "spellfire" as a weapon for the purpose of the Weapon Focus feat.
  A spellfire wielder can heal a target by touch, restoring 2 hitpoints per spellfire energy level expended for this purpose. This is not considered positive energy, so it does not injure undead.
  Use: Selected.

src:
This invocation (Greater; 5th; Eldritch Essence) allows you to place an arcane spell with a range of touch upon your eldritch blast. If the eldritch blast hits its target, the spell takes effect on that target as if you had touched it. If the eldritch blast misses its target, the spell is lost with no effect.

It takes a full-round action to cast the spell and fire the eldritch blast. Only a touch spell with a casting time no greater than 1 standard action can be placed upon your eldritch blast.

Only the first target of your eldritch blast is affected by the spell (for example, an eldritch greatreach chain delivers the touch spell on the initial target, not on any of the secondary targets). If your eldritch blast doesn't specify a target, you can't apply this invocation to the blast.

Treat greatreach blast as a spell whose level is equal to the touch spell placed upon the eldritch blast (minimum 5th level).

Templars are civil servants within a city-state's government organization commonly referred to as a "temple", "bureau" or "order". Each templar swears obedience to his temple, and absolute fealty to his sorcerer-king. In return, the sorcerer-king grants them spell power stolen from the elemental planes.

In most city-states, templars are the ultimate authority judge, jury, and executioner. Templars police and administer the city-states, and serve other civil roles ranging from general to jailor and from tax collector to garbage collector.

- Hit Die: d8
- Proficiencies: Templars are proficient in all simple weapons. Since templar training involves some education in warfare, templars receive two martial weapons proficiencies. Templars are proficient in light and medium armor and shields (except tower shields).

SPELLCASTING

You cast divine spells, which are drawn from the templar spell list. When you gain access to a new level of spells, you automatically know all the spells for that level on the templar's spell list. You can cast any spell you know without preparing it ahead of time. Essentially, your spell list is the same as your spells known list.
To cast a templar spell, you must have a Charisma score of 10 + the spell's level. The Difficulty Class for a saving throw against a templar's spell is 10 + the spell's level + the templar's Cha modifier. Like other spellcasters, a templar can cast only a certain number of spells of each level per day. In addition, you receive bonus spells for a high Charisma score.
You can also cast one domain spell of each spell level per day, as a cleric does. The domain spell is chosen at the time of casting from the spells associated with your assumed domains (see below), as you cast spells spontaneously and need not prepare spells ahead of time. A templar need not prepare spells in advance. You can cast any spell you know at any time, assuming you have not yet used up your spells per day for that spell level.
You use your sorcerer-king's sigil as divine focus.

哈瓦尔德，一名巡林客兼伐木工，总是自称爱好和平，说他最看重自己那把心爱的手斧，因为它砍柴效率高。尽管如此，当他的林区遭到怪物入侵时，哈瓦尔德仍会凶猛作战，而在这种时候，他那把确实能极快劈开木头的斧头，也在战斗中派上了用场。最著名的一次，是他清剿了附近森林里一群凶暴的狼人。然而，历经多次战斗后，哈瓦尔德最终战死在一群劫掠兽人的大军之下。随后拿起这把利刃的兽人勇士，毫不掩饰自己并非爱好和平，从那以后，这把斧头再也没用来砍过柴。
src: Harwald, a ranger and woodsman, always claimed to be a peace-loving man, saying that he chiefly valued his favorite handaxe for its efficiency in chopping wood. Despite this, Harwald could fight fiercely when his region of the woods suffered monster incursions, and on such occasions his axe, which could indeed cut through wood with remarkable speed, also served him well in battle. It did so most notably when he cleared the nearby forest of a group of aggressive werewolves. After many battles, however, Harwald eventually fell in battle against a horde of marauding orcs. The orc champion who then took up the blade made no pretence to being peace-loving, and from then on the axe was never used to chop wood.

Fire genasi are usually thought of as hot-blooded and quick to anger, and they have earned that reputation. Type of Feat: Metapsionic
Prerequisites: None
Specifics: To use this feat, you must expend your psionic focus. You can twin a power. Manifesting a power altered by this feat causes the power to take effect twice on the area or target, as if you were simultaneously manifesting the same power two times on the same location or target. Any variables in the power (such as duration, number of targets, and so on) are the same for both the resulting powers. The target experiences all the effects of both powers individually and receives a saving throw (if applicable) for each. In some cases, such as a twinned Psionic Charm, failing both saving throws results in redundant effects (although, in this example, any ally of the target would have to succeed on two dispel attempts to free the target from the charm effect).
Using this feat increases the power point cost of the power by 6. The power's total cost cannot exceed your manifester level.

dst: 除了泰坦帮的麻烦之外，纳西拉克还告诉我贫民窟里有许多人神秘失踪。泰坦帮行事并不以隐蔽著称，所以纳西拉克怀疑背后另有其人，或是别的什么东西。他希望我试着查明那可能是什么。我不太确定该从何入手。也许如果我探索神庙周围的区域，会发现一些线索。\n\n我已经找到了这些神秘失踪的人。他们被鼠人囚禁在下水道里，鼠人打算用兽化症感染他们，好把他们编入自己的鼠人军队。我决定把他们全部杀掉，因为担心他们确实已经被感染了。我应该向纳西拉克报告，他们是被鼠人绑架的，最终没能活下来。这样既能让他知道发生了什么，又不会泄露某些可能让他不安的细节。
src: In addition to the trouble with the Titan gang, Nasirak has told me of a number of mysterious disappearances of people who live in the slums. The Titan gang is not known for its subtlety, so Nasirak suspects that someone or something else is behind this. He would like me to try to determine who or what that might be. I am not really sure where to start. Perhaps if I explore the area surrounding the temple some clue will turn up.\n\nI have located these mysteriously missing people. They were being held captive in the sewers by wererats, who intended to infect them with lycanthropy so that they could be added to their wererat army. I decided to kill them all, for fear they had indeed been infected. I should report to Nasirak that they were kidnapped by wererats, and ultimately did not survive the experience. That will let him know what happened without letting slip certain details that might upset him.

在探索卡林港地下的废墟时，我从一只恐蛛手中救下了一个不寻常的半兽人，名叫赫兰加拉克。这个赫兰加拉克是海姆的牧师，似乎直到最近，他的部落“血刃”一直崇拜这位神祇，并试图避免像半兽人通常那样与其他种族交战。然而最近部落发生了领导层变动，前任领袖冈克鲁泽尔公主被驱逐，并被卖给了一个邪教，他们需要拥有王室血统的人进行某种奇怪的仪式献祭。新任领袖是格鲁扎尔，他试图恢复对格乌什的崇拜，并与鼠人结盟对抗卡林港的人类。赫兰加拉克希望我与他联手救出冈克鲁泽尔，并让她重新领导部落，挫败这个计划。

我已同意赫兰加拉克的计划。拯救公主是冒险者的经典任务，即使老故事里的公主通常不是半兽人。与赫兰加拉克一起，我应向西前往血刃镇，然后向南寻找邪教巢穴。

我们找到并救出了冈克鲁泽尔，并解决了邪教徒，他们不再构成威胁。现在我们需要返回半兽人镇对付格鲁扎尔。
src:
While exploring the subterranean ruins beneath Calimport, I rescued from a dire spider an unusual orc named Hrangarak. This Hrangarak is a cleric of Helm, and it seems that until recently his tribe, the Bloody Blades, was worshiping this deity and seeking to avoid warring with other races as is typical of orcs. Recently however the tribe has had a change of leadership, with their former leader Princess Gunkruzelle being ousted and sold to a cult who needed someone with royal blood for some sort of strange ritual sacrifice. Its new leader is Gruzhaur, who seeks to restore worship of Gruumsh and form an alliance with the wererats against the humans of Calimport. Hrangarak wants me to join with him to rescue Gunkruzelle and restore her to leadership of the tribe, frustrating this plan.

I have agreed to Hrangarak's plan. Rescuing a princess is a classic quest for adventurers, even if the princess is not usually an orc in the old stories. Together with Hrangarak, I should head west towards the Bloody Blades town, but then head south to find the Cultist's Lair.

We have found and rescued Gunkruzelle, and dealt with the cultists, who will no longer be any threat. Now we need to return to the orc town to deal with Gruzhaur.

dst:
（进阶职业）
说翠绿领主有园艺天赋，就像说红龙对火焰略有亲和力一样。翠绿领主是森林的最终守护者。他放弃了德鲁伊对自然秘密的全面理解之追求，将全部精力集中在世界的植物生命上。精灵和半精灵德鲁伊最有可能接受翠绿领主的角色。其他种族的德鲁伊，巡林客，以及偶尔的欧拜亥或艾罗娜牧师也已知会采用这一进阶职业。没有此类联系的角色几乎不可能成为翠绿领主，因为他们对种子，树苗和树木既无兴趣，也缺乏必要的理解。由于大多数翠绿领主对文明毫无用处，他们往往是独行者，在自己的树林中看着岁月流逝。

冒险的翠绿领主很罕见，但存在的那些却令人叹为观止。他们倾向于随身携带自己的花园，经常带着几个植物生物，如活化的树木和树人一同冒险。翠绿领主往往说话温和，性格随和，直到有人点燃火把并威胁到活着的植物。
 
 - 生命骰：d8
 - 武器和防具擅长：翠绿领主不获得任何额外的武器或防具擅长。
 - 技能点：4+ 智力调整值。
 - 每日法咒：每提升一个翠绿领主等级，角色获得新的每日法咒，如同他在加入该进阶职业前所属的神术施法职业上也提升了一级。然而，他不会获得该职业角色所获得的任何其他好处（例如驱散或叱喝术不死生物的几率提升）. 
 
 要求：
 阵营：任意非邪恶。
 基础攻击加值：+4。
 技能：知识 8 级，治疗 8 级。
 专长：植物抗斥，植物控制
 法咒：能够施放控制植物。
 
 职业特性：
 等级
 1： 制造注入：在第 1 级时，翠绿领主获得制造注入作为奖励专长。 
 2： 精通注入：在第 2 级时，角色可以自动识别注入中所包含的法咒以及该法咒的施法者等级。
         太阳滋养（Ex）*：在第 2 级时，翠绿领主获得从太阳中汲取能量的能力。
 3： 自发施法：从第 3 级开始，翠绿领主可以将储存的法咒能量引导为再生法咒，而无需事先准备。
 4： 植物亲和：在第 4 级时，翠绿领主可以叱喝术或命令植物，如同他比用于确定该专长好处的实际施法者等级高三级。
 5： 快速治疗：在第 5 级时，翠绿领主获得快速治疗作为奖励专长。
 6： 树人野性变身（Sp）：从第 6 级开始，翠绿领主可以使用野性变身变成树人的形态。
 8： 活化树木（Sp）：在第 8 级时，翠绿领主可以每天一次活化他 180 英尺内的一棵树。
 10：盖亚的拥抱：在第 10 级时，翠绿领主永久变为植物生物。
 
 * 未实现
src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
Saying the verdant lord has a green thumb is like calling a red dragon a creature with a slight affinity for fire. The verdant lord is the final defender of the Forest. He has left behind the druid's search for global understanding of nature's secrets to focus all his energies on the world's plant life.  Elven and half-elven druids are the most likely characters to embrace the role of the verdant lord. Druids of other races, rangers, and the occasional priest of Obad Hai or Ehlonna have also been known to adopt this prestige class. It's almost impossible for characters without such ties to become verdant lords because they have neither the interest in nor the required understanding of seeds, saplings, and trees.  Since most verdant lords have little use for civilization, they tend to be loners, watching the years pass by from their groves. 

Adventuring verdant lords are rare, but those who do exist are marvelous to behold. They tend to take their gardens with them, often bringing several plant creatures, such as animated trees and treants, along on adventures. Verdant lords tend to be soft-spoken, easygoing individuals, right up until someone lights a torch and threatens living plants.
 
 - Hit Die: d8
 - Proficiencies: A verdant lord does not gain any additional weapon or armor proficiencies.
 - Skill Points: 4+ Int Modifier.
 - Spells per Day: At each verdant lord level the character gains new spells per day as if he had also gained a level in a divine spellcasting class to which he belonged before adding the prestige class level. He does not, however, gain any other benefit a character of that class would have gained (such as an improved chance of turning or rebuking undead). 
 
 REQUIREMENTS: 
 Alignment: Any non-evil.
 Base Attack Bonus: +4.
 Skills: Lore 8 ranks, Heal 8 ranks.
 Feats: Plant Defiance, Plant Control
 Spells: Able to cast Control Plants. 
 
 CLASS FEATURES:
 Level
 1:  Create Infusion: At 1st level, the verdant lord gains Create Infusion as a bonus feat.  
 2:  Expert Infusion: At 2nd level, the character can automatically identify the spell contained in an infusion and the caster level of that spell.
         Sun Sustenance (Ex)*: At 2nd level, the verdant lord gains the ability to draw energy from the sun.
 3:  Spontaneity: Beginning at 3rd level, the verdant lord can channel stored spell energy into regeneration spells that he hasn't prepared ahead of time.
 4:  Plant Facility: At 4th level, the verdant lord can rebuke or command plants as if he were three levels higher than the actual caster level he uses to determine the benefits of that feat.
 5:  Fast Healing: At 5th level, the verdant lord gains Fast Healing as a bonus feat. 
 6:  Treant Wild Shape (Sp): Beginning at 6th level, the verdant lord can use wild shape to take the form of a treant.
 8:  Animate Tree (Sp): At 8th level, a verdant lord can animate a tree within 180 feet of him once per day.
 10: Gaea's Embrace: At 10th level, the verdant lord permanently becomes a plant creature.
 
 * NOT IMPLEMENTED

巴哈姆特的大多数使者和勇士都是尽职而强大的金属龙类。然而，巴哈姆特偶尔也会发现一位非龙族的勇士，他对善龙的崇敬不可动摇，对恶龙的仇恨可与最纯洁的金龙相媲美--这股善良而强大的力量让巴哈姆特感动，愿意为这位勇士在他的宫廷中提供一个位置。这位勇士便成为巴哈姆特的封臣。

dst: "如果你想知道的话，我还没有发现任何看起来像是暗杀某人的理由。但我发现了许多关于那把剑的迷人信息。它曾经是巨灵泽法德使用的武器。当伟大的巨灵卡林统治这片土地时，泽法德是他的副官之一。这把剑可以创造位面之门，并通过它们汲取力量……它实际上相当独特，比那个时代遗留下来的其他强大魔法物品更独特。我想你知道巨灵卡林和火巨灵门农是如何被精灵魔法囚禁在水晶中的历史吧？"
src: "I haven't found anything that looks like a reason to assassinate someone if that's what you're wondering. But I have found out a lot of fascinating stuff about that sword. It was once the weapon wielded by the djinni Zefad. When the great djinni Calim was ruling this land, Zefad was one of his lieutenants. The sword can create planar gates, and draw power through them...it is actually quite unique, more so than the other pieces of powerful magic left over from those times. I assume you know the history of how the djinni Calim and the efreeti Memnon were imprisoned in a crystal by Elven magic?"

dst: "啊，果然是你，正如我所怀疑的。当一些与我结盟的鸟儿报告了那场屠杀时，我想知道是否有一个潜在的盟友出现了。我看确实如此。作为你的奖赏，拿着这把钥匙。它可以打开我身后的箱子，里面有一些你可能觉得有价值的东西。也拿着这些金币。我们在袭击中缴获了它，但生活在野外，我不需要它。很可能你能更好地利用它。"
src: "Ah, so it was you, as I suspected. When some of the birds allied with me reported that massacre, I wondered if a potential ally had appeared on the scene. I see it was so. As your reward, take this key. It opens the chest behind me, which contains a few things you might find valuable. Take this gold as well. Heironeous's teachings focus on promoting good through the use of armed force. Those among Heironeous's servants, both clerics and paladins, who aspire to become weapons in their deity's unending war against evil hope one day to enter the Shining Blades. The Shining Blades of Heironeous is an order of knights dedicated to prowess in melee combat, which is achieved through prayer, devotion, and asceticism. Members of the Shining Blades have an austere and simple lifestyle, forsaking all worldly wealth and many earthly pleasures in their quest to become but a blade in the hand of Heironeous.

- Hit Die: d10
- Proficiencies: Shining Blades are proficient in all simple and martial weapons, all armor and shields.
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

Alignment: Lawful Good.
Base Attack Bonus: +7
Skills: Lore 7 ranks.
Spells: Able to cast 1st level divine spells.
Special: Clerics must have Good and War domains.

CLASS FEATURES:

All abilities only work with a Longsword (Deity Weapon).

Level
1: Shock Blade 2/day - Adds 1d6 Electrical damage to your weapon. Duration is a number of rounds equal to your class level + charisma modifier.
3: Shock Blade 3/day
5: Holy Blade 4/day - Adds 1d6 Electrical damage and 2d6 divine damage against evil to your weapon. Duration is a number of rounds equal to your class level + charisma modifier.
7: Holy Blade 5/day
9: Brilliant Blade 6/day - Adds 1d6 Electrical damage, 2d6 divine damage against evil, and +20 to attack to your weapon. Duration is a number of rounds equal to your class level + charisma modifier.

BONUS DIVINE SPELLS

Every other level in Shining Blade, the character gains new spells per day as if he had also gained a level in his highest divine caster class (Cleric or Paladin).

dst: 哈马德正在准备对变形蛛的总部发动攻击，因为我们已经掌握了其位置的情报。不过，他还有另一项任务要我在此期间完成。他的老朋友卡洛玛斯·泽卡尔，曾因在反对奴隶贸易应采取何种手段上的分歧与他闹翻，如今因我最近造访他的庄园而受到触动，主动联系哈马德试图和解。哈马德已被说服，愿意在卡洛玛斯牵涉的一件事上提供帮助。卡洛玛斯一直在卡林沙漠维持一个营地，据我所知，他在帮助一些人离开卡林杉（我没有被告知这些人究竟是谁，并被警告不要过多打听他们的事）。这个营地在夜间遭到暗中袭击，其中一些人被掳走，天命不明。哈马德派我以及他雇用的其他一些冒险者前往那里调查此事。要到达营地，我应先到他的庄园去见卡洛玛斯。他能够打开一道魔法界门将我送到营地，或许还能告诉我一些关于当前局势的更多情况。\n\n卡洛玛斯将我传送到了营地，在那里我遇到了贾拉尔·马卡希，一位巡林客，也是竖琴手同盟的成员，负责管理这个地方。我们一起追查到了袭击营地的源头：一处龙巫教使用的基地，被那些变成吸血鬼的教徒占据，他们这样做是为了更永久地侍奉不死龙族，该教派意图实现其统治。吸血鬼袭击营地是为了获取血液。我们已经杀穿了吸血鬼，但似乎前方某处仍有一条龙类，或许我们之间还有更多爪牙。我们发现了一些信息，表明这条龙相对年轻，尚未转化为龙巫妖，这意味着如果真要交战，我们或许有机会战胜他。
src: Hamad is preparing an assault upon the headquarters of the aranea, now that we have information on its location. However, he has another quest for me to complete in the meantime. His old friend Kalomas Zekar, with whom he had a fallin out over their disagreements about what methods should be employed in opposing the slave trade, has been inspired by my recent visit to his estate to contact Hamad and attempt a reconciliation. Hamad has been persuaded to lend assistance in a matter with which Kalomas is involved. Kalomas has been maintaining a camp in the Calim Desert for people who I am told he is assiting in leaving Calimshan (I have not been told just who these people are, and been warned against asking too many questions about them). This camp has been stealthily attacked during the night and some of the people in it carried off to some unknown fate. Hamad is sending me, and some of the other adventurers in his employ there to investigate the matter. To reach the camp I should first go see Kalomas at his estate. He will be able to open a magical portal transporting me to the camp, and perhaps tell me a little bit more about the situation.\n\nKalomas teleported me to the camp, where I met up with Jalar Makashi, a ranger and member of the Harpers who is running the place. Together we have tracked down the source of the raids upon the camp: a base used by the Cult of the Dragon, occupied by cultists who had become vampires so as to more permanently serve the undead dragons whose rule the cult seeks to bring about. The vampires were raiding the camp as a source of blood. We have fought through the vampires, but it seems there is still a dragon to be found somewhere ahead of us, perhaps with further minions still between us as well. We have found some information indicating that this dragon is relatively young, and not yet transformed into a dracolich, which means that we might have a chance in combat against him, if it comes to that.

- 抗病：对抗疾病的豁免检定获得 +2 种族加值。

src:
Nezumi, or "ratlings" as the humans call them, hail from the far east.  They used to control a large empire, which was destroyed in a great cataclysm, leaving the survivors to eke out an existence in the badlands left behind.  They are not physically large, being around 5'5" and 155 pounds in height and weight.  In shape they are humanoid, with a ratlike head, humanlike hands, and long hairless tails.  Their bodies are covered in a rough fur that varies from white, through grey and brown, to black.

Nezumi Ability Adjustments: +2 Con, -2 Cha
Favored Class (Rogue): A multiclass Nezumi's rogue class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

- Low-Light Vision: Allows them to see better than normal in the dark.
- Hardiness vs. Poisons: +2 racial bonus on saving throws against poisons.
- Hardiness vs. Disease: +2 racial bonus on saving throws against disease.
- 40' Movement
- Skill Affinity (Hide): +2 racial bonus to Hide checks.
- Skill Affinity (Move Silently): +2 racial bonus to Move Silently checks.
- Natural Weapon: Can make a natural bite or claw attack(1d4).
- Immune to the Shadowlands Taint: Nezumi can never acquire a Taint score, and suffer no ill effects from exposure to the Shadowlands. Effects such as the cloud of Taint spell or the special attacks of Shadowlands creatures can still harm them, however.

“……试试也无妨。沙华鱼人很可能过于排外，不愿与我们正式结盟。即使他们不结盟，他们的袭击也会成为对我们有利的宝贵牵制。当然，如果这些袭击能与我们的行动完全协调会更好，但如果无法做到，我也不会过于担心。

src:
A torn off and water-logged sheet of paper that seems to be the remains of a letter. Only the final section is still legible:

"...lose nothing by trying. It may well be that the sahuagin will prove too xenophobic to enter into a formal alliance with us. Even if they do not their raids will act as a valuable diversion in our favor. It would of course be better for these raids to be fully coordinated with our own activities, but I will not worry overmuch if that proves impossible.

                           -Zeaxua"

This further evidence of aranea organizing a war of hostile humanoids against Calimshan should probably be brought to the attention of someone in a position of authority, such as Hamad Galhadr.

Many armies boast units of soldiers who use a bow as their primary weapon, but most do not possess the discipline to gain the kind of experience the Peerless Archer has. 在9级时，对显现在狂念者身上的心智感应异能的惩罚增加到2点异能点。在13级时，惩罚增加到3点异能点，在17级时增加到4点异能点。此模式在传奇等级继续。
NWN实现细节：此能力只影响敌对显现者显现的异能。
src:
A wilder's temperamental mind is hard to encompass with the discipline of telepathy. When any telepathy power is manifested on a wilder of 5th level or higher, the manifester of the power must pay 1 power point more than he otherwise would have spent.
The extra cost is not a natural part of that power's cost. It does not augment the power; it is simply a wasted power point. The wilder's volatile mind can force the manifester of the telepathy power to exceed the normal power point limit of 1 point per manifester level. If the extra cost raises the telepathy power's cost to more points than the manifester has remaining in his reserve, the power simply fails, and the manifester exhausts the rest of his power points.
At 9th level, the penalty assessed against telepathy powers manifested on a wilder is increased to 2 power points. At 13th level, the penalty increases to 3 power points, and at 17th level it increases to 4 power points.  This pattern continues in epic levels.
NWN implementation detail: This ability only affects powers manifested by a hostile manifester.

The actual point of arrival is a designated area no larger than 10 feet by 10 feet. You can be transported any distance within a plane but cannot travel between planes. You can transport, in addition to yourself, any objects you carry, as long as their weight doesn't exceed your maximum load. You may also bring one additional willing Medium or smaller creature (carrying gear or objects up to its maximum load) or its equivalent per three caster levels. A Large creature counts as two Medium creatures, a Huge creature counts as two Large creatures, and so forth. All creatures to be transported must be in contact with one another, and at least one of those creatures must be in contact with you. Exceeding this limit causes the spell to fail.

An unwilling creature can't be teleported by word of recall. Likewise, a creature's Will save (or spell resistance) prevents items in its possession from being teleported. Unattended, nonmagical objects receive no saving throw.

(*Note: Cast this spell at location to mark it as your sanctuary. Cast the spell on self to teleport to your sanctuary.)

你唤出自身内在的野兽攻击性，通过心灵异能将你的双手转化为致命的利爪。你获得两次爪抓天生攻击，每次造成 1d4 点伤害（如果你是大型或更大则为 1d6，如果你是小型或更小则为 1d3）加上你的力量调整值。

你的利爪是天生武器，因此当你用它们攻击时被视为持有武器，并且它们可以受到增强或改善天生武器的异能，法咒和效果的影响。

你的利爪运作方式就像许多怪物的天生武器一样。你可以用一只爪子进行一次攻击，或以你的正常攻击加值用两只爪子进行全力攻击，取代你的正常攻击方式。你不会因双武器战斗而受到惩罚，且两次攻击都不是次要攻击。如果你的基础攻击加值为 +6 或更高，你不会获得任何额外攻击 - 你只是以正常攻击加值进行两次爪抓攻击。

你可以用一个瞬间的想法显能此异能，快到足以在你回合攻击前获得此异能的好处。显能此异能是一个迅捷动作，就像显能一个加速异能一样，并且它计入每轮一个加速异能的正常限制。

你仍然可以用你的爪子持有和操作物品，或像用手一样施放法咒。

Level: Psychic warrior 1

Range: Personal
Target: You
Duration: 1 hour/level
Power Points: see text

You call forth the aggressive nature of the beast inherent in yourself, psionically transforming your hands into deadly claws. You gain two natural attacks with your claws, each dealing 1d4 points of damage (1d6 if you are Large or larger, or 1d3 if you are Small or smaller) plus your Strength bonus.

Your claws are natural weapons, so you are considered armed when attacking with them, and they can be affected by powers, spells, and effects that enhance or improve natural.

Your claws work just like the natural weapons of many monsters. You can make an attack with one claw or a full attack with two claws at your normal attack bonus, replacing your normal attack routine. You take no penalties for two-weapon fighting, and neither attack is a secondary attack. If your base attack bonus is +6 or higher, you do not gain any additional attacks-you simply have two claw attacks at your normal attack bonus.

You can manifest this power with an instant thought, quickly enough to gain the benefit of the power on your turn before you attack. Manifesting this power is a swift action, like manifesting a quickened power, and it counts toward the normal limit of one quickened power per round.

You can still hold and manipulate items with your claws or cast spells just as well as you could with your hands.

Augment: If you spend additional power points, you can create larger, sharper, and more deadly claws, as shown on the table below.

                Small   Medium  Large

7               1d8     2d6     3d6

This augmentation is implemented as the following two augmentation options:
1. For every 2 power points spent, the size of the claws increases by one step on the table above. This increase may be used up to 3 times.
2. For every 4 power points spent, the size of the claws increases by one step on the table above. This increase may be used up to 3 times.

职业特性：

每日法咒/已知法咒：在每个等级，佛克路坎七弦琴手获得新的每日法咒（以及已知法咒，如果适用），如同她在添加此进阶职业等级之前所属的任何一个奥术施法职业和任何一个神术施法职业上也获得了等级一样。然而，她不会获得该职业角色会获得的任何其他好处。如果她在成为佛克路坎七弦琴手之前有多个奥术施法职业或神术施法职业，她必须决定将每个佛克路坎七弦琴手等级添加到哪个职业，以确定每日法咒，已知法咒和总施法者等级。

吟游诗人知识（Ex）：佛克路坎七弦琴手可以尝试回忆关于当地知名人物，传奇物品或著名地点的一些相关信息。她将她的佛克路坎七弦琴手职业等级加到她的吟游诗人知识检定上，因此她的吟游诗人知识检定加值等于她的吟游诗人等级 + 她的佛克路坎七弦琴手等级 + 她的智力调整值。
