无束缚：佛克路坎七弦琴手的德鲁伊誓言被放宽，允许她穿着轻型金属盔甲而不失去施法，超自然或类法咒能力。吟游诗人也不会因兼职而受到经验值惩罚。（未实现）
src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
Warrior, thief, spy, poet, woodland champion -the Fochlucan lyrist is a legendary figure who serves as the herald and teacher to great kings, the champion of the common folk, and the keeper of lore long forgotten elsewhere. Only the best and brightest are invited to become Fochlucan lyrists, and those who eventually win the approval of the Fochlucan College's masters are remarkable individuals indeed, skilled in swordplay, magic, and diplomacy.

REQUIREMENTS:
Alignment: Neutral good, neutral, chaotic neutral, or neutral evil.
Skills: Spellcraft 7 ranks , Persuasion 7 ranks , Lore 7 ranks , Perform 13 ranks , Pick Pocket 7 ranks
Spellcasting: Ability to cast 1st-level arcane and divine spells.
Class: Druid (for druidic language reqs).
Special: Bardic knowledge and evasion abilities.

- Hit Die: d6
- Proficiencies: Fochlucan lyrists gain no proficiency with any weapon or armor. 
- Skill Points: 6 + Int Modifier

CLASS FEATURES:

Spells per Day/Spells Known: At each level, a Fochlucan lyrist gains new spells per day (and spells known, if applicable) as if she had also gained a level in any one arcane spellcasting class and any one divine spellcasting class to which she belonged before adding the prestige class level. She does not, however, gain any other benefit a character of that class would have gained. If she had more than one arcane spellcasting class or divine spellcasting class before becoming a Fochlucan lyrist, she must decide to which class to add each Fochlucan lyrist level for the purpose of determining spells per day, spells known, and overall caster level. 

Bardic Knowledge (Ex): A Fochlucan lyrist can attempt to recall some relevant piece of information about local notable people, legendary items, or noteworthy places. She adds her Fochlucan lyrist class level to her bardic knowledge checks, so her bardic knowledge checks have a bonus equal to her bard level + her Fochlucan lyrist level + her Int modifier.

Bardic Music: A Fochlucan lyrist adds her lyrist level to her bard level to determine the number of times per day she can use her bardic music, the bardic music abilities she can employ, and the power of those abilities. For example, a 2nd-level rogue/5th-level bard/4th-level druid/3rd-level Fochlucan lyrist can use her bardic music eight times per day, can use any bardic music ability an 8th-level bard could use (assuming she meets the Perform skill rank requirements), and is treated as an 8th-level bard for adjudicating the effects of those abilities (such as number of targets, save DC, and so forth).

Unbound: A Fochlucan lyrist's druid oaths are relaxed, allowing her to wear light metal armor with no loss of spellcasting, supernatural, or spell-like abilities. A lyrist also suffers no experience point penalty for multi-classing.  (not implemented)

src:
Psychometabolism
Level: Psychic warrior 4
Manifesting Time: 1 standard action
Range: Personal
Target: You
Duration: Concentration
Power Points: 7
Metapsionics: None

You are almost impossible to move. Your weight does not vary; instead, you mentally attach yourself to the underlying fabric of the plane. You gain a +20 bonus on Discipline skill checks. You can't voluntarily move to a new location unless you stop concentrating, which ends the power.

You cannot apply your Dexterity bonus to Armor Class; however, your anchored body gains damage reduction 15/-.

You cannot make physical attacks or perform any other large-scale movements (you can make smallscale movements, such as breathing, turning your head, moving your eyes, talking, and so on). Powers with the teleportation descriptor manifested on you automatically fail.


Implementation note: To end concentrating on the power, use the control feat again. If the power is active, that will end it instead of manifesting it.

src:
Psychokinesis [see text]
Level: Psion/wilder 3
Manifesting Time: 1 standard action
Range: 120 ft.
Area: 120-ft. line
Duration: Instantaneous
Saving Throw: Reflex half or Fortitude half; see text
Power Resistance: Yes
Power Points: 5
Metapsionics: Empower, Maximize, Twin, Widen

Upon manifesting this power, you choose cold, electricity, fire, or sonic. You release a powerful stroke of energy of the chosen type that deals 5d6 points of damage to every creature or object within the area. The beam begins at your fingertips.

Cold: A bolt of this energy type deals +1 point of damage per die. The saving throw to reduce damage from a cold bolt is a Fortitude save instead of a Reflex save.
Electricity: Manifesting a bolt of this energy type provides a +2 bonus to the save DC and a +2 bonus on manifester level checks for the purpose of overcoming power resistance.
Fire: A bolt of this energy type deals +1 point of damage per die.
Sonic: A bolt of this energy type deals -1 point of damage per die and ignores an object's hardness.

This power's subtype is the same as the type of energy you manifest.

Augment: For every additional power point you spend, this power's damage increases by one die (d6). For each extra two dice of damage, this power's save DC increases by 1.

描述符：音波  
职业：图腾师

你将魂能塑造成一个怪异的面具，基本形态类似鳄鱼。它完全没有眼睛，一个奇特的角状突起从顶部和前方伸出--整体外观类似怪异的伊尔萨克。

你在聆听检定上获得 +4 表现加值。

魂能：你投入伊尔萨克面具中的每一点魂能，都会使聆听检定上的表现加值增加 2.  

脉轮绑定（额头） 

你的伊尔萨克面具融合到你的前额上，尽管你的嘴仍在面具的嘴内说话。你的视觉有些变暗，但你发现自己对周围的声音世界变得敏锐--包括一些你从未听过的声音。你发现仅凭聆听生物发出的声音，就能极其准确地辨别其位置。

你获得一种有限形式的盲感。你可以采取移动动作，精确定位你周围 10 尺内，且你对其有效果线的最近生物的位置。你投入伊尔萨克面具中的每一点魂能，都会使此能力的范围增加 10 尺。尽管你的其他感官得到增强，你的视觉敏锐度却减弱了。你在侦察检定上受到 -4 减值。对你有利的是，你在对抗幻术的豁免检定上获得 +4 加值。

脉轮绑定（图腾）

你的伊尔萨克面具成为你实际的脸，你的下颚延长成伊尔萨克的鳄鱼般巨口。这个面具太过笨拙，无法让你进行啮咬攻击，但你可以通过面具前方的角状突起聚焦音波能量，用它以纯音波射线刺击敌人。

每 2 轮一次，你可以将音波能量聚焦成一道至多 60 尺长的射线。这是一次远程接触攻击，每一点投入的魂能对单一目标造成 1d6 点音波伤害。
src:
Yrthak Mask

Descriptors: Sonic  
Classes: Totemist 
Chakra: Brow (totem) 
Saving Throw: None

You shape incarnum into a bizarre mask, basically crocodilian in form. It lacks eyes entirely, and a weird hornlike protrusion juts from the top and front-resembling the strange yrthak in its overall appearance.

You gain a +4 competence bonus on Listen checks.

Essentia: Every point of essentia that you invest in your yrthak mask increases the competence bonus on Listen checks by 2.  

Chakra Bind (Brow) 

Your yrthak mask fuses to your forehead, though your mouth still speaks inside the mouth of the mask. Your vision dims somewhat, but you find yourself alive to the world of sounds around you-including some you had never heard before. You find that you can discern a creature's location with great accuracy simply by listening to the sounds it makes.

You gain a limited form of blindsense. You can take a move action to pinpoint the location of the nearest creature within 10 feet of you to which you have line of effect. The range of this ability increases by 10 feet for every point of essentia you invest in your yrthak mask. Even as your other senses are heightened, your visual acuity diminishes. You take a -4 penalty on Spot checks. To your benefit, you gain a +4 bonus on saving throws against illusions. 

Chakra Bind (Totem)

Your yrthak mask becomes your actual face, and your jaws lengthen into the crocodilian maw of a yrthak. The mask is too awkward to allow you to make bite attacks, but you can focus sonic energy through the hornlike protrusion on the front of the mask, using it to stab your foes with rays of pure sound.

Once every 2 rounds, you can focus sonic energy into a ray up to 60 feet long. This is a ranged touch attack that deals 1d6 points of sonic damage to a single target for every point of invested essentia.

src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
Werewolves are humanoids who can transform themselves into wolves. In its natural form, a werewolf looks like any other member of its kind, though natural lycanthropes and those who have been afflicted for a long time tend to have or acquire features reminiscent of their animal forms. In animal form, a lycanthrope resembles a powerful version of a wolf, but on close inspection, its eyes show a faint spark of unnatural intelligence.

The werewolf prestige class consists of two different classes the werewolf class and the wolf class. The first level you take in the werewolf prestige classes will always be a werewolf level. After that, every time you take a level in the werewolf prestige class, you must choose whether to level in the wolf or werewolf class.

In general leveling in the wolf class will improve your stats in your wolf and werewolf form. Leveling in the werewolf class, will give you additional abilities to use.

- Hit Die: d8.
- Proficiencies: A Werewolf does not gain any additional weapon or armor proficiencies.
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:

Feats: True Lycanthrope or Iron Will
Alignment: Any non-lawful and non-good
Other: If not a true lycanthrope, you must be infected by someone who is.

WEREWOLF CLASS FEATURES:

Level
1: Lycanthropy, Alternate Form (Wolf), Low-light Vision, Shapechanger subtype, Werewolf Feat(Spot)
2: Alternate form (hybrid), Wolf Empathy, Damage reduction (5/silver), Weapon Focus (Bite)
3: Curse of Lycanthropy, Damage reduction (10/silver)

Note: Only true lycanthropes can advance to level 3 in the werewolf class.

WOLF CLASS FEATURES:

Level
1: Str + 2, Con + 2, Natural Armor + 2, Creature attacks
2: Dex + 4, Con + 2, Alertness, Knockdown

一个被称为马鲁的民族曾在此世界生活和征战，但他们的文明早已消逝于荒原，被可怕规模的内部战争摧毁和毁灭。由于这些所谓的血肉战争，马鲁转向一种鲜为人知的艺术，称为 衍生技艺，并以此创造活体武器来进行战斗。这些通过 衍生技艺 创造的生物被统称为马鲁之裔，但更常被称为马鲁后裔。马鲁在其他领域也很先进，但他们所有的技艺都无法拯救自己免于自我毁灭。然而，马鲁后裔在许多世界的被遗忘和荒芜的废土中存留至今。
  
有时胜利是通过诡计而非鲁莽冲锋获得的。这一考虑导致马鲁创造了马鲁潜伏者亚种。马鲁将这些生物用作刺客或部队中的奸诈附属，部队中还包括马鲁突袭者和马鲁战术师。马鲁潜伏者在任何情况下总是寻找优势，但像马鲁创造的其他亚种一样，他们具有遵循马鲁战术师命令的种族倾向。这种强迫在马鲁潜伏者中比在马鲁突袭者中稍强，但经过数代无监控的繁殖，强迫已减弱到一些马鲁潜伏者可以完全忽略它的程度。然而，那些在育婴所范围内公开违抗马鲁战术师的人会被立即下令处死。

src:
A people known as the marru once lived and warred in the world, but their civilization has long since passed into the waste, devastated and destroyed by internecine wars of terrible magnitude. As a result of these so-called Flesh Wars, the marru turned to a little-understood art called spawncraft, and in so doing created living weapons to wage their battles. These spawncrafted creatures have come to be known collectively as the spawn of marru, but are more commonly referred to as marruspawn. The marru were advanced in other areas as well, but all their arts couldn't save them from destroying themselves. However, marruspawn linger on in forgotten and blasted wastelands across many worlds.
  
Sometimes victory is gained through guile rather than through headstrong charges into battle. This consideration led to the marru's creation of the marrulurk subrace. The marru used these creatures as assassins or treacherous adjuncts to units that also included marrusaults and marrutacts. Marrulurks always look for an advantage in any situation, but like other subraces created by the marru, they have a racial inclination to follow the dictates of marrutacts. This compulsion is somewhat stronger in marrulurks than in marrusaults, but after generations of unmonitored breeding, the compulsion has faded to the point where some marrulurks can ignore it entirely. However, those that openly display disobedience to a marrutact in the confines of a cr�che are ordered immediately destroyed.

Ability Adjustments: +2 Strength, +6 Dexterity, +4 Constitution, +6 Wisdom, +4 Charisma
Favored Class (Rogue): A multiclass marrulurk's rogue class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

所有修验者都有一个偏好元素：气，土，火或水。修验者选择专精元素有时由他学习的修验者教团决定。修验者所知的法咒中至少有一半必须属于他的偏好元素，而由他的教团指定的法咒通常也属于该元素。修验者自动获得偏好元素法咒的法术专攻专长好处（+1 法咒 DC），无论其属于哪个学派。
作为专精一个元素的代价，修验者被禁止学习与不同元素相关的法咒。被禁止的元素由偏好元素决定，如下所述。
气：气法咒微妙，涉及旅行，直觉，影响，预言和幻术。土是气修验者的被禁止元素。全视之眼教团和春和风教团专精气魔法。
土：土法咒涉及韧性和决心，健康和成长，以及身体的强度。气是土修验者的被禁止元素。不破坩埚教团和完美雕塑教团专精土魔法。
火：火法咒具有破坏性和公然性，尽管它们也涉及智力，灵感和创造力。水是火修验者的被禁止元素。吞噬之焰教团专精火魔法。
水：水法咒涉及转变，净化，治疗和友谊。火是水修验者的被禁止元素。禁地荒原教团和细雨教团专精水魔法。
不可言说之谜教团的修验者可以专精四种元素中的任何一种。不可言说之谜教团也训练专精第五元素，虚空的修验者。
src:
Type: Class
Prerequisite: Shugenja level 1
All Shugenjas have a favored element: air, earth, fire, or water. A Shugenja's choice of specialized element is sometimes determined by the Shugenja order in which he studies. At least half the spells the Shugenja knows must belong to his favored element, and the spell dictated by his order often belongs to that element as well. Shugenjas automatically gain the benefits of the Spell Focus feat (+1 to spell DCs) for spells from their favored element, regardless of it's school
As the cost of specializing in one element, a Shugenja is prohibited from learning spells associated with a different element. The prohibited element is dictated by the favored element, as described below.
Air: Air spells are subtle, involving travel, intuition, influence, divination, and illusion. Earth is the prohibited element for Air Shugenjas. The Order of the All-Seeing Eye and the Order of the Spring Zephyr specialize in Air magic.
Earth: Earth spells involve resilience and resolve, health and growth, and the strength of it's body. Air is the prohibited element for Earth Shugenjas. The Order of the Impenetrable Crucible and the Order of the Perfect Sculpture specialize in Earth magic.
Fire: Fire spells are destructive and blatant, though they also deal with intelligence, inspiration, and creativity. Water is the prohibited element for Fire Shugenjas. The Order of the consuming Flame specializes in Fire magic.
Water: Water spells involve transformation, cleansing, healing, and friendship. Fire is the prohibited element for Water Shugenjas. The Order of the Forbidding Wasteland and the Order of the Gentle Rain specialize in water magic.
The Shugenjas of the Order of the Ineffable Mystery can specialize in any of the four elements. The Order of the Ineffable Mystery also trains Shugenjas who specialize in the fifth element, the void.

"几乎没有。我不知道是因为这里没有人富到可以贿赂他们来履行职责，还是他们只是把我们当作无望的事业放弃了，但你不太可能在这附近看到任何守卫，或其他与政府有关的人。这里甚至应该有一个政府运营的扶贫办公室，是几年前一些贵族安排设立的。你会以为如果有人能叫来守卫，他们就能，但尽管这个办公室应该像我们一样做慈善工作，据所有人所知，它从未真正做过。他们把自己锁在他们建立的漂亮豪华建筑里，你可能在来的路上见过，天知道在做什么。我猜是低效和腐败，就像这座城市里的大多数事情一样。"
src: "Hardly. I don't know if it's because no one here is rich enough to bribe them to do their jobs, or they've just given us up as a hopeless cause, but you're not likely to see any Watchmen around here, or much of anyone else involved with the government. There's even supposed to be a government-run Poverty Relief Office here, that some nobles arranged to set up a few years ago. You'd think they could call the Watch in if anyone could, but though this Office is suppposed to do charity work much as we do, as far as anyone can tell it never actually does. They lock themselves in that nice luxurious building they set up, that you might have seen on your way here, doing who knows what. Ineffecient and corrupt, I suppose, like most everything else in this city."

He hired on our band to assist him in this task, and we duly destroyed the Yuan-ti in question."

src: "There was this woman, a vampire as well but a mage too, I think, and some kind of leader. She was displeased with what the other vampires had done, kidnapping us. They weren't supposed to reveal their presence in that way, but it seems some of them were recently turned and hadn't anticipated how strong their bloodlust would be. They weren't able to control it, and wanted more blood than had been rationed to them. So they went after us. Anyway this mage vampire chewed them out and went on about how what they were doing was poor service to their lord, and showed a lack of devotion to the great cause, and stuff like that."

src:
The epic Cerebremancer is a scholar of two worlds, one of incantations and sigils, the other of thoughts shaped into force. They weave arcane threads with psionic clarity, bending the very essence of reality with twin pillars of intellect and magic. To them, the mind is just another spellbook, and magic merely another expression of will. In their hands, knowledge becomes transcendence, and dual mastery becomes a singular, unstoppable force.

Skill Points at Each Additional Level: 2 + Int Modifier
Bonus Feats: The epic Cerebremancer gains a bonus feat every six levels.

Special:
Spellcasting: At each class level the epic Cerebremancer continues to increase in arcane caster level (and spells known, if applicable).

src:
Acererak, the Devourer
  
Acererak, a half-human lich, grasped at godlike power only to lose his grip on reality. As a vestige, he grants abilities that are similar to a lich's powers.

Vestige Level: 5th
Binding DC: 25
Special Requirement: None

Influence: As a vestige, Acererak possesses the immortality he desired but none of the power that should accompany it. If you fall under his influence, you evince a strong hunger for influence and primacy. If you are presented with an opportunity to fill a void in power over a group of creatures, Acererak requires that you attempt to seize that power. You might impersonate a missing city offi cial, take command of a leaderless unit of soldiers, or even grab the reins of runaway horses to establish your supremacy.

Granted Abilities: 
While bound to Acererak, you gain powers that the great lich held in his legendary unlife.

Detect Undead: You can use detect undead as the spell at will (caster level equals your effective binder level).

Hide from Undead: At will as a standard action, you can cast hide from undead.

Lich's Energy Immunities: You gain immunity to cold and electricity damage.

Paralyzing Touch: As a standard action, you can make a touch attack to paralyze a living foe. The touched creature must succeed on a Fortitude save or be paralyzed for a number of rounds equal to one-half your effective binder level. Each round on its turn, the paralyzed creature can attempt a new saving throw as a full-round action, with success ending the effect immediately. Once you have used this ability, you cannot do so again for 5 rounds.

Undead Healing: Negative energy (such as that of an inflict spell) heals you rather than damaging you. If you are a living creature, positive energy (such as a cure spell) still heals you as well.

src: "He did nothing more than meet with a shopkeeper, to whom he delivered some letters and packages. This convinced me that my shipmate was no more than a cog in some larger device, and I realized that, to get to the real truth of whatever was going on, I would have to follow the shopkeeper. This I did, and he led me deep into a section of the city unfamiliar to me, the great palaces of the wealthy nobles. No surprise, I suppose. Those of the Rune would doubtless seek to extend their influence to the haunts of the rich and powerful in particular."

dst: 术士 寒冰锥
"我不指望他们会。通常，我们伊尔梅特的信徒以耐心和宽容忍受侮辱和冒犯。我们不害怕，事实上我们欢欣于自己受苦，但绝不会轻易给任何人带来痛苦，即使是敌人。这是我们神的命令。然而有时不抵抗邪恶本身会造成如此多的痛苦，以至于我们必须破例。但我必须警告你，即使我认为在这种情况下武力措施是合理的，它们已经被尝试过，结果并不令人满意。我不愿把你送入如此严重的危险中。"
src: "I do not expect that they will. Normally we followers of Ilmater bear insults and offenses with patience and forbearance. We do not fear, indeed we rejoice, to suffer ourselves, and yet would never lightly inflict suffering on anyone else, even an enemy. Such are the commands of our god. Yet sometimes not resisting evil can cause so much suffering itself that we must make an exception. I must warn you though, that even though I think forceful measures justifiable in these circumstances, they have already been attempted with less than satisfactory results. I hesitate to send you into such grave danger."

Incarnum forms a mask resembling the head of a steel-plated bull, complete with long, arcing silver horns. The mask's eyes are empty black pits.

While wearing a gorgon mask, you gain a +1 resistance bonus on Fortitude saves and a +2 resistance bonus on any check or saving throw to resist being bull rushed, tripped, overrun, or trampled. 

Essentia: Every point of essentia you invest in your gorgon mask increases your resistance bonuses by 1.

Chakra Bind (Throat)

The dusky, metallic scales of your gorgon mask extend down your neck, forming a sharp ridge along your upper spine. Wisps of green smoke escape from your mouth.

You gain the ability to breathe a cloud of petrifying gas on an adjacent foe. If the target fails a Fortitude save, it turns to stone, as the flesh to stone spell. You can use this ability once per day.

Chakra Bind (Totem) 

The metallic scales of your gorgon mask extend down over your shoulders, lending bulk and solidity to your frame. You feel strength coursing through your legs in particular, giving you the ability to run down your foes and crush them beneath your feet.

You gain the ability to make a trample attack. As a full-round action, you can move up to twice your speed and literally run over any creature equal to your own size or smaller. Your trample attack deals 1d8 points of bludgeoning damage (or 1d6 points if you are Small) plus 1-1/2 times your Strength modifier. Opponents have a Reflex save for half damage.

src:
School: Conjuration (Teleportation)
Level: Brd 4, Sor/Wiz 4, Travel 4
Components: V
Casting Time: 1 standard action
Range: Long (400 ft. + 40 ft./level)
Target: You and other touched willing creatures (i.e.. party members within 10ft of you)
Duration: Instantaneous
Saving Throw: None
Spell Resistance: No

You instantly transfer yourself from your current location to any other spot within range. You always arrive at exactly the spot desired - whether by simply visualizing the area or by stating direction**. You may also bring one additional willing Medium or smaller creature or its equivalent per three caster levels. A Large creature counts as two Medium creatures, a Huge creature counts as two Large creatures, and so forth. All creatures to be transported must be in contact with you. *

Notes:
* Implemented as within 10ft of you due to the lovely quality of NWN location tracking code.
** The direction is the same as the direction of where you target the spell relative to you. A listener will be created so you can say the distance.

法律的存在是有原因的。如果没有法律以及维护和执行法律的人，社会乃至生命本身将迅速崩溃为无政府状态。混乱在战场上迅速滋生，通常光荣的士兵有时会在战斗的欲望中失去理智。这个法咒通过迫使区域内所有混乱生物暂时被震慑，同时秩序者恢复应有的秩序，来消散这种火花。

src:
School: Evocation [Law]
Components: V, S
Range: Personal
Target: Self
Area: 40' Radius
Duration: Instantaneous
Saving Throw: Will negates(special, see below)
Spell Resistance: Yes

Laws are in place for a reason. Society, and life in general, would quickly crumble into anarchy were it not for the laws and the ones who uphold them and see to their maintain. Chaos breeds quickly on the battlefield, where normally honorable soldiers sometimes begin losing their minds in the lust of the fight. This spell diffuses the spark, by forcing all chaotic creatures in the area to stand stunned for a time, while the lawful restore what should be.
A word of caution to the caster of a chaotic influence: You may begin to notice a lessening of your anarchist tendencies with each casting of this spell.

在穿越卡林杉的旅途中，我遇到了一辆商队残骸，它曾遭到不明劫掠者的袭击。这些劫掠者残忍地杀害了商队成员，似乎更热衷于单纯的破坏而非抢劫。在继续我的旅程之前，追踪并解决他们或许是个好主意。\n\n事实证明，这次袭击是萨达拉什所为，他是一位信奉以暴力推进德鲁伊议程的暗影德鲁伊。我会见了他并试图避免战斗，因为我同情他的目标。萨达拉什要求我袭击我发现被毁商队所在道路南边的一座农场，并杀死那里所有人，以此证明我对他事业的忠诚。我照做了，他给了我丰厚的奖赏，包括一些金币和一把装有非常贵重物品的箱子的钥匙。今天我们俩都找到了一个新盟友，自然秩序的福祉无疑将从中受益。
src: While traveling through Calimshan, I came across the wreckage of a caravan that had been attacked by unknown raiders. These raiders had savagely killed the caravan members, and seemed more interested in simple destruction than in robbery. It might be a good idea to track them down and deal with them before continuing on my journey.\n\nIt turns out the attack was the work of Sadarash, a shadow druid who believes in using violence to advance the druidical agenda. I met with him and tried to avoid fighting, as I sympathize with his goals. Sadarash asked me to attack a farm to the south of the road on which I found the destroyed caravan and kill everyone there, thereby proving my commitment to his cause. I have done this and he has rewarded me well, with some gold and the key to a chest containing some very valuable items. Both of us have found a new ally this day, and the well-being of the natural order will doubtless benefit from this.

（进阶职业）
法师杀手是一个稀有的群体，专精于设计用来对抗其他施法者的魔法。法师杀手不仅像战士一样训练，还精通法咒以利用他们奥术敌人的弱点。有些人使用陷阱，另一些人偏好武器，但所有人都将他们的魔法技能磨练到极致 - 因为正是这些魔法能力使法师杀手区别于大多数普通的猎人和杀手。

法师杀手会与各种各样的人交往以帮助他们定位并接触他们的敌人，但克服这些敌人并终结他们悲惨生命的肮脏工作则牢牢地由法师杀手自己承担。

- 生命骰：d4。
- 武器和防具擅长：法师杀手不获得任何额外的武器或防具擅长。
- 技能点：2+ 智力调整值。

要求：

法咒：能够施放 4 级奥术。
专长：强韧加强，闪电反射，战斗施法，任意军用武器擅长。
技能：法咒辨识（10 级）.

职业特性：

等级
1：强化豁免 - 法师杀手可以选择获得 +1 加值到反射或强韧豁免。
2：强效召唤 - 任何用召唤法咒召唤出的生物都略微增强，获得一个额外生命骰以及攻击和伤害检定 +1 加值。
3：强化豁免。
4：专长 - 法术专攻：塑能 - 为所有塑能学派的法咒提供 +2 豁免 DC 加值。
5：强化豁免。
6：专长 - 法术专攻：死灵。
7：强化豁免。
8：专长 - 法术专攻：咒法。
9：强化豁免。
10：专长 - 法术专攻：变化。

奖励法咒

在法师杀手职业上获得等级时，角色获得新的每日法咒，如同他们在其最高奥术施法职业上也获得了等级一样。然而，通过此能力不会学习到新法咒。
src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
Mage Killers are a rare breed, specializing in magic designed to combat other spellcasters. The Mage Killer not only trains like a warrior, but also masters spells to exploit the weaknesses of their arcane foes. Some use traps, others prefer weapons, but all hone their magical skills to a fine point - for it is these magical abilities that distinguish Mage Killers from the majority of mundane hunters and killers.

A Mage Killer will fraternize with all sorts of people to help them locate and gain access to their enemies, but the dirty business of overcoming those foes and putting an end to their miserable lives is kept firmly on the Mage Killer's own shoulders.

- Hit Die: d4.
- Proficiencies: A Mage Killer does not gain any additional weapon or armor proficiencies.
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:

Spells: Able to cast 4th-level arcane spells.
Feats: Great Fortitude, Lightning Reflexes, Combat Casting, Any Martial Weapon Proficiency.
Skills: Spellcraft (10 ranks).

CLASS FEATURES:

Level
1: Improved Saves - The Mage Killer can choose to gain a +1 bonus to either Reflex or Fortitude saves.
2: Augment Summoning - Any creatures called forth with summoning spells are slightly enhanced, gaining one extra hit die and a +1 bonus on attack and damage rolls.
3: Improved Saves.
4: Feat - Spell Focus: Evocation - Provides a +2 bonus to the DC for all spells in the Evocation school.
5: Improved Saves.
6: Feat - Spell Focus: Necromancy.
7: Improved Saves.
8: Feat - Spell Focus: Conjuration.
9: Improved Saves.
10: Feat - Spell Focus: Transmutation.

BONUS SPELLS

Upon gaining a level in Mage Killer, the character gains new spells per day as if they had also gained a level in their highest Arcane spellcasting class. No new spells are learned through this ability, however.

“不完全是，因为正是通过我作为圣武士的侍奉，我才将我那可疑的邪魔血统中的元素引导到适当的道路上。我发现我无法完全根除恶魔的成分，它是我的一部分，但伊尔梅特教导我，一切邪恶都源于对某种善的腐化或扭曲，在他的帮助下，我可以回归那原初的善。我的恶魔嗜血欲可以转化为圣武士对正义的追求，而我邪魔般的狡诈天赋不必像其他泰夫林，1 级武者那样常常用于偷窃，而是可以用来侦察和渗透邪恶、防范其狡诈的陷阱、解救其囚犯……但我有些说远了，因为我是在后来才学到这些教训的。起初，我觉得我内心的恶魔完全是邪恶的，绝非容易对付的东西。”
src: "Not quite, for it is through my service as a paladin that I channel the dubious elements of my fiendish heritage into appropriate paths. I found I could not completely extirpate the demonic element, it was part of who I was, but Ilmater taught me that all evils come from the corruption or perversion of something good, and that with his aid I could return to that original good. My demonic bloodlust could be transformed into the paladin's fight for justice, and my fiendish aptitude for devious cunning need not be devoted to thievery, as it so often is among other tieflings, but used to scout and infiltrate evil, protect against its devious traps, liberate its prisoners...but I am getting a little ahead of things, for it was only later that I learned these lessons. At first I found the demon in me to be wholly evil, and no easy thing to deal with."

Haagenti, Mother of Minotaurs
  
Haagenti tricked the god of frost giants and paid a terrible price for that deed. She girds her summoners for battle and gives them the power to confuse foes.

Vestige Level: 2nd
Binding DC: 17
Special Requirement: To summon Haagenti, you must be Large.

Influence: You feel ashamed and occasionally bashful in the presence of beautiful creatures. In addition, Haagenti requires that you give deference to any creature you perceive as more attractive or charismatic than yourself. This deference might take the form of a bow, a salute, opening a door for the creature in question, not speaking until spoken to, or any other gesture that acknowledges the creature as superior to you. In any case, you must constantly treat any such creature with respect or suffer the penalty for defying Haagenti's influence.

Granted Abilities: 
Haagenti grants you some of Thrym's skill with arms and armor, plus her own aversion to transformation and the ability to inflict a state of confusion upon others.

Confusing Touch: You can confuse by touch. The target of your touch attack must succeed on a Will save or become confused for 1 round per three effective binder levels you possess. When you attain an effective binder level of 19th, this ability functions as a maze spell. Once you have used this ability, you cannot do so again for 5 rounds.

Immunity to Transformation: No mortal magic can permanently affect your form while you are bound to Haagenti. You are immune to polymorph and petrification effects.

Shield Proficiency: You are proficient with shields, including tower shields.

Weapon Proficiency: You are proficient with the battleaxe, greataxe, handaxe, and throwing axe.

半龙生物总是比同族中没有龙类血统的生物更为强大，它们的外表也暴露了其本性 - 鳞片，细长的特征，爬虫类的眼睛，以及夸张的牙齿和爪子。有时它们还长有翅膀。

创建半龙类

“半龙类” 是一种遗传模板，可添加到任何活着的，有实体的生物（以下称为基础生物） 上。
半龙使用基础生物的所有数据和特殊能力，除非此处另有说明。

体型与类型
该生物的类型变为龙类。体型不变。不要重新计算基础攻击加值或豁免。

生命骰
将基础生物的种族 HD 增加一个骰子等级，最大为 d12. 不要增加职业 HD.

速度
体型为大型或更大的半龙长有翅膀，能以两倍于其基础陆地速度飞行（最大 120 尺），机动性为普通。体型为中型或更小的半龙没有翅膀。

防御等级
天生防御提高 +4。

攻击
半龙有两次爪抓攻击和一次啮咬攻击，爪子是主要天生武器。如果基础生物能使用武器，半龙保留此能力。半龙徒手战斗时，进行攻击动作时使用爪子。当它持有武器时，通常改用武器。

全力攻击
半龙徒手战斗时，进行全力攻击时使用双爪和啮咬。如果持有武器，它通常将武器作为主要攻击，将啮咬作为天生次要攻击。如果它有一只手空闲，则使用爪子作为额外的天生次要攻击。

伤害
半龙有啮咬和爪抓攻击。如果基础生物没有这些攻击形式，使用下表中的伤害值。否则，使用下表中的值或基础生物的伤害值，取较高者。

特殊攻击
半龙保留基础生物的所有特殊攻击，并根据其龙类品种获得一种喷吐武器（见表格），每天可使用一次。半龙的喷吐武器造成 6d8 点伤害。成功的反射豁免（DC 10 + 1 半龙的种族 HD + 半龙的体质调整值） 可将伤害减半。

特殊性质
半龙拥有基础生物的所有特殊性质，外加 60 尺黑暗视觉和昏暗视觉。半龙免疫睡眠和麻痹效果，并根据其龙类品种获得一项额外免疫。

技能
半龙以龙类身份获得技能点，其技能点等于（6 + 智力调整值） ?(HD + 3). 不要将职业等级的生命骰计入此计算。半龙仅为其种族生命骰获得龙类技能点，并为其职业等级获得正常数量的技能点。将基础生物技能列表中的技能视为本职技能，其他技能视为跨职技能。

src:
Half-dragon creatures are always more formidable than others of their kind that do not have dragon blood, and their appearance betrays their nature - scales, elongated features, reptilian eyes, and exaggerated teeth and claws. Sometimes they have wings. 

Creating A Half-Dragon

"Half-dragon" is an inherited template that can be added to any living, corporeal creature (referred to hereafter as the base creature).
A half-dragon uses all the base creature's statistics and special abilities except as noted here.

Size and Type
The creature's type changes to dragon. Size is unchanged. Do not recalculate base attack bonus or saves.

Hit Dice
Increase base creature's racial HD by one die size, to a maximum of d12. Do not increase class HD.

Speed
A half-dragon that is Large or larger has wings and can fly at twice its base land speed (maximum 120 ft.) with average maneuverability. A half-dragon that is Medium or smaller does not have wings.

Armor Class
Natural armor improves by +4.

Attack
A half-dragon has two claw attacks and a bite attack, and the claws are the primary natural weapon. If the base creature can use weapons, the half-dragon retains this ability. A half-dragon fighting without weapons uses a claw when making an attack action. When it has a weapon, it usually uses the weapon instead.

Full Attack
A half-dragon fighting without weapons uses both claws and its bite when making a full attack. If armed with a weapon, it usually uses the weapon as its primary attack and its bite as a natural secondary attack. If it has a hand free, it uses a claw as an additional natural secondary attack.

Damage
Half-dragons have bite and claw attacks. If the base creature does not have these attack forms, use the damage values in the table below. Otherwise, use the values below or the base creature's damage values, whichever are greater.

Half-Dragon DamageSize Bite Damage Claw Damage
Fine                      1           -
Diminutive            1d2         1
Tiny                      1d3         1d2
Small                     1d4         1d3
Medium                 1d6         1d4
Large                    1d8         1d6
Huge                     2d6         1d8
Gargantuan          3d6         2d6
Colossal                4d6         3d6

Special Attacks
A half-dragon retains all the special attacks of the base creature and gains a breath weapon based on the dragon variety (see table), usable once per day. A half-dragon's breath weapon deals 6d8 points of damage. A successful Reflex save (DC 10 + 1 half-dragon's racial HD + half-dragon's Con modifier) reduces damage by half.

Half-Dragon Special Attacks:
Dragon Variety  Breath Weapon
Black           60-foot line of acid
Blue            60-foot line of lightning
Green           30-foot cone of corrosive (acid) gas
Red             30-foot cone of fire
White           30-foot cone of cold
Brass           60-foot line of fire
Bronze          60-foot line of lightning
Copper          60-foot line of acid
Gold            30-foot cone of fire
Silver          30-foot cone of cold

Special Qualities
A half-dragon has all the special qualities of the base creature, plus darkvision out to 60 feet and low-light vision. A half-dragon has immunity to sleep and paralysis effects, and an additional immunity based on its dragon variety.

Half-Dragon Immunities:
Dragon Variety Immunity

Blue             Electricity
Green          Acid
Red             Fire
White          Cold
Brass           Fire
Bronze         Electricity
Copper        Acid

Abilities
Increase from the base creature as follows: Str +8, Con +2, Int +2, Cha +2.

Skills
A half-dragon gains skill points as a dragon and has skill points equal to (6 + Int modifier) ?(HD + 3). Do not include Hit Dice from class levels in this calculation. The half-dragon gains dragon skill points only for its racial Hit Dice, and gains the normal amount of skill points for its class levels. Treat skills from the base creature's list as class skills, and other skills as cross-class.

Environment
Same as either the base creature or the dragon variety.

Challenge Rating
Same as the base creature + 2 (minimum 3).

Alignment
Same as the dragon variety.

Level Adjustment
Same as base creature +3.

This spell imbues an area with negative energy.

An undead creature created within or summoned into such an area gains +1 hit points per HD.

Furthermore, anyone who casts animate dead within this area may animate as many as double the normal amount of undead (that is, 4 HD per caster level rather than 2 HD per caster level).

翼人是阿塔斯本土的爬虫类种族，具体来说，是称为腹地的地区。他们很少离开家乡村庄，但最近的自然灾害促使不少少数人进入表土之地。他们在不熟悉的人面前通常沉默谨慎，但在朋友中间则乐观，开放，友好且好奇。每个翼人选择一条定义其个性的生活道路，或者也许反过来。战士翼人对表土之地的残酷最不以为意，并从军事策略中获得乐趣。德鲁伊翼人最关心自然，在消除对自然的威胁时获得最大乐趣。灵能翼人最善于社交，在解决谜题和争端等智力追求中获得最大乐趣。身体上，他们身高在5英尺到6英尺6英寸之间，有浅棕色鳞状皮肤。他们穿着很少，喜欢腰带和缠腰布，后脑有鳍状生长物。雄性和雌性之间没有可见区别。

翼人属性调整：+2 感知，+2 魅力，-2 敏捷
偏好职业（心灵术士）：兼职翼人的心灵术士职业在决定是否因兼职而受到经验值惩罚时不计入。

特殊能力：

- 30英尺基础速度
- 听力不佳：聆听获得-2种族惩罚。
- 天生武器：可进行天生咬击（1d4）和爪击（各1d3）.
- 爬虫类：在法咒效果上，翼人视为爬虫类。

src:
Pterrans are a reptilian race native to Athas, specifically to the region called the Hinterlands.  They rarely leave their home villages, but recent natural disasters have inspired more than the rare few to enter the Tablelands.  They are typically subdued and cautious among unfamiliar people, but when among friends they are optimistic, open, friendly, and inquisitive.  Each Pterran chooses a life path that defines their personality, or perhaps the other way around.  Warrior pterrans are the least disturbed by the brutality of the Tablelands, and take pleasure in military strategy.  Druidic pterrans are most concerned with nature, and take the greatest pleasure when they eliminate a threat to it.  Psionic pterrans are the most social, and take the greatest pleasure in intellectual pursuits such as solving riddles and resolving disputes.  Physically they are anywhere between 5' and 6'6" tall, with light brown scaly skin.  They wear little clothing, preferring sashes and loincloths, and have a finlike growth on the back of their head.  There is no visible distinction between males and females.

Pterran Ability Adjustments: +2 Wis, +2 Cha, -2 Dex
Favored Class (Psion): A multiclass pterran's psion class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

- 30' base speed
- Poor Hearing: -2 racial penalty to Listen.
- Natural Weapon: Can make natural bite(1d4) and claw attacks(1d3 each).
- Reptilian: Pterrans count as Reptilian for the purpose of spells.

阿瑞忒，第一位厄兰人
  
阿瑞忒，一位寻求永生的强大心灵术士，创造了一个新种族，却注定自己永无止境地重生。他授予的能力为缚灵者提供了几种强化身心的特性。

缚灵等级：4级
缚灵DC: 21
特殊要求：阿瑞忒不喜欢被提醒厄兰人被某些人视为憎恶，如果你已经缚灵于丘波克洛普斯或欧律诺墨，他不会回应你的召唤。

影响：在缚灵于阿瑞忒期间，你不会感到饥饿或疲倦，但如果你在缚灵持续期间不吃不睡，你会遭受负面效果。如果需要进行研究，阿瑞忒坚持要求你也寻找关于他和他对永生研究的传说，这通常会使你寻找信息的时间加倍甚至三倍。

授予能力：
在缚灵于阿瑞忒期间，你获得阿瑞忒在寻求永生过程中曾拥有的力量。

灵能恩惠：当你缚灵于阿瑞忒时，你获得13点灵能点。如果你已经拥有灵能，这些点加入你的灵能池，或者它们创建一个灵能池，并且在此缚灵持续期间你成为一个灵能生物。

抗力：你选择的一项豁免检定获得+4加值。你可以用一个移动动作将其改为另一项豁免检定。

伤害减免：你的身体变得异常坚韧，获得伤害减免5/-.

充盈：在缚灵持续期间，你获得灵能身体调整和身体净化的使用权。你可以像心灵术士一样展现每个灵能，并视其为你所知的灵能。你可以像心灵术士通常那样增幅每个灵能，用你的有效缚灵者等级代替显能者等级。
src:
Arete, the First Elan
  
Arete, a powerful psion who sought immortality, created a new race but doomed himself to never-ending rebirths. His granted abilities provide binders with access to several qualities that toughen the body and mind.

Vestige Level: 4th
Binding DC: 21
Special Requirement: Arete does not like to be reminded that the elan are considered abominations by some, and he does not answer your summons if you are already bound to Chupoclops or Eurynome.

Influence: You do not get hungry or tired while bound to Arete, but you do suffer negative effects if you do not eat or sleep for the duration that the vestige is bound. If faced with a need to do research, Arete insists that you seek out lore regarding him and his research into immortality as well, which can often double or even triple the time you spend seeking information.

Granted Abilities: 
While bound to Arete, you gain powers that Arete had at some point in his search for immortality.

Psionic Boon: You gain 13 power points when you bind to Arete. These are added to your pool of power if you already possess psionic power, or they create a pool and you become a psionic creature for the duration of this binding.

Resistance: Your gain a +4 bonus on a saving throw of your choice. You may change this to another saving throw as a move action.

Damage Reduction: Your body becomes unnaturally tough as you gain damage reduction 5/-.

Repletion: You gain access to the psionic powers body adjustment and body purification for the duration of the binding. You may manifest each power as a psion would and as if it is a power known by you. You may augment each power as a psion normally could, substituting your effective binder level in place of manifester level.

src:
At epic levels, the dragon shaman becomes a living embodiment of draconic majesty. Their auras grow stronger, their breath weapon rivals that of ancient wyrms, and their resilience is all but unshakable. With wings unfurled and power drawn directly from their totem dragon's essence, they stride through battle as a paragon of scaled might and unwavering purpose.

Hit Die: d10.
Skill Points at Each Additional Level: 2 + Intelligence modifier.
Bonus Feats: The epic Dragon Shaman gains a bonus feat every three levels.

Special:
Draconic Armor: The epic Dragon Shaman's Natural Armor bonus grows to +4 at level 22 and continues to increase by +1 every 5 levels thereafter.
Draconic Aura: The epic Dragon Shaman's draconic aura power continues to increase, becoming +6 at 25 and growing by 1 every 5 levels thereafter.

Epic Dragon Shaman Bonus Feat List:
Armor Skin, Blinding Speed, Epic Damage Reduction, Epic Energy Resistance, Epic Fortitude, Epic Leadership, Epic Prowess, Epic Reflexes, Epic Reputation, Epic Toughness, Epic Weapon Focus, Epic Will, Fast Healing, Great Charisma, Great Constitution, Improved Whirlwind Attack, Legendary Commander, Superior Initiative.

最初的夺魂者是一件传奇武器，拥有自我意识，据说能够随意变形为持有者想要的任何形态。它有时会以一把由残暴黑暗卫士挥舞的巨剑出现，有时又会以一把谋杀刺客手中的匕首现身。有些人相信这把武器实际上是一个以某种方式被困在剑刃中的邪恶恶魔。当然，这把武器自我意识和奇异力量的来源必定是彻底邪恶的。它之所以得名，不仅因为其吸取生命的力量，还因为它倾向于腐化任何触碰它的人。一些高尚的战士从邪恶持有者手中夺得此武器后，试图用它行善，却发现自己只要持有它，就会被不可抗拒地引向邪恶。\n\n有一次，当夺魂者落入一位精通锻造的战士手中时，它诱使这位战士制造了许多不同形态的复制品，并以某种方式将这些新武器注入了一些自身的特性。这把刀刃就是这些武器之一：它缺乏原版的自我意识和变形能力，威力也远不如原版，但仍保留了相同的基本特征：包括腐化持有者的能力。
src: The original Soulstealer was a legendary weapon that was sentient and said to be able to transform itself into whatever shape its wielder desired. It would make its appearance on one occasion as a mighty sword swung by a brutal blackguard, and on another as a dagger in the hands of a murderous assassin. Some believed that the weapon was actually a vile demon who had somehow been trapped within a blade. Certainly the source of the weapon's sentience and strange powers must have been thoroughly evil. It earned its name not only through its life-draining powers, but its proclivity to corrupt anyone who so much as touched it. Some noble warriors who captured the weapon from its evil wielders attempted to use it for good, only to find themselves irresistibly drawn to evil as long as they kept it in their possession.\n\nOnce when the Soulstealer came into the possession of a warrior with extensive knowledge of crafting, it induced him to make numerous copies of itself in various forms, and somehow infused these new weapons with some of its own properties. This blade is one of these weapons: it lacks the original's sentience and transformative abilities, and is much less powerful, but still retains the same basic characteristics: including the ability to corrupt its possessor.

dst: <StartCheck>[失败]</Start> "与你可能最终面对的东西相比，像你这样的冒险者和像哈辛这样的作家之间的能力差异微不足道。但现在我仔细想想，我意识到我其实并不在乎。我一直相信人要为自己的行为负责：即使别人指了路，走不走还是自己的选择。我不是你的监护人，就像我不是哈辛的一样。那就这样吧，我会告诉你我知道的，而你必须自己选择愿意为此冒什么风险。"
src: <StartCheck>[Failure]</Start> "Compared to what you might end up facing the difference in capability between an adventurer like you and a writer like Hasin is hardly significant. But now that I think about it I realize I don't really care. I have always believed men are responsible for their own actions: even if another points the way, one still chooses to walk down it. I am not your keeper any more than I was Hasin's. So be it then, I will tell you what I know, and you must choose for yourself what you are willing to risk as a result."

School: Conjuration (Healing)
Level: Cleric/Healer 5
Components: V, S, M
Range: Touch
Target: Dead creature touched
Duration: Instantaneous
Save: None
Spell Resistance: Yes (harmless)

Revivify miraculously restores life to a recently deceased creature. However, the spell must be cast within 1 round of the victim's death. Before the soul of the deceased has completely left the body, this spell halts it's journey while repairing somewhat the damage to the body. This spell functions like Raise Dead, except that the raised creature receives no level loss, no Constitution loss, and no loss of spells. The creature is only restored to -1 hit points (but is stable).

dst:
扎拉拉给了我一封信，让我交给伊纳斯·森卡尔，一位住在“学者角落”的历史学家。扎拉拉希望他协助研究古代巨灵魔法，尤其是关于卡洛玛斯·泽卡尔拥有的那把古老魔法剑，她小时候曾激活过它的力量。她告诉我，除了把详细说明她愿望的信交给他之外，我还可以提供最多5000金币（稍后由扎拉拉支付）以确保他协助。

我已经和伊纳斯·森卡尔谈过，但他不愿意仅仅为了钱而帮助扎拉拉。相反，他要我去被称为“黑暗卡林港”的古老废墟中寻找对历史研究有价值的东西，最好是一些书面记录（如果它能保存这么久，也许可以在石碑之类的东西上找到）。我听说人们可以在下水道的多个地点进入黑暗卡林港。也许在下水道系统的某处可以进入一处合适的废墟，让我找到森卡尔所要的东西。无论如何，如果想在这件事上取得任何进展，看来我必须这么做。

我设法找到了一件合适的物品，伊纳斯·森卡尔已经答应进行扎拉拉所要求的研究，并写出结果让我带给她。不过，这需要几天时间，所以我至少应该在接下来的48小时里找点别的事做。过了这段时间后，我应该计划返回。
src:
Zarala has given me a letter to take to Inas Senkhar, a historian living in the "Scholar's Corner." Zarala wants his assistance in researching ancient djinni magic, particularly regarding the ancient magical sword owned by Kalomas Zekar whose powers she was able to activate as a child. She has told me that in addition to taking him the letter detailing her wishes, I can offer him up to 5000 gold (to be paid later by Zarala) to secure his assistance.

I have spoken to Inas Senkhar, but he is not willing to assist Zarala solely in exchange for money. Instead he wants me to search the old ruins known as "Dark Calimport" for something of value to historical research, preferably some kind of written record (perhaps to be found on a stone tablet or the like if it has survived this long). I am told that one can gain access to Dark Calimport at various points in the sewers. Perhaps somewhere in the sewer system there is access to a suitable set of ruins where I can find what Senkhar seeks. At any rate, it seems I must if any progress is to be made on this matter.

I managed to locate an appropriate item, and Inas Senkhar has promised to do the research Zarala has requested and write up the results for me to take to her. This will take a couple of days, however, so I should find something else to occupy myself for at least the next 48 hours. After that period I should plan to return.

src:
Over time, the petitioners (spirits of the departed) who arrive in the Wilderness of the Beastlands acquire animal traits, eventually becoming celestial beasts or animals. Some instead mingle with the beasts they will one day become, creating new races that are perpetually half-animal, half-humanoid. Prominent among these are the wildren, beings descended from the union of partially transformed dwarf petitioners and celestial badgers.
  
Prowling the darkest forests of Karasuthra, the Beastlands' lowest layer, wildren build elaborate underground burrows, which they defend, out of a commingled racial memory, to the death. Often short-tempered and vengeful, wildren generally live solitary lives, emerging only occasionally from their burrows to hunt and seek mates.

Ability Adjustments: +4 Constitution, -2 Dexterity, -2 Charisma
Favored Class (Barbarian): A multiclass wildren's barbarian class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

- Medium creature
- 20' base speed. He can move at this speed even when wearing medium or heavy armor
- Level Adjustment: +1
- Darkvision
- Scent
- Two 1d4 claw attacks
- Stability - +4 bonus to resist being bull rushed or tripped
- Fury (Ex) - Once per day, a wildren who has taken at least 1 point of damage can choose to enter a brief state of fury. The wildren gains +4 to Strength and -2 to Armor Class. The fury lasts for 1 round.
- Outsider: Wildren count as outsiders for the purpose of spells.

src:
Type of Feat: Class
Prerequisite: Hexblade level 1
Once per day + the Hexblade's CHA modifier, as a free action, a hexblade can unleash a curse upon a foe. The target must be visible to the Hexblade and within 60 feet. The target of a Hexblade's curse takes a -2 penalty on attacks, saves, ability checks, skill checks and weapon damage rolls for one hour thereafter. A successful Will save (DC 10 + 1/2 Hexblade's class level + Hexblade's CHA mod)negates the effect. At every 4th level beyond 1st, a Hexblade gains the ability to use his curse one additional time per day.

Greater Hexblade's Curse

When a Hexblade attains 7th level, the penalties incurred by a target of his curse become -4 instead of -2.

Dire Hexblade's Curse

When a Hexblade attains 19th level, the penalties incurred by a target of his curse become -6 instead of -4.

Epic Hexblade's Curse

When a Hexblade attains 37th level, the penalties incurred by a target of his curse become -8 instead of -6.

You cause the cyst of a subject already harboring a necrotic cyst (see spell of the same name) to physically and spiritually enlarge itself at the expense of the subject's body and soul. XP Cost: 1,000 XP.

src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
Blurring the line between divine and arcane, the Mystic Theurge draws power from divine sources and musty tomes alike. While most spellcasters choose but one path to magical power, the Mystic Theurge chooses to walk two roads at once, mastering spells common to both cleric and wizard.  This weaving of both the arcane and the divine allows the Mystic Theurge an unparalleled diversity of spells and, in time, a Mystic Theurge can learn to cast almost any spell.

Mystic theurges are often obsessed with magical lore, and will travel to the ends of the earth to gain access to some new arcane secret or divine insight.

- Hit Die: d4.
- Proficiencies: A Mystic Theurge does not gain any additional weapon or armor proficiencies.
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:

Skills: Lore (6 ranks), Concentration (6 ranks), Spellcraft (6 ranks).
Arcane Spellcasting: Can cast level 2 spells or higher.
Divine Spellcasting: Can cast level 2 spells or higher.

BONUS SPELLS:

Each level, the Mystic Theurge gains new spells per day as if they had also gained a level in both their arcane spellcasting class and their divine spellcasting class.  No new spells are learned through this ability, however.

Korad only accepts select students, and would not train Zarala, but her thinking is that since even his students are quite formidable, one of them could be hired. She has told me to offer potential instructors an incentive of 250 gold per lesson, plus 500 up front, and given me some gold to pay this latter advance. I can keep whatever I don't need to spend.

src: Nasirak has told me of an Ilmaterian monk named Iram who is a hermit living in a cave just outside the city walls. This Iram sometimes offers training and instruction to other monks, and Nasirak has recommended that, as a monk, I would be well-advised to seek him out. He has given me a key to a grate near the north wall of the sewers beneath the slums, which I would have no reason to notice earlier, that leads to a series of passages and caves heading north, terminating out in the desert near the hermit's cave. This is the quickest route there, but Nasirak has warned me it can also be hazardous.\n\nI have followed the path laid out and located Master Iram in his cave. He has commenced my training program and given me a couple of tasks: I am to get the hair shirt in a bag in the southwest corner of his cave, which I am to wear during my training, and I am also to go back to the tunnel I traveled through to get here in order to obtain several items of monk gear found on a corpse therein.

Mauling Gauntlets

Descriptors: None  
Classes: Soulborn 
Chakra: Arms, hands
Saving Throw: None

Incarnum forms gauntlets that surround your hands (including any gloves or gauntlets you already wear) and extend up your arms to your elbows. The metal gleams a burnished blue. Spikes and blades jut out in various places from these gauntlets, each one whispering an ancient battle cry in your mind.

While wearing mauling gauntlets, you gain a +2 morale bonus on Strength checks (but not on Strength-based skill checks), such as those to bull rush an opponent. 

Essentia: Every point of essentia you invest in your mauling gauntlets increases the morale bonus by 2.  

Chakra Bind (Arms) 

Your mauling gauntlets extend winding bands of blue steel up past your elbows, almost to your shoulders. In places, these bands of metal seem fused with your skin.

Your mauling gauntlets double the critical threat range of any melee weapon you wield. 

Chakra Bind (Hands) 

Rather than actual gauntlets, this soulmeld transforms your hands into hard blue metal. Whenever you bend your fingers, echoes of the battlefield flit through your mind, until they form a constant undertone of war chants and battle cries inspiring you to greater accomplishments in battle.

You gain a morale bonus on unarmed strike damage equal to the morale bonus on Strength checks granted by the mauling gauntlets. You also gain the benefit of the Improved Unarmed Strike feat.

传奇天佑者与她的神祇越来越亲近，获得越来越多的神圣特征和抗力。真正高等级的传奇天佑者很容易被误认为天使，魔鬼，恶魔或类似的异界生物。

法咒：天佑者的施法者等级等于其职业等级。天佑者的每日法咒数量在 20 级后不再增加。天佑者不会学习额外法咒。

精通能量抗力（Ex）：从 22 级开始，此后每四级，天佑者将她的三种能量抗力之一增加 +10。

神圣恩赐（Ex）：在 25 级及此后每五级，天佑者与她的神祇之间的纽带变得更加强大并显现于肉体。此时她可以选择以下任意一项好处。

神圣属性：天佑者选择一项属性获得 +1 加值。每次选择此恩赐时，天佑者必须选择一项新的属性进行修改。

神圣技能：天佑者在一项技能上获得 +4 神圣加值。每次选择此恩赐时，天佑者必须选择一项新的技能进行修改。

神圣法咒：天佑者选择一项她已知的法咒；所选法咒的等级必须等于或低于她的天佑者等级除以 10. 她可以每天施放此法咒一次而不消耗法术位，且每次施放此法咒时都以施法者等级 +2 结算。每次选择此恩赐时，天佑者必须选择一项新的法咒使其成为神圣法咒。

这些好处会带来某种与天佑者神祇相称的肉体变化。这可以简单到发光的眼睛，也可以惊人到由液态火焰构成的皮肤。在所有情况下，除了神圣恩赐赋予的实际游戏好处之外，这种变化仅是肉体上的。

奖励专长：传奇天佑者在 23 级获得一个奖励专长（从传奇天佑者专长列表中选择），此后每三级再获得一个。

传奇天佑者奖励专长列表：制造传奇魔法武器和护甲，毁灭性重击，传奇坚忍，传奇勇武，传奇速度，传奇法术专攻，传奇法术穿透，传奇法咒施法，传奇武器专攻，传奇武器专精，忽略材料成分，精通战斗施法，压倒性重击，完美健康，法咒偷渡，顽强魔法。
src:
An epic favored soul continues to grow closer to her deity, gaining more and more divine characteristics and resistances. A truly high level epic favored soul is easily mistaken for an angel, devil, demon, or similar outsider.

Hit Die: d8.

Skill Points at Each Additional Level: 2 + Int modifier.

Spells: The favored soul's caster level is equal to her class level. The favored soul's number of spells per day does not increase after 20th level. The favored soul does not learn additional spells.

Improved Energy Resistance (Ex): Starting at 22nd level, and every four levels thereafter, the favored soul adds +10 to one of her three energy resistances.

Divine Gift (Ex): At 25th level and every five levels thereafter, a favored soul's bond with her deity grows stronger and manifests physically. She can choose any one of the following benefits at this time.

Damage Reduction (Ex): The favored soul's damage reduction increases by +2.

Increased Flight: The favored soul's flying speed increases by +10 ft.

Natural Armor: The favored soul's natural armor bonus increases by +2.

Sacred Ability: The favored soul gains a +1 bonus to an ability score of her choice. Each time this gift is chosen, the favored soul must select a new ability to modify.

Sacred Skill: The favored soul gains a +4 sacred bonus on one skill. Each time this gift is chosen, the favored soul must select a new skill to modify.

Sacred Spell: The favored soul selects one spell she knows; the selected spell's level must be equal to or less than her favored soul level divided by 10. She can cast this spell one time each day without expending a spell slot, and each time she casts this spell it resolves at caster level +2. Each time this gift is chosen, the favored soul must select a new spell to make sacred.

These benefits carry with them some form of physical change appropriate to the favored soul's deity. This can be something as simple as glowing eyes, or it can be something as impressive as skin made of liquid fire. In all cases, apart from the actual game benefit granted by the divine gift, this change is physical only.

Bonus Feats: The epic favored soul gains a bonus feat (selected from the list of epic favored soul feats) at 23rd level and again every three levels after that.

Epic Favored Soul Bonus Feat List: Craft Epic Magic Arms and Armor, Devastating Critical, Epic Endurance, Epic Prowess, Epic Speed, Epic Spell Focus, Epic Spell Penetration, Epic Spellcasting, Epic Weapon Focus, Epic Weapon Specialization, Ignore Material Components, Improved Combat Casting, Overwhelming Critical, Perfect Health, Spell Stowaway, Tenacious Magic.

哈马德正在准备对变形蛛的总部发动袭击，既然我们已经掌握了其位置的情报。然而，他还有另一个任务要我在期间完成。他的老朋友卡洛玛斯·泽卡尔，因在反对奴隶贸易应采用何种方法上的分歧而与他闹翻，最近因我拜访了他的庄园而受到启发，联系了哈马德并试图和解。哈马德已被说服在一件与卡洛玛斯有关的事情上提供帮助。卡洛玛斯一直在卡林沙漠中维持一个营地，据我所知，他正在帮助一些人离开卡林杉（我没有被告知这些人究竟是谁，并被警告不要过多询问他们的情况）。这个营地在夜间遭到暗中袭击，其中一些人被掳走，天命不明。哈马德派我和他雇用的其他一些冒险者前往那里调查此事。\n\n结果发现，营地遭到了与龙教有关的吸血鬼的袭击。我们追踪吸血鬼到了他们的基地，杀死了他们，并赶走了他们合作的那条龙类，从而解决了此事。我已向卡洛玛斯报告了此事。哈马德仍需要被告知。
src: Hamad is preparing an assault upon the headquarters of the aranea, now that we have information on its location. However, he has another quest for me to complete in the meantime. His old friend Kalomas Zekar, with whom he had a fallin out over their disagreements about what methods should be employed in opposing the slave trade, has been inspired by my recent visit to his estate to contact Hamad and attempt a reconciliation. Hamad has been persuaded to lend assistance in a matter with which Kalomas is involved. Kalomas has been maintaining a camp in the Calim Desert for people who I am told he is assiting in leaving Calimshan (I have not been told just who these people are, and been warned against asking too many questions about them). This camp has been stealthily attacked during the night and some of the people in it carried off to some unknown fate. Hamad is sending me, and some of the other adventurers in his employ there to investigate the matter. \n\nIt turned out the camp was being attacked by vampires associated with the Cult of the Dragon. We tracked the vampires to their base and slew them, and drove off the dragon they were working with, thereby resolving this matter. I have reported this to Kalomas. Hamad still needs to be informed.

"我得以追踪我敌人的足迹一小段路。他向东去了，朝着群山方向，但我不敢追得太远，因为那会让营地失去防御，而且我不确定单凭自己能否应付发现的东西。不过，既然现在有你们的支持，我希望继续前进，沿着那些足迹追到它们通向的任何地方。即使我们不知怎么失败了，卡洛玛斯也会在接下来几天保持这个界门开启，必要时给难民一条逃生之路，这能让我安心。但我毫不怀疑，我们联手应该能够永远终结这些事件所代表的任何威胁。"
src: "I was able to follow my foe's tracks for a bit. He went eastwards, toward the mountains, but I was nervous about going too far after him, for it would leave the camp without defense, and I was not sure if I alone could deal with whatever I found. Now that I have your support, however, I hope to continue on and follow those tracks wherever they lead. Even if we somehow fail, Kalomas will be keeping this portal open over the next few day, giving the refugees an avenue of escape if need be, which will set my mind at ease. But I do not doubt that together we should be able to end forever whatever menace these events represent."

src: "It may seem strange, but so it is. In serving our god and in serving others, we ultimately serve ourselves better than we realize. I can confer three powers upon the ring. For the first, you may choose to have either a field of protection that helps deflect physical blows, or one that will assist you in evading, resisting and generally saving yourself from magical attacks and the like. For the second, you can have the ring boost either your strength, your wisdom, or your charisma. For the third, you can either receive and increase in the frequency with which you can use your power to turn the undead, or the ability to cast a couple of restorative and healing spells through the ring."

Descriptors: Light 
Classes: Totemist

Saving Throw: None

You shape incarnum into a silvery mask with a long snout, clubbed protrusions at the crown, and a long, forked tongue. The silver scales of the mask glint and gleam in the light, and the tongue seems to sway of its own accord.

You can use a detect magic effect as the spell, with a range of 10 feet.

Essentia: Every point of essentia invested in this soulmeld increases the range by 10 feet.

Chakra Bind (Brow)

Your disenchanter mask binds to your forehead, and your eyes replace the glassy black eyes in the mask's sockets. Colors seem somehow more alive to your sight-particularly the colors of spell effects and items that you know to be magical.

When using this soulmeld's detect magic ability, you can instantly determine the number, strength, and location of each magical aura present as if you had been concentrating for 3 rounds. 

Chakra Bind (Totem) 

Your face lengthens and shapes into the mask you wear, and the dangling tongue of the mask becomes your own tongue. As you extend it, you can practically taste magic in the air, and when you use the tongue to drain magic, it tastes strong and sweet, almost like a liqueur.

You can use the long tongue of your disenchanter mask to make a melee touch attack as a standard action. If it hits, you suppress the opponent's primary weapon, if any, for ten rounds.

src: In the sewers beneath the temple district, I have encountered a wererat named Querzat, who does not share the hostile tendencies of the other wererats about, and in fact seeks a cure for his lycanthropic condition. He wants me to obtain a number of items he will need to effect a cure: some belladonna, a book detailing the proper preparation for the belladonna before he dare actually ingest it, and some alchemical equipment to actually carry out said preparations. This last can be obtained from a merchant named, according to Querzat, "Blimfin Nemquin or Temquin or something." I have been given a list of items to present to this Blimfin when I locate him. Querzat is not sure where the other two items might be found, but suggests I check out the various stores in the city.\n\nI have brought Querzat all the items he requested. Let us hope his cure is imminent.

阿塔斯世界的原生矮人是一群固执而专注的种族。他们偏好有意义的工作，并以其他种族罕见的热情投入其中。每个矮人都有一个“专注”，一个他们全身心投入直至完成的目标，并且很少让任何事情阻挡他们。矮人只与他们最亲密的朋友和盟友分享他们的专注主题，而一个在完成专注前死去的矮人会缠着其专注的对象直到它完成。在身体上，他们与其他位面的矮人很像，但与他们的远亲不同，他们完全没有毛发，并且觉得毛发的概念令人厌恶。他们的皮肤通常晒得很黑，并装饰着纹身。

阿塔斯矮人属性调整：+2 体质，-2 魅力。
偏好职业（战士）：在决定兼职阿塔斯矮人是否遭受兼职经验值惩罚时，其战士职业不计入。

- 抗法咒：对法咒的豁免检定获得+2种族加值。

src:
Dwarves native to the world of Athas are a stubborn, devoted lot.  They prefer meaningful tasks, and dive into them with an intensity seldom seen in other races.  Every dwarf has a "focus" a goal that they devote their entire being to until it is accomplished, and seldom let anything stand in their way.  Dwarves only share the subject of their focus with their closest friends and allies, and a dwarf who dies before completing their focus haunts the object of it until it is finished.  Physically they are much like dwarves of other planes, but unlike their distant kin they are completely hairless, and find the idea of hair repulsive.  Their skin is usually deeply tanned, and decorated with tattoos.

Athasian Dwarf Ability Adjustments: +2 Con, -2 Cha.
Favored Class (fighter): A multiclass Athasian dwarf's fighter class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

- Darkvision: Athasian Dwarves are able to see in the dark.
- Hardiness vs. Poisons: +2 racial bonus on saving throws against poisons.
- Hardiness vs. Spells: +2 racial bonus on saving throws against spells.
- Dwarven: Athasian Dwarves count as Dwarves for the purpose of spells.

“他向我表明，我完全传统的愿望——让一个民族强大并令人畏惧——不会通过旧的方式实现，那只会导致被我们无数的敌人追捕和杀死。当然，被人畏惧往往有好处，但随着时间的推移，我们兽人开始把制造恐惧当作目的本身。我们的战士精神是好的，我学到，但需要服从于守护和保护自己人民的责任，而不是浪费在无意义的残忍和野蛮上。”
src: "He showed me that my perfectly traditional desire to have a people powerful and feared would not be served by the old ways, that it led only to being hunted down and killed by our countless enemies. Certainly there are often advantages to being feared, but over time we orcs had come to seek inspiring terror as if it were an end in itself. Our warrior spirit was good, I learned, but needed to be subordinated to the duty of guarding and protecting one's people, not wasted on pointless cruelty and barbarity."

卓尔是原始黑皮肤亚种伊利斯瑞的后裔，也被称为黑暗精灵，因跟随女神罗丝走上邪恶与堕落的道路而被善良的精灵神祇诅咒成现在的模样。他们生活在幽暗地域，建立了一个基于权力和欺骗的母权社会。卓尔拥有类似抛光黑曜石的黑皮肤和纯白或淡黄色的头发。他们通常有非常苍白的眼睛（苍白到常被误认为白色），呈淡紫色，银色，粉色和蓝色。他们也往往比大多数精灵更小更瘦。

卓尔女性往往比男性更大更强壮。卓尔社会是神权政治和强烈的母权制，女性在政府，民兵和家庭中担任所有权力和责任的职位。她们的首选职业是牧师。
卓尔男性往往比女性更小更弱。在社会中，他们往往填补战士，巡林客和游荡者的低级职位，尽管他们的魔法天赋与其他精灵亚种相等，甚至更优越。他们的首选职业是法师。

卓尔属性调整：+2 敏捷，+2 智力，+2 魅力，-2 体质。
首选职业 女性（牧师）：在确定女性卓尔是否因兼职而受到 XP 惩罚时，兼职女性卓尔牧师职业不计入。
首选职业 男性（法师）：在确定男性卓尔是否因兼职而受到 XP 惩罚时，兼职男性卓尔法师职业不计入。

特殊能力：

- 无眠：免疫 '睡眠' 子类型的法咒和效果。
- 附魔坚韧：对抗影响心智法咒的豁免检定获得 +2 种族加值。
- 钢铁意志：对抗意志的豁免检定获得 +2 种族加值。
- 技能亲和（聆听）：聆听检定获得 +2 种族加值。
- 技能亲和（搜索）：搜索检定获得 +2 种族加值。
- 技能亲和（侦察）：侦察检定获得 +2 种族加值。
- 敏锐感官：卓尔自动进行主动搜索检定，且无移动惩罚。
- 黑暗视觉：卓尔可以在黑暗中视物。
- 法术抗力：先天法术抗力 11 加每等级 1。
- 光盲：突然暴露在光线下会使卓尔目盲 1 轮。此外，卓尔在明亮光线下行动时，攻击检定，豁免和检定受到 -1 环境惩罚。
- 类法咒能力：每天 1 次 - 黑暗术，妖火。施法者等级 3。
- 精灵：就法咒而言，卓尔被视为精灵。

src:
Descended from the original dark-skinned subrace called the Illythiiri, the drow also known as dark elves, were cursed into their present appearance by the good elven deities for following the goddess Lolth down the path to evil and corruption. Living in the Underdark, they built a matriarchal society based on power and deceit. The drow have black skin that resembles polished obsidian and stark white or pale yellow hair. They commonly have very pale eyes (so pale as to be often mistaken for white) in shades of lilac, silver, pink and blue. They also tend to be smaller and thinner than most elves.

Drow females tend to be bigger and stronger than males. Drow society is theocratic and strongly matriarchal with females holding all positions of power and responsibility in the government, the militia and in the home. Their preferred class is cleric.
Drow males tend to be smaller and weaker than females. In society they tend to fill the lower ranks as fighters, rangers and rogues although their aptitude for magic is equal, if not superior, to that of other elven subraces. Their preferred class is wizard.

Drow Ability Adjustments: +2 Dex, +2 Int, +2 Cha, -2 Con.
Favored Class  Females (Cleric): A multiclass female drows cleric class does not count when determining whether she suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.
Favored Class  Males (Wizard): A multiclass male drows wizard class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

- Sleeplessness: Immune to spells and effects of the 'Sleep' subtype.
- Hardiness vs. Enchantments: +2 racial bonus on saving throws against mind-affecting spells.
- Iron Will: +2 racial bonus on savings throws versus will.
- Skill Affinity (Listen): +2 racial bonus to Listen checks.
- Skill Affinity (Search): +2 racial bonus to Search checks.
- Skill Affinity (Spot): +2 racial bonus to Spot checks.
- Keen Senses: Drow make active Search checks automatically and with no movement penalties.
- Darkvision: Drow can see in the dark.
- Spell Resistance: Innate spell resistance of 11 plus 1 per level.
- Light Blindness: Abrupt exposure to light blinds a drow for 1 round. In addition drow suffer -1 circumstance penalty to attack rolls, saves and checks while operating in bright light.
- Spell-like Abilities: 1/day - Darkness, Faerie Fire. Caster level 3rd.
- Elven: Drow are considered Elven for the purpose of spells.

无论形态如何，半天界生物总是俊美动人，赏心悦目，拥有金色皮肤，闪亮眼眸，天使翅膀或其他彰显其高等本质的特征。

“半天界生物”是一个遗传模板，可添加到任何活体，有形，智力值4或更高且非邪恶阵营的生物上（以下称为基础生物）.

半天界生物使用基础生物的所有属性和特殊能力，除非此处另有说明。

体型与类型
生物的类型变为异界生物。不要重新计算生物的生命骰，基础攻击加值或豁免。体型不变。半天界生物通常是本地异界生物。

速度
半天界生物拥有羽翼，能以基础生物基础陆地速度的两倍飞行（良好机动性）.如果基础生物已有飞行速度，则改用该速度。

防御等级
天生防御提升+1（此加值与基础生物拥有的任何天生防御加值叠加）.

特殊攻击
半天界生物保留基础生物的所有特殊攻击，并获得以下特殊能力。
昼明术（Su）
半天界生物可随意使用昼明术效果（如同该法咒）.
破邪斩（Su）
每天一次，半天界生物可进行一次普通近战攻击，对邪恶敌人造成等于其HD的额外伤害（最多+20）.

类法咒能力
智力或感知值8或更高的半天界生物拥有两个或更多类法咒能力，取决于其生命骰，如下表所示。这些能力是累积的。除非另有说明，每个能力每天可使用一次。施法者等级等于生物的HD，豁免DC基于魅力。

1+ HD，防护邪恶 3/天，祝福
3+ HD，援助，侦测邪恶
5+ HD，治疗重伤，中和毒素
7+ HD，圣光击，移除疾病
9+ HD，驱散邪恶
11+ HD，圣言
13+ HD，圣洁灵光 3/天，圣化
15+ HD，群体魅惑怪物
17+ HD，召唤怪物 IX
19+ HD，复生

特殊性质
半天界生物拥有基础生物的所有特殊性质，外加以下特殊性质。
黑暗视觉
免疫疾病。
对酸 10，寒冷 10 和电击 10 的抗力。
伤害减免：5/+1（如果HD为11或更低）或10/+1（如果HD为12或更高）.
法术抗力等于生物的HD + 10（最多35）.
对抗毒素的强韧豁免获得+4种族加值。

属性
从基础生物提升如下：力量+4，敏捷+2，体质+4，智力+2，感知+4，魅力+4。

等级调整
与基础生物相同+4。
src:
No matter the form, half-celestials are always comely and delightful to the senses, having golden skin, sparkling eyes, angelic wings, or some other sign of their higher nature.

"Half-celestial" is an inherited template that can be added to any living, corporeal creature with an Intelligence score of 4 or higher and nonevil alignment (referred to hereafter as the base creature).

A half-celestial uses all the base creature's statistics and special abilities except as noted here.

Size and Type
The creature's type changes to outsider. Do not recalculate the creature's Hit Dice, base attack bonus, or saves. Size is unchanged. Half-celestials are normally native outsiders.

Speed
A half-celestial has feathered wings and can fly at twice the base creature's base land speed (good maneuverability). If the base creature has a fly speed, use that instead.

Armor Class
Natural armor improves by +1 (this stacks with any natural armor bonus the base creature has).

Special Attacks
A half-celestial retains all the special attacks of the base creature and also gains the following special
abilities.
Daylight (Su)
Half-celestials can use a daylight effect (as the spell) at will.
Smite Evil (Su)
Once per day a half-celestial can make a normal melee attack to deal extra damage equal to its HD (maximum of +20) against an evil foe.

Spell-like Abilities
A half-celestial with an Intelligence or Wisdom score of 8 or higher has two or more spell-like abilities, depending on its Hit Dice, as indicated on the table below. The abilities are cumulative. Unless otherwise noted, an ability is usable once per day. Caster level equals the creature's HD, and the save DC is Charisma-based.

1+ HD, Protection from evil 3/day, bless
3+ HD, Aid, detect evil
5+ HD, Cure serious wounds, neutralize poison
7+ HD, Holy smite, remove disease
9+ HD, Dispel evil
11+ HD, Holy word
13+ HD, Holy aura 3/day, hallow
15+ HD, Mass charm monster
17+ HD, Summon monster IX
19+ HD, Resurrection

Special Qualities
A half-celestial has all the special qualities of the base creature, plus the following special qualities.
Darkvision
Immunity to disease.
Resistance to acid 10, cold 10, and electricity 10.
Damage reduction: 5/+1 (if HD 11 or less) or 10/+1 (if HD 12 or more).
Spell resistance equal to creature's HD + 10 (maximum 35).
+4 racial bonus on Fortitude saves against poison.

Abilities
Increase from the base creature as follows: Str +4, Dex +2, Con +4, Int +2, Wis +4, Cha +4.

Level Adjustment
Same as base creature +4.

src:
Gnolls are hyena-headed humanoids that wander in loose tribes. Most have dirty yellow or reddish fur and grayish skin. As nocturnal carnivores, gnolls are natural predators and tend to think with their stomachs. Although they will form alliances with other humanoid races, they are just as soon to break them without regret or warning if it suits their need. Gnoll society if usually ruled by its strongest member who uses fear, intimidation and strength to remain in power. Gnolls are in excess of 7 feet tall and typically weigh over 300 pounds.

Gnoll Ability Adjustments: +4 Str, +2 Con, -2 Int, -2 Cha
Favored Class (Ranger): A multiclass gnoll's ranger class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:
- Darkvision: Gnolls are able to see in the dark.
- Natural Armor Bonus: Racial natural armor bonus of 1.
- Monstrous: Gnolls count as Monstrous Humanoids for the purpose of spells.
- Weapon Familiarity: Gnolls treat battleaxes and shortbows as simple weapons. 
- Racial Hit Dice: A gnoll begins with two levels of humanoid.
- Level Adjustment: +1

"不，他走到一个角落，靠着一面空白的墙！至少我是这么以为的，但接着他打开了一扇伪装成墙壁一部分的门，走了进去。当我从暗门后面窥视那个隐藏的房间时，我看到了他正在交谈的恐怖之物。那是一个亡灵怪物，脸上只有一个骷髅头！也许像你这样勇敢的<CUSTOM104>可能会继续深入，但我承认我当时吓得直接逃走了，所以没有再发现更多。"

Perhaps a brave <CUSTOM104> like you might have ventured further, but I confess I simply fled in terror at that point, and so discovered no more."

卡林杉的战士们偏爱弯曲的劈砍刀刃，弯刀在那里或许比费伦任何其他地方都更受欢迎。这把武器是以卡林杉弯曲风格打造的重剑，使其看起来像一把格外巨大的弯刀。虽然这种刀身样式是否真的优于传统重剑尚有争议，但仅凭其精湛的工艺和镀金剑柄，这把剑想必也能卖个好价钱。
src: The warriors of Calimshan have a fondness for curved, slashing blades, with scimitars being perhaps more popular there than anywhere else in Faerun. This weapon is a bastard sword made in the curving Calishite style, making it resemble an unusually large scimitar. While it is debatable whether this style of blade is really superior to a conventional bastard sword, it is likely that this partciular example would command a good price for its high level of craftsmanship and gold-plated hilt, if nothing else.

"有个叫奥雷巴斯·伊纳斯的裁缝。在商业区经营一家店铺。我们得到消息说他最近收到了一批附魔布料，可以制成具有特殊属性的服装。这东西值不少钱。你的任务是偷走这些魔法布料并交给我。麻烦的是，我们不确定他把它放在哪里。可能在他店里的任何地方，或者在他店铺上层的家里。你得仔细搜查这两个地方。完成这个任务后，我应该还有更多活给你。"
src: "There's a tailor by the name of Orebas Enath. Runs a shop in the merchant district. We've got word that he recently received a shipment of enchanted cloth that could be turned into garments with special properties. It's worth quite a bit. Your job is to steal this magical cloth and bring it to me. Trouble is, we're not sure just where he's keeping it. It could be anywhere in his shop, or in his home on the level above it. You'll have to search through both carefully. Once you've completed this job, I should have more for you."

在守卫总部，我遇到了一个叫塞卡娅·哈辛的人，她正徒劳地试图说服守卫队开始搜寻她失踪的丈夫阿拉达尔。阿拉达尔是一本关于名为扭曲符文会的邪恶组织的书的作者，几天前在着手研究一本后续书籍时失踪了。我已同意寻找他。塞卡娅告诉我，她最后一次见到他时，他正要去找一个叫拉玛什·卡萨特的人，那人住在贵族区的西侧，所以我应该从那里开始调查。如果我发现了什么，可以去商人区东北部塞卡娅的家中向她报告。

我和拉玛什·卡萨特谈过了，他转而让我去找水手科拉努·乌马尔。现在我已经和科拉努谈过，他又告诉我阿拉达尔可能调查过的两条线索：第一，他以前的一个船友德拉沙姆·埃纳尔，科拉努认为他曾是符文会的密探，现在住在商人区的西南部；第二，贵族区东北部一堵墙上的密门通往一个隐藏的房间，科拉努认为那是符文会的一个藏身处。既然已经有人告诉我该去哪里找，这扇门应该不会太难找到。

我已经搜查了那个隐藏的房间，它似乎早已被废弃，我发现了一块似乎带有某种魔法的守卫石。它很可能对这次调查有价值或关联，尽管目前还不清楚会是什么。无论如何，我在那里找不到其他东西了。

我已经和德拉沙姆·埃纳尔谈过了。埃纳尔否认自己是符文会的密探，但曾为某个神秘组织做过线人。阿拉达尔·哈辛早些时候找过他，从他那里得知了他所汇报的联系人的名字：费亚尔·泰塞纳尔，此人现在住在神殿区，提尔神殿以南。我接下来应该去找他。
src:
At Watch Headquarters, I ran into one Sekaya Hasin, who was futilely attempting to convince the Watch to initiate a search for her missing husband, Aladar. Aladar is the author of a book on the sinister organization known as the Twisted Rune, and disappeared a few days ago when he was engaged in researching a follow-up book. I have agreed to search for him. Sekaya told me that when she last saw him, he was going to speak to one Lamash Kasat, who lives along the western side of the Noble District, so that is where I should begin the investigation. If I discover anything I can report it to Sekaya at her home in the northeast of the Merchant District.

I spoke to Lamash Kasat, who in turn sent me to seek out the sailor Kolanu Umal. Now I have spoken to Kolanu, and he in turn has told me of two paths that Aladar might have investigated: first, a former shipmate of his, Drasham Enar, who Kolanu believes was an agent of the Rune, and who now lives in the southwest part of the Merchant District, and secondly, a hidden chamber accessed through a secret door in a wall in the northeastern part of the Noble District, that Kolanu believes to be a hideout used by the Rune. This door should not be too difficult to find now that I have been directed where to look.

I have searched through the hidden chamber, which seems to be long abandoned, and found a wardstone that seems to have some sort of magic in it. lt may well turn out to have some value or relevance to this investigation, though at the moment it is not clear what that would be. At any rate, I could find nothing else there.

I have spoken to Drasham Enar. Enar denies being an agent of the Rune, but once worked as an informant for some mysterious organization. Aladar Hasin had earlier sought him out, and learned from him the name of the contact he reported to: Feyar Tesenal, who now lives in the Temple District, south of the Temple of Tyr. I should speak to him next.

src:
Once members of an underprivileged caste of an ancient empire, the humans who would become skulks withdrew from the world through a magical ceremony that solidified their �untouchable?status. The ritual granted them natural camouflage, allowing skulks to blend in perfectly with their surroundings.  Skulks gather in small bands within or near human communities. When night falls, they engage in raids that result in bloodshed as the skulks' innate hatred for humans manifests itself in murderous rage. They use ambush, deception, and superior numbers to overwhelm their victims. 
  
Skulk Racial Traits:
+4 Dexterity, -2 Wisdom, -4 Charisma: Skulks are agile and graceful, but have weak wills and subdued personalities.
Humanoid (human): Skulks are humanoid creatures with the human subtype.
Medium: As Medium creatures, skulks have no special bonuses or penalties due to size.
Skulk base land speed is 30 feet.
Racial Hit Dice: A skulk begins with two levels of humanoid, which provide 2d8 Hit Dice, a base attack bonus of +1, and base saving throw bonuses of Fort +0, Ref +3, and Will +0.
+8 racial bonus on Move Silently checks and a +15 racial bonus on Hide checks: Skulks excel at keeping to the shadows. These bonuses apply only when a skulk is wearing light armor or no armor.
Innate Nondetection (Su): If a divination spell is attempted upon a skulk, the caster of the divination must succeed on a DC 20 caster level check.
Peerless Camouflage (Ex): Skulks can move at full speed (and can even run) while hiding, taking no penalties on Hide checks due to movement.
Favored Class: Rogue. A multiclass skulk's rogue class does not count when determining whether he takes an experience point penalty for multiclassing.
Level adjustment +1.

魔法是宇宙中所有自然或超自然力量中最反复无常，最难预测的一种。试图通过奥术公式将施法编纂成典，或是以意志之力为魔法强加秩序，本质上都是徒劳的 - 至少错乱法师们如此认为。相反，那些真正想要精通魔法的人必须忘却已知，放弃对奥术的任性掌控。正是在这种悖论之中，蕴藏着狂野魔法的可怖力量。

错乱法师追求的是无结构地施放法咒。通过承担引入随机元素的风险，她放弃了其他奥术施法者所拥有的安全可预测性。这种风险带来了其他施法者无法企及的力量潜力。当然，她也冒着力量减弱的风险，但魔法若非冒险，又算什么？混沌强大，她的魔法常将她带至其他施法者无法触及的力量巅峰 - 但混沌同样无常，她的法咒有时也会达不到预期。此外，她的法咒偶尔会以壮观的狂野波动展开，可能对错乱法师及其同伴造成灾难性的后果。错乱法师将此视为她信念的代价。

src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
Magic is one of the most capricious and unpredictable of all natural or supernatural forces in the universe. Attempts to codify spellcasting through arcane formulas, or to impose order on magic through the force of will, are essentially pointless - or so wild mages believe. Instead, those who would truly master magic must forget what they know and abandon their willful control of the arcane. Within this paradox lies the awesome power of wild magic. 

The wild mage aspires to cast spells without structure. By taking the risk of substituting an element of randomness, she gives up the safe predictability of other arcane spellcasters. This risk allows for the potential of power greater than other casters can hope for. Of course, she also risks the potential for less power, but what is magic if not risky? Chaos is strong, and her magic often carries her to heights of power that other casters cannot reach - but chaos is also fickle, and her spells sometimes fall short of her expectations. In addition, from time to time her spells unfold in spectacular wild surges that might prove catastrophic to the wild mage 
and her companions. The wild mage accepts this as the price of her convictions.

- Hit Die: d4
- Proficiencies: A Wild Mage gains no additional proficiencies
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS: 

Alignment: any chaotic
Skills: Lore 4 ranks, Spellcraft 8 ranks, Use Magic Device 4 ranks 
Feats: Magical Aptitude, Any metamagic feat 

CLASS FEATURES:

Level 
1: Wild Magic - Reduce caster level by 3, add 1d6 to caster level
2: Random Deflector 1/day - Spells targeting the Wild Mage target anyone within 20 ft for one round
3: Student of Chaos - When using a rod of wonder, roll twice and take the better result
4: 
5: Random Deflector 2/day
6: Chaotic Mind - The wild mage is immune to confusion, and is permanently under the effects of non-detection for scrying
7: 
8: Random Deflector 3/day
9: Reckless Dweomer - Turn any spell into a rod of wonder.
10: Wildstrike 1/day - Target spellcaster has a 50% chance of spell turning into a rod of wonder

The avariel are the most reclusive and least numerous of the elven subraces on Faerun. This elusiveness, along with their natural beauty, has instilled within them condescension and pity for their land-bound kin. They are, by nature, free spirits who possess and irrepressible zest for life. The most striking feature of the avariels is their soft, striking wings. Their skin is pale, often porcelain white, with tinges of blue of faint silver. They generally have silver-white or black hair, and are considered the most beautiful of the elven races.
