（进阶职业）
武术学生面临令人眼花缭乱的武术学校，每所都有自己的追随者和批评者。但很少有学校像醉拳一样不寻常--或一样有争议。通过像醉酒一样摇晃和蹒跚，醉拳手避开许多打击。同样，他们跌跌撞撞，东倒西歪的攻击让对手措手不及。此外，当他们真正饮酒时，醉拳大师可以表演真正惊人的力量和勇气壮举。

- 生命骰：d8
- 擅长：醉拳大师不获得武器或盔甲擅长。
- 技能点：4+ 智力调整值。

要求：

基础攻击加值：+4。
职业：反射闪避职业能力
专长：强韧加强，闪避。
翻滚：6 级。

职业特性：

1：如魔饮酒 - 你的身体处理酒精的方式与他人不同。每瓶或每大杯你消耗的酒精使你的敏捷，感知和智力各降低 1 点，但使你的力量和体质各增加 1 点。然而，你的反射豁免加值，敏捷对翻滚的加值和 AC 加值保持在其原始水平，无论你的新敏捷调整值如何。
  瓶子擅长 - 你可以使用瓶子作为武器，使用你的徒手基础攻击加值。
2：蹒跚 - 通过绊倒，踉跄和蹒跚，你可以进行冲锋攻击，让对手惊讶。
3：摆腰 - 你在攻击时摇摆晃动。在你的回合中，你对任何一个对手获得 +2 闪避 AC 加值。
4：卸除武器 - 角色可以尝试卸除对手的武器，攻击受到 -6 惩罚。
5：醉怒 - 醉拳大师可以像野蛮人一样狂暴，持续 1 小时。你获得 +4 力量，+4 体质，意志豁免 +2 士气加值，AC 受到 2 惩罚。此能力在你饮用酒精饮料时生效。
6：蹒跚 - 你的蹒跚动作让你每轮进行一次战斗虚招唬骗检定（对抗对手的智力调整值 + 魅力调整值）.虚招成功后，对手的敏捷调整值不会加到其 AC 上，针对醉拳大师的下一次攻击。你只能对其他人形生物使用蹒跚。
7：醉抱 - 醉拳大师可以擒抱对手而不引发借机攻击，并且你在所有对抗擒抱检定上获得 +4 能力加值。
8：药用目的 - 通过将你的气与酒精结合，你可以将酒精饮料转化为治疗药水，每天最多三次。药水只对创造它的角色有效。
9：精通卸除武器 - 角色在尝试卸除武器时不再引发借机攻击，惩罚降至 -4。
10：火焰之息 - 你可以使用你的气点燃体内的酒精，并从嘴里喷出火焰之息。
src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
Martial arts students face a bewildering array of martial arts schools, each with its own adherents and detractors. But few schools are as unusual -- or as controversial -- as Drunken Boxing. By weaving and staggering about as if inebriated, drunken boxers avoid many blows. Likewise, their stumbling, lurching attacks catch their opponents off guard. Moreover, when they actually imbibe alcohol, Drunken Masters can perform truly prodigious feats of strength and bravery.

- Hit Die: d8
- Proficiencies: The Drunken Master gains no proficiencies in weapons or armor.
- Skill Points: 4+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:

Base Attack Bonus: +4.
Class: Evasion class ability
Feats: Great Fortitude, Dodge.
Tumble: 6 ranks.

CLASS FEATURES:

1: Drink Like a Demon - Your body handles alcohol differently from other people. Every bottle or tankard of alcohol you consume reduces your Dexterity, Wisdom, and Intelligence by 1 point each, but increases your Strength and Constitution by 1 point. However, your Reflex save bonus, Dexterity bonus to Tumble, and AC bonus remain at their original levels regardless of your new Dexterity modifier.
  Bottle Proficiency - You can use bottles as weapons using your unarmed base attack bonus.
2: Stagger - By tripping, stumbling, and staggering, you can make a charge attack that surprises your opponents.
3: Swaying Waist - You weave and bob about as you attack. You gain a +2 dodge bonus to AC against any one opponent during your turn.
4: Disarm - Character can attempt to disarm an opponent at a -6 penalty to their attack.
5: Drunken Rage - Drunken Master can rage just as a barbarian does, with duration of 1 hour. You gain +4 to Strength, +4 to Constitution, a +2 morale bonus on Will saves, and a 2 penalty to AC. This ability works when you drink an alcoholic beverage.
6: Lurch - Your lurching movements let you make one feinting-in-combat Bluff check (opposed by opponents Intelligence modifier + Charisma modifier) per round. On a successful feint, the opponents Dexterity modifier is not added to his AC on the Drunken Masters next attack. You can only lurch other humanoids.
7: Drunken Embrace - The Drunken Master can grapple an opponent without provoking an attack of opportunity, and you gain a +4 competence bonus on all opposed grapple checks.
8: For Medicinal Purposes - By combining your ki power with alcohol, you can convert an alcoholic drink to a potion of heal up to three times per day. Potion only works on character creating it.
9: Improved Disarm - Character no longer incurs an attack of opportunity while attempting to disarm and the penalty drops to -4.
10: Breath of Flame - You can use your ki to ignite the alcohol within you and spew it forth from your mouth in a breath of flame.

"灰飞烟灭只是重生的必要前奏。而它是必要的。你以为以前没有人尝试过和平改革吗？它取得了什么成就？这片土地仍然是一个邪恶的地方，充满了腐败的官员、受虐待的奴隶、被赶到荒野并被剥夺与人类平等权利的‘怪物’种族，以及人类智慧在良好秩序的伪装下所能犯下的所有其他邪恶。除了灰飞烟灭它，还有什么选择？火焰必须吞噬一切，以便一个更美好的世界能从灰烬中崛起！" 说到最后，他大喊大叫，疯狂地挥舞着手臂。
src: "Destruction is but a necessary preliminary to regeneration. And it is necessary. Do you think no one has tried peaceful reform before? What has it accomplished? This land remains an evil place, full of corrupt officials, abused slaves, 'monstrous' races driven out into the wilds and denied any equality with humans, and every other evil human ingenuity can perpetrate under a mask of good order. What alternative is left but its destruction? The fire must consume all, that a better world may rise from the ashes!" By the end of this speech, he is yelling and waving his arms wildly.

dst: "他们说正在研究一种方法，在战斗开始前疏散像我这样的非战斗人员，但我开始怀疑他们是否真的知道该怎么做，甚至是否把这当作优先事项。太令人苦恼了！"

古老的苏尔帝国以其强大的大法师所掌握的伟大而可怕的力量而闻名。苏尔巫师深入探索其他人避开的奥术知识，在此过程中发现了许多黑暗而危险的秘密。苏尔帝国由高贵的家族统治，这些家族的首领是拥有无与伦比力量的法师，而这些家族之间无数的竞争和仇杀导致了一个精英战斗训练学校的兴起：奥术战士之道。奥术战士被训练为忠诚，坚定和绝对服从，他们是熟练的战士，研究奥术魔法，专门为了学习如何杀死强大的巫师。
    在苏尔帝国时代，奥术战士是他们大法师主人的守卫，用剑和法咒为最伟大的苏尔巫师服务。他们也是刺客和间谍，被训练来杀死敌对家族的强大巫师，以及保卫自己家族的巫师。在数百次法咒和钢铁的秘密决斗中，奥术战士与同类练习他们的技艺，从隐藏的奥术战士学院学习他们的技能。

- 生命骰：d8
- 武器和防具擅长：苏尔奥术战士不获得额外的武器和防具擅长。

src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
The ancient Suel Empire was known for the great and terrible power wielded by its mighty archmages. Suloise sorcerers delved deep into arcane lore that other folk avoided, unearthing many dark and dangerous secrets in the process. The Suel Empire was ruled by noble families headed by mages of unsurpassed power, and the countless rivalries and vendettas between these families led to the rise of an elite school of combat training: the way of the Archanamach. Conditioned for loyalty, determination, and absolute obedience, Archanamachs were skillful warriors who studied arcane magics for the express purpose of learning how to slay powerful wizards.
    In the days of the Suel Empire, the Archanamachs were guards for their archmage masters, serving the greatest Suel wizards with sword and spell. They were also assassins and spies trained to slay powerful wizards of rival families, as well as defend the wizards of their own families. In hundreds of secret duels of spell and steel, Archanamachs practiced their art against others of their kind, learning their skills from hidden Archanamach academies.

- Hit Die: d8
- Proficiencies: A Suel Archanamach gains no additional proficiencies.
- Skill Points: 4 + Int Modifier

REQUIREMENTS:

Base Attack Bonus: +6.
Feats: Any 4 Martial or Exotic Weapon Proficiencies, Combat Casting, Iron Will
Skills: Concentration 4 ranks, Jump 4 ranks, Spellcraft 5 ranks, Tumble 4 ranks.

Level

He has access to any spell from the Abjuration, Divination, Illusion, or Transmutation school on the Sorcerer spell list, and casts spells as a Sorcerer does.

找到圣环的第二块碎片后，费拉莎告诉我，有了两块戒指碎片，她就能施放一个预言法咒来定位最后一块碎片，然后打开一个临时界门，将人传送到那附近以取回最后一块碎片。她还承诺，如果我完成这次回收，将给予丰厚的奖赏。我接受了这个任务，并被传送到了某个隐蔽的墓穴。最后一块戒指碎片无疑就在附近，但和前两块一样由不死生物守卫着，所以我必须谨慎行事。我还必须记住，当我返回时界门会崩塌，所以在取回最后一块碎片之前我不应该回去。

我已经找到了这枚提尔圣环的最后一块碎片。我现在可以返回神殿了。
src:
In the lair of an undead monster, I found a broken piece of a magical ring inscribed with symbols of Tyr. When I showed it to Ferazha, the head priestess of the Temple of Shar, she recognized it as part of a holy artifact of Tyr stolen some time ago. She rewarded me for giving her the piece I found, and has told me that she would also like any other pieces of the ring that I should happen to find, so that the Temple of Shar might defile this artifact of their enemy Tyr.

Having found a second piece of the holy ring, I was informed by Ferazha that with two pieces of the ring, she could cast a divination spell that would locate the final piece, and then open a temporary portal that would transport one near that location to recover the last fragment. She also promised a substantial reward should I effect this recovery. I have accepted this quest and been transported to a hidden tomb somewhere. The final ring fragment is doubtless about, but is guarded by undead as the first two were so I must proceed with caution. I must also remember that the portal will collapse when I return, so I should not do so until the final piece is recovered.

I have found the final fragment of this holy ring of Tyr. I can now return to the temple.

dst: 当我接近行进山脉中的阿哈兹堡时，我遇到了一名从那里赶来的信使，带来了可怕的消息：堡垒正被炽焰斧部落的兽人大军及其食人魔盟友围攻。我能否突破围困的封锁线抵达堡垒尚存疑问，因此如果我在这里要做些有用的事，最好是在兽人大军的侧翼行动，可以通过向西沿着附近的河流或向东穿过森林到达，袭击巡逻队和外围部队。我也许还能向北前进，突袭兽人最初来源的洞穴，因为大部分兽人都不在，都聚集在堡垒周围。这应该会促使兽人主力派出分遣队来追捕我，或许能削弱他们到足以打破围困的程度。\n\n在兽人群的侧翼以及他们后方的洞穴中行动，我杀死了许多敌人，并大大扰乱了他们的活动。最终这削弱了他们，使我能够与从堡垒出击的士兵一起攻击主要的围困部队，杀死他们的酋长并击溃他们。炽焰斧兽人部落的力量已被粉碎，我认为他们不再是一个重大威胁了。我应该确保在酋长的尸体上或他的帐篷里搜寻任何关于这些人形军队的情报，但除此之外，我想我在这里的工作差不多完成了。
src: As I was approaching Fort Akhaz in the Marching Mountains, I came across a messenger traveling from there with dire news: the fort is being besieged by a horde of orcs of the Blazing Axes tribe and their ogre allies. It is doubtful that I could break through the siege cordon to reach the fort, so if I am to do anything useful here it would be best to operate on the flanks of the orc army, reached either by traveling along the nearby river to the west or the woods to the east, attacking patrols and outlying forces. I also might be able to make my way to the north and raid the caves the orcs came from in the first place, with most of them absent and around the fort. This should induce the main orc army to send out detachments to try to hunt me down, and perhaps weaken it enough that the siege could be broken.\n\nOperating on the flanks of the orc horde, and in the caves to their rear, I killed many and did much to disrupt their activities. Eventually this weakened them to the point that I was able to assail the main besieging force, along with soldiers sallying from the fort, slay their chieftan and rout them. The power of the Blazing Axes Orc tribe has been shattered and I do not think they will be a major threat anymore. I should make sure to search for any intelligence concerning these humanoid armies I can find on the chieftan's body or in his tent, but aside from that, I think my work here is just about done.

dst: 枯萎者 延时 深幽黑暗

萨曼·瓦拉迪告诉我，如果我想找活干，就应该去找一个叫纳马尔·萨拉坎的人，他是“闪耀探寻者”号的船长，目前可以在码头区找到他。这位萨拉坎船长显然想找一位冒险者帮忙调查他发现的一件神秘神器。萨曼已经向他提过我可能是合适的人选，所以他应该准备好在我提出愿意帮忙时接受我的协助。

我已经和萨拉坎船长谈过，并了解了一些他交给我的任务。他找到了一种魔法手段，可以创造一道通往某处水下废墟的界门，并希望我帮忙探索那里。我和任何穿过界门（或之后被召唤）的同伴都会获得防溺水的魔法保护。这种保护会持续四个小时，而且在完成任务之前我不应该从界门返回，因为那会打断法咒。在水下行动会让我变慢并降低攻击效果，阻止使用远程武器，并使任何涉及火焰的法咒效果有限（最多如此）。我只要准备好就可以直接进入界门。当我穿过时，必要的法咒会自动施放。

我在水下废墟中找到了一块上面有文字的泥板。虽然我不认识这种语言，但无疑有学者能翻译它，并揭示一些关于发现它的那座城市的信息。这应该能满足萨拉坎船长的要求。我现在应该回去找他。
src:
Saman Waladi has told me that if I am looking for work I should seek out one Namal Sarakan, captain of the ship Shining Searcher, currently to be found in the Docks District. This Captain Sarakan apparently wants the help of an adventurer in investigating some mysterious artifact he has found. Saman has already mentioned to him that I might be a suitable person for his needs, so he should be prepared to accept my assistance at such time as I offer it.

I have spoken to Captain Sarakan, and learned something about the task he has for me. He has found a magical means of creating a portal to some underwater ruin, and wants my help in exploring it. I and any companions who go through (or are later summoned) will be provided magical protection against drowning. This will last four hours, and I should not return through the portal until I have accomplished the task, as this will disrupt the spell. Operating underwater will slow me down and reduce the effectiveness of attacks, prevent the use of missile weapons, and render any spells that involve the use of fire of limited effectiveness (at best). I should simply enter the portal whenever I am ready. The necessary spells will be automatically cast as I go through.

I have located a tablet with writing on it in the undersea ruin. While the language is unknown to me, there are doubtless scholars who could translate it and reveal something about the city where it was found. This should meet Captain Sarakan's requirements. I should return to him now.

src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
No other vestige is quite like Tenebrous. The remnant of the divinity once possessed by Orcus, Tenebrous is perhaps the only vestige still worshiped in some places as a god, and so tightly bound to a living-if not mortal-being. This unique status grants Tenebrous the ability to manipulate the world in ways that other vestiges cannot. Some Tenebrous apostates revere Orcus, seeing Tenebrous as part of their sundered god and the seed from which he will one day sprout anew. Others see the corpulent fiend as the embodiment of Tenebrous's downfall. These followers believe that Tenebrous is a separate deity who attempted to manifest through Orcus, only to be laid low when the demon proved unworthy.

- Hit Die: d8
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:
Alignment: Any nongood
Skills: Concentration 5 ranks, Lore 8 ranks
Special: Ability to bind Tenebrous
Special: Able to turn or rebuke undead
Special: Must worship Tenebrous as a god (clerics can only have Chaos, Death, Evil, and Trickery domains)

CLASS FEATURES:
Level
1:  Eternal Bondage - You are always bound to Tenebrous
    Tenebrous's Rebuke - Damage or heal undead by spending a turn undead use
2:  Visage of the Dead - +1 bonus to dodge AC, Intimidate, and Tumble, and mindless undead treat you as friendly
3:  Destroy/Empower Undead - Spend turn undead attempts to do extra damage to mindless undead, or heal them
4:  Umbral Body - Cast umbral body at will
5:  Blast of the Void - Deal 1d8 damage per turning level to all living creatures

Soul Binding/Spellcasting: At each level except 1st, you gain new soul binds and spells per day and an increase in caster level (and spells known, if applicable) as if you had gained a level in both your soul binding-using class and your divine spellcasting class.

- Offensive Training vs. Orcs: +1 racial bonus on attack rolls against orcs.
- Offensive Training vs. Goblinoids: +1 racial bonus on attack rolls against goblinoids.

- Skill Affinity (Move Silently): +4 racial bonus to Move Silently
- Skill Affinity (Craft): +2 racial bonus to Craft Armor and Craft Weapon checks.
- Skill Affinity (Appraise): +2 racial bonus to Appraise checks.
- Partial Skill Affinity (Listen): +1 racial bonus to Listen checks.
- Partial Skill Affinity (Spot): +1 racial bonus to Spot checks.

- Light Sensitivity: Duergar suffer -2 penalty to attack rolls, saves and checks while operating in bright light.

炼金大师是专精于制作药水和灵药以重现 4 级或更高法咒效果的施法者。即使是涉猎炼金术的施法者也能提高制作药水的速度，对于冒险的施法者来说，这可以减少他们为下一次任务做准备所花费的时间。在其最高等级，炼金大师进阶职业允许施法者制作能重现一些最强大魔法效果的药水。

要求：

技能：炼金术 10 级，法咒辨识 10 级。
专长：调制药水，魔法工匠，技能专攻（炼金术）.
施法：能够施放 4 级奥术。

生命骰：d4
每级技能点：2 + 智力调整值。

职业特性：
每日法咒：炼金大师的训练侧重于魔法。因此，当角色获得新的炼金大师等级时，她获得新的每日法咒，如同她在添加此进阶职业之前所属的任意奥术施法职业也提升了一级。

1级：每日调制 2 次：炼金大师完善了调制药水的艺术。因此，她可以在一天（8 小时周期）内调制两瓶药水，而不是一瓶。

2级：调制药水（4级）：从 2 级开始，炼金大师对炼金术和魔法的深入研究允许她调制 4 级法咒的药水。

3级：调制药水（5级）：炼金大师可以调制 5 级法咒的药水。

4级：调制药水（6级）：炼金大师可以调制 6 级法咒的药水。

5级：每日调制 3 次：炼金大师可以在一天内调制三瓶药水。

7级：调制药水（7级）：炼金大师可以调制 7 级法咒的药水。

8级：调制药水（8级）：炼金大师可以调制 8 级法咒的药水。

9级：每日调制 4 次：炼金大师可以在一天内调制四瓶药水。

10级：调制药水（9级）：炼金大师可以调制 9 级法咒的药水。
src:
The master alchemist is a spellcaster who specializes in producing potions and elixirs that reproduce the effects of spells of 4th level or higher. Even spellcasters who dabble in alchemy gain the ability to improve the rate at which they can produce potions, which for adventuring spellcasters can reduce the amount of time they must spend preparing for their next quest. At its highest levels, the alchemist prestige class allows spellcasters to create potions that reproduce some of the most powerful magical effects available.

Requirements:

Skills: Alchemy 10 ranks, Spellcraft 10 ranks.
Feats: Brew Potion, Magical Artisan, Skill Focus (Alchemy).
Spellcasting: Ability to cast 4th level arcane spells.

Hit die: d4
Skill points at each level: 2 + Int modifier.

CLASS FEATURES:
Spells per Day: A master alchemist's training focuses on magic. Thus, when a character gains a new level of master alchemist, she gains new spells per day as if she had also gained a level in whatever arcane spellcasting class she belonged to before she added the prestige class.

1st: Brew 2/day: The master alchemist has perfected the art of brewing potions. As such, she can brew two potions in one day(an 8-hour period) instead of one.

2nd: Brew Potion (4th): Beginning at 2nd level, the master alchemist's advanced study of alchemy and magic allows her to brew potions of 4th-level spells.

3rd: Brew Potion (5th): The master alchemist can brew potions of 5th-level spells.

4th: Brew Potion (6th): The master alchemist can brew potions of 6th-level spells.

5th: Brew 3/day: The master alchemist may brew three potions in one day.

7th: Brew Potion (7th): The master alchemist can brew potions of 7th-level spells.

8th: Brew Potion (8th): The master alchemist can brew potions of 8th-level spells.

9th: Brew 4/day: The master alchemist may brew four potions in one day.

10th: Brew Potion (9th): The master alchemist can brew potions of 9th-level spells.

蔚蓝印记是一个古老的符号，据说体现了
自然世界的纯净，因此它对异怪而言
是极为可憎之物。
虽然德鲁伊和巡林客是最常被知晓施放
这个古老法咒的职业，但它的魔法几乎
是通用的，可以被所有施法职业掌握。
当你施放这个法咒时，你用手在空中
描绘蔚蓝印记，在空中留下一个发光的蓝色符文，
短暂片刻后它闪烁并
以一道蔚蓝光芒的脉冲充满效果区域。
区域内的任何异怪必须进行强韧
豁免检定，否则遭受以下不良效果。
较近的异怪先受影响。
每个效果持续 1 轮。

无：异怪不受任何不良效果影响，即使它未通过
豁免检定。
恶心：异怪在攻击
检定，豁免检定，技能检定和属性检定上承受 -2 罚值，持续 1 轮。
反胃：异怪无法攻击，施放法咒，集中
于法咒，或做任何事，只能进行一个移动动作，持续 1 轮。
眩晕：异怪无法进行任何动作，但其护甲等级
不受罚值，持续 1 轮。
震慑：异怪掉落所有持握之物，无法进行动作，
AC 承受 -2 罚值，并失去其 AC 上的敏捷加值（若有）,
持续 1 轮。

一旦生物从某个效果中恢复，它在表格上上升一级。
因此，被此法咒震慑的生物在之后一轮变为眩晕，
再之后一轮变为反胃，再之后一轮变为恶心，
然后在下一轮完全恢复。
src:
Evocation
Level: Druid 2, Ranger 2, Bard 3, Cleric 3, Paladin 3, Sorcerer 3, Wizard 3,
Components: S,
Casting Time: 1 standard action
Range: 30 ft.
Area: Multiple aberrations whose combined total Hit Dice do not exceed twice 
caster level in a spread emanating from the character to the extreme of the range
Duration: Instantaneous
Saving Throw: Fortitude negates
Spell Resistance: No

The cerulean sign is an ancient symbol said to embody
the purity of the natural world, and as such it is 
anathema to aberrations.
While druids and rangers are the classes most often
known to cast this ancient spell, its magic is nearly 
universal and can be mastered by all spellcasting classes.
When you cast this spell, you trace the cerulean sign
in the air with a hand, leaving a glowing blue rune
in the air for a brief moment before it flashes and fills
the area of effect with a pulse of cerulean light.
Any aberration within the area must make a Fortitude 
saving throw or suffer the following ill effects.
Closer aberrations are affected first.
Each effect lasts for 1 round.

None: The aberration suffers no ill effect, even if it fails the
saving throw.
Sickened: The aberration takes a -2 penalty on attack 
rolls, saving throws, skill checks, and ability checks for 1 round.
Nauseated: The aberration cannot attack, cast spells, concentrate
on spells, or do anything but take a single move action for 1 round.
Dazed: The aberration can take no actions, but has no penalty to
its Armor Class, for 1 round.
Stunned: The aberration drops everything held, can't take actions, 
takes a -2 penalty to AC, and loses its Dexterity bonus to AC (if any)
for 1 round.

Once a creature recovers from an effect, it moves up one level on the table.
Thus, a creature that is stunned by this spell is dazed the round after
that, nauseated the round after that, sickened the round after that, and
then recovers fully the next round.

丹塔利安，星辰皇帝
  
丹塔利安，因其传说与外貌而被称为星辰皇帝，是众多灵魂的集合体。他赋予缚灵者短距离传送，读取思想和阻止敌人的能力。

残魂等级：5级
缚灵DC:25
特殊要求：无

影响：丹塔利安的影响会使你变得冷漠并使用威严的手势。丹塔利安忍不住对当今的领袖感到好奇，因此每当你在100英尺内遇到明显是（或自称是）他人领袖的人时，丹塔利安要求你尝试读取那个人的思想。一旦你尝试过，无论成功与否，你都不需要再尝试读取那个人的思想。

授予能力：
契约魔法魔典证明了丹塔利安深邃的智慧和他对所有主题的广博知识。因为他知晓一切思想，他可以将那份力量的一部分授予你，以及仅凭思考就能旅行的能力。你还获得他威严气场的一部分，许多缚灵者将此归因于他的王室血统。

丹塔利安之威：当你调用此能力时（一个移动动作），任何看到你的生物在1轮内无法攻击你或以敌对法咒瞄准你。如果你尝试任何敌对行动，例如对受影响的生物或其盟友进行攻击检定或施放攻击性法咒，效果结束。一旦你使用了此能力，你在5轮内无法再次使用。

丹塔利安所知：与丹塔利安绑定时，你在学识检定上获得+8加值。

读取思想：随意作为整轮动作，你可以尝试读取任何你能看到的生物的表层思想。如果目标成功通过意志豁免，你在1分钟内无法读取其思想。如果你尝试读取智力属性比你高10点以上的生物的思想，你自动失败并震慑1轮。

思想旅行：作为一个标准动作，你可以瞬间将自己传送到任何你能看到的，在你所拥有的每个有效缚灵者等级5英尺范围内的位置。思想旅行是一种传送效果，每天可使用次数等于你的有效缚灵者等级。一旦你使用了此能力，你在5轮内无法再次使用。
src:
Dantalion, the Star Emperor
  
Dantalion, called the Star Emperor for his legend and appearance, is a composite of many souls. He grants binders the ability to teleport short distances, read thoughts, and stop foes.

Vestige Level: 5th
Binding DC: 25
Special Requirement: No

Influence: Dantalion's influence causes you to be aloof and use stately gestures. Dantalion can't help but be curious about the leaders of the day, so anytime you are within 100 feet of someone who clearly is (or professes to be) a leader of others, Dantalion requires that you try to read that person's thoughts. Once you have made the attempt, regardless of success or failure, you need not try to read that person's thoughts again.

Granted Abilities: 
Pact magic grimoires attest to Dantalion's profound wisdom and his extensive knowledge about all subjects. Because he knows all thoughts, he can grant you a portion of that power, as well as the ability to travel just by thinking. You also gain a portion of his commanding presence, which many binders ascribe to his royal origins.

Awe of Dantalion: When you invoke this ability (a move action), any creature that sees you is unable to attack you or target you with a hostile spell for 1 round. If you attempt any hostile action, such as making an attack roll or casting an offensive spell against the affected creature or its allies, the effect ends. Once you have used this ability, you cannot do so again for 5 rounds.

Dantalion Knows: While bound to Dantalion, you have a +8 bonus on Lore checks.

Read Thoughts: At will as a full-round action, you can attempt to read the surface thoughts of any creature you can see. If the target makes a successful Will save, you cannot read its thoughts for 1 minute. If you attempt to read the thoughts of a creature with an Intelligence score 10 points higher than your own, you automatically fail and are stunned for 1 round.

Thought Travel: As a standard action, you can instantly transport yourself to any location you can see that is within 5 feet per effective binder level you possess. Thought travel is a teleportation effect and is usable a number of times per day equal to your effective binder level. Once you have used this ability, you cannot do so again for 5 rounds.

dst: "我们的入会流程是这样的。我们设置了一个小迷宫。你从我附近的东墙那扇门进去，如果你能通过，就会从南边的门回到这里，准备被引入公会。迷宫里布满了锁住的门、陷阱和其他考验盗贼技能的测试。我们也不会手把手地指导那些梦想发财却没什么真本事的准盗贼。如果你没能走到迷宫的尽头，就永远别想活着出来：入口会在你身后封死。我们发现这样能减少我们不得不浪费时间的笨手笨脚之辈的数量。"
src: "Here's how our initiation process works. We've set up a bit of a maze. You enter through the door near me, on the east wall, and if you make it through you'll come back here through the door to the south, ready to be inducted into the guild. The maze is loaded with locked doors, traps, and other tests of a thief's skills. We're also not going to handhold would-be thieves with more dreams of wealth than actual abilities. If you don't make it to the end of the maze, you'll never get out of it alive: the entrance is sealed behind you. We find that cuts down on the number of bunglers we have to waste our time on."

dst: "此外，阿兹古尔卡在面对泽法德时，就已经在试图与火焰的代理人结盟，并学习指挥火焰的力量。当他被放逐时，他的这些联系并未全部失去，尽管他只能通过非常间接的影响返回这个位面，但他能够在火元素位面及相关领域采取远为有力的行动。他一直在那里较易被腐化的派系中忙于结交盟友。这赋予了他与火焰相关的力量，而他又能通过剑来引导这些力量。这就是为什么这把剑的力量——它汲取所有元素，但最初当然偏重空气——多年来似乎变得更加偏向火焰。"
src: "Furthermore, Azghulkar had already been attempting to make alliances with agents of fire and learning to command powers of flame when he faced Zefad. These connections of his were not all lost when he was banished, and though he was not able to return to this plane save through very indirect influences, he was able to act far more forcefully on the Plane of Fire and associated realms. He has been busy making allies among the more easily corruptible factions there. That has given him fire-related powers that he in turn has been able to channel through the sword. This is why the sword's powers, which drew on all elements but of course originally emphasized air, have seemed to become more fire-oriented over the years."

（进阶职业）
从虚无中，死亡的幽灵出现，一个装甲阴影高举着闪亮的刀刃。一瞬间，武士刀落下，以血腥的弧线将生命从肢体上分离。四周，恐怖的尖叫和恐惧的呼喊爆发，颤抖的手拔出刀刃与蒙面凶手战斗。目标已死，鬼面杀手平静地走开，剑和拳头无害地穿过他几乎透明的身体。
    很久以前，一个受迫害的危险战士氏族寻求报复压迫者的方法。通过巫术，氏族的施法者恳求黑暗精灵揭示一种方法，使他们的氏族能够在即将到来的冲突中生存，并报复试图粉碎他们的皇帝。氏族成员达成了一项黑暗交易，他们联系的恶魔精灵为氏族提供了一种实现他们渴望的血腥结局的手段。戴上可怕的 面具 以隐藏身份，氏族的战士潜入皇宫，通过他们所做契约的邪恶力量，无形无质地进入皇室，谋杀了整个皇族，再次使国家陷入血腥内战。没有人发现氏族的不光彩行为，直到今天，没有人知道鬼面杀手来自哪个氏族。
    如今，鬼面杀手作为雇佣刺客和间谍，一个隐藏在公开和荣誉行为幌子下的雇佣兵氏族。在执行任务时，他们戴着幽灵般白色的瓷恶魔面具以隐藏身份，并作为他们氏族与恶魔精灵所订契约的象征。通过训练和纪律，鬼面杀手学会最致命和最可怕的方式攻击敌人，并通过与精灵的神秘联系，鬼面杀手学会隐形，穿墙，甚至用精灵自己的眼睛看。

src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
From out of nothing the spectre of death appears, an armoured shadow with a brilliant blade held high. In a flash the katana falls, severing life from limb in a bloody arc. All around, screams of terror and shouts of fear erupt, as quaking hands draw blades to fight the masked murderer. His target dead, the ghost-faced killer walks calmly away as swords and fists pass harmlessly through his nearly transparent body.
    Long ago, a persecuted clan of dangerous warriors sought a way to take revenge against their oppressors. Through sorcery, the spellcasters of the clan beseeched dark spirits to reveal a way that their clan might survive the coming strife and take revenge on the emperor who sought to crush them. The clan members struck a dark bargain, and the demon-spirits they had contacted provided the clan with a means to the bloody end they desired.Donning terrifying masks to hide their identities, warriors of the clan crept into the imperial palace, and through the evil power of the pact they had made, passed invisibly and intangibly into the imperial household and murdered the entire imperial family, plunging the country into bloody civil war once again. No one ever discovered the clan's honourless actions, and to this day, no one knows what clan the ghost-faced killers came from.
    Today ghost-faced killers act as assassins and spies for hire, a mercenary clan that hides behind a guise of open and honourable conduct. When on a mission, they wear porcelain demon-masks of ghostly white to hide their identity and as a symbol of the pact their clan made with the demon spirits. Through training and discipline, ghost-faced killers learn to the deadliest and most terrifying way to attack foes, and through their mystic connection with spirits, ghost-faced killers learn to turn invisible, walk through walls, and even see with the eyes of the spirits themselves.

dst: "也许没你想的那么幸运。在大裂谷时，我们有时会炸塌隧道，以保护自己免受来自幽暗地域的攻击。虽然等到最后一刻，好把天花板砸到一群进攻的卓尔或其他威胁头上很诱人，但实际上很难把时机掐得那么准，而且很多事情都可能出错，比如你的陷阱被拆掉，只要时机不对。通常我们发现，最好在接近的敌人靠近之前就炸塌隧道。当然，这些变形蛛没有矮人那种经验。他们等得太久，让我们通过了。"
src: "Maybe not as lucky as you might think. Back in the Great Rift, we would sometimes collapse tunnels to protect ourselves from attacks coming out of the Underdark. While it was tempting to wait for the last moment so you could dump a ceiling onto a horde of assualting drow, or whatever the threat might be, in practice it was very difficult to time it that precisely, and lots of things that could go wrong, like your trap getting dismantled, if your timing wasn't just right. Usually we found it was better to collapse tunnels before the approaching enemies even got near. Of course these aranea don't have the kind of experience with this sort of thing that dwarves do. They waited too long and let us get through."

Elves and orcs with fiendish heritage are known to exist but those are distinct lines and are not true tieflings. - 附魔坚韧：对抗影响心智的法咒时豁免检定获得 +2 种族加值。

- 技能亲和（侦察）：侦察检定获得 +2 种族加值。
- 敏锐感官：雪精灵自动进行主动搜索检定，且没有移动惩罚。
- 微光视觉：使他们在黑暗中比正常看得更清楚。
- 精灵：就法咒而言，雪精灵被视为精灵。
src:
Snow elves are much like their southern brethren.  They make their home within nature, building grand cities of ice on the tops of distant mountaintops, only rarely leaving them to visit the outside world.  They have no special resistance to the cold, but their cities and magic protects them.  One of their few differences is their eyes and hair, both white as the snow surrounding them.

Snow Elven Ability Adjustments: +2 Dex, -2 Cha.
Favored Class (Wizard): A multiclass snow elf's wizard class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

- Sleeplessness: Immune to spells and effects of the 'Sleep' subtype.
- Hardiness vs. Enchantments: +2 racial bonus on saving throws against mind-affecting spells.
- Bonus Proficiencies (Longsword, Rapier, Shortbow, Longbow)
- Skill Affinity (Listen): +2 racial bonus to Listen checks.
- Skill Affinity (Search): +2 racial bonus to Search checks.
- Skill Affinity (Spot): +2 racial bonus to Spot checks.
- Keen Senses: Snow Elves make active Search checks automatically and with no movement penalties.
- Low-Light Vision: Allows them to see better than normal in the dark.
- Elven: Snow Elves are considered Elven for the purpose of spells.

护盾自身：随意作为一个标准动作，你可以指定每有效契灵等级10尺内的一个生物来分担你受到的伤害。只要目标生物保持在范围内，你从所有造成生命值伤害的效果中只受到一半伤害，它受到其余伤害。如果你指定另一个生物，或者你或目标死亡，该效果立即结束。效果结束后对你造成的任何伤害不再在你和目标之间分配，但已经分配的伤害不会重新分配给你。你一次只能以此能力影响一个生物。不愿成为此能力目标的生物可以尝试意志豁免来抵消该效果。
src:
Dahlver-Nar, the Tortured One
  
Once a human binder, Dahlver-Nar now grants powers just as other vestiges do. He gives his summoners tough skin, a frightening moan, protections against madness, and the ability to share injuries with allies.

Vestige Level: 2nd
Binding DC: 17
Special Requirement: None

Influence: You shift quickly from distraction to extreme focus and back again. Sometimes you stare blankly off into space, and at other times you gaze intently at the person or task at hand. Since Dahlver-Nar dislikes any task that requires more than 1 round of concentration (such as some spellcasting, concentration on an effect, or any action that requires a Concentration check), he requires that you undertake no such activities while under his influence.

Granted Abilities: 
Dahlver-Nar armors you and blends his madness with your sanity, lending you some of his selfish powers.

Mad Soul: Binding to Dahlver-Nar grants you immunity to Wisdom damage, Wisdom drain, and confusion effects.

Maddening Moan: You can emit a frightful moan as a standard action. Every creature within a 30-foot spread must succeed on a Will save or be dazed for 1 round. Once you have used this ability, you cannot do so again for 5 rounds. Maddening moan is a mind-affecting sonic ability.

Natural Armor: You gain an enhancement bonus to your natural armor equal to one-half your Constitution bonus (if any).

Shield Self: At will as a standard action, you can designate one creature within 10 feet per effective binder level to share the damage you take. As long as the subject creature remains within range, you take only half damage from all effects that deal hit point damage, and it takes the rest. The effect ends immediately if you designate another creature or if either you or the subject dies. Any damage dealt to you after the effect ends is no longer split between you and the subject, but damage already split is not reassigned to you. You can affect one creature at a time with this ability. An unwilling target of this ability can attempt a Will save to negate the effect.

dst: 战魂预知

我得到警告，据说贫民区东北部有一栋房子被危险幽灵萦绕，进入这座古老破败建筑的人有时再也无法出来。这似乎是一个需要提防的危险，或者，对于像我这样的冒险追寻者来说，也许是一个机会。

我进入了那栋房子，到达二楼后，我困在了根据我交谈过的一个幽灵所说，是由幻象构成的迷宫中。要逃脱，我必须在我进入任何门后随机传送到的某个房间里找到一个界门，并在受益于真知术效果时进入它。要施放这样的法咒，我应该寻找某种魔法神器的四块碎片，并找到一个有铁砧的房间，在那里我可以将它们组装起来。

我已经通过界门逃脱，最初将我困在幻象迷宫中的强大幽灵已被击败，帮助我的幽灵也已从将他困在这里的诅咒中解脱。这件事似乎已经了结。
src:
I have been warned that a house in the northeast of the Slums district is believed to be haunted by dangerous spirits, and that those who enter this old and decrepit structure sometimes fail to come out again. This would seem a danger to beware, or perhaps, for seekers of adventure such as myself, an opportunity.

I have entered the house, and upon reaching the second floor have become trapped in what according to a ghost I talked to is a maze of illusions. To escape, I must find a portal in one of the rooms to which I am randomly transported upon entering any door and enter it while benefitting from the effects of a True Seeing spell. To cast such a spell, I should look for four fragments of some kind of magical artifact, and find a room with an anvil in which I can assemble them.

I have escaped through the portal, the mighty spectre who entrapped me within that maze of illusions to begin with has been defeated, and the ghost who assisted me has been freed from whatever curse was holding him here. This matter would seem to be concluded.

Regenerate critical wounds does not restore hit points lost from starvation, thirst, or suffocation, nor does it allow a creature to regrow or attach lost body parts. 地底人是那些选择--或被迫--生活在地下世界的洞穴和蜿蜒通道中的人类群体的后裔。经过几代人，这些人类适应了这个充满自然奇观和危险生物的陌生世界。一些地底人社会已经几代没有冒险到地表，而其他人已经完全忘记了他们的真正起源。然而，那些生活在通往地下领域的洞穴附近的人偶尔会到地表探险，甚至与地表人类进行有限的贸易。地底人是一个简单，氏族化的人民，致力于他们的家园和种族的安全。由于他们称之为家的洞穴和隧道中有大量邪恶和掠食性种族和生物，地底人变得迅速，隐秘且以生存为导向。尽管在技术方面相当原始和质朴，但地底人通过在地下生存的卓越知识弥补了这一不足，尽管他们甚至避开地下领域的最深处。

地底人种族特性：
类人生物（人类）：地底人是类人生物，具有人类亚种。
中型：作为中型生物，地底人没有因体型而获得特殊奖励或惩罚。
地底人基础陆地速度为30英尺。
黑暗视觉：地底人可以在黑暗中看到60英尺远。
1级时额外4个技能点，每增加一个等级额外1个技能点，因为地底人（像他们的人类祖先一样）多才多艺且有能力。(1级时的4个技能点作为奖励添加，不乘以倍数。)
聆听检定+2种族加值：作为地下猎人生活了几代人，使地底人拥有敏锐的听力。
伪装（特异能力）：地底人可以随意改变皮肤颜色以拟形怪周围地形，在躲藏检定上获得+4种族加值。在自然地形中，此加值增加到+10。
光线敏感（特异能力）：地底人在明亮阳光下或日光术半径内会目眩。
天赋职业：任意。
src:
The underfolk are descendants of bands of humans who chose-or were forced-to live in the caves and twisting passageways of the underground world. Over generations, these humans adapted to this strange world, filled with natural wonders and dangerous creatures. Some underfolk societies have not ventured to the surface in generations, and others have forgotten their true origins altogether. However, those who live close to the caves that give entry to the underground realms make occasional forays to the surface and even engage in limited trade with surfacedwelling humans. Underfolk are a simple, clannish people dedicated to their homes and the safety of their race. Because of the multitude of evil and predatory races and creatures in the caves and tunnels they call home, underfolk have become quick, stealthy, and survival-oriented. Although rather primitive and rustic when it comes to technology, underfolk make up for this lack with a superior knowledge of how to survive beneath ground, although even they avoid the deepest depths of the subterranean realms.

Underfolk Racial Traits:
Humanoid (human): Underfolk are humanoid creatures with the human subtype.
Medium: As Medium creatures, underfolk have no special bonuses or penalties due to size.
Underfolk base land speed is 30 feet.
Darkvision: Underfolk can see in the dark out to 60 feet.
4 extra skill points at 1st level and 1 extra skill point at each additional level, since underfolk (like their human ancestors) are versatile and capable. (The 4 skill points at 1st level are added on as a bonus, not multiplied in.)
+2 racial bonus on Listen checks: Living as underground hunters for generations has given underfolk keen hearing.
Camouflage (Ex): Underfolk can change their skin coloration at will to mimic the surrounding terrain, giving them a +4 racial bonus on Hide checks. In natural terrain, this bonus increases to +10.
Light Sensitivity (Ex): Underfolk are dazzled in bright sunlight or within the radius of a daylight spell.
Favored Class: Any.

"别那么肯定。我一直在收到证实你所发现之事的报告。斥候注意到大批地精在米尔森林集结，兽人则在行军山脉聚集。这些也不是普通的劫掠队伍。它们行动时带着大多数此类人生物部落所极度缺乏的精准和军事纪律，并且装备了数量异常之多的魔法增强武器。诚然，过去这样的类人生物队伍对大型文明社区几乎不构成威胁，但那是因为它们传统上恰恰缺乏这些家伙似乎拥有的东西：团结、纪律、适当的训练和装备。"
src: "Don't be so sure. I've been receiving reports that confirm what you discovered. Scouts have noticed large bands of goblins massing in the Forest of Mir, and orcs assembling in the Marching Mountains. These are not normal raiding parties, either. They operate with a precision and military discipline that is singularly lacking in most such tribes of humanoids, and are equipped with an unusually large number of magically enhanced weapons. It is true that in the past such humanoid bands have posed little threat to large civilized communities, but that is because they have traditionally lacked precisely what these seem to possess: unity, discipline, proper training and equipment."

你将座狼之灵聚集在周身，形成一件斗篷般的衣物。它极像一张座狼皮，从你头顶上那兽首的顶部，到沿你双臂延伸的前腿，再到垂在你身后的后腿。皮毛深色而浓密，脸上那玻璃般的红眼闷燃着。

你的座狼皮在躲藏和潜行检定上给予你 +2 表现加值。

魂能：你投入座狼皮中的每一点魂能，都会使躲藏和潜行检定上的表现加值增加 2。

脉轮绑定（脚） 

你座狼皮的后腿融入你自己的双腿，拉长你的脚和小腿，同时缩短你的大腿，使你能够像掠食动物一样用脚趾飞跑。你的双腿完全被座狼的深灰色皮毛覆盖。

你的基础陆地速度增加 5 尺，并且你投入座狼皮中的每一点魂能再额外增加 5 尺。

脉轮绑定（手） 

The forelegs of your worg pelt fuse into your own arms, adding weight and bulk to your hands. Your arms and hands are completely covered in the dark gray fur of a worg.

When you hit with a bite attack you attempt to trip the opponent as a free action without making a touch attack or provoking an attack of opportunity. If the attempt fails, the opponent cannot react to trip you. 

脉轮绑定（图腾）

The head of your worg pelt becomes one with your own head. Your eyes begin to glow red and replace the glassy eyes of the pelt, while your lower jaw extends to join the upper muzzle of the pelt, granting you a fierce bite attack.

You gain a bite attack that deals 1d6 points of damage. You gain an enhancement bonus on attack rolls and damage rolls with your bite equal to the number of points of essentia you invest in it.
src:

Descriptors: None  
Classes: Totemist 
Chakra: Feet or hands (totem) 
Saving Throw: None

You gather worg spirits around you to form a cloaklike garment. It strongly resembles the pelt of a worg, from the top of the beast's head perched atop your own to forelegs extending down your arms and rear legs hanging behind you. The fur is dark and thick, and glassy red eyes smolder in its face.

Your worg pelt grants you a +2 competence bonus on Hide and Move Silently checks. 

Essentia: Every point of essentia that you invest in your worg pelt increases the competence bonus on Hide and Move Silently checks by 2.

The hind legs of your worg pelt fuse into your own legs, lengthening your feet and shins while shortening your thighs, enabling you to run on your toes like a predatory animal. Your legs are totally covered in the dark gray fur of a worg.

Your base land speed increases by 5 feet, plus an additional 5 feet for every point of essentia you invest in your worg pelt. 

Chakra Bind (Hands) 

The forelegs of your worg pelt fuse into your own arms, adding weight and bulk to your hands. Your arms and hands are completely covered in the dark gray fur of a worg.

When you hit with a bite attack you attempt to trip the opponent as a free action without making a touch attack or provoking an attack of opportunity. If the attempt fails, the opponent cannot react to trip you. 

Chakra Bind (Totem)

The head of your worg pelt becomes one with your own head. Your eyes begin to glow red and replace the glassy eyes of the pelt, while your lower jaw extends to join the upper muzzle of the pelt, granting you a fierce bite attack.

You gain a bite attack that deals 1d6 points of damage. You gain an enhancement bonus on attack rolls and damage rolls with your bite equal to the number of points of essentia you invest in it.

A dim, blue glow surrounds the subjects, protecting them from attacks, granting them resistance to spells cast by chaotic creatures, and slowing chaotic creatures when they strike the subjects. This abjuration has four effects.

First, each warded creature gains a +4 deflection bonus to AC and a +4 resistance bonus on saves. Unlike protection from chaos, this benefit applies against all attacks, not just against attacks by chaotic creatures.

src:
Evocation [Force]
Level: Sorcerer 4, Wizard 4,
Components: V, S,
Casting Time: 1 Standard Action
Range: Medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Target: Up to four creatures, no two of which are more than 30 ft. apart
Duration: Instantaneous
Saving Throw: None
Spell Resistance: Yes

Sparking bolts of blue magic, like giant magic missiles, streak from your
outstretched hand to strike your foes and explode in sparkling bursts.

You create powerful missiles of magical force, each of which darts from your
fingertips and unerringly strikes its target, dealing 2d6 points of damage.
The missile then explodes in a burst of force that deals half this amount of
damage to any creatures adjacent to the primary target.

The missile strikes unerringly, even if the target is in melee or has anything
less than total cover or concealment. A caster cannot single out specific parts
of a creature.

You gain one missile for every four caster levels. Extra missiles distribute 
themsleves amongst your enemies evenly.

如果法咒有多个目标或允许多次攻击，你选择一个目标受邪术影响；所有其他目标只承受法咒的正常效果。

你每天可以使用此能力的次数等于 3 + 你的魅力调整值（最低1次）.

注意：如果你有万髓之主专长，只有第一个槽位的精髓会被使用。
src:
Beginning at 5th level, you can apply an eldritch essence invocation you know (other than greatreach blast or spellblast) to any arcane spell that affects a target or that requires a melee or ranged touch attack. The spell's level must be at least as high as the level of the eldritch essence (for example, you can apply hellrime blast only to a spell of 4th level or higher). If the essence requires a saving throw, use the normal save DC for that essence. If an eldritch essence invocation changes the damage of the spell, it can be applied only to a spell that deals damage (you can't add brimstone blast to charm monster).

If the spell has more than one target or allows more than one attack, you choose one target to be affected by the invocation; all other targets take only the normal effect of the spell.

You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Cha modifier (minimum 1).

NOTE: If you have Lord of All Essences feat, only the essence from first slot will be used.

With every strike, they channel years of training, hatred, and precision into devastating blows that bypass even supernatural defenses. At epic levels, their Rancor damage intensifies, their resistances grow stronger, and their Death Attacks become nearly impossible to avoid, making them the ultimate bane of their hated foes.

dst: 我再次见到了我以前的雇主萨曼·瓦拉迪，并因在沙漠中从强盗手中救下他而得到了丰厚的报酬。他还请我为他完成另一项小任务：与城市守卫总部的海关检查员交谈，并从他那里取得官方文件，证明萨曼正在运送的一些货物已通过检查。据萨曼说，我只需提到他的名字，并出示他给我的盖有他印章的文件，因为一切都已经安排好了。\n\n事实证明，这件事比萨曼所说的要稍微复杂一些，因为海关检查员期望得到一笔贿赂，作为完成安排的条件。不过，我现在已经拿到了必要的证明，应该把它带给萨曼。
src: I have again met my former employer, Saman Waladi, and been generously rewarded for saving him from the bandits in the desert. He has also asked me to perform another small task for him: speaking to the Customs Inspector at City Watch Headquarters, and obtaining from him official papers indicating that some goods Saman is shipping have passed his inspection. According to Saman, I need only mention his name and display a paper he has given me with his seal, as arrangements have already been made.\n\nThe matter proved a bit more complicated than Saman indicated, as the Customs Inspector expected a bribe as a condition of completing the arrangements. However, I now have the necessary certificate, and should take it to Saman.

dst:
（进阶职业）
对于任何神祇的仆人来说，没有比那些罕见时刻更大的喜悦了，当她守护神的存在成为一种真实，可触的力量，将力量的颤栗传遍她的身体，让她的灵魂翱翔。对于一些人来说，这种体验的滋味是如此强大的吸引力，以至于他们开始献身于培养它，希望通过沉思的生活更接近他们的神祇。这些虔诚的追随者花费数小时祈祷和冥想，净化他们的灵魂，使他们值得与神性更紧密的接触。虽然一些虔心祈者退出世界进入私人静修，但其他人保持活跃，甚至冒险，发现真正接近他们的神祇来自于在世界上实现神祇的意志。作为回报，他们发现自己的思想，身体和灵魂被净化，完善，并最终与他们的神祇接近合一。

- 生命骰：d6。
- 武器和防具擅长：虔心祈者不获得任何额外的武器或防具擅长。
- 技能点：2+ 智力调整值。

2：心智灵活 - 虔心祈者获得心智灵活专长。
3：神性完整 - 每天一次，虔心祈者可以治疗自己等于其虔心祈者等级 4 倍的生命值。
4：

8：

src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
For any servant of a deity, no joy is greater than at those rare moments when the presence of her patron deity is a real, tangible force, sending shivers of power through her body and sending her soul soaring. For some, the taste of this experience is such a powerful attraction that they begin devoting their lives to cultivating it, hoping to attain a greater closeness to their deity through a life of contemplation. Spending hours in prayer and meditation, these devoted followers purify their souls, making them worthy of closer contact with the divine. While some contemplatives withdraw from the world into private retreats, others remain active, even adventuring, finding that true nearness to their deity comes from living out their deity's will in the world. In return, they find their minds, bodies, and souls purified, perfected, and finally brought close to union with their deity.

- Hit Die: d6.
- Proficiencies: A Contemplative does not gain any additional weapon or armor proficiencies.
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:

Spellcasting: Able to cast 1st-level divine spells.
Skills: Lore 13 ranks.

CLASS FEATURES:

Level
1: Bonus Domain - The contemplative gains access to an additional domain.
    Divine Health - The contemplative is immune to disease.
2: Slippery Mind - The contemplative gains the slippery mind feat.
3: Divine Wholeness - Once per day, the contemplative can heal herself 4 times her contemplative level in hit points.
4:
5: Divine Body - The contemplative becomes immune to poison.
6: Bonus Domain
7: Divine Soul - The contemplative gains SR of 15 + Contemplative level.
8:
9:
10: Mystic Union - The contemplative changes racial type to outsider and gains DR of 10/+1

BONUS SPELLS

Upon gaining a level in contemplative, the character gains new spells per day as if he had also gained a level in his highest divine caster class.

src:
The Tuladhara are among the rarest of planetouched; a crossbreed between humans and the enigmatic rilmani, the neutral exemplars.  To them, balance is everything.  They are not emotionless, but almost always consider all sides of an issue, acting without bias.  Unlike some rumors may have you believe, however, they do not betray trust and friendship easily.  Physically they resemble lithe and graceful humans, and are sometimes mistaken at a distance for half-elves.  Up close, metallic-colored skin and opalescent eyes give them away.  They are balanced in dress as in all things; not too flashy, but still fashionable.

Favored Class (Druid): A multiclass tuladhara's druid class does not count when determining whether he suffers an XP penalty for multiclassing.

Special Abilities:

- 30' base speed
- Darkvision: Tuladhara are able to see in the dark.
- Skill Affinity (Persuade): +2 racial bonus to Persuade checks.
- Skill Affinity (Sense Motive): +2 racial bonus to Sense Motive checks.
- Resist Acid: Innate acid resistance of 5.
- Resist Sonic: Innate sonic resistance of 5.
- Resist Electrical: Innate electrical resistance of 5.
- Spell-like Abilities: 1/day - Magic Circle vs Alignment.

src: "If you want to help, you could go out through the back entrance here (the one covered by a cloth, we haven't put a proper door up yet), and take a look at all the construction materials there. There's lumber, rope, barrels of stuff...anyway, you could probably find something to hide behind and keep watch. I think there are some stacked up crates out there that would serve the purpose. With any luck, you'll be able to see who's coming to disrupt things and stop them. If you can scare or fight them off, that would be good. If you can find some solid evidence about who is behind this as well that would be even better. We have limited funds, as I said, but if you accomplish either of those tasks I'm sure I could scrape up some sort of reward. Oh, one other thing, the vandalism always occurs at night, so you probably shouldn't waste time watching during the day."

The striking fist or flashing sword pales beside a psion's focused stare. Psionic powers arise from a regimen of strict mental discipline developed over months and years of self-scrutiny and subconscious discovery. src: "Basically, yes. Normally we followers of Ilmater bear insults and offenses with patience and forbearance. We do not fear, indeed we rejoice, to suffer ourselves, and yet would never lightly inflict suffering on anyone else, even an enemy. Such are the commands of our god. Yet sometimes not resisting evil can cause so much suffering itself that we must make an exception. I must warn you though, that even though I think forceful measures justifiable in these circumstances, they have already been attempted with less than satisfactory results. I hesitate to send you into such grave danger."

dst: 我与一位塞露涅的牧师谈过，他正试图在卡林港为这位神祇建立一座神殿，希望以此对抗莎尔在世界这一地区过大的影响力。他告诉我，神殿的建造工作正受到破坏者的干扰，他们夜间出动，捣毁白天建好的一些部分。他请求我设法处理此事。他建议我从神殿后门出去，那里堆放着大量建筑材料，找些板条箱躲在后面。从那里我可以在夜间（破坏行为发生时）进行监视，运气好的话，我会看到破坏者靠近，并能够阻止他们。如果可能的话，最好还能找到一些确凿的证据，查明幕后主使是谁。\n\n我看到一个可疑的身影靠近神殿，在他造成任何破坏之前把他吓跑了。然而，如果我想查明他是谁或他的目的是什么，我就必须动身追赶。他跑得很快，如果我不尽快追上他，很可能会在这个错综复杂的巷弄迷宫中跟丢他。我需要朝他离开的方向追去，并希望在各个岔路口找到他往哪个方向去的线索。如果几分钟内还没找到他，很可能就再也追不上了。
src: I spoke to a priest of Selune who is attempting to establish a temple to that deity in Calimport, in hopes of counteracting the excessive influence of Shar in this region of the world. He told me that construction work on the temple is being disrupted by vandals, who strike at night and wreck some of the building done during the day. He has asked me to try and do something about this. He suggests I go out the back entrance of the temple, where a lot of constuction materials are piled up, and find some crates to hide behind. From there I can watch during the night (when the vandalism occurs) and with any luck I will see the perpetrators approach and be able to stop them. It would be good as well to find some solid evidence about who is behind this, if possible.\n\nI saw a suspicious figure approaching the temple and scared him off before he could do any damage. If I wish to find out anything about who he is or what his purposes are, however, I will have to set out in pursuit. He can run quickly and I will likely lose him in this complicated maze of alleys if I do not catch up to him soon. I need to head off in the direction he went and hope to find clues as to which direction he took at any intersections. If I have not found him within a few minutes it will likely be too late to ever do so.

Last Judgment
Necromancy [Death, Good]
Level: Clr 8, Sor/Wiz 8, Wrath 8
Components: V, Celestial (caster must be good outsider)
Casting Time: 1 round
Range: Close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target: One evil humanoid, monstrous humanoid, or
giant/2 levels
Duration: Instantaneous
Saving Throw: Will partial
Spell Resistance: Yes

Reciting a list of the targets' evil deeds, you call down the judgment of the heavens upon their heads. Creatures that fail their saving throw are struck
dead and bodily transported to the appropriate Lower Planes to suffer their eternal punishment. Creatures that succeed nevertheless take 3d6 points of temporary Wisdom damage as guilt for their misdeeds overwhelms their minds.

This spell affects only humanoids, monstrous humanoids, and giants of evil alignment.

A true resurrection or miracle spell can restore life to a creature slain by this spell normally. A resurrection spell works only if the creature's body can be recovered from the Lower Planes before the resurrection is cast.

你可以侦测环绕不死生物的光环。揭示的信息量取决于你研究特定区域的时间。
第1轮：不死生物光环的存在或缺失。
第2轮：区域内不死生物光环的数量以及最强不死生物光环的强度。如果你为善良阵营，且最强不死生物光环的强度为压倒性（见下文），并且该生物的生命骰至少为你角色等级的两倍，你将被震慑1轮且法咒结束。
第3轮：每个不死生物光环的强度和位置。如果光环在你的视线之外，则你能辨别其方向但无法确定其确切位置。
光环强度：不死生物光环的强度由不死生物的生命骰决定，如下表所示：

生命骰              强度
1 或更低      微弱
2 - 4           中等
5 - 10          强烈
11 或更高    压倒性
残留光环：不死生物光环在其原始来源被摧毁后会残留。如果侦测不死生物被施放并指向这样的位置，法咒会显示光环强度为暗淡（甚至比微弱光环更弱）. 光环在此暗淡等级下残留的时间取决于其原始强度：

原始强度   残留光环持续时间
微弱   1d6 轮
中等    1d6 分钟
强烈  1d6x10 分钟
压倒性    1d6 天
每轮，你可以转向侦测新区域的不死生物。法咒可以穿透障碍，但 1 英尺厚的石头，1 英寸厚的普通金属，一张薄铅片，或 3 英尺厚的木头或泥土会阻挡它。

You can detect the aura that surrounds undead creatures. The amount of information revealed depends on how long you study a particular area.
1st Round: Presence or absence of undead auras.
2nd Round: Number of undead auras in the area and the strength of the strongest undead aura present. If you are of good alignment, and the strongest undead aura's strength is overwhelming (see below), and the creature has HD of at least twice your character level, you are stunned for 1 round and the spell ends.
3rd Round: The strength and location of each undead aura. If an aura is outside your line of sight, then you discern its direction but not its exact location.
Aura Strength: The strength of an undead aura is determined by the HD of the undead creature, as given on the following table:

HD              Strength
1 or lower      Faint
2 - 4           Moderate
5 - 10          Strong
11 or higher    Overwhelming
Lingering Aura: An undead aura lingers after its original source is destroyed. If detect undead is cast and directed at such a location, the spell indicates an aura strength of dim (even weaker than a faint aura). How long the aura lingers at this dim level depends on its original power:

Original Strength   Duration of Lingering Aura
Faint   1d6 rounds
Moderate    1d6 minutes
Strong  1d6x10 minutes
Overwhelming    1d6 days
Each round, you can turn to detect undead in a new area. The spell can penetrate barriers, but 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of common metal, a thin sheet of lead, or 3 feet of wood or dirt blocks it.

Arcane Material Component: A bit of earth from a grave.

Solitary Warrior (Su): Starting at 7th level, when you are adjacent to at least two foes, your armor class increases by 1 and you deal an extra 1d6 points of damage with each successful attack made with the gauntlets.
Cheat Death (Su): At 8th level and higher, you automatically heal 1 hit point if your hit points drop to between -1 and -9. This ability functions once per day.
Power of One (Su): At 10th level, Bullybasher's Gauntlets grant a +2 enhancement bonus to your Constitution score. At 14th level, the bonus rises to +4. It rises to +6 at 18th level.
Rough and Tumble (Su): At 11th level, you gain damage reduction 5/magic.
Giant Bearing (Su): Beginning at 13th level, you gain a +2 bonus to Strength, a -2 penalty to Dexterity (to a minimum of 1), a -1 penalty on attack rolls, and a +4 bonus on grapple checks. 
Stone Gathering (Su): At 15th level and higher, you can hurl rocks. The rocks deal 2d6 (plus Strength modifier) points of bludgeoning damage.
Frightful Presence (Su): Starting at 17th level, you unsettle surrounding foes when you are attacking or charging. Creatures within a radius of 30 feet are subject to the effect if they have fewer Hit Dice than you. A potentially affected creature that succeeds on a Will save (DC 10 + 1/2 your character level + your Charisma modifier) suffers no ill effect and is immune to your frightful presence for 24 hours. Those who fail the save become shaken for 4d6 rounds.
No Wound Too Big (Su): At 18th level and higher, while wearing Bullybasher's Gauntlets, you heal 2 points of damage every hour.
Lightning Punch (Su): Beginning at 19th level, once per day on command, you can charge Bullybasher's Gauntlets with chain lightning. The next creature struck by the gauntlets is the target of the spell, and secondary bolts can strike other foes within 30 feet. A charge is maintained until the gauntlets strike a creature. The save DC is 19, or 16 + your Charisma modifier, whichever is higher. Caster level 15th.

dst: 技能手套
快速选择 2

哈马德正在准备对变形蛛的总部发动攻击，因为我们已经掌握了其位置的情报。不过，他还有另一项任务要我在此期间完成。他的老朋友卡洛玛斯·泽卡尔，曾因在反对奴隶贸易应采取何种手段上的分歧与他闹翻，如今因我最近造访他的庄园而受到触动，主动联系哈马德试图和解。哈马德已被说服，愿意在卡洛玛斯牵涉的一件事上提供帮助。卡洛玛斯一直在卡林沙漠维持一个营地，据我所知，他在帮助一些人离开卡林杉（我没有被告知这些人究竟是谁，并被警告不要过多打听他们的事）。这个营地在夜间遭到暗中袭击，其中一些人被掳走，天命不明。哈马德派我以及他雇用的其他一些冒险者前往那里调查此事。要到达营地，我应先到他的庄园去见卡洛玛斯。他能够打开一道魔法界门将我送到营地，或许还能告诉我一些关于当前局势的更多情况。

卡洛玛斯将我传送到了营地，在那里我遇到了贾拉尔·马卡希，一位巡林客，也是竖琴手同盟的成员，负责管理这个地方。贾拉尔告诉我，几天前他曾与营地的一名神秘袭击者遭遇，对方将他击倒后逃走，并掳走了一名难民。贾拉尔追踪他的足迹足够远，确定他向东逃往山区，但在没有支援的情况下不愿追得太远。现在他已与我同行，并提议我们一起向东进发，试图追查这一威胁的源头。

向东行进时，我们发现了从营地被绑架者之一的尸体。检查显示有迹象表明他是被吸血鬼杀死的。如果我们要对付的是吸血鬼，我应该四处寻找可以劈成木桩的木质物品，因为要永久杀死一个吸血鬼需要用到这些。

我们已经找到并潜入了一处神秘绑架者使用的隐藏据点。在探索该地时，我们发现了证据表明这是龙巫教的基地，该组织帮助龙转化为不死龙巫妖，他们最终意图让整个费伦臣服于其统治。一些教徒显然将自己转化为吸血鬼，以便在永久的不死状态下继续侍奉他们的龙族领主，这很可能解释了我们发现的吸血鬼出没的证据。我们必须谨慎，因为面对这个教派，很可能在前方某处会遇到一条龙类，甚至一条龙巫妖。
src:
Hamad is preparing an assault upon the headquarters of the aranea, now that we have information on its location. However, he has another quest for me to complete in the meantime. His old friend Kalomas Zekar, with whom he had a fallin out over their disagreements about what methods should be employed in opposing the slave trade, has been inspired by my recent visit to his estate to contact Hamad and attempt a reconciliation. Hamad has been persuaded to lend assistance in a matter with which Kalomas is involved. Kalomas has been maintaining a camp in the Calim Desert for people who I am told he is assiting in leaving Calimshan (I have not been told just who these people are, and been warned against asking too many questions about them). This camp has been stealthily attacked during the night and some of the people in it carried off to some unknown fate. Hamad is sending me, and some of the other adventurers in his employ there to investigate the matter. To reach the camp I should first go see Kalomas at his estate. He will be able to open a magical portal transporting me to the camp, and perhaps tell me a little bit more about the situation.

Kalomas teleported me to the camp, where I met up with Jalar Makashi, a ranger and member of the Harpers who is running the place. Jalar told me that a few days ago he had an encounter with one of the camp's mysterious assailants, who knocked him down and fled, carrying off one of the refugees. Jalar followed his tracks long enough to determine that he fled east towards the mountains, but was unwilling to go too far in pursuit without support. Now he has joined with me, and proposed that together we head east in an attempt to track down the source of this menace.

Traveling east, we came across the body of one of the people kidnapped from the camp. Examination revealed signs that he had been slain by vampires. If we are dealing with vampires, I should look around for wooden objects I can break up into stakes, since these will be needed to kill a vampire permanently.

We have located and penetrated some hidden stronghold being used by the mysterious kidnappers. Exploring the place, we have come across evidence that it is a base of the Cult of the Dragon, an organization that helps dragons transform themselves into undead dracoliches, to whose rule they ultimately intend to subject all Faerun. Some cultists apparently transform themselves into vampires so that they may keep serving their draconic lords in permanent undeath, which likely explains the evidence we have come across that vampires are about. We must be cautious, for with this cult it is quite possible that a dragon or even a dracolich is to be encountered somewhere further in.

卡林港是一座古老的城市，而悠久的岁月通常意味着城市当前的建筑是建立在更古老建筑的废墟之上的。在卡林港阳光照耀的街道和闪闪发光的塔楼之下，隐藏着大量的下水道、废墟、墓穴和洞穴。这个“地下城”被统称为“黑暗卡林港”，据传那里既有巨大的危险，也有巨大的宝藏，其中一些甚至可以追溯到卡林杉最早的起源时期，那时它由巨灵统治。关于人们在这些黑暗通道中可能发现什么，流言四起：盗贼的藏身处、 monstrous vermin、亡灵恐怖、黑暗穴居类人生物部落、隐藏的神庙。那些试图揭开这些传闻真相的人，并不总能回来。
src: Calimport is an ancient city, and great age usually means that a city's current structures are built atop the ruins of older ones. Beneath the sunlit streets and gleaming towers of Calimport lies a mass of sewers, ruins, tombs and caverns. This "undercity" is collectively described as "Dark Calimport," and is rumored to be home to both great dangers and great treasures, some of which may even date to the earliest origins of Calimshan, when it was ruled by djinn. Rumors abound as to what one may find in these dark passages: hideouts of thieves, monstrous vermin, undead horrors, tribes of dark-dwelling humanoids, hidden temples. Those who seek to uncover the truth of such reports do not always return.

dst: 家庭

沙漠民族的传说讲述了一颗很久以前从天而降的星辰，它触碰到大地，引发了一场巨大的爆炸，将这片土地化为废墟。当火焰熄灭，烟雾从曾经翠绿而生机勃勃的土地上散去后，只剩下一个荒凉的陨石坑和四周数英里的荒地。
 
尽管陨石坑周围是一片空旷无情的景象，这个地方仍然吸引着访客。第一批探索这个地洞的人报告了无法解释的现象和萦绕不去的影像，但无法指出其来源。无论是奥术还是神术魔法（甚至灵能辐射）似乎都没有从盆地中散发出来，但显然有某种奇怪的力量在起作用。
 
一位名叫阿玛瓦鲁的富有进取心的法师，她的众多兴趣包括天球，资助了一次更大规模的探险。阿玛瓦鲁和她众多的儿女们前往盆地建立了一个永久前哨站。有传言说她希望从陨石坑及附近地区开采残留的星金属，有时可以从这些金属中熔炼和精炼出奇异的合金和纯金属。
 
不幸的是，事情对阿玛瓦鲁来说并不顺利。采矿工具经常无缘无故地损坏，没人能立即查明原因。役畜和奴隶会突然陷入恐慌，每个人都报告说梦到越来越强烈的恐惧，通常涉及被微小沙粒的压倒性重量缓慢埋葬而死。有一天，阿玛瓦鲁发回给资助者的报告突然中断了。被指派传递消息的信使再也没有回来，资助者雇佣的新信使也未能返回。最终，阿玛瓦鲁的冒险被当作代价高昂的损失注销，这个地方也被遗忘了。

这是一个4级遭遇区域，取自沙暴资料书。因此，它包含一些技能使用，有限的休息和合理的战斗。它也很短，可以在一小时或更短时间内完成。请注意，此遭遇区域使用了沙暴的炎热危险，因此适应这种环境的种族如布卡和阿舍拉提，以及拥有耐热专长的角色将表现最佳。角色在尝试此遭遇区域之前应装备齐全。
src:
Histories of the desert people tell of a star that fell from heaven long ago and touched the earth, creating a great explosion that laid waste to the lands. After the fires had gone out and the smoke had cleared over the formerly green and vibrant land, there remained only a bleak crater and miles of waste on all sides.
 
Despite the empty, unforgiving landscape all around the crater, the location still drew visitors. The first to explore the hole in the earth reported unexplained phenomena and haunting images, but couldn't specify a source. Neither arcane nor divine magic (or even psionic emanations) seemed to radiate from the basin, yet clearly some strange force was at work.
 
An enterprising wizard named Ammavaru, whose many interests included the celestial sphere, financed a larger expedition. Ammavaru and her large family of sons and daughters headed to the basin to set up a permanent outpost. The story circulated that she hoped to mine the crater and nearby areas for residual starmetals, from which exotic alloys and pure metals are sometimes smelted and refined.
 
Unfortunately, things did not go well for Ammavaru. Mining implements broke on a regular basis, for no reason anyone could immediately determine. Work animals and slaves were given to sudden panics, and everyone reported dreams of ever-increasing dread, usually involving a slow death from being buried under a crushing weight of tiny sand particles. One day, the reports from Ammavaru back to her financiers simply ceased. The courier assigned to run messages never returned, and new couriers hired by the financiers also failed to return. Eventually, Ammavaru's venture was written off as a costly loss, and the location was forgotten.

This is a 4th level encounter area, taken from the Sandstorm sourcebook. As such, it features some skill use, limited resting, and reasonable combat. It is also short, and can be completed in an hour or less. Please note that this encounter area uses Sandstorm's heat dangers, and therefore races adapted to that such as Bhuka and Asherati and characters with the Heat Endurance feat will do best. Characters should be fully equipped before attempting the encounter area.

在找到圣戒的第二块碎片后，阿达拉斯告诉我，有了戒指的两块碎片，他可以施放一个预言法咒来定位最后一块碎片，然后打开一个临时界门，将人传送到那附近以取回最后一块碎片。他还承诺，如果我完成这次回收，将给予丰厚的奖励。我接受了这个任务，现在已经从它的不死守卫那里取回了这枚提尔圣戒的最后一块碎片。回到神殿后，我得知我的奖励就是这枚戒指本身，它将再次变得完整，并注入一套我可以自己选择的力量。一旦我准备好并知道我想选择什么力量，阿达拉斯就会着手为戒指注入力量。
src:
In the lair of an undead monster, I found a broken piece of a magical ring inscribed with symbols of Tyr. When I showed it to Adaras, the head priest of the Temple of Tyr, he recognized it as part of a holy artifact of Tyr stolen some time ago. He rewarded me for returning the piece I found, and has told me that he would also like any other pieces of the ring that I should happen to find.

Having found a second piece of the holy ring, I was informed by Adaras that with two pieces of the ring, he could cast a divination spell that would locate the final piece, and then open a temporary portal that would transport one near that location to recover the last fragment. He also promised a substantial reward should I effect this recovery. I accepted this quest and  have now recovered the final fragment of this holy ring of Tyr from its undead guardians. Returning to the temple, I was informed that my reward would be this very ring, made whole once more, and infused with a set of powers that I myself can choose. As soon as I am ready and know what powers I wish to select, Adaras will proceed to empower the ring.

src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
All warlocks harbor at least a grudging respect for the entities responsible for their powers. They are clearly beings of great mystical might, and thus worthy of regard. A rare few warlocks go beyond this attitude to actual reverence or worship of the fiendish, fey, or extraplanar powers that have made them far more than mortal. Such is the life of an eldritch disciple devoted to a deity who granted her the arcane talents of the warlock. Though her powers might take different forms, she knows that the source is the same.

(This includes eldritch blast.) You do not, however, gain any other benefit a character of that class would have gained.

Iaijutsu is the martial art of drawing a weapon, almost always a katana and attacking with it in the same fluid motion. It is the foundation of some forms of dueling, and its masters are feared and respected throughout the world.

Level

  Canny Defense - While wearing no armor, the Iaijutsu Master can add their Intelligence modifier to their AC while using a katana.
4: Bonus Feat.

Damage granted from the Iaijutsu Focus is inline with those given in the source book from which the class came.

src:
Type of Feat: Class Specific.
Prerequisite: Runecaster Level 3.
Specifics: The Runecaster gains the ability to add more charges to an item at level 3. To do this, adjust the counter till you have selected the desired number of charges, then press the Rune Charges option to turn it on. Finally, cast the spell you wish to Inscribe. Inscribe Rune must be turned on for this to work. The cost for a charged item is Spell level * Caster Level * Charges * 50, while the XP cost is the gold cost/25.

At level 8, the Runecaster gains the ability to Inscribe runes that have Uses per day instead of charges. Follow the same procedure as for Charges, except select Rune Uses Per Day. The cost for a uses per day item is Spell level * Caster Level * Charges * 400, while the XP cost is the gold cost/25.

Turning on either Charges or Uses Per Day will turn off the other option, as they do not stack. The maximum number of charges is 50, while the maximum uses per day is 5. Rune Count +1 increases the number of charges or uses by 1, while Rune Count +10 increases the number by 10. Rune Clear resets the number to 1, the minimum.
Use: Selected.

A green ray springs from your outstretched hand. You must make a ranged touch attack to hit the target. Forms of movement barred by a dimensional anchor include astral projection, blink, dimension door, ethereal jaunt, etherealness, gate, maze, plane shift, shadow walk, teleport, and similar spell-like or psionic abilities. A dimensional anchor does not prevent summoned creatures from disappearing at the end of a summoning spell.

src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
The Foe Hunter has but one purpose in life: to kill creatures of the type she hates. She is willing to pay any price or risk any danger to prevail against this hated foe. Her blade is anathema to such creatures, and her body is more often than not proof against their attacks. Though her hatred of this enemy is boundless and unending, it is not unthinking or rash. She lives to put an end to her hated foe, but she does not throw away her own life needlessly.

- Hit Die: d10.
- Proficiencies: Foe Hunters gain no weapon or armor proficiencies.
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:

Base Attack Bonus: +7.
Feats: Favored Enemy, Trackless Step, Weapon Focus (any).

CLASS FEATURES:

Levels
1: Hated Enemy - The Foe Hunter gains all bonuses against their hated enemy.
  Rancor +1d6 - First attack of the round deals bonus damage to hated enemies. Bonus damage even works on enemies immune to criticals.
2: Hated Enemy Damage Reduction 3/- - Character gains damage reduction from all hated enemies.
3: Rancor +2d6
4: Hated Enemy Damage Reduction 5/-
  Hated Enemy Spell Resistance
5: Rancor +3d6
6: Hated Enemy Damage Reduction 7/-
7: Rancor +4d6
8: Hated Enemy Damage Reduction 9/-
9: Rancor +5d6
10: Death Attack - The Foe Hunter can make a death attack against a hated enemy that is denied its Dexterity bonus to AC.
  Hated Enemy Damage Reduction 11/-

NOTES:
Hated Enemy Damage Reduction - Could not properly implement damage reduction vs. a specific race due to game engine limitations. The player regenerates the HP instead of having it resisted.
Death Attack - The foe hunter can make a death attack against a hated enemy that is denied its Dexterity bonus to AC.

CLASS FEATURES:

Level
1: Army Power - Able to inspire allies within 30 feet, giving them +2 on saving throws, attacks rolls, ability checks (turning), skill checks and damages rolls. Allies must be able to hear you.

BONUS SPELLS

Each two levels in Battleguard of Tempus, the character gains new spells per day as if he had also gained a level in his highest caster class (druid, cleric). He does not learn any new spells through his abilities.

dst: 恶魔低沉的声音介入了这场争斗。"泽卡尔充满了我的力量，这力量在数百年间已与那把剑的力量交织在一起。即便是泽法德的后裔也无法与之抗衡。你所有那些徒劳的阻挠，只会确保当我重返你们位面时，你将第一个被杀死。说起来你还真帮了大忙，因为我早就想杀死这个风之子的后裔了。凡人的事情往往就是如此。无论他们策划出多么宏大的阴谋，最终都不过是在侍奉他们理所应当的主人——深渊的领主们。这个泽卡尔如此，你也将如此。看着这一切真是有趣极了。"
src: The booming voice of the demon intrudes upon the struggle. "Zekar is filled with my power, which has entwined itself with that of the sword over many centuries. Even this descendant of Zefad cannot prevail against it. All your feeble attempts to frustrate me have done is insure that you will be the first to be slain when I return to your plane. Quite helpful of you, actually, as I have long desired the death of this child of air. So often that is the way of things with mortals. Whatever grand schemes they hatch, in the end they simply end up serving their rightful masters, the lords of the Abyss. So it was with this Zekar, and so it will be with you. It is most amusing to watch."

dst: 扎拉拉觉得她在魔法和历史研究上花了太多时间，想要拓展一些不同的活动。具体来说，她认为自己的武器技能需要提高，想要一些武术训练。由于她无法离开庄园，她让我找一个合适的教练来庄园，并建议我去看看位于贵族区的卡拉达尔·科拉德的学校。科拉德只接受精选的学生，不会训练扎拉拉，但她的想法是，既然他的学生都相当厉害，可以雇佣其中一个。她让我向潜在的教练提供每节课250金币的报酬，外加500金币的预付款，并给了我一些金币来支付这笔预付款。我不需要花掉的部分可以自己留着。\n\n我找到了科拉德的一个学生，一个叫加拉德·阿沙勒的人，他表示有些愿意接受这份工作。然而，他对金钱报酬不太感兴趣，反而要求我为他完成一项任务。他让我去拜访他的兄弟，塔兰·阿沙勒，目前被关押在城市守卫队总部附近的地牢里。这个塔兰知道阿沙勒戒指的位置，这是加拉德想要的家庭传家宝，并愿意告诉他的兄弟它的位置。然而，加拉德决定不和他兄弟说话，因为他认为兄弟是家族的耻辱，所以他想让我代替他去和他说话，并做任何其他必要的事情来取回戒指。看来我必须这样做才能完成扎拉拉交给我的这个任务。
src: Zarala feels that she has been spending too much time in magical and historical research, and wants to branch out into some different activities. Specifically, she thinks her skill with weapons needs improvement and wants some martial training. Since she cannot leave the estate, she has asked me to locate an approrpriate instructor who could come there, and suggested I look at Khaladar Korad's school, located here in the Noble district. Korad only accepts select students, and would not train Zarala, but her thinking is that since even his students are quite formidable, one of them could be hired. She has told me to offer potential instructors an incentive of 250 gold per lesson, plus 500 up front, and given me some gold to pay this latter advance. I can keep whatever I don't need to spend.\n\nI have found one of Korad's students, one Garad Ashaler, who has expressed some willingness to take on this job. He is not much interested in monetary compensation, however, and has instead demanded that I perform a task for him instead. He has asked me to visit his brother, Taran Ashaler, who is currently detained in the City Watch's dungeons, near their headquarters. This Taran knows the location of the Ashaler Ring, an heirloom of the family that Garad wishes to have, and has offered to tell his brother its location. Garad, however, has resolved not to speak to his brother who he regards as a disgrace to the family, so he wants me to speak to him instead and do whatever else is necessary to recover the ring. It seems I must do this if I am to complete this assignment from Zarala.

dst: 在穿越卡林杉的旅途中，我发现了一支商队的残骸，它曾遭到不明袭击者的攻击。这些袭击者残忍地杀害了商队成员，似乎更热衷于单纯的破坏而非抢劫。在继续旅程之前，追踪并解决他们或许是个好主意。\n\n原来这次袭击是萨达拉什所为，他是一位暗影德鲁伊，信奉用暴力推进德鲁伊的目标。我会见了他，并试图避免战斗，因为我同情他的目标。萨达拉什要求我袭击我发现被毁商队所在道路南边的一座农场，杀死那里所有人，以此证明我对他事业的忠诚。他承诺如果我这样做，会给予我奖励。
src: While traveling through Calimshan, I came across the wreckage of a caravan that had been attacked by unknown raiders. These raiders had savagely killed the caravan members, and seemed more interested in simple destruction than in robbery. It might be a good idea to track them down and deal with them before continuing on my journey.\n\nIt turns out the attack was the work of Sadarash, a shadow druid who believes in using violence to advance the druidical agenda. I have met with him and tried to avoid fighting, as I sympathize with his goals. Sadarash has asked me to attack a farm to the south of the road on which I found the destroyed caravan and kill everyone there, thereby proving my commitment to his cause. He has promised to reward me if I do this.

Level: Cleric 3, Druid 2
Components: V, S,
Casting Time: 1 action
Range: Touch
Target: Living creature touched
Duration: 10 rounds + 1 round/level
Saving Throw: Will negates (harmless)

With a touch of your hand, you boost the subject's life energy, granting him or her the fast healing ability for the duration of the spell.  This healing applies only to damage sustained during the spell's duration, not to that from previous injuries.  The subject heals 2 hit points per round of such damage until the spell ends and is automatically stabilized if he or she begins dying from hit point loss during that time.

Regenerate moderate wounds does not restore hit points lost from starvation, thirst, or suffocation, nor does it allow a creature to regrow or attach lost body parts. The effects of multiple regenerate spells do not stack, only the highest-level effect applies.  Applying a second regenerate spell of equal level extends the first spell's duration by the full duration of the second spell.

src:
(PRESTIGE CLASS)
At first, it seems like a contradiction -- an arcane spellcaster that "loses herself" in a blind fury. Yet, the rage mage makes for an interesting case, since her approach to magic is based on the primal passion of magic more than the studious quasi-scientific approach.

A rage mage taps into the primal essence of magic, using her own natural anger and frenzy to channel the arcane power in flashy, flamboyant ways. Like the barbarian, the rage mage is often the product of a less civilized society. All rage mages must have at least some background as a barbarian (or some other class that grants a rage or frenzy ability), as well as training as a wizard, sorcerer, or -- very rarely -- a bard.

Rage mages are usually found working with barbarians. They tend to shy away from traditional spellcasters and avoid the colleges and guilds where such individuals usually gather.

- Hit Die: d8.
- Proficiencies: Rage mages gain no proficiency with any weapon or armor.
- Skill Points: 2+ Int Modifier.

REQUIREMENTS:
To qualify to become a rage mage, a character must fulfill all the following criteria.

Alignment: Any nonlawful.
Base Attack Bonus: +4.
Feat: Combat Casting.
Spells: Able to cast 2nd-level arcane spells.
Special: Rage or frenzy ability.

CLASS FEATURES:

Level
1: Spell Rage 1/day - When casting a spell from abjuration, conjuration, evocation, necromancy or transmutation school while in a rage, the rage mage uses her character level as her caster level. Temporarily takes -2 penalty to Armor Class. At the end of the rage, the character is fatigued.
2: Overcome Spell Failure - arcane spell failure reduced by 10% while wearing light or medium armor.
3: Rage +1 use/day - additional use of rage ability.
4: -
5: Spell Rage 2/day
    Angry Spell - +2 bonus to the save DC for spells form abjuration, conjuration, evocation, necromancy or transmutation school.
6: -
7: Spell Fury - sudden empower spell usable once during each rage.
8: Rage +1 use/day - additional use of rage ability.
9: Tireless Rage - no longer fatigued at the end of the rage.
10: Warrior Cry - the character receives benefits of the Tenser's Transformation spell, but without losing her spellcasting ability, 1/day.
    Spell Rage 3/day

BONUS SPELLS

Every other level in Rage Mage, the character gains new spells per day as if they had also gained a level in their highest Arcane spellcasting class. No new spells are learned through this ability, however.

这本书既试图记录为善良阵营神祇和崇高事业而使用军事力量的历史，也试图反驳那些声称这种使用本质上自相矛盾或至少作为一般规则不可取的人。作者认为，邪恶仆从的暴力活动必将要求善良一方出于自卫而做出回应，而且如果我们接受战争可以为国家存亡——在作者看来是相对微不足道的事情——而合理化，那么当它被用于侍奉神祇或推进恩赐这样神圣而崇高的目标时，无疑就更加合理了。自然，有许多人对圣战的想法感到不安，因此出现了许多官方和非官方的压制此书的尝试。结果，此书的副本很难获得。愿意以近乎狂热的热情投身于并为之战斗的冒险者可能会发现这本书是一本有用的指南。\n\n注意：使用这本书将给予玩家一些经验值，其数量与玩家的等级成反比。这本特定的书将主要惠及以对神祇或事业极度虔诚为特征的职业：牧师、武僧、圣武士、托姆勇士和矮人防御者，其他职业只能获得少量经验值。
src: This book seeks both to record the history of the use of military force in the service of good-aligned deities and noble causes, and refute those who claim that such use is inherently self-contradictory or at least undesirable as a general rule. The author argues that the violent activities of servants of evil will inevitably require those of good to respond in self-defense, and that if we accept that war can be justified for the survival of nations, in the author's view a comparatively trivial matter, surely it is even more justified when employed for causes as holy and noble as service to a deity or the advancement of virtue. Naturally there are many who are uncomfortable with the idea of holy wars and as a result there have been a number of attempts, both official and unofficial, to suppress this work. Copies of it are hard to come by as a result. Adventurers with a willingness to devote themselves to, and fight for, a cause greater than themselves with something approaching fanaticism may find this book a helpful guide.\n\nNote: Using this book will provide some experience to the player, the amount being inversely proportional to his level. This particular book will primarily benefit classes characterised by intense devotion to a deity or cause: clerics, monks, paladins, Champions of Torm, and Dwarven Defenders, with other classes receiving only a slight XP gain.

哈马德正在准备对变形蛛的总部发动袭击，既然我们已经掌握了其位置的情报。然而，他还有另一个任务要我在期间完成。他的老朋友卡洛玛斯·泽卡尔，因在反对奴隶贸易应采用何种方法上的分歧而与他闹翻，最近因我拜访了他的庄园而受到启发，联系了哈马德并试图和解。哈马德已被说服在一件与卡洛玛斯有关的事情上提供帮助。卡洛玛斯一直在卡林沙漠中维持一个营地，据我所知，他正在帮助一些人离开卡林杉（我没有被告知这些人究竟是谁，并被警告不要过多询问他们的情况）。这个营地在夜间遭到暗中袭击，其中一些人被掳走，天命不明。哈马德派我和他雇用的其他一些冒险者前往那里调查此事。\n\n结果发现，营地遭到了与龙教有关的吸血鬼的袭击。我们追踪吸血鬼到了他们的基地，杀死了他们，并赶走了他们合作的那条龙类。此事已报告给哈马德，他因我解决了此事而奖励了我。
src: Hamad is preparing an assault upon the headquarters of the aranea, now that we have information on its location. However, he has another quest for me to complete in the meantime. His old friend Kalomas Zekar, with whom he had a fallin out over their disagreements about what methods should be employed in opposing the slave trade, has been inspired by my recent visit to his estate to contact Hamad and attempt a reconciliation. Hamad has been persuaded to lend assistance in a matter with which Kalomas is involved. Kalomas has been maintaining a camp in the Calim Desert for people who I am told he is assiting in leaving Calimshan (I have not been told just who these people are, and been warned against asking too many questions about them). This camp has been stealthily attacked during the night and some of the people in it carried off to some unknown fate. Hamad is sending me, and some of the other adventurers in his employ there to investigate the matter. \n\nIt turned out the camp was being attacked by vampires associated with the Cult of the Dragon. We tracked the vampires to their base and slew them, and drove off the dragon they were working with. This has been reported to Hamad, who rewarded me for resolving this matter.
